text.title: 血帆的阴谋
text.objectives: 去向藏宝海湾的大副克拉兹报告你的发现。
text.description: 这是一张藏宝海湾的地图，上面用红叉所标的地方就是你现在站的位置。$b$b图上潦草的写着几行字：$b$b“你们的任务就是悄悄地在此地扎营，等待舰队指挥官发出信号后再开始攻击。”$b$b“我指派布鲁斯中尉负责。这一次不同以往。我们定将一举拿下藏宝海湾。”$b$b地图上还扎着一把匕首，位置正好是藏宝海湾。
text.completion: 当然，我正等你呢，$C。让我看看你的发现……$B$B
text.completed: 去找荆棘谷海角藏宝海湾的大副克拉兹。

english.title: Bloodsail Treachery
english.objectives: Report your findings to First Mate Crazz in Booty Bay.
english.description: The map shows Booty Bay with a red "X" drawn precisely at the spot at which you are standing.$b$bThe scribbled text reads:$b$b"Set up your command post here, and bide your time.  The Fleet Master will send out word when it's time to make your move."$b$b"I'm placing Lieutenant Bruce in charge here.  This time will be different.  This time we take Booty Bay once and for all."$b$bThe map is held in place with a dagger, placed right through the location of Booty Bay.
english.completion: Sure, I remember you, $c.  Back from scouting I see....
english.completed: Report to First Mate Crazz at Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

text.title: 必须警告大财主
text.objectives: 向大财主里维加兹报告血帆的进攻计划。
text.description: 真见鬼！那么说血帆海盗在计划攻打藏宝海湾？天哪，那些杂种可够胆。藏宝海湾永远是黑水强盗的！$b$b这事比我想的要严重。马上去向大财主里维加兹报告你的发现！他就在藏宝海湾。
text.completion: Bloodsail Buccaneers attacking Booty Bay?  This isn't the first time that those blaggards have tried something.  Booty Bay is impenetrable! Sounds like they might be changing their strategies up, though.  Wouldn't put it past Firallon to try something crazy.  Very well, let's see what else they're up to.
text.completed: 去找荆棘谷海角藏宝海湾的大财主里维加兹。

english.title: The Baron Must Be Told
english.objectives: Report the planned Bloodsail attack to Baron Revilgaz.
english.description: Shiver me timbers!  So the Bloodsail Buccaneers are planning some sort of attack on Booty Bay?  Why, the nerve of those scoundrels.  Booty Bay will always be run by the Blackwater Raiders!$b$bThis is bigger than I thought.  Report what you have learned to Baron Revilgaz at once!  You'll find him here in Booty Bay.
english.completion: Bloodsail Buccaneers attacking Booty Bay?  This isn't the first time that those blaggards have tried something.  Booty Bay is impenetrable! Sounds like they might be changing their strategies up, though.  Wouldn't put it past Firallon to try something crazy.  Very well, let's see what else they're up to.
english.completed: Report to Baron Revilgaz at Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

text.title: 进攻的细节
text.objectives: 消灭8名血帆水手和8名血帆大法师，把血帆海图和血帆的命令带回来。
text.description: 我想知道细节，$n。我们对血帆的优势大部分取决于我们在藏宝海湾的要塞，但情报也扮演着一个关键的角色。$b$b血帆在那边建了一些寒酸的营地，就号称是“南部指挥所”了。好吧，你得去他们那个可怜的南部指挥所里清剿一番，搜查他们的计划，干掉他们的人。不管找到什么情报都回来告诉我。
text.progress: 啊哈，$N。你从南边的血帆营地那里带回什麽消息啦?
text.completion: 干得漂亮，$N。现在我们已经了解他们的计画了，粉碎这计画应该也只是时间问题。$B$B既然这帮蠢货就停泊在海岬附近……$B$B
text.completed: Return to Baron Revilgaz at Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

english.title: Details of the Attack
english.objectives: Kill 8 Bloodsail Sea Dogs and 8 Bloodsail Elder Magi, and bring back the Bloodsail Charts and the Bloodsail Orders.
english.description: I want to know details, $n.  Our supremacy over the Bloodsail is due largely in part to our stronghold here in Booty Bay, but intelligence also plays a critical role.$b$bThe Bloodsail maintain a few meager camps to the south which they call their "Southern Command."  Well, you're going to raid their excuse for a southern command, find their plans, and slaughter their men.  Return with whatever information you can find.
english.progress: Ahoy, $n.  What word do you bring of the Bloodsail encampment to the south?
english.completion: Perfect, $n.  Now that we know their plan, it's just a matter of time. And to think the fools have dropped anchor just off the cape....
english.completed: Return to Baron Revilgaz at Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

text.title: 事关鼻烟
text.objectives: 藏宝海湾的迪格要你给他带15撮鼻烟。
text.description: 啊，海洋生活。我不能说这生活过得很美，但这是我的生活。$b$b我进港时总喜欢找瓶上头的老酒，来点上等的鼻烟。不是什么好习惯，但没有这些还算哪门子海盗啊，是吧？$b$b所以你能想象，当我知道镇子的里草药师博变卖家当离开了的时候，有多难过。说是他的货都叫血帆袭击者给劫了。$b$b我敢说像你这样无畏的$c能说服他们拿点出来分享，啊？
text.progress: 运气如何?找到那些东西了吗，夥计?
text.completion: 好极了，$N!正好我马上就要出海了!真是不知道该对你说些什麽好，哥们。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Deeg at Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

english.title: Up to Snuff
english.objectives: Deeg in Booty Bay wants you to bring him 15 tiny heaps of Snuff.
english.description: Ah, the sea life.  I ain't gonna say it's the good life, but it's my life.$b$bWhen I get into port I like to find me a good bottle of grog and some high quality snuff.  Nasty habits but what's a pirate without his vices, right?$b$bSo you can imagine how heartbroken I was to find out the herbalist here in town has gone and sold out of the stuff.  Says his shipment got hijacked by those damned Bloodsail Raiders.$b$bI bet a fearless $c like you could convince 'em to share the goods, eh?
english.progress: Any luck finding the goods, matey?
english.completion: Good show, $n!  And just before I need to ship out too!  Can't thank you enough, old friend.
english.completed: Return to Deeg at Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

text.title: 找眼睛
text.objectives: 从血帆海盗处夺回迪兹的眼睛。
text.description: 呔！谁在那儿？$b$b啊，没了我那只特别附魔的眼睛，我啥也不是。在战斗中瞎了双眼就够糟的了！不过好在我们停靠的米奈希尔港里有个流浪法师帮我弄了一只特制的魔法玻璃眼，能让我重见天日。$b$b昨晚我出门的时候跟几个血帆海盗撞了个满怀。我的眼睛，就这么被抢走啦！好像这些家伙有办法溜到藏宝海湾里来。$b$b帮帮这老水手，把我的眼睛找回来呗？
text.progress: 喂，哥们!虽然我看不见，但你这个小子一进港口我就闻出你的味道来啦。$B$B我的眼睛还能找回来吗?船长知道我的眼睛落在那帮肮脏的血帆海盗手里以後大骂了我一顿。$B$B对我这样的了望员来说，没眼睛的日子可真是太悲惨了!我现在都已经习惯了住在了望台上……要是以後我再也看不见了，非得被发配去洗船舱不可。
text.completion: 太令我吃惊了，太令我吃惊了!你找到我那美丽的眼睛了!让我看看她还合适不合适。$B$B哈哈!我又能看见东西啦!!$B$B
text.completed: Return to Dizzy One-Eye at Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

english.title: Keep An Eye Out
english.objectives: Retrieve Dizzy's Eye from the Bloodsail Buccaneers.
english.description: Avast!  Who goes there?$b$bArgh, I am but useless without me special enchanted eye.  Bad enough to have lost me eyes in battle in the first place!  But by some stroke o' luck we docked in Menethil and a traveling wizard enchanted a special glass eye that let me see again.$b$bLast night I ended up gettin' jumped by some Bloodsail Buccaneers on me way out.  Took me eye, they did!  Seems those blokes have found their way to Booty Bay.$b$bHelp an old sea dog out by gettin' me eye back?
english.progress: Ahoy, me bucko!  Might not be able to see but I can smell ye from halfway across port. Could really use me eye back.  Captain's going to keelhaul me when he finds out me peeper is in the hands of them dirty Bloodsail Buccaneers. What good is a lookout who can't see?  The crow's nest used to be me home...without me deadlights I'd be lucky to scrub the bilge.
english.completion: Shiver me timbers and timber me shivers!  Ye found me beautiful eye!  Let's see if she still fits. $n ho!  Blimey, I can see!!
english.completed: Return to Dizzy One-Eye at Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

text.title: 战争不会结束
text.objectives: 乘坐基沙恩的小船前往赤脊山的止水湖营地。
text.description: 这些黑石兽人会召集一支部队来对付B连和你，$n。如果你准备出发了，就来止水湖的码头和我们会合，我们会坐船到止水湖另一侧的止水湖营地去。$B$B码头见，$n。
text.completion: It's orc killin' time.
text.end: 乘坐基沙恩的小船抵达目的地。
text.completed: 与赤脊山止水湖营地的约翰·J·基沙恩谈一谈。

english.title: It's Never Over
english.objectives: Take Keeshan's Riverboat to Camp Everstill in Redridge.
english.description: Those Blackrock orcs are gonna need an army to handle the Bravo Company and you, $n. When you're ready to go, meet us at the dock facing Lake Everstill and we'll set off on my riverboat for Camp Everstill on the other side of the lake.$B$BSee you there, $n.
english.completion: It's orc killin' time.
english.completed: Speak with John J. Keeshan at Camp Everstill in Redridge.

text.title: 一名老水手
text.objectives: 把饱经风霜的硬币带给藏宝海湾的舰队指挥官海角。
text.description: 这枚饱经风霜的硬币是在“好孩子”布鲁斯的尸体上找到的。正面刻着一条从没见过的巨大海盗船；背面则刻着“急浪船会”。$b$b海盗经验丰富的人可能会明白这硬币是什么，或者代表了什么。
text.progress: What's that you've got there, $r?  Let me see it.
text.completion: That coin!  Where did you get it? Bruce... yes, I see.  He was one of the Blackwater Raiders once.  One of us, before Greymane closed the Gilneas ports and held his crew captive. I know that what happened in Gilneas changed the people there, but I never expected them to change their loyalties.  Especially not Bruce. If you wouldn't mind, could I keep the coin?  I'll pay its worth in gold.
text.completed: Report to Fleet Master Seahorn at Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

english.title: An Old Sea Dog
english.objectives: Bring the Weather-Beaten Coin to Fleet Master Seahorn in Booty Bay.
english.description: This old, weathered coin was found on the body of the pirate "Good-Boy" Bruce.  Its front side bears the image of a large, unfamiliar pirate ship; on its back side, the term "Brashtide Crew".$b$bSomeone who has been in the piracy business for some time might know what this coin is, or what it means.
english.progress: What's that you've got there, $r?  Let me see it.
english.completion: That coin!  Where did you get it? Bruce... yes, I see.  He was one of the Blackwater Raiders once.  One of us, before Greymane closed the Gilneas ports and held his crew captive. I know that what happened in Gilneas changed the people there, but I never expected them to change their loyalties.  Especially not Bruce. If you wouldn't mind, could I keep the coin?  I'll pay its worth in gold.
english.completed: Report to Fleet Master Seahorn at Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
english.turninWindow: Bruce, before the sickness took hold.

text.title: 恶狼成群
text.objectives: 杀死12头恐狼。
text.description: 对镇民来说，恐狼是最为普遍的威胁。它们潜伏在森林四周，大部分都在河的北岸。它们可不是你在艾尔文森林，或者你老家见到的那种癞皮狗。它们跟人一样大，凶猛异常。$B$B如果你愿意帮助夜色镇的人，就去捕杀恐狼，好让我们的街道安全一些。
text.completion: Don't go thinking that was too easy. Far greater dangers lurk deeper in the woods.
text.completed: Return to Commander Althea Ebonlocke at Darkshire in Duskwood.

english.title: Wolves at Our Heels
english.objectives: Kill 12 Dire Wolves.
english.description: The dire wolves are the most common threat to the townsfolk here. They lurk in the forests on all sides of us, though most are along the north bank of the river.$B$BThese aren't the runt dogs you see in Elwynn, or wherever you come from. They're big as a man and twice as vicious.$B$BIf you wish to assist the people of Darkshire, hunt the dire wolves so our streets can be safer.
english.completion: Don't go thinking that was too easy. Far greater dangers lurk deeper in the woods.
english.completed: Return to Commander Althea Ebonlocke at Darkshire in Duskwood.

starters.name: 指挥官阿尔泰娅·埃伯洛克

enders.name: 指挥官阿尔泰娅·埃伯洛克

text.title: 你说你想要一场革命
text.objectives: 溜过前线，去和龙喉哨站的扎伊拉谈谈。
text.description: 要是你所言不虚，$n，那我们在龙喉氏族里就有朋友了。我们可以巧施离间，可免双方血光之灾。$B$B我能帮上忙，但最危险的一步还是得看你。$B$B我的斧咬战士会对海岸发动一次进攻。对方摸不着头脑的时候，你就溜到后方，去同扎伊拉接头洽谈革命事宜。$B$B我们要武装龙喉，推翻他们的恶魔主子！
text.completion: $n, what are your people doing? Are you attacking the Dragonmaw or are you here to rid us of Mor'ghor's corruption? Ah, I see now. I like the way you think. Warchief Mor'ghor won't even know what hit him. Let's do this!
text.completed: 溜过前线，去和龙喉哨站的扎伊拉谈谈。

english.title: You Say You Want a Revolution
english.objectives: Slip through the front lines at Dragonmaw Port and speak with Zaela.
english.description: If what you say is true, $n, then we have friends within the Dragonmaw Clan. We can support an insurgency from within their ranks and avoid a lot of bloodshed on both sides.$B$BI can help, but the most dangerous part is up to you.$B$BMy Axebite Warriors will launch an offensive on the shores. During the confusion, I need you to slip behind the lines and speak with your revolutionary contact, Zaela.$B$BWe'll arm the Dragonmaw and overthrow their fel masters!
english.completion: $n, what are your people doing? Are you attacking the Dragonmaw or are you here to rid us of Mor'ghor's corruption? Ah, I see now. I like the way you think. Warchief Mor'ghor won't even know what hit him. Let's do this!
english.completed: Slip through the front lines at Dragonmaw Port and speak with Zaela.

text.title: 干烤狼肉串
text.objectives: 从恐狼身上获得5块狼肉硬肋排。
text.description: 干烤狼肉串是全家人的最爱！当然，我可以给你做一些。但首先我需要素材。$B$B给我带五块狼肉硬肋排来。在镇子北边的河边就有恐狼可以捕杀，不过如果我是你，就不会走到林子深处去。
text.progress: Were you able to find five wolf skirt steaks yet?
text.completion: Mmm-mmm! The skirtsteak's the best part. It's not an efficient way to cook, though. Here, have this recipe. It's a little different, but flank meat's easier to come by when you really need a meal.
text.completed: Return to Chef Grual at Darkshire in Duskwood.

english.title: Seasoned Wolf Kabobs
english.objectives: Gather 5 Wolf Skirt Steaks from Dire Wolves.
english.description: Seasoned wolf kabobs are a house favorite!  Sure, I can make you some.  But first I'll need the supplies.$B$BBring me five wolf skirt steaks.  The dire wolves near the river north of town are good to hunt; I wouldn't stray too far into the woods if I were you.
english.progress: Were you able to find five wolf skirt steaks yet?
english.completion: Mmm-mmm! The skirtsteak's the best part. It's not an efficient way to cook, though. Here, have this recipe. It's a little different, but flank meat's easier to come by when you really need a meal.
english.completed: Return to Chef Grual at Darkshire in Duskwood.

text.title: 起义
text.objectives: 武装3名龙喉工人或商人，然后消灭10名龙喉执行者和4名龙喉术士。
text.description: 部落提供给我们的武器远远足够了。我们四个应该分头行动，尽可能地武装龙喉工人和商贩。$B$B别小瞧了我们，$n。你会发现那怕是贩夫走卒也有匹夫之勇。$B$B尽量多造成一些伤害，把龙喉分队武装起来，让长久以来压迫人民的邪能执行者和术士见鬼去。咱们在这里碰头，发动最后的一击！
text.completion: We've lost a lot of good orcs, but the fight is going our way, $n. Mor'ghor's regime is collapsing. All that remains is to destroy the beast himself.
text.completed: Return to Zaela at Dragonmaw Port in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Insurrection
english.objectives: Arm 3 Dragonmaw Workers or Merchants, then slay 10 Dragonmaw Enforcers and 4 Dragonmaw Warlocks.
english.description: The weapons the Horde has supplied us with will be more than enough. The four of us should split up and arm as many Dragonmaw workers and merchants as we can.$B$BDon't underestimate us, $n. You'll find even our tradesmen are ferocious in battle.$B$BLet's do as much damage as possible. Arm a squad of Dragonmaw and lay waste to the fel enforcers and warlocks that have intimidated my people for so long. Then meet back here to launch our final strike!
english.completion: We've lost a lot of good orcs, but the fight is going our way, $n. Mor'ghor's regime is collapsing. All that remains is to destroy the beast himself.
english.completed: Return to Zaela at Dragonmaw Port in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 莫格霍尔之死
text.objectives: 杀死龙喉哨站的莫格霍尔酋长。你也可以征召龙喉商人和工人来帮助你。
text.description: 时候到了。莫格霍尔今天必死无疑。$B$B要当心，$c。恶魔之血在他扭曲的血管里流淌，令他能召唤非自然之力。是的，他会被消灭。但这将是一场苦战。$B$B你该记得莫格霍尔的所在，就在营地的高处。我们那里再相见。干掉他！$B$B要是你需要，可以征召3名龙喉追随者——你会需要的。
text.completion: Well done, $n! You have done the Horde proud in my absence. The Dragonmaw have joined us, with Zaela as their new leader. Blood was shed, but casualties were low, and we have their complete loyalty. Our Horde grows stronger!
text.completed: Speak with Garrosh Hellscream at Dragonmaw Port in Twilight Highlands.
text.giverWindow: 莫格霍尔逃得过外域，但逃不过今天了。

english.title: Death to Mor'ghor
english.objectives: Slay Warchief Mor'ghor in Dragonmaw Port. You can still recruit Dragonmaw Merchants and Workers to help you.
english.description: The time has come. Mor'ghor dies today.$B$BBe warned, $c. Demon blood courses through his wretched veins, and he channels unnatural power. He will be destroyed, yes. But it will not be an easy fight.$B$BYou remember where Mor'ghor resides, at the top of the camp. I will meet you there. Finish him!$B$BBe sure to recruit 3 Dragonmaw followers if you are short - you will need our help.
english.completion: Well done, $n! You have done the Horde proud in my absence. The Dragonmaw have joined us, with Zaela as their new leader. Blood was shed, but casualties were low, and we have their complete loyalty. Our Horde grows stronger!
english.completed: Speak with Garrosh Hellscream at Dragonmaw Port in Twilight Highlands.
english.giverWindow: Mor'ghor survived Outland. But he won't survive this.

text.title: 黑蟹蛋糕
text.objectives: 从结网毒蜘蛛身上割下6块暗色肉块。
text.description: 我可以告诉你一个秘密——黑“蟹”蛋糕实际上是用蜘蛛肉做的！听起来是有点恶心，不过这种蛋糕的味道绝对一流！$B$B但如果你想尝尝的话，恐怕我这儿没肉了。我需要一些肉块才能把蛋糕做出来。$B$B材料可以从结网毒蜘蛛身上拿——它们的巢就在北边，河流和山脚中间的地方。
text.progress: Hail, $n.  Did you get that lump meat for me?
text.completion: Ah yes, a nice lump you have there!  Let me just get this seasoned with my secret spices (no looking!) and get them to skittering on a skillet for a while... And, although Dusky Crab Cakes are my specialty and I won't give out the recipe, here's the recipe for a dish that's almost as good.
text.completed: Return to Chef Grual at Darkshire in Duskwood.

english.title: Dusky Crab Cakes
english.objectives: Gather 6 Dusky Lumps from Venom Web Spiders.
english.description: I'll let you in on a little secret - Dusky "Crab" Cakes are really made from spider meat!  I know it's a bit disgusting, but the cakes have a nice, tangy flavor and make great snacks!$B$BIf you want to try some still, I'm afraid I'm out of meat. I need some lump meat to whip up a few more cakes.$B$BVenom Web Spiders are a good source - they nest to the north, between the foothills and the river.
english.progress: Hail, $n.  Did you get that lump meat for me?
english.completion: Ah yes, a nice lump you have there!  Let me just get this seasoned with my secret spices (no looking!) and get them to skittering on a skillet for a while... And, although Dusky Crab Cakes are my specialty and I won't give out the recipe, here's the recipe for a dish that's almost as good.
english.completed: Return to Chef Grual at Darkshire in Duskwood.

text.title: 同血帆打交道
text.objectives: 去找藏宝海湾北部瀑布的扬希·格里尔森。
text.description: 这些计划可……真有意思。菲尔拉伦，你可不是这种笨蛋！$b$b瞧，他有三艘船全权负责炮火，从通道里攻进来的人也不多。光靠三艘船和几个步卒是没法儿拿下藏宝海湾的。这他也知道。$b$b不，他们还有别的打算……你得把它查清楚。去和镇子北边的血帆征兵员扬希·格里尔森谈谈。$b$b没错，$n。你最好希望他们别认出你来。
text.completion: Yarr, ya made a good decision, lad.
text.completed: 去找藏宝海湾北部瀑布的扬希·格里尔森。

english.title: Getting In With the Bloodsail
english.objectives: Report to Yancey Grillsen at the waterfall north of Booty Bay.
english.description: These plans are... interesting.  Firallon, you're smarter than this!$b$bLook, he has all three ships devoted to cannon fire, and only a few men coming in through the tunnel.  He can never take Booty Bay with three ships and a dozen footmen.  And he knows that.$b$bNo, they've got something else planned... and you're going to find out what it is.  Speak to Yancey Grillsen, the Bloodsail Recruiter, just to the north of town.$b$bThat's right, $n.  You'd better hope that they don't recognize your face.
english.completion: Yarr, ya made a good decision, lad.
english.completed: Report to Yancey Grillsen at the waterfall north of Booty Bay.

text.title: 颤地者特罗格佐尔
text.objectives: 获得颤地者的木棍。
text.description: 你得马上把这事给解决掉！$B$B回到西北方的前线，杀掉他们的将军颤地者特罗格佐尔。把他的棒子给我带来作为证据。
text.progress: Is he dead? Do you have the cudgel?
text.completion: Finally, we can move forward and rescue the Stonefather.
text.completed: Return to Gravel Longslab on the Fractured Front in Deepholm.
text.giverWindow: 在他毁掉这一地区之前阻止他！

english.title: Troggzor the Earthinator
english.objectives: Obtain the Earthinator's Cudgel.
english.description: You have to put an end to this now!$B$BGo back northwest onto the front and kill their battle leader, Troggzor the Earthinator. Bring me his cudgel as proof.
english.progress: Is he dead? Do you have the cudgel?
english.completion: Finally, we can move forward and rescue the Stonefather.
english.completed: Return to Gravel Longslab on the Fractured Front in Deepholm.
english.giverWindow: Stop him before he earthinates the countryside!

text.title: We Have a Situation
text.objectives: Speak with Clay Mudaxle on the Fractured Front in Deepholm.
text.description: One of Clay's catapult teams is broken down on the front. I need you to get some parts from him and get that catapult back in the fight, $n.

english.title: We Have a Situation
english.objectives: Speak with Clay Mudaxle on the Fractured Front in Deepholm.
english.description: One of Clay's catapult teams is broken down on the front. I need you to get some parts from him and get that catapult back in the fight, $n.

text.title: 隐士
text.objectives: 找到乞丐鬼屋高塔里的居民。
text.description: 我听说在乞丐鬼屋那儿有活动迹象。人们报告说在镇子东边的高塔里看见过灯光。$B$B很少有人有胆量靠近逆风小径。自从我得知这个消息以来，你是第一个来报告的，去查看一下，确保住在里面的是人类。
text.completion: Ah, welcome, stranger. I'd offer you something, but there's not much here... Could I beg you to run some errands for a poor old hermit?

english.title: The Hermit
english.objectives: Find the denizen of the tower at Beggar's Haunt.
english.description: I've been told there's signs of activity at Beggar's Haunt. People have reported seeing lights in the tower to the east of town.$B$BFew would be bold enough to stay that close to Deadwind Pass. You're the first to report since I've learned about this; go check it out and make sure whatever's in there is human.
english.completion: Ah, welcome, stranger. I'd offer you something, but there's not much here... Could I beg you to run some errands for a poor old hermit?

starters.name: 指挥官阿尔泰娅·埃伯洛克

text.title: 水下伏兵
text.objectives: 保卫沙克斯·奥布里的安全。
text.description: 太糟了。看来刺脊正在酝酿一次进攻。$b$b纳迦素以战斗无情而著称。除非我们都死了，否则他们是不会停止进攻的。$b$b并不是我把自己的性命看得要比船员重，但你一定要保护我。没有我的航海知识，船员们是没法儿活着回到藏宝海湾的。$b$b纳迦们会从海上打过来。我要你和我留在这上面阻挡进攻。坐上炮位把他们打回去。$b$b你准备好了吗，$n？
text.completion: 我们打退了纳迦的进攻!$B$B如果不是你出手帮助，我们是不可能成功的，$N。$B$B等涨潮的时候，我们就马上离开。原本我想让你加入我们的，但是你的英雄之旅才刚刚开始，我可不想妨碍你。$B$B即便你现在只是个微不足道的$R，将来你也必定大有作为!$B$B
text.end: 保卫沙克斯·奥布里
text.completed: 去阿拉希高地，找法迪尔海湾的沙克斯·奥布里。

english.title: Death From Below
english.objectives: Protect Shakes O'Breen during the attack.
english.description: This is bad. It seems the Daggerspines are amassing for an attack.$b$bNaga are known for their ruthlessness in battle. They will keep attacking until I am dead.$b$bI don't value my own life above that of my crew members, but you must help to defend me. The crew will not be able to make it back to Booty Bay without my knowledge of the seas.$b$bThe naga will be coming from the sea. I need you to remain up here with me to fend off the attack. Man the cannon and drive them back.$b$bAre you ready, $n?
english.completion: We survived the attack! We could not have done it without you, $n. We'll be heading out as soon as the tide rises. If you weren't such a promising hero I'd offer you a place on my crew. But I can tell you have bigger fish to fry. Even if you are a puny $r....
english.completed: Return to Shakes O'Breen at Faldir's Cove in Arathi Highlands.

text.title: 看你忠于谁了
text.objectives: 获得藏宝海湾舰队指挥官海角的牛头。
text.description: 有桩事情……$b$b扬希听到了一些东西。我有几个耳目，他们几杯酒下肚之后告诉了我一个故事，说是有个$r$c把南部指挥所搜了个遍，就为了找海图和命令书，顺带还干掉了几个强力的海盗。$b$b虽然就像我说的，他们当时已经喝高了，不过呢……海盗总归要宁可信其有不可信其无。所以我要交给你一件小差事，从菲尔拉伦那儿直接下达的……把舰队指挥官海角的牛头给我带来。
text.progress: Firallon special-ordered this one himself.  Said the tauren's too much of a risk.
text.completion: Well blow me down!  Now there's something ya don't see too often. Welcome aboard, $n.  Plunder and booty await ye.
text.completed: Return to Yancey Grillsen in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

english.title: Seeing Where Your Loyalties Lie
english.objectives: Obtain the Head of Fleet Master Seahorn in Booty Bay.
english.description: Thar be just one thing...$b$bYancey hears things.  A few o' me hearties were pretty deep in their cups when they told me about some $r $c that came a-rollin' through the Southern Command lookin' for charts and orders.  Even ran a couple o' good pirates through, $g he: she; did.$b$bLike I said, they were up to their eyeballs in grog, but still... a buccaneer's gotta trust his ears.  So I've just got one small task for ye, one sent down from Firallon hisself...$b$bBring me the head of Fleet Master Seahorn.
english.progress: Firallon special-ordered this one himself.  Said the tauren's too much of a risk.
english.completion: Well blow me down!  Now there's something ya don't see too often. Welcome aboard, $n.  Plunder and booty await ye.
english.completed: Return to Yancey Grillsen in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

text.title: 我觉得挺像个牛头人海盗
text.objectives: 获得一只牛头和一顶特大号的海盗帽，然后把它们带给舰队指挥官海角。
text.description: 菲尔拉伦想要我的角？这下有意思了。不过我们倒也不是没办法。$b$b这个叫扬希的多半不是很熟悉我。大多数外族人都觉得我们牛头人长一个模样。事实上……大多数外族人都觉得我们牛头人长得……和某种四条腿的农畜一个模样。$b$b藏宝海湾的制皮工利克奎兹就养着一头，而我的海盗帽子都是在纳尔克那里私人定做的。去把牛头的替代品和帽子准备好，然后送过去。
text.progress: You should know that most tauren would find this shameful.  I find it... amusing.
text.completion: That should fool that Bloodsail dimwit. This was fun, $n.
text.completed: Return to Fleet Master Seahorn at Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
text.turninWindow: 安息吧，甜心女王。您的牺牲我们不会忘记。

english.title: Looks Like a Tauren Pirate to Me
english.objectives: Obtain a Cow Head and an Oversized Pirate Hat, then bring them back to Fleet Master Seahorn.
english.description: Firallon wants MY head?  Now that's interesting.  But it's nothing we can't work around.$b$bThis Yancey character probably doesn't know my face too well.  Most non-tauren find us tauren indistinguishable from one another.  In fact... most non-tauren find us indistinguishable from... a certain four-legged farm creature.$b$bRikqiz the leatherworker keeps one of these creatures here in Booty Bay, and Narkk is my chief supplier for pirate hats.  Get a replacement head and a hat, then return with both.
english.progress: You should know that most tauren would find this shameful.  I find it... amusing.
english.completion: That should fool that Bloodsail dimwit. This was fun, $n.
english.completed: Return to Fleet Master Seahorn at Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
english.turninWindow: Good night, sweet queen.  Your sacrifice will not be forgotten.

objectiveDetails.description: 将两样东西交给舰队指挥官海角

text.title: 海盗生涯的第一天
text.objectives: 把你的文书交给尼哈鲁船长。
text.description: 你或许是杀掉了舰队指挥官，但规矩就是规矩，命令就是命令。我的命令说，所有的新海盗都要从水兵干起。这就是规矩。$b$b你要去服侍尼哈鲁船长，斩浪号的指挥官。船是舰队最西边的那艘，就停在海角南边。$b$b去船长室找他，带好你的文书。
text.progress: I trust y'got yer papers, swabbie.  I'd hate t'send ye all the way back to Yancey.
text.completion: Yes... yes... I see... well, everything appears to be in order. Slayer of the great Seahorn, eh?  That doesn't matter on MY ship.  Only thing you're gonna be slaying is deck stains.  Grab a mop.
text.completed: Report to Captain Keelhaul within the Riptide in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

english.title: Your First Day as a Pirate
english.objectives: Bring Yer Papers to Captain Keelhaul.
english.description: Ye may be a slayer of Fleet Masters, but rules is rules and orders is orders.  And MY orders say that all new pirates start out as swabbies.  It's the rule.$b$bYou're to be working for Captain Keelhaul, the commander of the Riptide.  It's the westernmost ship in the fleet, which is parked south of the tip o' the cape.$b$bFind him in his captain's chambers, and bring yer papers.
english.progress: I trust y'got yer papers, swabbie.  I'd hate t'send ye all the way back to Yancey.
english.completion: Yes... yes... I see... well, everything appears to be in order. Slayer of the great Seahorn, eh?  That doesn't matter on MY ship.  Only thing you're gonna be slaying is deck stains.  Grab a mop.
english.completed: Report to Captain Keelhaul within the Riptide in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

text.title: 贴身保护
text.objectives: 护送土灵投石车安全抵达针石熔渣场。
text.description: 好了，我想我把它修好了。你得让投石车前往石头穴居人的城镇，针石熔渣场，就在前线北方。$B$B司机会和你一起去的，我要回去向将军汇报。$B$B毫无疑问石头穴居人会在路上劫你们。你要保证他们别动投石车。它可是我们的大杀器。$B$B等你准备好了就让我知道，$n。
text.completion: Word of your prowess has spread ahead of you, $r. Let's see if you can help us keep these fungal horrors off of the front.
text.completed: Speak with Pyrium Lodestone at Needlerock Slag in Deepholm.

english.title: Close Escort
english.objectives: Escort the Earthen Catapult safely to Needlerock Slag.
english.description: Alright, I think I've got it working again. You've got to get the catapult to the stone trogg town, Needlerock Slag, just to the north of the front.$B$BThe driver will go with you. I'll head back and let Gravel know.$B$BThere's no doubt that the stone troggs will try to stop you. You just keep them off of the catapult. It packs a big punch.$B$BLet me know when you're ready, $n.
english.completion: Word of your prowess has spread ahead of you, $r. Let's see if you can help us keep these fungal horrors off of the front.
english.completed: Speak with Pyrium Lodestone at Needlerock Slag in Deepholm.

text.title: 水兵的职责
text.objectives: 在斩浪号甲板上拿条水兵拖把，打扫2分钟。
text.description: 我要斩浪号的表面光洁可鉴，仿佛闪闪发光的红宝石，水兵$n。我的船上纪律严明，像你这样的水兵就要听话！$b$b那么，你还在等什么，你这河蚌脑袋的舱底耗子？上甲板去打扫！
text.completion: I heard the most furious mopping sounds from down here, mate.  That's EXACTLY what your Captain likes to hear.
text.completed: Return to Captain Keelhaul within the Riptide in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

english.title: Swabbing Duty
english.objectives: Pick up a Swabbie's Mop on the deck of the Riptide, then keep the deck clean for 2 minutes.
english.description: I want the surface of the Riptide t'shine like a star ruby, Swabbie $n.  I keep a tight ship around here, and it's swabbies like you that make it happen!$b$bWell, what're y'waitin' for, y'cockle-brained bilgerat?  Head updecks and start swabbin'!
english.completion: I heard the most furious mopping sounds from down here, mate.  That's EXACTLY what your Captain likes to hear.
english.completed: Return to Captain Keelhaul within the Riptide in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

text.title: 海盗的病痛
text.objectives: 获得5捧酸橘。
text.description: 牙龈病，真要命，$r。$b$b我知道你是新来的，可能还不需要放血，可我们其它的海盗都要对付一种叫做坏血病的小玩意儿。这也是我们为什么在这儿存着这么多酸橘的原因。$b$b好吧……曾经存着这么多酸橘。有人劫了咱们上一批货，不过他们跑不远——也许就在附近的岛子上？把它们带回来，说不定我能想办法是不是能把你提拔上去。
text.progress: I've seen too many good men die to such a preventable disease, $r.  We need those limes.
text.completion: I'll distribute these right away, $r.  And I'll see what I can do to put in the good word for you.
text.completed: Return to Garr Salthoof within the Riptide in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

english.title: The Bane of Many A Pirate
english.objectives: Obtain 5 Bushels of Limes.
english.description: Gum disease.  It's a real problem, $r.$b$bI know you're new and all, and probably haven't ever needed your gums cut, but the rest of us pirates have to deal with a little thing called SCURVY.  It's why we keep so many limes around here.$b$bWell... we used to keep limes around here.  Someone made off with our last shipment, but they can't have gone far - maybe to the nearby islands?  Bring them back, and maybe I'll see what I can do to get you promoted from swabbie.
english.progress: I've seen too many good men die to such a preventable disease, $r.  We need those limes.
english.completion: I'll distribute these right away, $r.  And I'll see what I can do to put in the good word for you.
english.completed: Return to Garr Salthoof within the Riptide in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

text.title: 炮弹泳
text.objectives: 从斩浪号的水底收集6枚血帆炮弹。
text.description: 看在都是水兵的份上帮个忙吧？$b$b尼哈鲁要我从海底收集一些炮弹。我来告诉你这事儿为什么不成吧。$b$b-第一：我胳膊短。瞧瞧它们！你真的以为我能抱起一枚炮弹，哪怕是在水下面吗？$b$b-第二：我呼吸系统有问题。憋气个十秒钟我就开始翻白眼了$b$b-第三：下面有鲨鱼。$b$b你得帮帮我，$n！我已经被降职得不能再降了……我可不想知道接下来会是什么！
text.progress: I wasn't always a swabbie, you know.
text.completion: Thanks, $n.  I'd been hearing whispers about "Pretty Boy" and a "boo-box".  I don't think I want to go in the boo-box.
text.completed: Return to "Pretty Boy" Duncan on the Riptide in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

english.title: Cannonball Swim
english.objectives: Obtain 6 Bloodsail Cannonballs from the water beneath the Riptide.
english.description: Help out a fellow swabbie?$b$bKeelhaul asked me to gather up some cannonballs at the bottom of the ocean.  Let me tell you why this doesn't work for me.$b$b- One: I have tiny arms.  Look at them!  Do you really think I can pick up a cannonball, even underwater?$b$b- Two: I have a weak respiratory system.  I start to white out after holding my breath for more than ten seconds.$b$b- Three: There are sharks.$b$bYou gotta help me, $n!  I've been demoted as far as I can... I don't want to see what comes next!
english.progress: I wasn't always a swabbie, you know.
english.completion: Thanks, $n.  I'd been hearing whispers about "Pretty Boy" and a "boo-box".  I don't think I want to go in the boo-box.
english.completed: Return to "Pretty Boy" Duncan on the Riptide in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

text.title: B连战斗工具：伪装
text.objectives: 采集5堆树叶和5块狐狸粪便。
text.description: 在我们干掉黑石军队，拯救赤脊山之前，咱们得弄点补给来。这活得你去干，菜鸟。$B$B基沙恩让我负责B连战斗工具的伪装。我要你去南边给我“采集”点东西来。你得事先了解一下这活儿，这活儿分两个部分：（1）树叶和（2）狐狸的粪便。两样都要。$B$B你以为伪装是什么东西做的？$B$B去南边，把我要的东西弄来。$g小伙子:姑娘;。
text.progress: Leaves and poop - that's what I need.
text.completion: Nice job, rookie. I'm gonna go ahead and put the camo in the box. We should be ready soon.
text.completed: Return to Krakauer at Camp Everstill in Redridge.

english.title: Bravo Company Field Kit: Camouflage
english.objectives: Gather 5 Piles of Leaves and 5 pieces of Fox Poop.
english.description: We're gonna need some supplies before we take out the Blackrock army and save Redridge. That's where you come in, rookie.$B$BKeeshan put me in charge of getting camouflage together for the Bravo Company field kit. What I need you to do is head south and do a little "gardening." There are two parts to this little adventure that you should know about: (1) Leaves and (2) Fox poop. We need 'em both.$B$BWhat did you think camo was made of?$B$BHead south and gather what I asked for, $g pal:lady;.
english.progress: Leaves and poop - that's what I need.
english.completion: Nice job, rookie. I'm gonna go ahead and put the camo in the box. We should be ready soon.
english.completed: Return to Krakauer at Camp Everstill in Redridge.

text.title: B连战斗工具：麻醉剂
text.objectives: 收集8个泥浆鱼人的腺体。
text.description: 这个任务的第一部分就是秘密行动，$n。想要完成任务，我们需要悄无声息地放倒敌人。麻醉剂是必不可少的。$B$B止水湖底的泥浆鱼人的腮腺里含有麻醉剂。我要你下到水底去，然后给我搞点泥浆鱼人的腮腺来。这活你能干吗？$B$B弄够数了就回来找我。$B$B你不知道那湖在哪里？你的眼睛是用来喘气的吗，白痴？一路奔西就是了。
text.progress: Did you recover the glands?
text.completion: Perfect. Those orcs won't know what hit 'em - literally. I'll need a few minutes to get these in working order and then I'll put them in the Bravo Company field kit.
text.completed: Return to Messner at Camp Everstill in Redridge.

english.title: Bravo Company Field Kit: Chloroform
english.objectives: Collect 8 Muckdweller Glands.
english.description: The first part of this mission is all covert ops, $n. To that end, we need to be able to incapacitate the enemy without making any sounds. To do that we're going to need chloroform.$B$BThe muckdwellers at the bottom of Lake Everstill hold chloroform in their glands. I'm going to need you to go underwater and recover muckdweller glands. Think you can handle it?$B$BCome back to me once you've recovered enough glands.$B$BWhere's the lake you ask? Open your eyes, dummy. Directly west.
english.progress: Did you recover the glands?
english.completion: Perfect. Those orcs won't know what hit 'em - literally. I'll need a few minutes to get these in working order and then I'll put them in the Bravo Company field kit.
english.completed: Return to Messner at Camp Everstill in Redridge.

text.title: 猎杀黑石猎人
text.objectives: 干掉8名黑石猎人。
text.description: 从这里向南走，在湖边大道上有一群潜伏在林荫之下的黑石兽人，他们专门袭击毫无准备的路人。那群兽人是黑石军队的第一道防线。他们都是黑石军队的探子，会把看到的一切都报告给他们的头目。必须干掉他们，否则我们在这儿的任务就会被破坏。$B$B去南边，杀掉你看到的每个黑石猎人。
text.completion: Great work, $n. We need to move quickly before they send for reinforcements.
text.completed: Return to Danforth at Camp Everstill in Redridge.

english.title: Hunting the Hunters
english.objectives: Kill 8 Blackrock Hunters.
english.description: Just south of here on the Lakeridge Highway are a group of Blackrock orcs that stalk the forests under cover of darkness and ambush the uninitiated. That group is the first line of defense for the Blackrock army. They're scouts, reporting everything they see back to their central command. They need to be taken OUT or our mission here could be compromised.$B$BHead south and kill every Blackrock hunter that you see.
english.completion: Great work, $n. We need to move quickly before they send for reinforcements.
english.completed: Return to Danforth at Camp Everstill in Redridge.

text.title: 接头人：布鲁贝克
text.objectives: 找到布鲁贝克。
text.description: 在我们干这坏事之前得先一起去弄套战斗工具来。你来协助我，$n。侦察也是个问题。多亏暴风城给咱们派来了人手。军情七处把我的老战友布鲁贝克派来帮我们侦察敌情了。你得去见见他，他就在离这里不远的南边。$B$B去见他，然后看看他有什么情报。
text.completion: Brubaker is dead. It looks like the orcs are attempting to send a message with this grizzly display. Upon closer examination you notice something in Brubaker's pouch.

english.title: Point of Contact: Brubaker
english.objectives: Find Brubaker.
english.description: Before we do a damned thing we need to get a field kit together. You'll help with that, $n. There's also a matter of scouting. Thankfully for that we got some help from Stormwind. An old war buddy of mine, Brubaker, was sent here by SI:7 to scout around for us. You're to meet him in the field, just south of here.$B$BMeet up with Brubaker and find out what he knows.
english.completion: Brubaker is dead. It looks like the orcs are attempting to send a message with this grizzly display. Upon closer examination you notice something in Brubaker's pouch.

text.title: 虐囚
text.objectives: 将布鲁贝克的报告带给赤脊山止水湖营地的约翰·J·基沙恩。
text.description: <你展开了便签，读着上面的内容。>$B$B基沙恩，如果你看到这张便签，那么我八成已经死了。很可能是我的行踪败露了。$B$B战俘们受到了兽人难以名状的虐待。没错，我说的是战俘，基沙恩。兽人们关押了整整一笼子的战俘。如果你要把这山谷掀个底儿朝天，你得先救出那些战俘。$B$B告诉我的妻子我爱她，你一定要干掉这些杂碎。$B$B布－布鲁贝克$B$B另，我还在他们那里发现了黑龙。$B$B将布鲁贝克的报告带回给基沙恩。
text.progress: They got Brubaker?
text.completion: DAMN IT! This just got complicated. We've got prisoners of war to rescue before we can blow up the valley. Not to mention the orcs have black dragons on their side. Are you ready, $n?

english.title: Unspeakable Atrocities
english.objectives: Deliver Brubaker's Report to John J. Keeshan at Camp Everstill in Redridge.
english.description: <You unfold the note and begin reading.>$B$BKeeshan, if you're reading this note, I'm dead. Likely that my position was compromised.$B$BOrcs are committing unspeakable atrocities against their prisoners. Yes, prisoners, Keeshan. They've got cages full of P.O.W's. If you're gonna blow up this valley, you'll need to free the prisoners first.$B$BTell my wife I love her and to take out the damned trash.$B$B-Brubaker$B$BPS - They've got black dragons.$B$BTake Brubaker's report back to Keeshan.
english.progress: They got Brubaker?
english.completion: DAMN IT! This just got complicated. We've got prisoners of war to rescue before we can blow up the valley. Not to mention the orcs have black dragons on their side. Are you ready, $n?

text.title: 没材料怎么做煎蛋卷……
text.objectives: 在亚戈瓦萨采集5颗沙德拉之卵。
text.description: 东北边的邪枝巢穴守卫照看着沙德拉产下的卵。就算我们把邪枝巨魔杀掉，那些卵还在，孵化以后产生的可怕生物就会进一步蔓延到荒野里。$B$B我们得正确处理这个问题。只要你看见蛋囊，就把它撕开，将里面的蛋带给我。不要把它们毁掉，你有可能会把小蜘蛛给放出来的。$B$B你把它们带回来以后，我会想个合适的办法处理掉！
text.progress: Do you have the eggs?
text.completion: I'll see these are burnt to ash right away, and scattered to the winds for good measure.
text.completed: Return to Gilda Cloudcaller at Quel'Danil Lodge in The Hinterlands.

english.title: Can't Make An Omelette Without...
english.objectives: Collect 5 Shadraspawn Eggs from Agol'watha.
english.description: The Vilebranch broodguards to the northeast tend the eggs of Shadra's brood. Even if we kill the Vilebranch, those eggs will still sit there, waiting to hatch and release those horrible creatures further into the wilds.$B$BWe need to take care of this properly. Tear any eggs you see out of the egg sacks and bring them to me. Don't try to destroy them on your own; you might let the little ones out.$B$BWhen you get them back here, I'll see that they're properly disposed of!
english.progress: Do you have the eggs?
english.completion: I'll see these are burnt to ash right away, and scattered to the winds for good measure.
english.completed: Return to Gilda Cloudcaller at Quel'Danil Lodge in The Hinterlands.

text.title: 保卫贫瘠之地
text.objectives: 去北贫瘠之地的前沿哨所，向那里的卡加尔·战痕报道。
text.description: 数年来，贫瘠之地一直是部落在卡利姆多的势力中心，这里也是连接杜隆塔尔的兽人与莫高雷的牛头人的重要纽带。$B$B大灾变带来了混乱，洪水、地震、甚至野猪人的入侵都让我们与这片生命的草原生生分离。$B$B你看上去已经准备好迎接挑战了。去前沿哨所找卡加尔·战痕报道吧，确保通往贫瘠之地的要道畅通无阻！从剃刀岭附近向西，穿越怒水河然后找到他。
text.completion: A fresh recruit from Orgrimmar is it? I'll take what I can get. Keeping the roads open has been a nightmare.
text.completed: 去北贫瘠之地的前沿哨所，向那里的卡加尔·战痕报道。

english.title: Preserving the Barrens
english.objectives: Report to Kargal Battlescar at Far Watch Post in Northern Barrens.
english.description: For years, the Barrens have been the heart of the Horde presence on Kalimdor, a vital link between the orcs of Durotar and the tauren settlements in Mulgore.$B$BIn the chaos of the cataclysm, floods, earthquakes, and even a quilboar invasion threaten to separate us from this vital grassland.$B$BYou look ready for a challenge. Report to Kargal Battlescar at Far Watch Post and ensure the route to the Barrens remains clear! Head west from nearby Razor Hill and cross the Southfury River to find him.
english.completion: A fresh recruit from Orgrimmar is it? I'll take what I can get. Keeping the roads open has been a nightmare.
english.completed: Report to Kargal Battlescar at Far Watch Post in Northern Barrens.

text.title: 禁食
text.objectives: 在爬虫废墟消灭6名茧缚受害者。
text.description: 东边的爬虫废墟里充斥着成年的沙德拉蜘蛛，它们大得足以在晚上把一个矮人拖走，你到了那儿就会明白了……到处都是缚成茧的尸体。$B$B它们不会让他们活很久，$n，但会花几天的时间消化尸体。想要救那些受害者已经太迟了，不过我们不能让那些蜘蛛吃得太胖了。一定要除掉那些茧。
text.completion: A grim task for sure, $n, but it'll keep the spiders left alive from recovering. I thank you.
text.completed: Return to Gilda Cloudcaller at Quel'Danil Lodge in The Hinterlands.

english.title: Starvation Diet
english.objectives: Destroy 6 Cocooned Victims at the Creeping Ruins.
english.description: The Creeping Ruin to the east is crawling with fully-grown Shadraspawn spiders. They're large enough to drag off an entire dwarf in the night, and you'll see evidence enough of that when you get there... bodies are cocooned all through the ruins.$B$BThey don't keep them alive for long, $n, but they feed off the bodies for days. It's too late to save the victims, but we can't let those spiders grow fat and thrive. Make sure you get rid of those cocoons.
english.completion: A grim task for sure, $n, but it'll keep the spiders left alive from recovering. I thank you.
english.completed: Return to Gilda Cloudcaller at Quel'Danil Lodge in The Hinterlands.

text.title: 吸引注意力
text.objectives: 去找荆棘谷海角红雾号的舰队指挥官菲尔拉伦。
text.description: 水兵$n！今天可不是老船长尼哈鲁的好日子。今天我失去了最好的水兵。$b$b舰队指挥官菲尔拉伦来信了。很明显他听说了你在这里的卓越表现，并且希望能把你调到红雾号当他的水手长和三副。她就停在斩浪号旁边。$b$b好好干，这可是你出人头地的时候，水兵$n。我建议你接受他的提议。$b$b解散！
text.completion: So ye be the one that did ol' Seahorn?  Yancey sent word, but I wanted to make sure he hadn't been telling his tall tales again. I'll make it brief.  Ye did well on Keelhaul's crew, but I expect ye to do even better on mine.  I've got an entire fleet to attend to, so you'll be helpin' to run the day-to-day of me ship. Welcome aboard the Crimson Veil, sailor.

english.title: Attracting Attention
english.objectives: Report to Fleet Master Firallon within the Crimson Veil in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
english.description: Swabbie $n!  This is a sad day fer ol' Cap'n Keelhaul.  Today I lose m'best swabbie.$b$bA letter's come in from Fleet Master Firallon.  Apparently he's heard about the excellent swabbin' y'been doin', and he wants t'take ye aboard the Crimson Veil as his Jack o' Swords and third mate.  She's moored just next t'the Riptide.$b$bPiracy career-wise, this's a big step fer ye, Swabbie $n.  I recommend y'take his offer.$b$bDismissed!
english.completion: So ye be the one that did ol' Seahorn?  Yancey sent word, but I wanted to make sure he hadn't been telling his tall tales again. I'll make it brief.  Ye did well on Keelhaul's crew, but I expect ye to do even better on mine.  I've got an entire fleet to attend to, so you'll be helpin' to run the day-to-day of me ship. Welcome aboard the Crimson Veil, sailor.

text.title: 守夜人
text.objectives: 在夜色镇东南的盲眼玛丽的鬼屋外消灭8具恐怖骸骨。
text.description: 恐怕我只有找你帮忙了，$n。暴风城的军队要对付更为邪恶的力量，连一个步兵也抽不出来保护夜色镇。保卫家乡的事情，就只能靠我和其他的守夜人了。$B$B不幸的是，这里还有比狼更严重的威胁。恐怖骸骨徘徊在东南郊外盲眼玛丽的鬼屋附近。如果置之不理的话，它们就会在晚上拜访我们的家园。$B$B把那些亡灵处理掉，然后来找我拿你的赏钱。
text.completion: 好极了，$N!我一定要表扬你为夜色镇所做的贡献!$B$B
text.completed: Return to Commander Althea Ebonlocke at Darkshire in Duskwood.

english.title: The Night Watch
english.objectives: Kill 8 Rotting Horrors near Blind Mary's Haunt, southeast of Darkshire.
english.description: I'm afraid you're all I've got to help here, $n. Stormwind's forces are so taxed by greater evils that they can't spare a single footman to protect Darkshire. It's up to me and the rest of the Night Watch to keep our homes safe.$B$BThere's more threats here than just wolves, unfortunately. Rotting horrors roam near Blind Mary's Haunt, on the southeast outskirts. If they're not kept in check, they'll be visiting our homes in the night.$B$BDeal with the undead and report back to me for your bounty.
english.completion: Splendid, $n.  For your service to the people of Darkshire you shall be rewarded.
english.completed: Return to Commander Althea Ebonlocke at Darkshire in Duskwood.

starters.name: 指挥官阿尔泰娅·埃伯洛克

enders.name: 指挥官阿尔泰娅·埃伯洛克

text.title: 战俘
text.objectives: 解救被关押在撕裂者山谷监狱里的战俘。
text.description: B连战斗工具准备就绪了，$n。你现在就装备上它，然后进入东南方向的撕裂者山谷，解救我们的战俘。我会派约根森来掩护你。$B$B现在那些战俘正被关押在山谷东北边的大笼子里面，但是笼子的钥匙却在山谷南面的一个洞穴里。你得去偷那把钥匙，声东击西，然后解救我们的人。$B$B祝你好运，$n！我会通过战斗工具和你保持联系。
text.completion: Looks like the P.O.W.s are free. Time to initiate Operation: End All.
text.completed: Speak with John J. Keeshan at Camp Everstill in Redridge.
text.turninWindow: 我体内流淌着战争的热血。

english.title: Prisoners of War
english.objectives: Free the Prisoners of War locked up in the prison at Render's Valley.
english.description: The Bravo Company field kit is ready, $n. I'm gonna equip you with it and you're gonna enter Render's Valley, southeast of here, and free our P.O.W.s.  I'm sending Jorgensen with you to watch your back.$B$BNow the prisoners are being held on the northeast side of the valley in a large cage, but the key to the cage is in a cave on the south side of the valley. You'll have to steal the key, create a distraction, and free the citizens.$B$BGood luck, $n! I'll be in touch through the field kit.
english.completion: Looks like the P.O.W.s are free. Time to initiate Operation: End All.
english.completed: Speak with John J. Keeshan at Camp Everstill in Redridge.

text.title: 老滑膛
text.objectives: 使用老滑膛对着微笑假人开5炮练练手。
text.description: 我们有活儿要干。你对操纵火炮有多少经验？嗯……真的？好，那么上了年纪而且破破烂烂的海盗大炮呢？$b$b我们在甲板上有几尊老式的大炮：你一次装一颗炮弹，瞄准，就炮位，然后开火。从侧面打三桅船是肯定没问题……对付小艇之类的就没辙了。$b$b你干吗不乘上去，然后朝微笑假人开几炮看看呢？
text.completion: I like the cut of your gib, $n.
text.completed: Return to Ironpatch within the Crimson Veil in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
text.giverWindow: 真正的勇士。

english.title: Ol' Blasty
english.objectives: Practice using the cannon by hitting Smilin' Timmy Sticks 5 times with cannonballs from Ol' Blasty.
english.description: We've got some work to do.  How much experience have you got with cannons?  Hmm... really?  Well, how about with ancient, fallin'-apart pirate cannons?$b$bWe've got a few cannons updecks that work the old-fashioned way: you load one cannonball in at a time, aim, lock it into place, and fire.  Works well if you're tryin' to hit the side of a three-sailer... not so well for rowboats and the like.$b$bWhy don't you head upstairs and lob a few shots at Smilin' Timmy Sticks?
english.completion: I like the cut of your gib, $n.
english.completed: Return to Ironpatch within the Crimson Veil in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
english.giverWindow: A real trooper.

text.title: 我们的死敌
text.objectives: 消灭哈圭罗岛的15名忍者。
text.description: 嘿，新来的$g小子:姑娘;，来看一看这个。$b$b<矮人翻开眼罩，露出一只完好，灵活的眼珠。>$b$b我戴这眼罩不是因为瞎了，而是因为这颗眼珠实在是太过灵活，正常那只眼睛反而成了它的负担。$b$b这只眼睛啥都瞧得真切，比方讲那些跟着我们过来的蒙面大盗。舰队指挥官说他们从来没在哈圭罗岛出现过。你到那儿后就发射这支信号枪，然后咱们一齐把他们干掉。
text.completion: Excellent work, $n.  The eternal battle wages on, but we've tipped the scales in favor of the pirates today.  Firallon will be happy to hear the news.
text.completed: Return to "Dead-Eye" Drederick McGumm on the Crimson Veil in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

english.title: Our Mortal Enemies
english.objectives: Kill 15 Ninjas on Jaguero Isle.
english.description: Hey, new $g guy: girl;, take a look at this.$b$b<The dwarf flips up his eyepatch to reveal a living, functional eyeball.>$b$bI don't wear this patch because of any lost eye.  I wear it because this OTHER eye is so strong, the normal one was just weighin' it down.$b$bThis eye's good for seein' all kinds of things, like those masked hooligans that follow us around.  Fleet Master says that they've been spotted over on Jaguero Isle.  Once you get there, fire this flare gun, and I'll help you spot 'em.
english.completion: Excellent work, $n.  The eternal battle wages on, but we've tipped the scales in favor of the pirates today.  Firallon will be happy to hear the news.
english.completed: Return to "Dead-Eye" Drederick McGumm on the Crimson Veil in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

starters.name: “死亡之眼”德雷德里克·麦克古姆

enders.name: “死亡之眼”德雷德里克·麦克古姆

text.title: 船头海战
text.objectives: 跟红雾号外的血帆浆手谈一谈，然后用大炮消灭75名风险投资公司油井工人。
text.description: 现在你学会了操纵火炮，该打打实靶了！$b$b风险投资公司在南边发现了金子……他们称之为“黑金”的一种稀有货色。要我说更像黑斑病。$b$b我们打算把那些金子抢过来，不过首先，得除掉风险投资公司的人。我找了一个桨手能把你带过去，走跳板下船，去小岛北岸跟他交谈。
text.completion: Ahahaha!  Blasted 'em clear off their rigging!  I'll drink to that! You've got a bright future, kid.
text.completed: Return to Ironpatch on the Crimson Veil in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

english.title: Drive-By Piracy
english.objectives: Speak with the Bloodsail Oarsman outside the Crimson Veil, then use the cannon to kill 75 Venture Co. Oil Workers.
english.description: Now that you know how to handle our cannons, it's time to hit some real targets!$b$bThe Venture Company has found gold to the north of here... a rare type they call "Black Gold".  More like a Black Spot if you ask me.$b$bWe're going to take that gold, but first, we need to get rid of those Venture Company goons.  I've got an oarsman who will take you out there.  Head off the ship down the gangplank and speak with him on the islet's northern shore.
english.completion: Ahahaha!  Blasted 'em clear off their rigging!  I'll drink to that! You've got a bright future, kid.
english.completed: Return to Ironpatch on the Crimson Veil in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

text.title: 少女之运号
text.objectives: 到荆棘谷海角少女之运号你的船长室报到。
text.description: 我知道你刚来红雾号，但我要派你去执行别的任务。少女之运号是舰队的第三艘，停在东边。她的船长——斯蒂沃特船长——已经不在了。$b$b那些该死的蒙面人！$b$b总而言之，艾隆帕跟我说了你在海上的英雄之举，而我又人手紧缺。我想你应该能胜任这份新工作。$b$b祝贺你，伙计。你是少女之运号的新船长了。
text.completion: You see a set of plans unrolled on the table.  They explain everything! These are the details of the impending attack on Booty Bay.  Battle formations, plans of attack, and something about a group called the "Brashtide Crew".

english.title: The Damsel's Luck
english.objectives: Report to your Captain's Chambers within the Damsel's Luck in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
english.description: I know ye just arrived here on the Crimson Veil, but I need to send ye off on another task.  The Damsel's Luck is the third ship in me fleet, moored over to the east.  Her skipper - Captain Stillwater - is no longer with us.$b$bDamn those masked hoodlums!$b$bAnyhow, Ironpatch told me about yer heroics at sea, and I be runnin' low on quality brigands.  I think yer more than capable for this new duty.$b$bCongratulations, matey.  Ye be the new captain of the Damsel's Luck.
english.completion: You see a set of plans unrolled on the table.  They explain everything! These are the details of the impending attack on Booty Bay.  Battle formations, plans of attack, and something about a group called the "Brashtide Crew".

text.title: 要赢得战争，就要比战争还残酷
text.objectives: 使用B连战斗工具，在黑石塔楼和黑石军需营帐旁各安放一枚爆盐炸弹。
text.description: <B连战斗工具的无线电响了起来。>$B$B你明白了吗，$n？你现在知道要怎么赢得对那些野兽的战争了吗？要比战争还残酷！要绝不留情！$B$B现在战俘都脱险了，你可以安放爆盐炸弹了。小心接近每一座建筑，然后安放炸药。$B$B在黑石军需营帐和黑石塔楼处安放炸药。等你搞定之后来撕裂者山谷东边的岩页峡谷，与我和其他的B连战士会合。
text.completion: And now, we blow the whole damned thing up.
text.completed: Speak with John J. Keeshan at Shalewind Canyon in Redridge.
text.giverWindow: 要赢得战争，就要比战争还残酷。

english.title: To Win a War, You Gotta Become War
english.objectives: Use the Bravo Company Field Kit to plant a Seaforium Charge at the Blackrock Tower and Blackrock Munitions Hut.
english.description: <The Bravo Company radio beeps.>$B$BDo you understand yet, $n? Do you now see what we gotta do to win a war against these monsters? YOU GOTTA BECOME WAR! NO MERCY!$B$BWith the P.O.W.s freed you're clear to plant the seaforium. Carefully make your way into each of the structures out there and plant a charge.$B$BPlant a seaforium charge at the Blackrock munitions hut and the Blackrock tower. Once you're done meet up with me and the rest of Bravo Company at Shalewind Canyon, east of Render's Valley.
english.completion: And now, we blow the whole damned thing up.
english.completed: Speak with John J. Keeshan at Shalewind Canyon in Redridge.
english.giverWindow: To win a war, you must become war.

objectiveDetails.description: 在军需营帐安放爆盐炸弹
在黑石塔楼安放爆盐炸弹

text.title: 幽灵的发丝
text.objectives: 把鬼梳带给盲眼玛丽。
text.description: 在夜色镇南边山上的一座旧农舍里，有一个可怜又可悲的鬼魂盲眼玛丽。$B$B给，拿上这把鬼梳，让盲眼玛丽去梳头。然后把梳子带回来，我来将上面的幽灵的头发清下来。$B$B要当心，那房子周围如今潜伏着黑暗。
text.progress: <哭泣>哦，不要，不要看着我!我自己把眼睛挖掉了，但是我还是能感觉到你在看我!$B$B我长得很丑陋!很丑陋!求求你，把脸转过去吧!!
text.completion: 这是什麽?梳子?太可爱了!它滑过我的头发，好像它们不再那麽僵硬可怕了。$B$B唉，要是有面镜子该多好……$B$B

english.title: Ghost Hair Thread
english.objectives: Bring the Spectral Comb to Blind Mary.
english.description: There is a poor, sad spirit, Blind Mary, who haunts an old farm house in the hills south of Darkshire.$B$BHere, take this Spectral Comb and ask Blind Mary to comb her hair.  Then bring back the comb and I will glean from it the Ghost Hair I'll need for the thread.$B$BAnd take care, for dark things now lurk near that house...
english.progress: <Sob> Oh please, don't look at me!  I tore out these eyes with my own hands, but I can still feel your gaze!$B$BI'm hideous!  Hideous!  Please, look away!!
english.completion: What is this?  A comb?  It's lovely!  And it glides through my hair as if it weren't the stiff, stringy horror that it is. Oh, if only I had a mirror...

text.title: 夜色镇的补给
text.objectives: 跟夜色镇的伊瓦夫人谈一谈。
text.description: 哦，我这可怜的老东西该怎么办？我需要来自夜色镇的补给，但是村子太远，我又太老、浑身无力……我永远也无法到那里。$B$B你能不能到夜色镇给我带回一些幽灵的发丝来？你可以从夜色镇广场伊瓦夫人她家里拿到它。
text.completion: 啊，你要的是鬼魂的发丝，是吗?我已经没有存货了，不过如果你能提供鬼魂的头发的话，我可以做一些给你……$B$B

english.title: Supplies from Darkshire
english.objectives: Speak with Madame Eva in Darkshire.
english.description: Oh, what is a poor old man to do?  I need some supplies from Darkshire, but the village is so far away and I am so old and feeble...I would never make the trip.$B$BCan you go to Darkshire and bring me back some ghost hair thread?  You can get it from Madame Eva at her home on the Darkshire square.
english.completion: Ah, ghost hair thread is what you need, is it?  I'm afraid I have none in stock, but I can make some for you...if you can supply the ghost hair.

text.title: 归还梳子
text.objectives: 把幽灵的梳子还给夜色镇的伊瓦夫人。
text.description: 不！！！！！$B$B拿走，把梳子从我身边拿走！$B$B我是一个怪物，再没有人会认为我可爱了！
text.progress: 我想你已经见过盲眼玛丽了，你拿到梳子了吗?
text.completion: 我可以用这些做一个鬼魂发丝的线轴给你，还能剩下几个备用。这些就当做跟你买这些线的费用吧。$B$B

english.title: Return the Comb
english.objectives: Return the Ghost Hair Comb to Madame Eva in Darkshire.
english.description: NO!!!!!$B$BTake it, take this comb away from me!$B$BI'm a monster, and no one will ever think me lovely again!
english.progress: I sense that you have seen Blind Mary.  You have my comb...?
english.completion: I can make a spool of ghost hair thread with this, and have a few strands to spare.  Here are some coins for those extra strands.

text.title: 送交发丝
text.objectives: 将幽灵的发丝交给乞丐鬼屋高塔里的亚伯克隆比。
text.description: 这是你的发丝，$n。从绑缚邪恶的灵魂，到把生命缝进毫无生气的物体中，它有千般用处。
text.progress: 我要把鬼魂的发丝挂在门窗上，来阻绝那些该死的亡魂。你替我拿来发丝了吗?
text.completion: 真令人高兴!这对我太有用了……$B$B请拿着这个，$N，做为我对你可敬的帮助的报酬。$B$B

english.title: Deliver the Thread
english.objectives: Bring the Ghost Hair Thread to Abercrombie in his tower at Beggar's Haunt.
english.description: Here is your thread, $n.  It has a thousand uses, from binding evil spirits to sewing life into inanimate objects.
english.progress: I need to string the ghost hair thread along my door and my windows to keep out unwanted spirits.  Did you get it for me?
english.completion: Delightful!  This will do splendidly... Here, good $n, take this as payment for your honorable deed.

text.title: 别·停·下
text.objectives: 将至少5名乳石守护者从苍白栖地带到塞拉赞恩的王座附近的石环中。
text.description: 当死亡之翼来临的时候，石龙聚集在他身边。在他消失之后，它们又群龙无首，开始吞噬我们的族类。$B$B我已经集结了许多乳石守护者，但是没法把它们领到安全地点去。得有一个身手更敏捷的人来做这件事，我看你就不错。$B$B带领他们冲向东边的塞拉赞恩的王座。当然，有些可能坚持不下来，但是只要你保持移动，总是可以把一部分送到目的地，让它们加入我们的行列。
text.completion: Well done. Of my main strengths, speed is not one.
text.completed: Return to Terrath the Steady within the Pale Roost.

english.title: Don't. Stop. Moving.
english.objectives: Rush at least 5 Opalescent Guardians east by ground, out of the Pale Roost, to the stone circle near Therazane's Throne.
english.description: When Deathwing came, the Stone Dragons flocked to him. In his absence, they are again without purpose. They swarm and feed upon our kin.$B$BI have bound dozens of Opalescent Guardians, but am unable to lead them from the safety of cover. I need someone more swift, as I suspect you might be.$B$BLead them by ground towards Therazane's Throne to the east. Surely, some will not make it, but as long as you keep moving, you should be able to bring several to join our forces there.
english.completion: Well done. Of my main strengths, speed is not one.
english.completed: Return to Terrath the Steady within the Pale Roost.

objectiveDetails.description: 与坚定者特尔拉斯交谈
护送乳石守护者抵达安全地点

text.title: 飞得高，摔得重
text.objectives: 杀死6只石龙。
text.description: 石龙只会屈服于力量。当我们给了他们足够的惩罚，它们就会重新屈从于我们的意志。$B$B我派出了一些我最强大的石巨人到了西边的旷野中。他们会将这些石龙击落到地面。你则需要去确保这些野兽摔下来一次之后就再也飞不起来。
text.completion: Not just fast it seems. You have some bite in you.$B$BWell done, $c.
text.completed: Return to Terrath the Steady within the Pale Roost.

english.title: Hard Falls
english.objectives: Kill 6 Stone Drakes.
english.description: Stone Dragons bow only to strength. When we have punished them enough, they will bend back to our will.$B$BI have sent many of my strongest giants onto the fields in the west. They will bring the drakes to the ground. You will see to it that they do not take wing again after they fall.
english.completion: Not just fast it seems. You have some bite in you.$B$BWell done, $c.
english.completed: Return to Terrath the Steady within the Pale Roost.

text.title: 脆弱的价值
text.objectives: 拿到砌石槌。
text.description: 现在该吸引龙母的主意了。为此，我们需要一把穴居怪用来献祭给她时使用的槌子。$B$B在苍白栖地南部找到那些驯服石化蜥蜴的石头穴居人驯兽师。你应该能在其中一个的尸体上找到槌子。
text.progress: Did you find a mallet?
text.completion: Glorious.$B$BNow we will deal a blow to the stone dragons that they will remember for the next hundred years.
text.completed: Return to Terrath the Steady within the Pale Roost.

english.title: Fragile Values
english.objectives: Retrieve a Stonework Mallet.
english.description: It is now time to draw the Broodmother's attention. To do so, we will need a mallet that the troggs use when making offerings to her.$B$BSeek out the Stone Trogg Beast Tamers that are attempting to tame basilisks in the southern portions of the Pale Roost. You will find a mallet on one of their corpses.
english.progress: Did you find a mallet?
english.completion: Glorious.$B$BNow we will deal a blow to the stone dragons that they will remember for the next hundred years.
english.completed: Return to Terrath the Steady within the Pale Roost.

text.title: 共鸣一击
text.objectives: 打败埃奥瑟拉。
text.description: 在苍白栖地的西翼，你可以找到一块共鸣水晶。用锤子击打它，龙母就会出现。$B$B做好战斗准备，我会到那里帮你，但她也不是好对付的。
text.completion: Impressive, fleshling. You are far more capable than I initially assumed.$B$BI will extend that sentiment to the Stonemother as well.
text.completed: Return to Terrath the Steady within the Pale Roost.
text.giverWindow: 石龙之母

english.title: Resonating Blow
english.objectives: Defeat Aeosera.
english.description: On the western edge of the Pale Roost, you will find a resonating crystal. Strike it with the mallet and the broodmother will come.$B$BBe ready for battle. I will be there to aid you, but she will not be easily overcome.
english.completion: Impressive, fleshling. You are far more capable than I initially assumed.$B$BI will extend that sentiment to the Stonemother as well.
english.completed: Return to Terrath the Steady within the Pale Roost.
english.giverWindow: Broodmother of the Stone Drakes.

text.title: 僵尸酒
text.objectives: 跟旅店老板斯密茨谈一谈。
text.description: 我需要一瓶特别的酒——僵尸酒。夜色镇血鸦旅店里的旅店老板斯密茨应该有一些。$B$B请赶快，$n。夜晚变得冷起来了，我需要那酒来暖和身子！
text.completion: 你想要些殭屍汁?嗯…这东西味道很呛—很少有人点它。$B$B

english.title: Zombie Juice
english.objectives: Speak with Tavernkeep Smitts.
english.description: I need a bottle of a certain liquor - Zombie Juice.  Tavernkeep Smitts at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire should have some.$B$BAnd please hurry, $n.  These nights get cold, and I need that drink to put fire in my veins again!
english.completion: You need some Zombie Juice, do you?  Hmm...that's some strong stuff - I don't usually get requests for it.

text.title: 收集腐败之花
text.objectives: 从静谧花园墓场收集5朵腐败之花。
text.description: 如果你能给我弄些腐败之花来，我就能给你酿一批僵尸酒。$B$B腐败之花长在奇怪的地方。它们喜欢长在死掉的东西上面，暮色森林可不缺这种东西！$B$B我最近在静谧花园墓场看到过一些。到坟墓附近找找看……不过要当心那里的行尸。
text.progress: Hi, $n.  Do you have those rot blossoms for me yet?
text.completion: Good,  you got the rot blossoms. I'll whip up the zombie juice... it's strong stuff, I warn you.
text.completed: Return to Tavernkeep Smitts at Darkshire in Duskwood.

english.title: Gather Rot Blossoms
english.objectives: Gather 5 Rot Blossoms from Tranquil Gardens Cemetary.
english.description: If you bring me some rot blossoms then I can brew you up a batch of zombie juice.$B$BRot blossoms grow in strange places.  They tend to flourish on dead things, and Duskwood has its fair share of those!$B$BI've seen a few of them growing at Tranquil Gardens Cemetery lately. Check near the graves... but mind the dead that are walking about near there.
english.progress: Hi, $n.  Do you have those rot blossoms for me yet?
english.completion: Good,  you got the rot blossoms. I'll whip up the zombie juice... it's strong stuff, I warn you.
english.completed: Return to Tavernkeep Smitts at Darkshire in Duskwood.

text.title: 急浪船帮
text.objectives: 跟少女之运号上的长牙约翰·库珀、红雾号上的大块头肖恩·斯托克和斩浪号的狼嚎玛丽·史密斯谈一谈。
text.description: 海图上提到了一个名叫急浪船帮的组织。这名字你头一次见，但你听说最近是有些新人加入了海盗队。$b$b也许你该拜访他们，看看他们知道些什么。
text.completion: The Brashtide Crew aren't just pirates... they're worgen pirates!  And they're joining in on the attack! Revilgaz is definitely going to want to know about this.
text.completed: Return to your Captain's Quarters within the Damsel's Luck in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

english.title: The Brashtide Crew
english.objectives: Speak with Long John Copper on the Damsel's Luck, Enormous Shawn Stooker on the Crimson Veil, and Wailing Mary Smitts on the Riptide.
english.description: The charts mention a group called the Brashtide Crew.  This name is new to you, though you've heard about a few other newcomers to the Buccaneers.$b$bMaybe it's time you paid them a visit and found out what they know.
english.completion: The Brashtide Crew aren't just pirates... they're worgen pirates!  And they're joining in on the attack! Revilgaz is definitely going to want to know about this.
english.completed: Return to your Captain's Quarters within the Damsel's Luck in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

objectiveDetails.description: 跟长牙约翰·库珀谈一谈
跟大块头肖恩·斯托克谈一谈
跟狼嚎玛丽·史密斯谈一谈

text.title: 内部沉船
text.objectives: 破坏酒桶、火药桶，以及炮弹箱。
text.description: 对藏宝海湾的进攻迫在眉睫。你必须赶快回到藏宝海湾通知里维加兹。$b$b但首先，趁他们还信任你，不妨先在海盗们的粮草上搞点破坏。海盗们多半都会把补给分给舰队，放在甲板下。
text.completion: You've set the pirates back several days' work.  Hopefully this will delay their attack.
text.completed: Return to your Captain's Quarters within the Damsel's Luck in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

english.title: Sinking From Within
english.objectives: Sabotage the Barrel of Grog, the Barrel of Gunpowder, and the Crate of Cannonballs.
english.description: The attack on Booty Bay is looming.  You'll have to return to Booty Bay quickly and inform the Baron.$b$bFirst, however, it might be a good idea to sabotage some of the pirates' supplies while you're still in their favor.  The pirates keep most of their supplies belowdecks, spread out across the entire fleet.
english.completion: You've set the pirates back several days' work.  Hopefully this will delay their attack.
english.completed: Return to your Captain's Quarters within the Damsel's Luck in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

text.title: 叛舰喋血
text.objectives: 指控9名血帆海盗叛变，然后处死他们。
text.description: 回到藏宝海湾之前，你该尽可能地打击血帆海盗。不幸的是，即便作为船长，你也不能冷血地就那么把其他海盗统统咔嚓掉。$b$b不过，你倒是可以，处决哗变者……再说这事儿向来难以理论。$b$b说起来，船上最下层的这些血帆海盗最近一直行为挺可疑……
text.completion: The fewer Bloodsail Buccaneers that Booty Bay has to fight, the better.  However, it might be best to stop slaughtering your supposed allies before you draw suspicion to yourself.
text.completed: Return to your Captain's Quarters within the Damsel's Luck in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

english.title: Making Mutiny
english.objectives: Accuse 9 Bloodsail Corsairs of mutiny, then kill them.
english.description: Before returning to Booty Bay, you should do everything you can to weaken the Bloodsail Buccaneers.  Unfortunately, even as captain, you're prohibited from killing other buccaneers in cold blood.  Only a Fleet Master can do that.$b$bYou can, however, put mutineers to the sword... and mutiny can be awfully hard to disprove.$b$bSpeaking of which, those Bloodsail corsairs that hang out on the lowest level of the ships have been acting awfully suspicious...
english.completion: The fewer Bloodsail Buccaneers that Booty Bay has to fight, the better.  However, it might be best to stop slaughtering your supposed allies before you draw suspicion to yourself.
english.completed: Return to your Captain's Quarters within the Damsel's Luck in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

text.title: 宝藏的召唤
text.objectives: 去找荆棘谷海角藏宝海湾的大财主里维加兹。
text.description: 你觉得破坏搞得差不多，血帆的战斗计划也拿到了。大财主里维加兹要你做得你都做完了。$b$b是摘下海盗帽，回到藏宝海湾的时候了。战斗即将打响。
text.completion: The Brashtide!?  I thought they were dead and gone YEARS ago! No, that absolutely makes sense.  And it's not good news either.  The Brashtide are formidable foes, and if their numbers are anywhere near what they were before they disappeared, we're in for a nasty battle.

english.title: Call of Booty
english.objectives: Report to Baron Revilgaz at Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
english.description: You feel like you've done just about enough damage, and you know the Bloodsail's battle plans.  You've done everything that Baron Revilgaz has asked of you.$b$bIt's time to hang up the pirate hat and return to Booty Bay.  The battle looms near.
english.completion: The Brashtide!?  I thought they were dead and gone YEARS ago! No, that absolutely makes sense.  And it's not good news either.  The Brashtide are formidable foes, and if their numbers are anywhere near what they were before they disappeared, we're in for a nasty battle.

text.title: 斯塔文的传说
text.objectives: 去找夜色镇大厅的书记员达尔塔。
text.description: 我来这里，是因为我从我的兄弟斯塔文那里收到了一封信，我已经很多年没见过他了。我刚到，就有人说他已经死了……$B$B整个镇子拒绝进行更多解释。只要提起他的名字，就会引起恐慌和猜疑。仿佛我自己还没有受够似的！$B$B我担心如果我的挫折和愤怒进一步扩大，不知道会做出怎样的事情来。我请求你，帮我查清楚。恳求书记员达尔塔，让他把我兄弟的消息说出来。
text.completion: 我能帮你吗?

english.title: The Legend of Stalvan
english.objectives: Seek out Clerk Daltry in the Darkshire Town Hall.
english.description: I'm here because I received a letter from my brother Stalvan, who I haven't seen in years. On arriving here, I was told he was dead...$B$BThe entire town refuses to offer any further explanation. Any mention of his name is met with terror and suspicion. As if I didn't have enough of that myself!$B$BI'm afraid of what will happen if my frustration and anger grows any further. I beg you, help me get to the bottom of this. Implore Clerk Daltry for any information he may have on my brother.
english.completion: Can I help you?

text.title: 被偷的信件
text.objectives: 到阳光树林找到一捆被切碎的信件。
text.description: 你想知道有关斯塔文的事情……$B$B你已经不是第一个，知道吗。我们这儿常有外来人来打听他的事情。永远是外来人。住在这里的所有人都知道得很清楚。$B$B总而言之，你运气不好。我丢失了一半的档案。几天前野生狼人闯进了镇大厅，把这地方翻了个底朝天。$B$B你需要的文件很可能已经一路散落在了西边阳光树林的深处。要我说，它就不值得去找。
text.progress: Look, $gsir:miss;, I really don't want any trouble...
text.completion: By the light... you actually went and got it? I'm shocked. I suppose I owe you thanks for returning it to the archives.
text.completed: Return to Clerk Daltry at Darkshire in Duskwood.

english.title: The Stolen Letters
english.objectives: Collect the Bundle of Shredded Letters from Brightwood Grove.
english.description: You want to know about Stalvan...$B$BYou're not the first, you know. We get outsiders coming through asking about him every so often. Always outsiders. Everyone who lives here knows better.$B$BYou're out of luck, anyway. I'm missing half the archives. Feral worgen broke into the town hall not a few nights ago and tore the place to shreds.$B$BThe documents you'll want are probably strewn all across Brightwood Grove by now, deep in the woods to the west. Not worth it if you ask me.
english.progress: Look, $gsir:miss;, I really don't want any trouble...
english.completion: By the light... you actually went and got it? I'm shocked. I suppose I owe you thanks for returning it to the archives.
english.completed: Return to Clerk Daltry at Darkshire in Duskwood.

text.title: 引爆山谷
text.objectives: 引爆撕裂者山谷。
text.description: 你刚才安放的都是些高能炸药，$n。当我按下这个B连战地工具上的按钮，整个山谷就将化为一片死亡的火海。$B$B我觉得这荣耀的时刻应该由你来启动，这一切完全归功于你。$B$B准备好了吗？
text.completion: Did you see those orcs explode? THAT'S HOW WE DO IT IN BRAVO COMPANY! Now to clean up the rest of these jackasses.
text.end: 引爆撕裂者山谷。
text.completed: 与赤脊山止水湖营地的约翰·J·基沙恩谈一谈。

english.title: Detonation
english.objectives: Blow up Render's Valley.
english.description: Those explosives you planted were high yield, $n. When I push this button on the Bravo Company field kit, that whole valley is gonna be consumed by a massive fireball of death.$B$BYou know, I think you should do the honors. You did all the hard work, after all.$B$BReady?
english.completion: Did you see those orcs explode? THAT'S HOW WE DO IT IN BRAVO COMPANY! Now to clean up the rest of these jackasses.
english.completed: Speak with John J. Keeshan at Camp Everstill in Redridge.

text.title: 黑暗的角落
text.objectives: 在烂果园寻找一张被撕破的日记书页。
text.description: 如果你真的那么在意，我就帮你，$n。我知道其他的文献在什么地方。我就是太害怕了，不敢去找。$B$B这些可怕的夜之魇不在森林里徘徊的时候，会聚集在几个地方。其中一处就是南边的烂果园。它们把那儿的建筑当成巢穴，如果文献没被吃掉的话，你应该就能在那里找到它……不过，我猜你得把它们的巢穴都搜遍才行。
text.progress: You're back in one piece, I see.
text.completion: This was all you found? That's bad news, I'm afraid...
text.completed: Return to Clerk Daltry at Darkshire in Duskwood.

english.title: In A Dark Corner
english.objectives: Search the Rotting Orchard for the Torn Journal Page.
english.description: If you're that serious about this, I'll help you, $n. I know where the other documents must be. I'm just too terrified to do anything about it.$B$BThere's only a few places that those horrible Nightbane beasts gather when they're not prowling the forest. One of them's the Rotting Orchard to the south. They use the buildings there as their dens, so if they haven't just eaten the other documents, you might find one there... but you'll have to search their lairs thoroughly, I wager.
english.progress: You're back in one piece, I see.
english.completion: This was all you found? That's bad news, I'm afraid...
english.completed: Return to Clerk Daltry at Darkshire in Duskwood.

text.title: 罗兰之墓
text.objectives: 罗兰之墓寻找斯塔文日记的其他几页。
text.description: 这还不是全部……$B$B你应该放手，$n。只有罗兰之墓还没有找过。那是镇子南边的一个矿洞，暮色森林狼人最大的巢穴。夜色镇没有人能从那里活着回来。事实上，根据我这里的记录显示，那些怪物一开始就是从那里出现的……谁知道里面还潜伏着怎样的邪恶？$B$B求求你，$n，放弃吧。把整件事忘记，再也不要提起它。
text.progress: I told you, $n, it's not worth pursuing...
text.completion: You actually went and got it?! I don't know whether to call you brave or insane. But once again, my archives thank you.
text.completed: Return to Clerk Daltry at Darkshire in Duskwood.

english.title: Roland's Doom
english.objectives: Search Roland's Doom for the remaining pages of Stalvan's Journal.
english.description: This isn't all of it...$B$BYou should let it go, $n. The only place left to look is Roland's Doom. That's the mine south of town, and the largest lair of worgen in Duskwood. Nobody in Darkshire has ever made it back from that place alive. In fact, some of the records I have here imply that's where the monsters first came from... who knows what evil's lurking in there?$B$BPlease, $n, just give it up. Let's just forget about this whole thing, and never speak of it again.
english.progress: I told you, $n, it's not worth pursuing...
english.completion: You actually went and got it?! I don't know whether to call you brave or insane. But once again, my archives thank you.
english.completed: Return to Clerk Daltry at Darkshire in Duskwood.

text.title: 斯塔文·密斯特曼托的命运
text.objectives: 将斯塔文的传说交给托比亚斯·密斯特曼托。
text.description: 你把所有的都找到了。除了最后一页……$B$B……就在我这儿。别那么看着我。你读了以后就明白了。你知道，有人甚至说它被诅咒了。事实上，狼人闯进来把这些掳走的时候，我真是松了一口气！$B$B给你。都给你。我谢谢你找回我的档案，但我不想再和这件事牵涉上关系。求求你，别管我就好。
text.progress: You're back! Did you find anything about my brother?
text.completion: I can't thank you enough... I had hoped for this to be a joyous reunion, but the more I learn, the less glad I am to have asked. But I must know.

english.title: The Fate of Stalvan Mistmantle
english.objectives: Take The Legend of Stalvan back to Tobias Mistmantle.
english.description: You've recovered everything. Everything except the last page...$B$B...which I've got right here. Don't look at me like that. You'll understand when you read it. Some even say it's cursed, you know. In fact, I was relieved when the worgen broke in and made off with these!$B$BTake it. Take all of it, in fact. I thank you for recovering my archives, but I don't want anything to do with this ever again. Please, just leave me be.
english.progress: You're back! Did you find anything about my brother?
english.completion: I can't thank you enough... I had hoped for this to be a joyous reunion, but the more I learn, the less glad I am to have asked. But I must know.

text.title: 挖掘真相
text.objectives: 将密斯特曼托家族戒指交给伊瓦夫人。
text.description: 这不可能。我的兄弟意志坚强，可如此邪恶……如此病态和暴力，血腥的邪恶……$B$B<托比亚斯用手捂着脸，避开了他的目光。>$B$B我必须找到答案。我需要知道那封信是怎么寄到我手上的。我需要知道斯塔文是不是真的这么做了。$B$B我需要知道为什么……$B$B把我的戒指拿去，$n。将它交给伊瓦夫人。那个女人对古物十分在行，什么都明白……是很疯狂，但事到如今我什么都得试试。
text.progress: What dark whispers guide you to my door, $c?
text.completion: How interesting. It's been quite a while since I've seen such a ring...

english.title: Clawing at the Truth
english.objectives: Bring the Mistmantle Family Ring to Madame Eva.
english.description: This can't be. My brother was strong-willed, but such vileness... such sickness and violent, bloody evil...$B$B<Tobias brings a hand to his face, averting his gaze.>$B$BI must have answers. I need to know how I got that letter. I need to know if Stalvan really did this.$B$BI need to know why...$B$BTake my ring, $n. Bring it to Madame Eva. That woman is a follower of old arts and makes no secret of it... call it madness, but I'll try anything at this point.
english.progress: What dark whispers guide you to my door, $c?
english.completion: How interesting. It's been quite a while since I've seen such a ring...

text.title: REUSE - BREADCRUMB
text.objectives: 将密斯特曼托家族戒指交给伊瓦夫人。
text.description: 这不可能。我的兄弟意志坚强，可如此邪恶……如此病态和暴力，血腥的邪恶……$B$B<托比亚斯用手捂着脸，避开了他的目光。>$B$B我必须找到答案。我需要知道那封信是怎么寄到我手上的。我需要知道斯塔文是不是真的这么做了。$B$B我需要知道为什么……$B$B把我的戒指拿去，$N。将它交给伊瓦夫人。那个女人对古物十分在行，什么都明白……是很疯狂，但事到如今我什么都得试试。

english.title: REUSE - BREADCRUMB
english.objectives: Bring the Mistmantle Family Ring to Madame Eva.
english.description: This can't be. My brother was strong-willed, but such vileness... such sickness and violent, bloody evil...$B$B<Tobias brings a hand to his face, averting his gaze.>I must have answers. I need to know how I got that letter. I need to know if Stalvan really did this.$B$BI need to know why...$B$BTake my ring, $n. Bring it to Madame Eva. That woman is a follower of old arts and makes no secret of it... call it madness, but I'll try anything at this point.

text.title: 密斯特曼托的复仇
text.objectives: 在镇子北边的密斯特曼托庄园使用密斯特曼托家族戒指。
text.description: 恐怕我无法回答托比亚斯的问题。但我可以帮你找到那唯一一个拥有答案的人……$B$B斯塔文·密斯特曼托。$B$B把这枚戒指拿到北边林子里的密斯特曼托庄园去，斯塔文的尸体就埋在那里。进去以后，拿着戒指。让残月的光芒穿过戒指，灵魂会回应你的召唤。$B$B去吧，$n。生者的问题能比死者的答案带来更多的宽慰。
text.completion: Master Harris may have been right. I would have been better to leave the past behind. I've got a new life now. Whether it's that of a monster or a man is up to me. As for you, I cannot thank you enough for your assistance, regardless of the outcome. Please, take this with my thanks.
text.completed: Return to Tobias Mistmantle at Darkshire in Duskwood.

english.title: Mistmantle's Revenge
english.objectives: Use the Mistmantle Family Ring at Manor Mistmantle, east of town.
english.description: I'm afraid I cannot give Tobias the answers he seeks. But I can help you find the only person who can...$B$BStalvan Mistmantle.$B$BTake the ring into the woods to the east, to Manor Mistmantle, where Stalvan's body was buried. Enter, and hold the ring before you. Let the waning moon pour its light through the ring, and the spirits will answer your call.$B$BTake heed, $n. The questions of the living can offer more comfort than the answers of the dead.
english.completion: Master Harris may have been right. I would have been better to leave the past behind. I've got a new life now. Whether it's that of a monster or a man is up to me. As for you, I cannot thank you enough for your assistance, regardless of the outcome. Please, take this with my thanks.
english.completed: Return to Tobias Mistmantle at Darkshire in Duskwood.

text.title: 信任的代价
text.description: 这个世界的麻烦似乎永不消退。它们不断变化、改变、重生，但永续长存。$B$B风声给我们带来了一个叛徒的低语，此人就在我们中间。我们派了一名最好的哨兵去进行调查，而现在她死了。我以为叛徒不知道我们的行动，却因此害了她……我过于轻率，而她为我的愚昧付出了代价。$B$B我需要一个新面孔来继承她的遗志。一个城里的人所不认识的面孔。这是一个危险的任务。你愿意帮助我吗？

english.title: The Value of Trust
english.description: The troubles of this world seem to never fade. They shift, change, and reform, but they are ever-present.$B$BThe wind brought us whispers of a traitor in our midst. We sent one of our best sentinels to investigate, and now she has turned up dead. I did her disservice in assuming that the traitor would not be aware of our movements... I was brash, and she paid for my folly.$B$BI need a new face to pick up the trail. Someone the people of the city won't know. This is a dangerous request. Will you help me?

text.title: 送酒
text.objectives: 把僵尸酒带给乞丐鬼屋的亚伯克隆比。
text.description: 这是你的僵尸酒……$B$B……喝的时候要当心。它烈得连死人都能给喝活过来！
text.progress: 我需要喝些殭屍汁在寒冷的夜里保持暖和。你替我拿殭屍汁来了吗?
text.completion: 真是太感谢你了，$N。你用你的愚蠢—我是说……你的善良─温暖了一个老人的心!$B$B拿着，这代表我的感激之情。$B$B

english.title: Juice Delivery
english.objectives: Bring the Zombie Juice to Abercrombie at Beggar's Haunt.
english.description: Here's your Zombie Juice...$B$B...and be careful with this stuff.  It's strong enough to raise the dead!
english.progress: I need that Zombie Juice to keep me warm on these cold, dark nights.  Did you get it for me?
english.completion: A thousand thanks, $n.  You warm an old man's heart with your foolish-...I mean...with your kindness! Here you are, friend.  Take this as a token of my gratitude.

text.title: 食尸鬼雕像
text.objectives: 从密斯特曼托庄园的恶臭的食尸鬼身上收集7块食尸鬼的肋骨。
text.description: 在这个镇子的郊外，那些行尸还没把我吃掉可真是个奇迹！事实上，就在昨天，一群食尸鬼还在捶我塔边的围墙！$B$B我想做一个雕像——一个吓唬食尸鬼的“稻草人”。为此我需要食尸鬼的肋骨。你可以在密斯特曼托庄园那儿恶臭的食尸鬼身上找到很多，就在夜色镇北边……$B$B帮我把肋骨拿来，我可以给你一些钱作为报酬。
text.progress: I'm sure you could find plenty of ribs in Raven Hill as well, but you might not want to wander so far at night...
text.completion: 啊，谢谢。这样就可以了!$B$B
text.completed: Return to Abercrombie at Beggar's Haunt in Duskwood.

english.title: Ghoulish Effigy
english.objectives: Gather 7 Ghoul Ribs from Fetid Corpses at Manor Mistmantle.
