english.description: Out here on the outskirts of town, it's a wonder the walking dead haven't eaten me!  In fact, just yesterday a pack of ghouls was pounding on the walls of my tower!$B$BI want to make an effigy - a kind of "scarecrow" for ghouls.  To do that I need some ghoul ribs.  You can find plenty of them on the fetid corpses wandering Manor Mistmantle's grounds, north of Darkshire...$B$BGet the ribs for me, and I will repay you with some coin.
english.progress: I'm sure you could find plenty of ribs in Raven Hill as well, but you might not want to wander so far at night...
english.completion: Ah, thanks.  These will do just the trick!
english.completed: Return to Abercrombie at Beggar's Haunt in Duskwood.

text.title: 极烈朗姆酒
text.objectives: 去藏宝海湾找大财主里维加兹的极烈朗姆酒。
text.description: <大财主里维加兹叹了口气。>就算我对菲尔拉伦的计划了如指掌，咱们也没法儿应付血帆和急浪的两面夹击。这次要想守住藏宝海湾非得靠老天显灵不可。$b$b我在自己的房间里藏了一桶极烈朗姆酒。下三段楼梯，右手边的第一扇门就是。你大可以忽略桶上的警告……眼下这种事情就用不着去管它了。
text.completion: This must be the doublerum.  You pour a glass for Revilgaz, then consider pouring one for yourself...

english.title: Doublerum
english.objectives: Find Baron Revilgaz's Barrel of Doublerum within Booty Bay.
english.description: <Baron Revilgaz sighs.>  Even with all my suspicions about Firallon's plot, we aren't prepared for a full two-front attack between the Bloodsail and the Brashtide.  It's going to take a small miracle to hold Booty Bay today.$b$bI've got a barrel of Doublerum in my chambers.  Take the stairs down three flights, and check the first door on your right.  You can ignore the warnings on the barrel... those should be the least of your worries.
english.completion: This must be the doublerum.  You pour a glass for Revilgaz, then consider pouring one for yourself...

text.title: 去找里维加兹
text.objectives: 把极烈朗姆酒给藏宝海湾的里维加兹送去。
text.description: 外面发生了什么事情。难道是血帆已经打来了？$b$b你最好赶紧把极烈朗姆酒给里维加兹送去。赶紧。
text.progress: Guess who showed up while you were gone?
text.completion: AH!  Much better, $n.  Now, let's get down to business.  I believe that you and I have a town to save.

english.title: Return to Revilgaz
english.objectives: Bring the Doublerum to Baron Revilgaz at Booty Bay.
english.description: Something is happening outside.  Could the Bloodsail already be here?$b$bYou'd better get Revilgaz his doublerum.  Quickly.
english.progress: Guess who showed up while you were gone?
english.completion: AH!  Much better, $n.  Now, let's get down to business.  I believe that you and I have a town to save.

text.title: 食人魔小偷
text.objectives: 把亚伯克隆比的箱子还给亚伯克隆比。
text.description: 一周前我正在远离房子的地方采药，一帮食人魔袭击了我！我只能逃跑，把一箱贵重的工具和药草丢下了。$B$B他们把我赶走之后，食人魔们就大摇大摆地回到了暮色森林南边的食人魔山里。我肯定我的箱子还在那山附近。$B$B求求你，$n，帮我拿回那个箱子，我真的很需要它。
text.progress: 你找到我的木箱了吗?如果找到的话，请赶快把它给我!
text.completion: 感谢亡─呃，我是说，谢谢你，$N，你干得太棒了!$B$B啊哈!太高兴了!今晚真是太高兴了!$B$B
text.completed: Return to Abercrombie at Beggar's Haunt in Duskwood.

english.title: Ogre Thieves
english.objectives: Return Abercrombie's Crate to Abercrombie.
english.description: A few weeks ago I was picking herbs far from my house, and a band of ogres attacked me!  I ran, and I was forced to leave behind a crate of precious tools and herbs.$B$BAfter they chased me off, the ogres swaggered back to the ogre mound in southern Duskwood.  I'm sure my crate is somewhere near the mound.$B$BPlease, $n, retrieve this crate for me for I miss it sorely.
english.progress: Do you have my crate?  If so, then please...give it to me quickly!
english.completion: Thank the Nec-...well, thank YOU, $n!  You have more than earned your reward. Aha!  Happy!  Happy nights ahead!!
english.completed: Return to Abercrombie at Beggar's Haunt in Duskwood.

text.title: 给镇长的信
text.objectives: 将亚伯克隆比的信交给夜色镇的镇长艾尔罗·埃伯洛克。
text.description: 将这封信交给夜色镇的镇长艾尔罗·埃伯洛克……当他读到这封信，并了解你为我所做的一切时……我肯定他会和我一样高兴的！哈哈哈哈！
text.progress: A letter? What's this all about?
text.completion: You fool! You've doomed us all!

english.title: Note to the Mayor
english.objectives: Bring Abercrombie's Letter to Ello Ebonlocke, Mayor of Darkshire.
english.description: Take this note to Ello Ebonlocke, the Mayor of Darkshire.$B$BHe and I are old friends...and when he reads it and discovers what you did for me...I'm sure he'll be just as happy as I am!  Hahahaha!
english.progress: A letter? What's this all about?
english.completion: You fool! You've doomed us all!

text.title: 蹒跚的威胁
text.objectives: 在蕨墙村北部沼泽里杀死7名枯藤爬行者或枯藤狂暴者。
text.description: 尘泥沼泽是部落的地盘，$n。人类大可以拥有他们的小岛，还有他们金贵的沙洲，但沼泽是属于我们的。$B$B假以时日，我们一定会从僵局里走出来，大败人类。但目前，我们必须固守自己的领地。北边的枯藤沼泽兽会从沼泽里爬出来，袭击任何接近的活物。要想拥有这片沼泽，就不能让自己的土地跟我们对着干！$B$B如果你想为部落效力的话，就杀掉沼泽兽。你会得到奖赏的。
text.completion: Well done, $n. We'll be able to focus on greater threats here now.
text.completed: Return to Krog at Brackenwall Village in Dustwallow Marsh.

english.title: A Shambling Threat
english.objectives: Slay 7 Withervine Creepers or Withervine Ragers in the marsh north of Brackenwall Village.
english.description: Dustwallow is Horde territory, $n. The humans may have their little island and their precious sand bar, but the marsh belongs to us.$B$BIn time, we will surely win this stalemate with the humans. For now, we must master our own territory. The withervine bog beasts to the north rise from the marsh itself to attack any living thing that approaches. If we own this marsh, we must not let our own land fight back against us!$B$BSlay the bog beasts, if you wish to serve the Horde. You will be rewarded.
english.completion: Well done, $n. We'll be able to focus on greater threats here now.
english.completed: Return to Krog at Brackenwall Village in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: 眺望群星
text.objectives: 找到玛丽，说服她把反射面拿出来完成维克托尔的项目。
text.description: 我的侏儒朋友考格答应帮我制造一件装置，可以让我端详群星。根据考格的蓝图，我首先需要想一个让光线反射的办法。$B$B我记得这儿有一个叫玛丽的女人，因为总是带着一副眼镜，所以很出名。也许你可以找到玛丽，看她能不能借我们一个反射面？我记得她从前就住在暮色森林南边……
text.completion: 哦，当然，我以前是有只单眼透镜。$B$B

english.title: Look To The Stars
english.objectives: Locate Mary and persuade her to give up a reflective surface for Viktori's project.
english.description: My gnomish friend, Cog, has promised to help me build a device which will let me peer towards the stars. According to Cog's blueprint, what I need first is a way to reflect light.$B$BI remember a woman by the name of Mary who became well known around these parts for always carrying a looking glass.  Perhaps you can track Mary down and see if she might lend us a reflective surface for this project?  I believe she once resided in southern Duskwood. . .
english.completion: Why yes, I used to own a looking glass.

text.title: 疯狂的食尸鬼
text.objectives: 从疯狂的食尸鬼手中拿回盲眼玛丽的眼镜。
text.description: 那副眼镜是我最心爱的宝贝，直到……那次事故。从那以后，我就把它丢在了谷仓里。那儿经常有只疯狂的食尸鬼在游荡。也许被他捡走了。谣传说那恶魔般的怪物就住在静谧花园墓场。
text.progress: 考格看过我们的观星机器的雏形之後非常满意。你找到合适的反光镜了吗?
text.completion: 太棒了!这面反光镜很有用，非常感谢你!$B$B
text.completed: Return to Viktori Prism'Antras at Darkshire in Duskwood.
text.giverWindow: 眼镜在他的手上，但他已经疯掉了。

english.title: The Insane Ghoul
english.objectives: Retrieve Mary's Looking Glass from the Insane Ghoul.
english.description: The looking glass was one of my finest treasures until. . .the incident.  After that happened, I discarded it behind the barn.  There was an insane ghoul who used to roam back there.  Perhaps he picked it up.  Rumor has it the devilish beast resides in the Tranquil Gardens Cemetery.
english.progress: I showed Cog the beginnings of our star-viewing machine.  He was impressed.  Did you happen to find a reflective device?
english.completion: Most superb!  This will work perfectly.  Many thanks!
english.completed: Return to Viktori Prism'Antras at Darkshire in Duskwood.
english.giverWindow: He carries the looking glass.  Also, he is insane.

text.title: 高级玻璃
text.objectives: 杀掉暮色森林南部食人魔山里的扎克乌尔，取得食人魔的单片眼镜。
text.description: 现在要完成这件装置，还需要一件东西。考格的蓝图上提到了某种镜片。据我所知，只有一种镜片足够大，而想要弄到十分困难。$b$b暮色森林南边的山里住着一名叫做扎克乌尔的食人魔。如果你可以的话，把他的单片眼镜拿给我，我可以用它当镜片。
text.progress: 你有没有说服札克乌尔把他的单片眼镜借给我们做实验?
text.completion: 观星工具终於完成了!谢谢你，$N。现在我可以继续我的研究了……$B$B
text.completed: Return to Viktori Prism'Antras at Darkshire in Duskwood.
text.giverWindow: 石拳氏族的勇士

english.title: Classy Glass
english.objectives: Kill Zzarc'Vul in the southern ogre mound in Duskwood and collect the Ogre Monocle.
english.description: Now there is just one more item needed to complete this device.  Cog's blueprint calls for a lens of some sort.  The only lens I know of that would be large enough will be very difficult to acquire.$b$bThere is an ogre by the name of Zzarc'Vul who resides in the mound in southern Duskwood.  If you can, bring to me his monocle and I will use that as our lens!
english.progress: Were you able to convince Zzarc'Vul to lend us his monocle for our experiment?
english.completion: At last!  The stargazing device is complete!  Thank you, $n.  Now I can continue my research. . .
english.completed: Return to Viktori Prism'Antras at Darkshire in Duskwood.
english.giverWindow: Champion of the Stone Fist Clan.

text.title: 说话的骨头
text.objectives: 夜色镇的指挥官阿尔泰娅·埃伯洛克要你消灭5具骷髅战士和5具骷髅法师。
text.description: 还有更污秽的亡灵需要对付，$n。$B$B镇子更南端的静谧花园墓场，是一个你绝不会想要在晚上去的地方。从地里爬出来的骸骨诡诈得足够回忆起如何挥舞斧头，或是施放法术。$B$B它们究竟有多危险，就不用我来解释了。小心行事，记住，如果你退缩了，那么夜色镇的人民就要受苦。
text.completion: 夜色镇的人民感谢你的帮助，$N。你用行动证明了你是我们守夜人忠实的盟友。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Commander Althea Ebonlocke at Darkshire in Duskwood.

english.title: Bones That Walk
english.objectives: Commander Althea Ebonlocke of Darkshire wants you to kill 5 Skeletal Warriors and 5 Skeletal Mages.
english.description: There's even fouler undead left to deal with, $n.$B$BTranquil Gardens Cemetery, further south of town, is a place you don't want to be caught in at night. The bones that rise from the ground there are cunning enough to remember how to swing an axe or cast a spell.$B$BI shouldn't need to explain how dangerous that makes them. Proceed with caution, but remember the people of Darkshire that will suffer if you falter.
english.completion: The people of Darkshire thank you, $n.  You have proven yourself to be a great ally of The Night Watch.
english.completed: Return to Commander Althea Ebonlocke at Darkshire in Duskwood.

starters.name: 指挥官阿尔泰娅·埃伯洛克

enders.name: 指挥官阿尔泰娅·埃伯洛克

text.title: 塞拉摩的援军
text.objectives: 前往尘泥沼泽的塞拉摩岛，跟兵营的盖兰·维米斯队长谈一谈。
text.description: 霍索恩死了……我唯一的儿子被杀害了……贫瘠之地的局势已经失控，$n。$B$B我得承担起保卫凯旋壁垒的重责，处理相关的一切事务。但是我需要援军。塞拉摩的援军数周前就该抵达这里的！$B$B前往尘泥沼泽的塞拉摩岛，问问盖兰·维米斯队长是怎么回事。沼泽中的道路有那么难走吗？
text.completion: What now, soldier? Reinforcements? For the Barrens? We've been bleeding supplies and men there for months! Does someone need to remind Twinbraid of the attack on Northwatch? Our losses at Honor's Stand? What happened to the men I sent to Triumph Hold? We've nothing to spare! Listen $n, if you want to help out our cause, you'll focus your efforts here in Dustwallow. Between the deserters and the Horde encroachment... we could use a hand.
text.completed: 去尘泥沼泽塞拉摩岛的兵营找盖兰·维米斯队长。

english.title: Reinforcements From Theramore
english.objectives: Travel to Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh and talk to Captain Garran Vimes in the main barracks.
english.description: Hawthorne dead... my own son murdered... the situation in the Barrens is out of control, $n.$B$BI'm going to take charge of Fort Triumph and try to lock things down. To do that, I'm going to need reinforcements. Reinforcements that were promised from Theramore weeks ago!$B$BTravel to Theramore in Dustwallow Marsh and give Captain Garran Vimes an earful. What good is that blasted road through the swamp if the men and materiel aren't rolling in?
english.completion: What now, soldier? Reinforcements? For the Barrens? We've been bleeding supplies and men there for months! Does someone need to remind Twinbraid of the attack on Northwatch? Our losses at Honor's Stand? What happened to the men I sent to Triumph Hold? We've nothing to spare! Listen $n, if you want to help out our cause, you'll focus your efforts here in Dustwallow. Between the deserters and the Horde encroachment... we could use a hand.
english.completed: Travel to Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh and talk to Captain Garran Vimes in the main barracks.

text.title: 林子里的狼人
text.objectives: 在阳光树林里杀死7名夜行狼人。
text.description: 黑暗无情地逼近暮色森林。卡尔文大师的要求是驱逐邪恶和异端。通过我们的努力，夜色镇居民才能得以安全。$b$b你觉得自己够资格加入我们吗？$b$b我曾经也和你有一样的想法。在对守夜人的自鸣得意大失所望后，我加入了卡尔文大师的麾下。如果你愿意证明自己，那就不要光动嘴皮子。$b$b去阳光树林里找夜行狼人来试试你的身手。我们来看看你是不是有本事捕杀这些怪物。
text.completion: Impressive, $n. It would seem that you are capable enough to handle yourself. Perhaps a more suitable challenge could be found for one of your abilities.
text.completed: Return to Calor at Darkshire in Duskwood.

english.title: Worgen in the Woods
english.objectives: Kill 7 Nightbane Worgen in Brightwood Grove.
english.description: Darkness seems drawn inexorably to Duskwood. Master Carevin's quest is the expulsion of evil and heresy. Through our efforts are the people of Darkshire kept safe.$b$bYou believe yourself worthy to join us?$b$bI once thought as you. Disillusioned by the complacency of the Watch, I joined Master Carevin. If you wish to prove yourself, it will not be through words.$b$bTest your skills against the Nightbane worgen in Brightwood Grove. We'll see if you have what it takes to hunt these monsters.
english.completion: Impressive, $n. It would seem that you are capable enough to handle yourself. Perhaps a more suitable challenge could be found for one of your abilities.
english.completed: Return to Calor at Darkshire in Duskwood.

text.title: 烂果园
text.objectives: 在烂果园里杀掉10头夜行织影狼人。
text.description: 狼人的祸害已经从阳光树林里蔓延出来了。在南边，夜色镇边上的烂果园已经成了这些野兽的聚集地。$B$B这里的狼人不但狡猾，$n，而且凶残邪恶。他们会从远处召唤肮脏的阴影将敌人撕成碎片。到烂果园去，杀掉织影狼人，保护镇子的安全！
text.completion: You performed well against the Shadow Weavers, $n. But even now, years after their first arrival, there seem to be so many to replace the ones we kill. I will put my faith in Master Carevin. No doubt he will get to the bottom of the problem.
text.completed: Return to Calor at Darkshire in Duskwood.

english.title: The Rotting Orchard
english.objectives: Kill 10 Nightbane Shadow Weavers at the Rotting Orchard.
english.description: The worgen infestation stretches further than Brightwood Grove. To the south, on the very edges of Darkshire itself, the Rotting Orchard is host to even more of the savage beasts.$B$BThe worgen there are more cunning, $n, but just as savage and evil. They conjure foul shadows to tear their enemies apart from a distance. Go to the Rotting Orchard, and slay the Shadow Weavers to keep the town safe!
english.completion: You performed well against the Shadow Weavers, $n. But even now, years after their first arrival, there seem to be so many to replace the ones we kill. I will put my faith in Master Carevin. No doubt he will get to the bottom of the problem.
english.completed: Return to Calor at Darkshire in Duskwood.

text.title: 邪齿和堕落
text.objectives: 在罗兰之墓杀掉8头夜行邪齿狼人和8头夜行堕落狼人。
text.description: 你之前的成功让我相信，你已经做好了准备，可以对付林子里最强大的狼人。$b$b在这里安家的狼人里，邪齿狼人和堕落狼人是最危险的。他们在附近的洞穴，以及南部的矿洞里驻扎了下来。$b$b即便是在很远的地方，你也能看见他们营火的光亮……
text.completion: $N，实话说吧，我没想到你能做得这麽好，你显然是个出类拔萃的$C。嗯，如果你想正式加入卡尔文主人的队伍，我很乐意为你写一封推荐信。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Calor at Darkshire in Duskwood.

english.title: Vile and Tainted
english.objectives: Kill 8 Nightbane Vile Fangs and 8 Nightbane Tainted Ones in Roland's Doom.
english.description: Your previous accomplishments have convinced me that you are ready to take on the toughest worgen infesting the woods.$b$bOf the worgen that have made their new home here, the Vile Fangs and the Tainted Ones have proven the most dangerous. They've settled down near some of the caves and in the mine to the south.$b$bFrom far away you can even see the light from their bonfires...
english.completion: $n, to be honest with you, I did not believe that you would get this far, but you are clearly a $c to be reckoned with. In fact, if you wish to formally join Master Carevin's struggle, I will gladly write for you a letter of recommendation.
english.completed: Return to Calor at Darkshire in Duskwood.

text.title: 林子里的狼人
text.objectives: 将卡洛尔的便笺交给乔纳森·卡尔文。
text.description: 给你，$n。把这个消息带给卡尔文大师。$b$b<他迅速地抽出一张褪色的羊皮纸递给你。>$b$b再多几个你这样的人，我们就能征服守夜人！也许我们几个今天所展开的工作，到那时候就能完成了。
text.progress: 嗯，有什麽事吗?请快一点，我还有紧急的事情要处理。
text.completion: 对不起，我刚才冷落你了，$N，不过你肯定能看出我非常忙。你已经得到了卡洛尔的赞许，他还特意为你写了推荐信─我可以肯定地说，你所做的决不仅仅是鸡毛蒜皮的小事。$B$B我们现在的处境相当危险，$N，任何人的帮助对我们都很宝贵。我们要抗击恶魔、不死生物，以及所有与他们为伍的人。你要非常小心谨慎地行事，不要相信任何不愿向我们伸出援手的人。$B$B为了圣光的荣耀，我们一定要战斗到底。$B$B

english.title: Worgen in the Woods
english.objectives: Bring Calor's note to Jonathan Carevin.
english.description: Here you go, $n. Bring this message to Master Carevin.$b$b<He quickly removes a piece of faded parchment and offers it to you.>$b$bA few more like you, and we will outnumber the Night Watch! Perhaps then we could complete the work that we few carry on today.
english.progress: Yes, what is it? Make it quick, I've pressing matters to attend to.
english.completion: Excuse me for my cold reception, $n, but as I'm sure you can tell, I am an extremely busy man. I see that you have impressed Calor--and I assure you, that is no small feat--and that he has given his recommendation. There are unsavory types afoot, $n, and we can use the help of all who have proven themselves. We battle against demons, the undead, and those who would provide them aid. Be vigilant, be wary, and trust none who would not give aid to our cause. Glory under the Light.

text.title: 暗皮大灭绝
text.objectives: 击败20只暗皮豺狼人。
text.description: 既然止水湖南面的黑石兽人已经灰飞烟灭了，我们可以把注意力转向北面加拉德尔山谷的暗皮豺狼人军队了。$B$B我要你去把他们都杀掉，$n！行动任务：灭绝，士兵。为了B连，为了联盟！
text.completion: We're closing in on the Blackrock high command. There's nowhere left for those dogs to run.
text.completed: Return to Danforth at Shalewind Canyon in Redridge.

english.title: Shadowhide Extinction
english.objectives: Kill any 20 Shadowhide Gnolls.
english.description: Now that every Blackrock orc south of Lake Everstill is nothing more than ash and cinder, we can turn our attention to the Shadowhide gnoll army of Galardell Valley, directly north of here.$B$BI want you to head out there and kill 'em all, $n! Initiate Operation: Extinction, soldier. For Bravo Company and for the Alliance!
english.completion: We're closing in on the Blackrock high command. There's nowhere left for those dogs to run.
english.completed: Return to Danforth at Shalewind Canyon in Redridge.

text.title: 黑暗之塔
text.objectives: 获得伊尔加拉之匙。
text.description: 我们很走运，山谷里的本地人有重要情报。我们身后的这两位是兰萨尔兄弟，他们告诉我说，控制加拉德尔山谷豺狼人的是伊尔加拉之塔里的一个强大的大法师。问题在于，那座塔被魔法力场封锁了。$B$B我们要做的第一件事就是要拿到钥匙，让你进去。豺狼人将军范高雷有你要的入场券。杀死他拿到钥匙。$B$B我会再联络的。
text.progress: I hear you loud and clear, $n.
text.completion: Now that the easy part is over, it's time for phase two.
text.completed: Speak with John J. Keeshan at Shalewind Canyon in Redridge.

english.title: The Dark Tower
english.objectives: Recover the Key of Ilgalar.
english.description: We got lucky with some vital intelligence from the locals of this valley. Those two behind us, the Ranthals, have informed me that the gnolls in Galardell Valley are being controlled by a powerful magus in the tower of Ilgalar. The problem is that the tower is sealed by a magical force field.$B$BThe first thing we need to do is get the key that will get you inside. The gnoll general, Fangore, has your ticket inside. Kill General Fangore and get the key.$B$BI'll be in touch.
english.progress: I hear you loud and clear, $n.
english.completion: Now that the easy part is over, it's time for phase two.
english.completed: Speak with John J. Keeshan at Shalewind Canyon in Redridge.

text.title: 大魔导师杜内
text.objectives: 杀死大魔导师杜内。
text.description: <B连战地工具振动了起来。>$B$B干得好，孩子。我有一些重要情报要告诉你。塔里的大法师是个名叫杜内的人类。这该死的叛徒居然为黑石兽人卖命。我要他死。$B$B用伊尔加拉之匙进到塔里去。想办法登上塔顶，让杜内瞧瞧B连是怎么对付叛徒的。$B$B完事之后回到岩页峡谷同我汇合。$B$B基沙恩通话完毕。
text.completion: He teleported away? Mentioned Darkblaze? What the hell is going on here. Looks like it's time to strap in and finish this nonsense.
text.completed: Speak with John J. Keeshan at Shalewind Canyon in Redridge.
text.giverWindow: 该让一个大法师像个小姑娘哭哭啼啼的了。别告诉梅森纳这是我说的。

english.title: The Grand Magus Doane
english.objectives: Kill Grand Magus Doane.
english.description: <The Bravo Company field kit vibrates.>$B$BGood work, kid. I've got some vital intel for you. The magus in the tower is a human named Doane. Damned traitor is working for the Blackrock orcs. I want him dead.$B$BUse the key of Ilgalar and get inside that tower. Work your way to the top and show Doane what Bravo Company does with traitors.$B$BRendezvous back at Shalewind Canyon when the deed is done.$B$BKeeshan, over and out.
english.completion: He teleported away? Mentioned Darkblaze? What the hell is going on here. Looks like it's time to strap in and finish this nonsense.
english.completed: Speak with John J. Keeshan at Shalewind Canyon in Redridge.
english.giverWindow: Time to make a magus cry like the little girl that he is. Don't tell Messner I said that.

text.title: 准备起飞
text.objectives: 获得藏宝海湾港务局的纳尔克的手雷。
text.description: 我有个点子，不过可能要让你跑跑腿。作为一个地精财阀，黑水强盗手上有不少炸药。事实上，我知道咱们的老朋友纳尔克在店的后头就藏着一箱，就在港务局。$b$b去把东西给我拿来，假如它们还没炸的话。
text.progress: You're still alive?
text.completion: You brought them!  I'm beginning to think the tide is turning in our favor, $n.
text.completed: Return to Baron Revilgaz at Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

english.title: Prepare for Takeoff
english.objectives: Obtain Narkk's Handbombs from the Old Port Authority inside Booty Bay.
english.description: I've got an idea, but it's going to involve some footwork on your part.  As a goblin cartel, the Blackwater Raiders have a lot of explosives on hand.  In fact, I know for a fact that our old friend Narkk keeps a case in the back of his shop, in the Old Port Authority.$b$bGo grab them and bring them here, if they haven't already exploded.
english.progress: You're still alive?
english.completion: You brought them!  I'm beginning to think the tide is turning in our favor, $n.
english.completed: Return to Baron Revilgaz at Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

text.title: 卡利姆多的召唤
text.objectives: 从藏宝海湾坐船去棘齿城，然后跟加兹鲁维谈一谈。
text.description: 嘿，你有没有见过这么长的一条鱼？短鳍的？蓝色的？听到史蒂夫这名字会有反应的？$b$b算了，我接着找吧。$b$b事实上……我来藏宝海湾这里还有一个理由。尘泥沼泽的克罗格老板正在寻找新鲜血液。得有人帮我们保护巨槌食人魔不被灭了。你看起来挺壮的。$b$b到码头边上去等下一班船吧，然后坐到棘齿城去。在那里，加兹鲁维会帮助你的。$b$b史蒂夫？史蒂夫！
text.completion: Yeah?  What can I do for ya?
text.completed: 去找北贫瘠之地棘齿城的加兹鲁维。

english.title: The Call of Kalimdor
english.objectives: Ride the ship from Booty Bay to Ratchet, then speak with Gazlowe.
english.description: Say, you haven't seen a fish about this long?  Short fins?  Responds to the name Steve?  He's blue?$b$bNever mind, I'll keep looking.$b$bActually... there was another reason I came here to Booty Bay.  Boss Krog, over in Dustwallow, is looking for new blood.  Someone to help us Stonemaul from getting overrun.  You look strong enough.$b$bWait on the edge of the pier for the next ship, then ride to Ratchet.  Gazlowe should be able to help you from there.$b$bSteve?  Steve!
english.completion: Yeah?  What can I do for ya?
english.completed: Report to Gazlowe at Ratchet in Northern Barrens.

text.title: 急浪的终航
text.objectives: 跟藏宝海湾的科博克交谈，乘坐大胆的驭风者。然后用手雷消灭85名急浪船员并摧毁6艘急浪攻击艇。
text.description: 这些凶残的狼人海盗源源不断地从北方涌进港口，咱们是没法儿挺过来的。好在，他们似乎没有装备大炮，所以要是我们能把你送出港，你就能从空中攻打他们。$b$b部落的飞行管理员科博克就在转弯角那儿。跟他谈谈，让他知道你需要征用他最勇敢的双足飞龙。$b$b带些手雷，你得用它们阻止那些攻击艇！
text.completion: I hope those mongrels know how to doggy paddle! Actually, I take that back.
text.completed: Return to Baron Revilgaz at Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

english.title: The Final Voyage of the Brashtide
english.objectives: Speak with Kebok in Booty Bay to board a Bold Wind Rider.  Then use the handbombs to destroy kill 85 Brashtide Crewmen and destroy 6 Brashtide Attack Boats.
english.description: We'll never survive this attack with all these worgen pirates pouring into the harbor from the north.  Luckily, it looks like they're not armed with cannons, so if we can get you out of the harbor, you can attack from the skies.$b$bKebok, the Horde flight master's assistant, is right around the corner.  Talk to him and let him know that you're going to need his bravest wind rider.$b$bBring a couple armloads of handbombs with you.  You'll need all of them to stop those attack boats!
english.completion: I hope those mongrels know how to doggy paddle! Actually, I take that back.
english.completed: Return to Baron Revilgaz at Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

text.title: 寻找海角
text.objectives: 去找藏宝海湾的舰队指挥官海角。
text.description: 急浪打进来的时候，海角抓起手边的武器就跳下去了。你应该可以在下面找到他——他多半正在那些杂种的脑袋上戳窟窿眼呢。$b$b去帮帮他。我在这儿先忍着。
text.completion: I should have known these Brashtide were alive and up to no good.  I'd written them off years ago.

english.title: Seeking Seahorn
english.objectives: Report to Fleet Master Seahorn in Booty Bay.
english.description: When the Brashtide pulled in, Seahorn grabbed the nearest weapon he could find and jumped off the ledge here.  You'll find him down below, probably pounding new holes into those worgen's skulls.$b$bHelp him out down there.  I can handle the motivation from up here.
english.completion: I should have known these Brashtide were alive and up to no good.  I'd written them off years ago.

text.title: 逆转急浪
text.objectives: 消灭10名藏宝海湾的急浪强夺者。
text.description: 到处都是急浪的人！恐怕大财主的藏宝海湾地精卫兵双拳难敌四手。$b$b你既然要下去大展拳脚，干嘛不帮我把他们除掉些呢？$b$b等你搞定了，也别麻烦回来找我。我可能会很忙的。
text.completion: We need to keep moving, $n.  Booty Bay won't hold out for much longer.
text.completed: Return to Baron Revilgaz at Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

english.title: Turning the Brashtide
english.objectives: Kill 10 Brashtide Raiders in Booty Bay.
english.description: The Brashtide are everywhere!  The Baron's Booty Bay Bruisers are no match for their sheer numbers, I'm afraid.$b$bWhile you're down here in the fray, why don't you help me get rid of a few of them?$b$bWhen you're done, don't bother coming back here.  I'll probably be pretty busy.
english.completion: We need to keep moving, $n.  Booty Bay won't hold out for much longer.
english.completed: Return to Baron Revilgaz at Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

text.title: 少女之（恶）运
text.objectives: 消灭8名藏宝海湾的血帆海盗。
text.description: 我听说这艘船的名字叫少女之运号。你不曾是她的船长吗？那你肯定对里面熟。$b$b急浪仍是我们目前主要的心腹之患，但我们不想遭受不必要的火炮打击。抓好我后面的绳子，干掉那些恶形恶相的血帆海盗。完事后去跟大财主报告。
text.completion: Attacking your former crewmen... You really have grown into a real pirate, $n!
text.completed: Return to Baron Revilgaz at Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

english.title: The Damsel's (Bad) Luck
english.objectives: Kill 8 Bloodsail Corsairs in Booty Bay.
english.description: I heard that this ship here is the Damsel's Luck.  Didn't you used to be the captain of that thing?  You must know your way around it, then.$b$bThe Brashtide are our main concern, but we still don't want to take an unnecessary pummeling from those cannons of theirs.  Grab this rope behind me and take out some of those angry-looking corsairs.  Check in with the Baron when you're done.
english.completion: Attacking your former crewmen... You really have grown into a real pirate, $n!
english.completed: Return to Baron Revilgaz at Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

text.title: 飞往蕨墙
text.objectives: 跟棘齿城的布拉高克谈一谈，飞往蕨墙村。然后去找克罗格。
text.description: 听着，我对部落不是特别喜欢……但话又说回来，我也不怎么讨厌你们。$b$b你们的金币和别人的没什么区别。$b$b那两个脑袋的食人魔和他的宠物鱼给了我一点钱作为你的盘缠。我相信你在尘泥沼泽要找的人名字叫做克罗格。去那儿最好的办法就是跟我们的飞行管理员布拉高克谈谈。你愿意的话，他会让你飞过去。是免费的，这还得多谢你的那位朋友。
text.completion: Lok'tar, $r.  Welcome to Brackenwall.
text.completed: 去找尘泥沼泽蕨墙村的克罗格。

english.title: Flight to Brackenwall
english.objectives: Speak with Bragok in Ratchet to fly to Brackenwall Village.  Then report to Krog.
english.description: Listen, I got no special love for the Horde... but then again, I got no real hate for you guys either.$b$bYour gold is as good as anyone else's.$b$bThat two-headed ogre and his pet fish left some gold for your travel costs.  I believe the person you're looking for in Dustwallow goes by the name of Krog.  And the best way to get there is to talk to our flight master, Bragok.  He'll fly you there, if you want.  The flight's free, thanks to your friend.
english.completion: Lok'tar, $r.  Welcome to Brackenwall.
english.completed: Report to Krog at Brackenwall Village in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: 飞往塞拉摩
text.objectives: 跟棘齿城的布拉高克谈一谈，飞往塞拉摩。然后去找加莉亚·哈斯汀。
text.description: 听着，我对联盟不是特别喜欢……但话又说回来，我也不怎么讨厌你们。$b$b你们的金币和别人的没什么区别。有时候还更好。$b$b杰妮给了我一点钱作为你的盘缠。我相信你在尘泥沼泽要找的人名字叫做加莉亚·哈斯汀。去那儿最好的办法就是跟我们的飞行管理员布拉高克谈谈。你愿意的话，他会让你飞过去。是免费的，这还得多谢你的那位朋友。
text.completion: 欢迎来到塞拉摩。
text.completed: 跟尘泥沼泽塞拉摩的加莉亚·哈斯汀谈一谈。

english.title: Flight to Theramore
english.objectives: Speak with Bragok in Ratchet to fly to Theramore.  Then report to Calia Hastings.
english.description: Listen, I got no special love for the Alliance... but then again, I got no real hate for you guys either.$b$bYour gold is as good as anyone else's.  Sometimes better.$b$bJeyne left some gold for your travel costs.  I believe the person you're looking for in Dustwallow goes by the name of Calia Hastings.  And the best way to get there is to talk to our flight master, Bragok.  He'll fly you there, if you want.  The flight's free, thanks to your friend.
english.completion: Welcome to Theramore.
english.completed: Speak with Calia Hastings at Theramore in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: 血帆的末日
text.objectives: 跟藏宝海湾的科博克谈一谈，乘双足飞龙去杀掉舰队指挥官菲尔拉伦。
text.description: 我们基本上胜券在握了，这绝大部分要归功于你。不过，还有一件未竟的任务……杀掉舰队指挥官菲尔拉伦。$b$b看上去菲尔拉伦的船员好像是死得差不多了，但我太熟悉这个老水手了，他不会就此罢休的。不，他打算负隅顽抗，同船共存亡。$b$b再去跟科博克谈谈，找条双足飞龙。你登舰的时候我会想法吸引火力的。
text.completion: $n!  You're awake!  We found you bobbing in the harbor, shortly after the remaining attackers had turned tail.  We were worried about you for a while there... I've been meaning to thank you, $n.  Not only did you provide us with the intelligence to prepare for this attack, but you helped fight off the Bloodsail AND the Brashtide.  Your name will always be remembered here in Booty Bay. We here in Booty Bay pride ourselves on our booty.  Care to take first pick?
text.completed: Return to Baron Revilgaz at Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
text.giverWindow: 是时候和血帆算总账了。杀死菲尔拉伦。

english.title: Bloodsail's End
english.objectives: Speak with Kebok in Booty Bay to get a wind rider, then kill Fleet Master Firallon.
english.description: We've nearly won the day, largely thanks to you.  One task remains, however... kill Fleet Master Firallon.$b$bIt looks like most of Firallon's crew is already dead, but I know that old sea dog well enough to know that he's not done yet.  No, he's cooped up tight in his cabin, ready to go down with his ship.$b$bSpeak with Kebok again to get a wind rider.  I'll try to hold off the cannonfire while you're on board.
english.completion: $n!  You're awake!  We found you bobbing in the harbor, shortly after the remaining attackers had turned tail.  We were worried about you for a while there... I've been meaning to thank you, $n.  Not only did you provide us with the intelligence to prepare for this attack, but you helped fight off the Bloodsail AND the Brashtide.  Your name will always be remembered here in Booty Bay. We here in Booty Bay pride ourselves on our booty.  Care to take first pick?
english.completed: Return to Baron Revilgaz at Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
english.giverWindow: It's time to end the Bloodsail, once and for all.  Kill Firallon.

objectiveDetails.description: 杀死舰队指挥官菲尔拉伦

text.title: 最后的较量
text.objectives: 听从托比亚斯的号令跃上角鹰兽，摧毁部落炮艇。
text.description: 只有击落那艘飞艇，我们才有逃命的机会。$B$B我有个计划。过去，覆舟海湾有一些支持反叛军的人。因此我曾设法从仓库里拿到了大量燃烧弹。$B$B我们需要某种小巧的飞行工具，在不惊动敌人的情况下给予他们致命一击。暗夜精灵的角鹰兽是个不错的选择。$B$B准备就绪后，就听从托比亚斯的号令吧。
text.progress: The only risks worth taking are the ones that lead to victories worth having.
text.completion: We did it, $n.  We've started the evacuation.  If we leave soon we'll leave the Forsaken fleet in the dust.
text.completed: Return to Lorna Crowley at Keel Harbor in Gilneas.

english.title: Endgame
english.objectives: Jump on a Hippogryph when Tobias signals you and destroy the Horde Gunship.
english.description: We need to get rid of that flying gunship if our people have any chance of escaping.$B$BHere's the plan.  Keel Harbor had its share of rebel sympathizers in the old days.  I've managed to round up a hefty amount of incendiary explosives from one of our storehouses.$B$BWe're going to hit the enemy with a force small enough to fly undetected.  The night elf hippogryphs should do the trick.$B$BTobias will give you the signal when we're ready to go.
english.progress: The only risks worth taking are the ones that lead to victories worth having.
english.completion: We did it, $n.  We've started the evacuation.  If we leave soon we'll leave the Forsaken fleet in the dust.
english.completed: Return to Lorna Crowley at Keel Harbor in Gilneas.

text.title: 致命的植物
text.objectives: 采集5根乱坟草。
text.description: 我需要大量的乱坟草，用在哈里斯大师的药剂上。这种植物很难入手，但我们不能断绝其供应。$B$B乱坟草缠人的劲头很足……要是不当心的话，你在明白怎么回事之前它就能把你缠住！如果你愿意帮忙的话，我将十分乐意为你收集到的乱坟草支付报酬。$B$B你可以在东南边的约根农场那儿找到很多。
text.progress: Do you have the corpseweed?
text.completion: I thank you, $c... and I'm sure the worgen that may be returned to sanity with the potion this will make would thank you too.
text.completed: Return to Apprentice Fess in Duskwood.

english.title: A Deadly Vine
english.objectives: Collect 5 pieces of Corpseweed.
english.description: I need large amounts of corpseweed for Master Harris's concoctions. It's difficult to obtain, but we can't let our supply dwindle.$B$BCorpseweed is tough stuff to tangle with... the plant will get you before you get it, if you're not careful! But if you'd like to help out, I'll eagerly pay you for any you gather yourself.$B$BYou'll find plenty of it all over the Yorgen Stead to the southeast.
english.progress: Do you have the corpseweed?
english.completion: I thank you, $c... and I'm sure the worgen that may be returned to sanity with the potion this will make would thank you too.
english.completed: Return to Apprentice Fess in Duskwood.

text.title: 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！
text.objectives: 用B连攻城坦克消灭200个黑石士兵。
text.description: 我是来帮你和B连收拾这个烂摊子的。你得驾驶B连攻城坦克清出一条通往基沙恩的哨站的路来，它就在北边，山谷的另一头。$B$B目前的情况需要高度戒备，黑石兽人已经掌握了你的位置，并派大部队前来阻击你。将他们全部消灭。$B$B咱们另一边见。愿圣光怜悯你的灵魂。
text.completion: The only thing left to deal with now are the orcs holding out at Stonewatch Keep.
text.completed: Speak with Colonel Troteman at Keeshan's Post in Redridge.

english.title: AHHHHHHHHHHHH! AHHHHHHHHH!!!
english.objectives: Use the Bravo Company Siege Tank to kill 200 Blackrock soldiers.
english.description: I'm here to help you and Bravo Company end this mess. You're to get in the Bravo Company siege tank and clear a path to Keeshan's Post on the other side of the valley, north of here.$B$BThis is a high alert situation soldier as the Blackrock orcs are now aware of your location and sending a large force to meet you head on. Terminate them all with extreme prejudice.$B$BI'll see you on the other side. May the Light have mercy on your soul.
english.completion: The only thing left to deal with now are the orcs holding out at Stonewatch Keep.
english.completed: Speak with Colonel Troteman at Keeshan's Post in Redridge.

text.title: 石之王座
text.objectives: 去找塞拉赞恩的王座的塞拉赞恩。
text.description: 我要回我的王座了。我不想再见到任何一个大地之环的人了，但你是个例外，$r。假如你愿意帮助我们重建我们的国度，也许我们也可以帮你。$B$B时间会检验一切。
text.completion: You returned. This is good. The Stone Lords have been asking after you.

english.title: The Stone Throne
english.objectives: Seek out Therazane at Therazane's Throne.
english.description: I am returning to my throne. I've no desire to see any more of these Earthen Ring, but you remain welcome here, $r. If you wish to help us rebuild our realm, perhaps we can help you in return.$B$BAll things in time.
english.completion: You returned. This is good. The Stone Lords have been asking after you.

text.title: 迷失在深渊中
text.objectives: 在碎岩之渊中找到佩波，并带着他安全地离开隧道。
text.description: 佩波又失踪了，大约是在碎岩之渊中的某处。$B$B他很幸运，他的个头不足以引起那些掠石虫的注意，但用不了多久他就会过于靠近某条虫子，然后被吃掉。无论他想去干什么，都不值得为此送了命。$B$B他好像挺喜欢你的。请你去找到他，把他带出那些隧道，到更安全的地方去。
text.completion: You've done well. Now that these are rocklings are free to learn our ways, they will grow tall and strong. One day, we will extinguish the gyreworm infestation from our realm, and these rocklings shall no longer be plagued in their youth.
text.completed: Return to the Pyrite Stonetender at Therazane's Throne.

english.title: Lost In The Deeps
english.objectives: Find Pebble within the Crumbling Depths and lead him safely out of the tunnels.
english.description: Pebble has gotten himself lost again, somewhere deep in the Crumbling Depths.$B$BHe's fortunate that his size makes him unworthy of the effort for those gyreworms, but it's only a matter of time before he stumbles too close to one and gets eaten. Whatever he's so intent on down there is certainly not worth it.$B$BHe seems to like you. Please, go and find him and bring him out of those tunnels to safer playing grounds.
english.completion: You've done well. Now that these are rocklings are free to learn our ways, they will grow tall and strong. One day, we will extinguish the gyreworm infestation from our realm, and these rocklings shall no longer be plagued in their youth.
english.completed: Return to the Pyrite Stonetender at Therazane's Throne.

text.title: 前往银行
text.objectives: 跟科赞岛上科赞第一银行的第一银行柜台员谈一谈。
text.description: 嗨，宝贝儿。嗯？你准备好举行聚会了？$B$B不行？！你知道的，我很爱你，我其实不想说的，但是你自己看看……我觉得吧，你应该冲到镇上，买一身新行头。$B$B别那样看着我……你也希望穿得漂漂亮亮的对吧？难道你不想光彩照人地出席聚会吗，哪怕是为了我？我毕竟是你的男朋友啊！$B$B先去银行取上几大捆杏仁币吧。便宜货可配不上你！
text.completion: Oh, it's you, ma'am! Sorry, I didn't recognize you at first with all of these commoners milling about. You people cool your heels! $n is here! Here are your macaroons, ma'am. Come back anytime if you need more.

english.title: Off to the Bank
english.objectives: Speak with the FBoK Bank Teller at the First Bank of Kezan on Kezan.
english.description: Yo, baby. Wassup? You ready for the party?$B$BNo?! You know I love you, so I don't know how to say this, but check it... I think you need to swing into town to buy a new outfit for the party.$B$BDon't look at me like that... you want to look gooood, right? Don't you want to look super fine for me? I am your boyfriend after all!$B$BSwing by the bank first and pull out plenty of macaroons. You don't want to buy any of that cheap stuff!
english.completion: Oh, it's you, ma'am! Sorry, I didn't recognize you at first with all of these commoners milling about. You people cool your heels! $n is here! Here are your macaroons, ma'am. Come back anytime if you need more.

text.title: 前往银行
text.objectives: 跟科赞岛上科赞第一银行的第一银行柜台员谈一谈。
text.description: 嗨，宝贝儿。嗯？你准备好举行聚会了？$B$B不行？！你知道的，我很爱你。我觉得吧，你应该冲到镇上，买一身新行头。$B$B别那样看着我……你也希望穿得风度翩翩的对吧？难道你不想光鲜体面地出席聚会吗，哪怕是为了我？我毕竟是你的女朋友啊！$B$B先去银行取上几大捆杏仁币吧。别买便宜货！
text.completion: Oh, it's you, sir! Sorry, I didn't recognize you at first with all of these commoners milling about. You people cool your heels! $n is here! Here are your macaroons, sir. Come back anytime if you need more.

english.title: Off to the Bank
english.objectives: Speak with the FBoK Bank Teller at the First Bank of Kezan on Kezan.
english.description: Hi, babe. Are you ready for the party?$B$BNo?! You know I love you, right? I think you need to swing into town and buy a new outfit for the party.$B$BDon't look at me like that... you want to look your best? Don't you want to look good for me? I am your girlfriend after all!$B$BMake sure you swing by the bank first and pull out plenty of macaroons. Don't buy any of that cheap stuff!
english.completion: Oh, it's you, sir! Sorry, I didn't recognize you at first with all of these commoners milling about. You people cool your heels! $n is here! Here are your macaroons, sir. Come back anytime if you need more.

text.title: 决战石堡要塞
text.objectives: 干掉萨瑞尔祖恩和加塞尔佐格。
text.description: 现在就剩黑石的指挥官们了，$n。他们现在都躲进了石堡要塞，从这里一直向南就能看见那地方。我要你和其他的B连战士冲进石堡要塞，彻底粉碎这次黑石兽人的入侵。$B$B$n，一个活口也别留。
text.completion: Come in, $n. Are you there? If you can hear me: Blackrock has the upper hand. I repeat. Blackrock has the upper hand. GET BRAVO COMPANY OUT OF TH...
text.completed: Speak with Colonel Troteman at Keeshan's Post in Redridge.

english.title: Showdown at Stonewatch
english.objectives: Kill Tharil'zun and Gath'Ilzogg.
english.description: Only the Blackrock high command remains, $n. They're all holed up in Stonewatch Keep, directly south of our position here at Keeshan's Post. I want you and the rest of Bravo Company to enter Stonewatch and put an end to the Blackrock orc invasion.$B$B$n, no survivors.
english.completion: Come in, $n. Are you there? If you can hear me: Blackrock has the upper hand. I repeat. Blackrock has the upper hand. GET BRAVO COMPANY OUT OF TH...
english.completed: Speak with Colonel Troteman at Keeshan's Post in Redridge.

text.title: 黑暗烈焰，灭世者的子嗣
text.objectives: 使用召唤号角来召唤黑暗烈焰，并击败它。
text.description: 托德曼的声音戛然而止，周围的世界随之陷入了死寂。你在远处看见了一条成年的黑龙！
text.completion: They died in defense of the Alliance. In defense of our kingdom! Heroes, all of them, and they will be laid to rest as such.
text.completed: Report to Colonel Troteman at Keeshan's Post in Redridge.
text.giverWindow: 黑暗烈焰必须死！

english.title: Darkblaze, Brood of the Worldbreaker
english.objectives: Use the Horn of Summoning to call for Darkblaze. Defeat Darkblaze.
english.description: As Troteman cuts out, the world around you grows eerily silent. In the distance you see a full grown black dragon!
english.completion: They died in defense of the Alliance. In defense of our kingdom! Heroes, all of them, and they will be laid to rest as such.
english.completed: Report to Colonel Troteman at Keeshan's Post in Redridge.
english.giverWindow: Darkblaze must die!

text.title: 玛法里奥·怒风
text.objectives: 跟达纳苏斯月神殿的玛法里奥·怒风谈一谈。
text.description: 我向玛法里奥提起过你要来。他似乎非常想要亲自见你。$B$B你应该去月神殿找他。他就站在我们敬爱的泰兰德·语风身边，他归来之后就一直在这个位置上尽职尽责。$B$B我必须提醒你……玛法里奥有他自己的保留意见。你作为你们人民的代表，跟他会晤可谓责任重大。

english.title: Malfurion Stormrage
english.objectives: Speak to Malfurion Stormrage in the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.
english.description: I've spoken to Malfurion of your coming. He seemed very interested in meeting you himself.$B$BYou should go to him in the Temple of the Moon. You'll find him standing beside our beloved Tyrande Whisperwind, where he's remained diligently ever since his return.$B$BI must warn you... Malfurion has his reservations. You may be carrying a great burden for your people by being the one to meet with him.

text.title: A Bit of Privacy
text.objectives: Meet Malfurion Stormrage in the Temple Garden in Darnassus.
text.description: I greatly wish to speak with you, but I'd prefer a more intimate environment. One where we might have a bit of privacy from prying ears.$B$BIf you would, meet me in the Temple Garden in just a moment.

english.title: A Bit of Privacy
english.objectives: Meet Malfurion Stormrage in the Temple Garden in Darnassus.
english.description: I greatly wish to speak with you, but I'd prefer a more intimate environment. One where we might have a bit of privacy from prying ears.$B$BIf you would, meet me in the Temple Garden in just a moment.

text.title: 约根狼人
text.objectives: 检查约根农场的一堆松散的泥土。
text.description: 我的同胞们在乌鸦岭致力于治疗这片森林里的野生狼人。情况本身无法好转，但那些还没有深陷疯狂的狼人，依然能够恢复理智。$B$B尽管大多数狼人已经没救了，我们还是密切注意着他们的意志，看其中是否有一星半点的希望……能让他们回到过去的生活。$B$B我曾看见一名孤独的狼人徘徊在约根农场，在建筑之间挖起一堆土来……你能不能去查看一下那个土堆，看他有没有留下什么东西？
text.completion: Sounds like a close call! But he ran off without harming you further... He might be still fighting it. Master Harris must know!
text.completed: Return to Apprentice Fess in Duskwood.

english.title: The Yorgen Worgen
english.objectives: Examine the Mound of Loose Dirt at the Yorgen Farmstead.
english.description: My kinsmen at Raven Hill are concerned with curing the feral worgen in these forests. The condition itself cannot be lifted, but sanity can be restored to those not too far gone.$B$BWhile most here have proven beyond help, we keep an eye out for those that retain vestiges of their minds... attachments to their old lives.$B$BI've seen a lone worgen lurking the Yorgen Farmstead, digging in a pile of dirt between the buildings...could you check out that pile and see if he's left anything?
english.completion: Sounds like a close call! But he ran off without harming you further... He might be still fighting it. Master Harris must know!
english.completed: Return to Apprentice Fess in Duskwood.

text.title: Breadcrumb to Badlands
text.description: Something bad happened.

english.title: Breadcrumb to Badlands
english.description: Something bad happened.

text.title: 给哈里斯大师的货物
text.objectives: 将一捆乱坟草交给乌鸦岭的奥利弗·哈里斯。
text.description: 必须立刻把这个消息通知给哈里斯大师。$B$B给，沿着路走，把这包乱坟草送到乌鸦岭的营地里去。告诉他我们在约根农场所看到的事情。
text.progress: What brings you out this way, my good $gsir:lady;?
text.completion: Welcome to our humble camp. I wouldn't call it pleasant, but it's at least somewhat private. Beg your pardon? A worgen at the farm?

english.title: Delivery to Master Harris
english.objectives: Deliver the Bundle of Corpseweed to Oliver Harris at Raven Hill.
english.description: Master Harris will want to know of this immediately.$B$BHere, take this package of corpseweed down the road to the camp at Raven Hill. Tell him what we saw at the Yorgen Stead.
english.progress: What brings you out this way, my good $gsir:lady;?
english.completion: Welcome to our humble camp. I wouldn't call it pleasant, but it's at least somewhat private. Beg your pardon? A worgen at the farm?

text.title: 我们无法解除的诅咒
text.objectives: 在腐草农场寻找潜伏的狼人，用哈瑞斯的针剂让他镇静下来。
text.description: 我们所做的并非治疗。变形一旦发生就无法逆转。但心智……$B$B如果心智被损害的部分不是很多，通过炼金术，还是可以恢复的。你遇到的狼人似乎还在挣扎着保持理智，$n。我们必须再次将他找到。$B$B如果他逃离了约根农场，就到南边的腐草农场找找看，他也许就藏在其中一幢建筑里。$B$B给他注射这针剂，让他镇静下来。你得离得很近才行。
text.completion: You've got him! No time to lose, then. We'll prepare to administer the serum right away. JITTERS! Get ready!
text.completed: Return to Oliver Harris at Raven Hill in Duskwood.
text.giverWindow: 使用哈瑞斯的针剂使他平静下来。

english.title: A Curse We Cannot Lift
english.objectives: Search the Addle Stead for the Lurking Worgen and use Harris's Ampule to tranquilize it.
english.description: What we do here is not a cure. The transformation cannot be removed once inflicted. But the mind...$B$BThe mind can be restored, through alchemy,  if enough is left intact. This worgen you've encountered sounds like he's fighting to stay aware, $n. We've got to find him again.$B$BIf he's fled the Yorgen Stead, search the Addle Stead to the south; he may be lurking in one of the buildings.$B$BInject him with this ampule to tranquilize him. You'll need to be quite close.
english.completion: You've got him! No time to lose, then. We'll prepare to administer the serum right away. JITTERS! Get ready!
english.completed: Return to Oliver Harris at Raven Hill in Duskwood.
english.giverWindow: Use Harris's Ampule to tranquilize him.

text.title: 基特斯的虫子
text.objectives: 从黑寡妇蜘蛛身上收集8份寡妇蛛毒囊。
text.description: 哈、哈里斯大师的血清需要许多素材。他让我来采集。$B$B许多都还好……我是说，乱坟草已经够要命的了，但和寡妇蛛毒比起来还是小巫见大巫。你见过这儿的寡妇蜘蛛吗？哪怕小型的寡妇蜘蛛都有一个人那么大。就算拿着枪，我也不敢去打它们！$B$B太吓人了。如果你愿意替我去做，我将很高兴付钱给你！把寡妇蛛毒带给我就行！你可以在东边的林子里找到它们，沿着路朝北就是。
text.progress: Did you get it? Please tell me you got it...
text.completion: Oh thank you, thank you! You've saved me from having to go out in the woods with those awful things! At least for a day, that is...
text.completed: Return to Jitters at Raven Hill in Duskwood.

english.title: The Jitters-Bugs
english.objectives: Collect 8 Widow Venom Sacs from Black Widows.
english.description: M-Master Harris requires many reagents for his serums. He has me gather them for him.$B$BMost of it's not so bad... I mean, the corpseweed is pretty bad, but it's not as bad as the widow venom. Have you seen the widows around here? The hatchlings are the size of a man. Even with a gun, I can't stand to go out hunting them!$B$BIt's just too terrifying. If you'll go do it for me, I'll gladly pay you! Just bring me back some widow venom! You'll find them all in the woods to the east, just north of the road.
english.progress: Did you get it? Please tell me you got it...
english.completion: Oh thank you, thank you! You've saved me from having to go out in the woods with those awful things! At least for a day, that is...
english.completed: Return to Jitters at Raven Hill in Duskwood.

text.title: 深埋
text.objectives: 在晨光之林墓穴的通道里寻找光铸冠。
text.description: <你将弓安在棒子上，神器就要完成了。这神圣象征的顶部中央还有一个大大的豁口。>$B$B<你再一次地感觉到它拽着你的胳膊，急切地要你穿过墙上的窟窿，进入前方蜿蜒的通道。最后一块碎片一定就在那里。>
text.completion: <In the darkest depths of this earthen tunnel, you spy the faintest gleam. The last piece is found!>

english.title: Buried Below
english.objectives: Search the tunnel under the Dawning Woods Catacombs for the Lightforged Crest.
english.description: <You attach the arch to the rod, and the artifact is nearly complete. A large gap still sits at the center of the holy symbol's head.>$B$B<Once again you feel it tug your arm, urging you towards the hole in the wall and the winding tunnel ahead. The last piece must be through there.>
english.completion: <In the darkest depths of this earthen tunnel, you spy the faintest gleam. The last piece is found!>

text.title: 摩本特·费尔的命运
text.objectives: 在荒弃鬼屋寻找摩本特·费尔的踪迹。
text.description: 在迷失于森林里之前，我记得的最后一件事就是摩本特·费尔。他是一个邪恶的亡灵巫师，也是这片土地上出现那么多亡灵的罪魁祸首。$B$B我曾请求一名冒险者帮我除掉他。我想他们成功了！但艾丽辛顿修女告诉我这里依然充斥着坟里爬出来的食尸鬼和幽灵。$B$B摩本特·费尔应该在乌鸦岭墓地北边的荒弃鬼屋里咽下了最后一口气。去那儿看看他变成什么样了……
text.completion: His clothes and bloodstains? If it's not tricks, it's something worse...
text.completed: Return to Sven Yorgen at Raven Hill in Duskwood.

english.title: The Fate of Morbent Fel
english.objectives: Search Forlorn Rowe for signs of Morbent Fel.
english.description: Before I was lost to the woods, the last thing I remember is Morbent Fel. He was a vile necromancer, and the reason this land swarms with so many vile undead.$B$BI asked an adventurer to help me put an end to him. I thought they did! But Sister Elsington tells me the land still crawls with ghouls and spectres ripped from the grave.$B$BMorbent Fel should have breathed his last in the house on Forlorn Rowe, north of Raven Hill Cemetary. Go there and see what's become of him...
english.completion: His clothes and bloodstains? If it's not tricks, it's something worse...
english.completed: Return to Sven Yorgen at Raven Hill in Duskwood.

text.title: 潜藏的巫妖
text.objectives: 跟艾丽辛顿修女谈一谈。
text.description: 这里的其他人也和我有一样的疑虑。摩本特·费尔作为亡灵复生了……而且可能比以前更为强大。打倒了一个亡灵巫师，可站起来的却是一个巫妖。而现在他继续糟蹋着这片土地。$B$B我还记得暮色森林以前的样子，$n。我记得天空明亮，森林安宁。这样下去不行！必须将摩本特·费尔永远消灭。$B$B去跟艾丽辛顿修女谈谈。她的预言或许能将你引领到摩本特·费尔的所在之处，告诉你如何才能将他击败。
text.completion: It's heartening to see one so recently recovered be so concerned with the plight of others. Sven spares himself suffering by not dwelling on his own misfortune.

english.title: The Lurking Lich
english.objectives: Speak with Sister Elsington.
english.description: The others here share my suspicion. Morbent Fel lives on in undeath...and may be even more powerful than before. A necromancer was struck down, but a lich may have risen in his place. And now he continues to ruin this land.$B$BI remember Duskwood before all this, $n. I remember bright skies and peaceful woods. This can't stand! Morbent Fel must be stopped for good.$B$BSpeak to Sister Elsington. Her vision might guide you to where Morbent Fel is, and how he can be defeated.
english.completion: It's heartening to see one so recently recovered be so concerned with the plight of others. Sven spares himself suffering by not dwelling on his own misfortune.

text.title: 在圣光的指引下
text.objectives: 去找乌鸦岭墓地的光铸棒。
text.description: 斯温是对的。我可以在乌鸦岭墓地下面感觉到一个强大的邪恶存在。邪恶正潜藏在其墓穴中。摩本特·费尔一定就是源头。$B$B你需要圣光的力量才能把他打倒，$n。斯温告诉我最初杀掉摩本特·费尔的英雄们使用过一件由光铸铁制成的神器。那件神器还在这里！$B$B我也能感觉到它，黑暗中的一丝微光。到乌鸦岭去找它，让圣光指引你。
text.completion: <Buried in the cold dirt, you find a brilliant metal shaft. But there are holes where pieces of the artifact are clearly missing.>

english.title: Guided by the Light
english.objectives: Find the Lightforged Rod in Raven Hill Cemetery.
english.description: Sven is correct. I can feel the presence of a powerful evil deep beneath the Raven Hill Cemetery. Evil lurks in its catacombs, and Morbent Fel must be the source.$B$BYou will need the power of the Light to strike him down, $n. Sven told me the heroes who first slew Morbent Fel wielded an artifact of lightforged iron, imbued with holy power. That artifact is still here!$B$BI can feel it as well, a glimmer of light amidst the darkness. Search Raven Hill for it, and let the Light guide you through it.
english.completion: <Buried in the cold dirt, you find a brilliant metal shaft. But there are holes where pieces of the artifact are clearly missing.>

text.title: 凯旋而归
text.objectives: 去找赤脊山湖畔镇的所罗门镇长。
text.description: 返回湖畔镇，告知所罗门镇长黑石的入侵已经被粉碎了。一定要让他知道这自由有多么来之不易－－为了拯救赤脊山，为了拯救暴风城，我们牺牲了五名最优秀的战士。$B$B你是B连最后的幸存者，$n。你要让B连的传奇为人传诵。$B$B解散。
text.completion: They will never be forgotten, $n. What you and the rest of Bravo Company sacrificed in order to save Redridge will be a tale told for ages to come. While I can in no way make up for the loss of your friends, I feel that you must be rewarded for such a heroic deed. These are Keeshan's possessions - the only things we found when we dredged the lake for his body. Troteman has informed me that Keeshan would have wanted you to take something as the lone surviving member of Bravo Company. Remember them, $n!

english.title: Triumphant Return
english.objectives: Report to Magistrate Solomon at Lakeshire in Redridge.
english.description: Return to Lakeshire and let Solomon know that the Blackrock invasion has been stopped. Make sure he understands the cost at which our freedom came - that we lost five of our finest heroes to save Redridge and ultimately, Stormwind.$B$BYou are the last surviving member of Bravo Company, $n. It is up to you to keep its legacy alive.$B$BDismissed.
english.completion: They will never be forgotten, $n. What you and the rest of Bravo Company sacrificed in order to save Redridge will be a tale told for ages to come. While I can in no way make up for the loss of your friends, I feel that you must be rewarded for such a heroic deed. These are Keeshan's possessions - the only things we found when we dredged the lake for his body. Troteman has informed me that Keeshan would have wanted you to take something as the lone surviving member of Bravo Company. Remember them, $n!

text.title: 藏尸者的复仇
text.objectives: 杀死夜色镇的缝合怪。
text.description: 你不是第一个被亚伯克隆比操纵的笨蛋了！那个步履蹒跚的老人被我们称作藏尸者。他是一个邪恶的亡灵巫师，是这个镇子的祸害。$B$B现在，他把你给的材料缝合在一起，赐予了生命，将其变成了一个可怕的造物，而且它就要到镇子里来了！$B$B那丑陋的生物随时都可能抵达！如果你还有一点良心，$n，你就得帮助守夜人把这憎恶赶走，拯救我们的镇子！
text.completion: Thank the light, he's gone... I'll say you've made amends by helping save the lives of those here, $n.
text.completed: Return to Lord Ello Ebonlocke at the Darkshire Town Hall in Duskwood.
text.giverWindow: 缝合怪，藏尸者的礼物

english.title: The Embalmer's Revenge
english.objectives: Slay Stitches in Darkshire.
english.description: You're not the first fool to be manipulated by Abercrombie! That doddering old man is known as The Embalmer to us. He's a vile necromancer and a blight upon this town.$B$BAnd now, sewn together and given life by the very materials you brought him, his horrible creation approaches!$B$BThat hideous creature will be upon us in mere moments! If you have any heart, $n, you'll help the Night Watch drive off the abomination and save our town!
english.completion: Thank the light, he's gone... I'll say you've made amends by helping save the lives of those here, $n.
english.completed: Return to Lord Ello Ebonlocke at the Darkshire Town Hall in Duskwood.
english.giverWindow: The Gift of the Embalmer

text.title: 英雄的召唤：暮色森林！
text.objectives: 去找暮色森林夜色镇的指挥官阿尔泰娅·埃伯洛克。
text.description: $n，暮色森林的市民迫切需要你的援助！我从守夜人的领袖，指挥官阿尔泰娅·埃伯洛克那里收到一封求救信。$B$B若要前往夜色镇，你必须穿过赤脊山西南角的大桥。然后沿着路，就能走到夜色镇。要小心潜伏在郊外的野兽！
text.completion: You are the help that we requested? I suppose you will have to do.

english.title: Hero's Call: Duskwood!
english.objectives: Report to Commander Althea Ebonlocke at Darkshire in Duskwood.
english.description: $n, the citizens of Duskwood are in dire need of your assistance! I have here a letter from Commander Althea Ebonlocke, leader of the Night Watch, pleading for help.$B$BTo reach Darkshire you should travel across the bridge located in the southwest corner of Redridge. Once you cross the bridge you will be in Duskwood. Then you just follow the road to Darkshire. Beware of the savage beasts that stalk the countryside!
english.completion: You are the help that we requested? I suppose you will have to do.

enders.name: 指挥官阿尔泰娅·埃伯洛克

text.title: 水元素
text.objectives: 获得6个水元素护腕。
text.description: 我来荆棘谷是为了研究当地一景：奈亚斯祭坛。但错就错在，我拒绝听从库尔森上校的命令，结果被关在牢笼里好几年。现在既然我出来了，我想应该继续最初的研究才是。$b$b祭坛坐落在西边的一个小岛上，就在祖昆达的南面。把岛上水元素的护腕给我收集一些来。$b$b哦，你完成任务以后，可以使用这个装置，那样就免得再一路走回来了。
text.progress: 嗯，$N?
text.completion: These will do for my purposes.  Though we can't activate the altar with bracers alone...
text.completed: Use Emerine's Telling-Sphere to summon Emerine Junis within Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: Water Elementals
english.objectives: Acquire 6 Water Elemental Bracers.
english.description: I arrived in Stranglethorn to study a feature known as the Altar of Naias, but made the unfortunate choice of denying Colonel Kurzen's advances, which earned me several years in that cage.  Now that I'm out, I figure I might as well continue with my original studies.$b$bThe altar is on an island to the west, south of Zul'Kunda.  Gather some of the bracers from the island's water elementals.$b$bOh, and you can use this device when you're finished.  No need to make you walk all the way back here.
english.progress: Yes, $n?
english.completion: These will do for my purposes.  Though we can't activate the altar with bracers alone...
english.completed: Use Emerine's Telling-Sphere to summon Emerine Junis within Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 你可以让鱼人离开海洋……
text.objectives: 从北荆棘谷的黑鳃鱼人那里获得6瓶海盐。
text.description: 我需要有样东西，能够把这些护腕里原生的元素力量分离开来……最好是能量强大、研磨性好的，而且得是来自海洋的东西。$b$b虽然黑鳃鱼人从海洋移居到了内陆，但他们依然把海盐放在瓶子里随身携带。他们用这东西干什么，我不太清楚，不过它可以帮助我们完成研究。你可以在反抗军营地南边、以及巴拉尔废墟东边的林地里找到黑鳃鱼人。
text.progress: The salt?
text.completion: We have what we need.  Are you ready to activate the Altar of Naias, $n?
text.completed: Use Emerine's Telling-Sphere to summon Emerine Junis within Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: You Can Take the Murloc Out of the Ocean...
english.objectives: Obtain 6 vials of Sea Salt from Murkgill murlocs in Northern Stranglethorn.
english.description: I need something to cut into the raw, elemental power of these bracers... something strong and abrasive, but still of the sea.$b$bThe Murkgill murlocs have moved inland from the sea, but they still carry vials of sea salt on them.  What they use it for, I can't be sure, but it will serve for our studies.  You can find the Murkgill in the glade south of the Rebel Camp and east of Bal'lal ruins.
english.progress: The salt?
english.completion: We have what we need.  Are you ready to activate the Altar of Naias, $n?
english.completed: Use Emerine's Telling-Sphere to summon Emerine Junis within Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 奈亚斯祭坛
text.objectives: 用奈亚斯的礼物召唤奈亚斯，然后获得奈亚斯的精华。
text.description: 你带来的盐非常有效，护腕上的天然附魔已经被激活。我利用这些附魔组成了一枚召唤徽章……算是一个礼物吧，假如你愿意这么想的话。$b$b回到奈亚斯岛上去，将这礼物放在奈亚斯的祭坛上。拿到奈亚斯的精华后再告诉我。
text.progress: I eagerly await the results.
text.completion: My colleagues within the Kirin Tor will be happy to learn that the heart is ours. Thank you for your assistance, $n.  I couldn't have done it without you.
text.completed: Use Emerine's Telling-Sphere to summon Emerine Junis within Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: The Altar of Naias
english.objectives: Use the Gift of Naias to summon Naias, then obtain the Heart of Naias.
english.description: The salt you brought was sufficient to activate the bracers' innate enchantments.  I have taken these enchantments and combined them into a summoning token... a gift, if you will.$b$bReturn to the Isle of Naias, and place the gift on Naias' altar.  Call me again once you have Naias' heart.
english.progress: I eagerly await the results.
english.completion: My colleagues within the Kirin Tor will be happy to learn that the heart is ours. Thank you for your assistance, $n.  I couldn't have done it without you.
english.completed: Use Emerine's Telling-Sphere to summon Emerine Junis within Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 劣质药品
text.objectives: 从库尔森的营地获得7瓶密林药剂。
text.description: 我有预感，库尔森的药草师们比药剂本身还要叫人不安。库尔森想要排除异己的时候，将药剂谎称为“药品”是再好不过的办法了。$B$B我们要研究一下那些药剂。到东南边的库尔森的营地找找看——那些药草师和丛林战士们应该会随身带着药剂。
text.progress: I'm a little bit of an alchemist in my spare time, you know.
text.completion: Well done, $n.  Now, let's see what they've got in this elixir of theirs...
text.completed: Return to Brother Nimetz at the Rebel Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: Bad Medicine
english.objectives: Obtain 7 Jungle Remedies from the Kurzen Compound.
english.description: I have a feeling that Kurzen's Medicine Men are distributing more than just medicine.  Kurzen needs some way to quelch insubordination, and an elixir under the guise of "medicine" would be the perfect way to do that.$B$BWe need those remedies for research.  Search the Kurzen Compound to the southeast - his medicine men and jungle fighters should carry the remedies on their bodies.
english.progress: I'm a little bit of an alchemist in my spare time, you know.
english.completion: Well done, $n.  Now, let's see what they've got in this elixir of theirs...
english.completed: Return to Brother Nimetz at the Rebel Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 比对样本
text.objectives: 获得7份晶背蜥蜴的血样。
text.description: <尼麦兹修士分析着你给他的样本。>$b$b这……这只是石化蜥蜴的血而已！$b$b不，大部分是石化蜥蜴的血。他们还加了别的东西。我需要对照样本来进行适当的比对。$b$b这些血，多半是他们从营地东边的晶背蜥蜴身上抽的。给我弄些纯净的样本来，我好搞清楚药剂的成分。
text.progress: There's something not quite healthy about this elixir, $n.  Even though I haven't completed my analysis, I can sense it.
text.completion: This will do.  Please hold on for a moment while I test this out.
text.completed: Return to Brother Nimetz at the Rebel Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: Control Sample
english.objectives: Obtain 7 samples of Crystal Spine Basilisk Blood.
english.description: <Brother Nimetz analyzes the samples you've given him.>$b$bThis... this is just basilisk blood!$b$bNo, it's mostly basilisk blood.  They've added something to it though.  I'll need a control sample to perform a proper comparison.$b$bThey most likely obtained the blood from the crystal spine basilisks, found to the east of their compound.  Bring me back some pure samples, and I'll have this elixir figured out.
english.progress: There's something not quite healthy about this elixir, $n.  Even though I haven't completed my analysis, I can sense it.
english.completion: This will do.  Please hold on for a moment while I test this out.
english.completed: Return to Brother Nimetz at the Rebel Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 疯狂的源头
text.objectives: 从物资储藏点的库尔森成员身上获得一块低语蓝石。
text.description: 把石化蜥蜴的血析出后，我发现了一种不寻常的沉积物。貌似是某种蓝色水晶……$b$b<尼麦兹修士查阅着笔记。>$b$b不是蓝色歌唱水晶……不是蓝色波光碎片……$b$b<他朝后翻了几页。>$b$b……不是一块心灵之眼。不，和我们在荆棘谷所见过的都不符。假如有谁还有这种物质，我想把它弄来。去那些高阶库尔森成员的洞里，看他们有没有。
text.progress: Make sure you handle that stuff carefully, $n.  We don't know what it is.
text.completion: I knew they'd have some more of this substance.  I'm going to send this to my contacts at Fort Livingston, to the south.  Hopefully they'll have some more luck with it. Thank you for everything, $n.
text.completed: Return to Brother Nimetz at the Rebel Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: The Source of the Madness
english.objectives: Obtain a Whispering Blue Stone from Kurzen troops within the Stockpile.
english.description: After reducing the basilisk blood out of the elixir, I've uncovered an unusual precipitate.  It appears to be a blue crystal of some sort...$b$b<Brother Nimetz consults his notes.>$b$bIt's not a singing blue crystal... not a pulsing blue shard...$b$b<He flips forward a few pages.>$b$b... not a piece of the Mind's Eye.  Nope, this isn't something we've seen before in Stranglethorn.  If anyone has any more of this substance, I want it.  Check the high-ranking Kurzen troops, in the back of their cave.
english.progress: Make sure you handle that stuff carefully, $n.  We don't know what it is.
english.completion: I knew they'd have some more of this substance.  I'm going to send this to my contacts at Fort Livingston, to the south.  Hopefully they'll have some more luck with it. Thank you for everything, $n.
english.completed: Return to Brother Nimetz at the Rebel Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 库尔森的命运
text.objectives: 获得库尔森营地监狱记录和库尔森营地军官名册。
text.description: 你好，$c。我们是暴风城的士兵，从库尔森营地逃出来的反抗军，你可以在东南边找到那座大型哨所。我们一直听命于库尔森上校，直到他和他身边的人一个个变得疯狂起来……$b$b于是我们揭竿而起，在这里设立营地对抗库尔森。如今，我的情报说库尔森失踪了。我信任我的情报来源，但也想从第三方口中听到这个消息。拜托你，到营地去找些有关他下落的文件来。
text.progress: What were you able to find, $n?
text.completion: They KILLED him?  And all this time, I thought he had them underneath an iron bootheel...
text.completed: Return to Lieutenant Doren at Rebel Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.
text.giverWindow: 我要你去查一下库尔森到底发生了什么事。

english.title: The Fate of Kurzen
english.objectives: Obtain the Kurzen Compound Prison Records and the Kurzen Compound Officers' Dossier.
english.description: Hello, $c.$b$bWe are soldiers of Stormwind, and rebels from Kurzen's Compound, a large outpost that you'll find just to the southeast of here.  We were under the command of Colonel Kurzen, until he and those close to him started to descend into madness...$b$bWe rebelled, set up camp here, and stood against Kurzen.  Now, my sources are telling me Kurzen has disappeared.  I trust my source, but it would help to hear from a third party.  Please, head into the compound and find some documentation of his fate.
english.progress: What were you able to find, $n?
english.completion: They KILLED him?  And all this time, I thought he had them underneath an iron bootheel...
english.completed: Return to Lieutenant Doren at Rebel Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.
english.giverWindow: I need you to find out what happened to Kurzen.

text.title: 逃离疯狂
text.objectives: 营救贝尔林·燃翎、艾茉琳·朱里斯和奥斯伯恩·奥布诺提斯。
text.description: 库尔森的死让人松了一口气，但更让人感兴趣、同时也是更为紧要的事情，是争取营地里潜在的盟友。$b$b我不管监狱记录上怎么说，我知道这三人为什么被关起来：违抗命令。他们一定逃过了疯狂的命运，就像我的反抗军同志们一样。为了封住口，他们遭到了关押。$b$b找到他们，$n。找到他们，然后把他们送回来。
text.completion: Thank you, $n.  It looks like my suspicions were correct... the three prisoners seem to have escaped the affliction that gripped Kurzen and the rest of his men. Before you arrived, Emerine teleported them over to Stormwind to get cleaned up after their ordeal.  They promised to return soon.
text.completed: Return to Lieutenant Doren at the Rebel Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: Spared from Madness
english.objectives: Rescue Berrin Burnquill, Emerine Junis, and Osborn Obnoticus inside Kurzen's Compound.
english.description: Kurzen's death is a relief, but what's more interesting, and perhaps more immediate, is the sign of some potential allies within the compound.$b$bI don't care what it says on that prison record, I know EXACTLY why those 3 were locked up: refusal to follow orders.  They must have been spared from the madness, much like my fellow rebels here, and incarcerated for speaking up.$b$bFind them, $n.  Find them, and send them back here.
english.completion: Thank you, $n.  It looks like my suspicions were correct... the three prisoners seem to have escaped the affliction that gripped Kurzen and the rest of his men. Before you arrived, Emerine teleported them over to Stormwind to get cleaned up after their ordeal.  They promised to return soon.
english.completed: Return to Lieutenant Doren at the Rebel Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

objectiveDetails.description: 营救奥斯伯恩·奥布诺提斯

text.title: 消灭库尔森的后继者
text.objectives: 杀死物资储藏点里的士官长安德斯、士官长高鲁斯、士官长米兰达和士官长艾斯奎维尔。
text.description: 我们的盟友已经被救了出来，该给库尔森的营地最后一击了。现在正是他们最为薄弱的时机，而有了你的帮助，就可以将他们一举铲除。$b$b军官名册上有这么四个人——安德斯、高鲁斯、米兰达，还有艾斯奎维尔——目前仅存的几名高级军官。到营地后面的洞穴里去找他们，把这四人都消灭，将会给库尔森部队以沉重的打击。$b$b愿荣耀伴随你，$n。
text.completion: Marvelously executed, $n.  My men and I can handle the rest. With Kurzen out of the picture, we may be able to continue our original expedition here in Stranglethorn, which was... ahh... No matter.  Please, feel free to peruse our armor stores.  You may find something that fits you well.
text.completed: Return to Lieutenant Doren at the Rebel Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: Stopping Kurzen's Legacy
english.objectives: Kill Chief Anders, Chief Gaulus, Chief Miranda, and Chief Esquivel within The Stockpile.
english.description: Now that our allies have been evacuated, it's time to run a final raid on Kurzen's Compound.  They will never be weaker than they are right now, and with your help, we may be able to weaken them beyond repair.$b$bThose four names that were listed in the Officers' Dossier - Anders, Gaulus, Miranda, and Esquivel - will be the highest-ranking personnel remaining.  Look for them in that cave in the back of their compound.  Removing all four will be devastating to Kurzen's forces.$b$bGo with honor, $n.
english.completion: Marvelously executed, $n.  My men and I can handle the rest. With Kurzen out of the picture, we may be able to continue our original expedition here in Stranglethorn, which was... ahh... No matter.  Please, feel free to peruse our armor stores.  You may find something that fits you well.
english.completed: Return to Lieutenant Doren at the Rebel Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 刚刚孵化
text.objectives: 将鞭尾幼龙带给反抗军营地的塞斯曼下士。
text.description: 翻找士兵物品的时候，你低头发现，一条新生的幼龙正在抬头看你。难道它一路跟着这个库尔森民兵？$b$b你能看出它在研究你，记忆你的形象，模仿你的动作。$b$b鞭尾幼龙和你形成了联系。$b$b也许反抗军营地有人知道该怎么养一条鞭尾幼龙。
text.completion: Yes, the little one seems to have taken a liking to you.  You're lucky... at this age, the raptors are calm, peaceful, and easily trained.  Keep her, $n... she may come in handy. In fact...
text.completed: 将鞭尾幼龙带给反抗军营地的塞斯曼下士。

english.title: Just Hatched
english.objectives: Bring the Lashtail Hatchling to Corporal Sethman at the Rebel Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.
english.description: While looking through this soldier's possessions, you look down to see a newborn raptor hatchling looking back up at you.  Was it following this Kurzen militiaman the whole time?$b$bYou can see it studying you, learning your features and following your movements.$b$bThe lashtail hatchling has formed a bond with you.$b$bPerhaps someone back at the Rebel Camp will know what to do with a raptor hatchling.
english.completion: Yes, the little one seems to have taken a liking to you.  You're lucky... at this age, the raptors are calm, peaceful, and easily trained.  Keep her, $n... she may come in handy. In fact...
english.completed: Bring the Lashtail Hatchling to Corporal Sethman at the Rebel Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 我想她饿了
text.objectives: 在北荆棘谷杀死晶背蜥蜴，让你的鞭尾迅猛龙吃40口。
text.description: 看起来你的小迅猛龙饿了。要是你打算养她的话，干嘛不去给她找点吃的呢？鞭尾龙经常袭击荆棘谷东边库尔森营地里的石化蜥蜴。$b$b也许她还不够强壮，无法独自捕猎，但我肯定她不介意尝尝刚宰的石化蜥蜴肉什么味道。
text.completion: She looks bigger already!  You can see, these raptors grow quickly.  You are lucky to have found such a strong companion. Keep her by your side as long as you can, $n.  I'm sure she will prove to be an asset in the future.
text.completed: Return to Corporal Sethman at the Rebel Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: I Think She's Hungry
english.objectives: Kill Crystal Spine Basilisks in Northern Stranglethorn, and let your Lashtail Raptor eat 40 bites of their meat.
english.description: It looks like your young raptor is hungry.  If you're looking to keep her, why don't you find something for her to eat?  The lashtail often attack the basilisks of Stranglethorn, which can be found to the east, beyond Kurzen's Compound.$b$bShe probably isn't strong enough to hunt on her own yet, but I'm sure she will eat freshly killed basilisk meat.
english.completion: She looks bigger already!  You can see, these raptors grow quickly.  You are lucky to have found such a strong companion. Keep her by your side as long as you can, $n.  I'm sure she will prove to be an asset in the future.
english.completed: Return to Corporal Sethman at the Rebel Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 克拉兹克烹饪术
text.objectives: 把克拉兹克的烹调锅带给克拉兹克。
text.description: 营地里的饭基本上都是我负责做。工作量那叫一个大啊，直到我从地精商人那里买来一台烹调锅。那可真是好东西！给我节省了无数的时间……可惜它坏了！$B$B你能帮我把锅带给那个地精，让他帮我修好吗？他的名字叫克拉兹克。据我所知，他在南边的猎人营地，和奈辛瓦里在一起。
text.progress: 你好!你找我有事?
text.completion: 噢，我看看，这不是我的烹调锅嘛!多麽精致的杰作呀，但现在却变成了一堆破铜烂铁。让我看看到底是出了些什麽毛病呢……$B$B啊哈!看来是蒸汽泵锈掉了，垫圈也破了，齿轮也磨坏了。天啊，那哥们难道整天拿这可爱的小锅煮大象麽?$B$B你问我能不能修好它?鱼儿会游麽?鸟儿会飞麽?当然!$B$B但是我可不白修，嗯嗯，总是要互惠互利的嘛……$B$B
text.completed: Report to Krazek at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: Krazek's Cookery
english.objectives: Bring Krazek's Crock Pot to Krazek.
english.description: I do most of the cooking at the camp.  It used to be a lot of work, until I bought a mechanical cooking pot from a goblin merchant.  The pot is a wonder!  It saved me countless hours...until it broke!$B$BCan you take the pot back to the goblin for me so he can fix it?  His name is Krazek.  Last I heard, he was staying with Nesingwary in the hunters' camp just to the south.
english.progress: Hello!  You brought me something?
english.completion: Oh I see, it's a Krazek's Crock Pot!  An ingenious piece of work, but it can break a spring or throw a gear now and then.  Let me see what's wrong with this one... Aha!  Its steam charger is rusted out, it has a cracked knuckle-gasket and its fobulator is missing teeth.  I'm surprised the pot could even boil a turnip in this state! Can I fix it?  Of course I can fix it! But there's a price.  Oh yes, there is always a price...
english.completed: Report to Krazek at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 血顶的见解
text.objectives: 从一名血顶萨满祭司那里获得血顶图腾。
text.description: 我一直没机会好好感谢你的搭救之恩。$b$b谢谢你，$n。$b$b我还没从被囚禁的虚弱中恢复过来，我想你或许可以帮我把研究进行下去。作为蛮锤部族的一名萨满祭司，我对血顶部落的萨满仪式很感兴趣。$B$B他们的魔法似乎演化到了一个很有趣的方向上。假如我能有一根他们用的图腾，就可以展开研究了。你可以在西南边海岸的巴拉尔废墟那里找到它们。
text.progress: Beware: they may put up a fight.
text.completion: I think I can read this text... Fascinating! Tsul'kalu, Mahamba, Pogeyan... what are these names?
text.completed: Return to Berrin Burnquill at the Rebel Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: Bloodscalp Insight
english.objectives: Obtain a Bloodscalp Totem from a Bloodscalp Shaman.
english.description: I never got to properly thank you for saving me.$b$bThank you, $n.$b$bI'm still a little fatigued from my captivity, so I thought you might help me with my studies.  As a shaman of the Wildhammer clan, I'm very interested in the shamanic practices of the Bloodscalp tribe.$B$BTheir magic seems to have diverged in an interesting direction.  If I had one of the totems that their shaman use, I could begin my studies.  You'll find them at the Bal'lal ruins, on the coast to the southwest.
english.progress: Beware: they may put up a fight.
english.completion: I think I can read this text... Fascinating! Tsul'kalu, Mahamba, Pogeyan... what are these names?
english.completed: Return to Berrin Burnquill at the Rebel Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 血顶的圣物
text.objectives: 在伽什废墟的血顶巨魔那里获得一尊苏尔卡鲁的雕像、一尊穆哈姆巴的模型，以及一尊博格雅恩的雕像。
text.description: 啊……这些一定是他们图腾生物的名字——那些被封为神灵的动物。让我看看……穆哈姆巴是水，博格雅恩是……天空？火？这部分我弄不明白。$b$b我需要有关他们神灵的更多情报。附近有一个血顶巨魔的营地，位于伽什废墟内部。也许你在那里会有所斩获。
text.progress: It's likely that these totemic creatures are based on some of the fantastic creatures that roam this jungle.
text.completion: First you save me from the madman's jail cell, and now you bring me some keys to understanding trollish shamanism. This is turning out to be a pretty good week! Thank you again, $n.  I will see to it that you have the support of the Wildhammer clan as you continue on your journeys.
text.completed: Return to Berrin Burnquill at the Rebel Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: Sacred to the Bloodscalp
english.objectives: Obtain an Icon of Tsul'kalu, an Icon of Mahamba, and an Icon of Pogeyan from Bloodscalp trolls in the Tkashi Ruins.
english.description: Ahh... these must be names of their totemic creatures - the animals that they attribute to the spirits.  Let's see... Mahamba as water, Tsul'Kalu as earth, Pogeyan as... air?  Fire?  I can't make this part out.$b$bI'd like some more information on these spirits of theirs.  The Bloodscalp have a camp close to here, in the Tkashi ruins.  Maybe you can find some details there.
english.progress: It's likely that these totemic creatures are based on some of the fantastic creatures that roam this jungle.
english.completion: First you save me from the madman's jail cell, and now you bring me some keys to understanding trollish shamanism. This is turning out to be a pretty good week! Thank you again, $n.  I will see to it that you have the support of the Wildhammer clan as you continue on your journeys.
english.completed: Return to Berrin Burnquill at the Rebel Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 深深扎根
text.objectives: 从北荆棘谷巴拉尔废墟获得血顶秘闻石板。
text.description: 说句不大相干的，我最近有个……私人项目，需要收集一些巨魔的传说故事。我在想你是不是能帮忙给弄些来。$b$b巴拉尔废墟位于西南面的海岸边，那里的血顶巨魔有大量石板，记录着他们的故事。当然，你要是能够把它们给我带来，我是不会让你白跑的。
text.progress: Did you make it down to Bal'lal Ruins yet?  Did you find the tablet?
text.completion: To be honest, I'm sending this information home to Stormwind, for my wife and son.  They love to hear about what I've been doing out here in the jungle, and I only get to visit so often.  Every little bit helps. Thank you, $n.
text.completed: Return to Corporal Sethman at the Rebel Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: Deep Roots
english.objectives: Obtain the Bloodscalp Lore Tablet from the Bal'lal Ruins in Northern Stranglethorn.
english.description: On a somewhat unrelated note, I've been putting together a collection of troll stories and legends for a... personal project.  I was just thinking you might be able to help me find some of them.$b$bThe Bloodscalps at the Bal'lal ruins, on the coast to the southwest, maintain a large tablet documenting some of their stories.  Of course, I'll reimburse you if you're able to bring any of these stories back to me.
english.progress: Did you make it down to Bal'lal Ruins yet?  Did you find the tablet?
english.completion: To be honest, I'm sending this information home to Stormwind, for my wife and son.  They love to hear about what I've been doing out here in the jungle, and I only get to visit so often.  Every little bit helps. Thank you, $n.
english.completed: Return to Corporal Sethman at the Rebel Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 心爱的颅骨
text.objectives: 去找反抗军营地的奥斯伯恩·奥布诺提斯，把鞭尾幼龙的新颅骨给他看。
text.description: 你的迅猛龙宠物好像找到了一件新玩具：从附近巨魔的颅骨堆里弄来的一颗颅骨。$b$b这颗颅骨是怎么跑出来的，你并不清楚，但是不知为何，她对它爱不释爪。$b$b你从库尔森营地救出来的那个侏儒奥斯伯恩·奥布诺提斯是巨魔历史和哲学方面的专家。也许他知道这颗颅骨有什么特别之处。
text.completion: What do we have here?  A young raptor, and her pet $r.  Hah! More importantly, what is that skull you have there?  This was no ordinary troll.  He was big... ... and strong, too.  You know, I've been meaning to try my hand at some troll magic.  How hard could it be?  Let's use this strong fellow as a test subject, shall we?
text.completed: 去找北荆棘谷反抗军营地的奥斯伯恩·奥布诺提斯。

english.title: Favored Skull
english.objectives: Report to Osborn Obnoticus at the Rebel Camp and show him your Lashtail Hatchling's new skull.
english.description: Your pet raptor seems to have found a new toy: a skull, from a nearby troll skull pile.$b$bWhat sets this skull apart from the rest is beyond you, but for some reason, she won't put it down.$b$bOsborn Obnoticus, the gnome you saved from Kurzen's Compound, is an expert in troll history and physiology.  Maybe he'll have some idea what makes this one so special.
english.completion: What do we have here?  A young raptor, and her pet $r.  Hah! More importantly, what is that skull you have there?  This was no ordinary troll.  He was big... ... and strong, too.  You know, I've been meaning to try my hand at some troll magic.  How hard could it be?  Let's use this strong fellow as a test subject, shall we?
english.completed: Report to Osborn Obnoticus at the Rebel Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 就是干这个的鼻子
text.objectives: 让鞭尾幼龙嗅出8尊迦什神像的所在。
