text.description: <奥斯伯恩又看了看颅骨。>$b$b生前，他强大有力，是巨魔的领主。只要我们帮忙，他就能再度成为主宰。$b$b血顶食腐者们徘徊在西南边的废墟里，他们储藏着能够帮助我们的魔法神像。这些神器被埋在沙子里。让你的幼龙找到它们，$n……然后把它们带到这里来。
text.progress: How many did you find?
text.completion: These will provide a bit of... what's the troll word?  Voodoo?  Juju?  Tiklabang? It doesn't matter.  If we're going to re-build a troll, we need troll magic, and these fetishes are full of it.
text.completed: Return to Osborn Obnoticus at the Rebel Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: A Nose for This Sort of Thing
english.objectives: Use your Lashtail Hatchling to sniff out 8 Tkashi Fetishes.
english.description: <Osborn looks at the skull again.>$b$bIn life, he was strong, powerful, a lord among trolls.  With our help, he can be a lord once more.$b$bThe Bloodscalp scavengers that wander the ruins to the southwest hoard magical fetishes that can help us.  They hide these artifacts under the ground.  Use your hatchling to find these artifacts, $n... then bring them here.
english.progress: How many did you find?
english.completion: These will provide a bit of... what's the troll word?  Voodoo?  Juju?  Tiklabang? It doesn't matter.  If we're going to re-build a troll, we need troll magic, and these fetishes are full of it.
english.completed: Return to Osborn Obnoticus at the Rebel Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 物理标本
text.objectives: 到祖昆达获得甘祖拉恩的躯体。
text.description: 灵魂准备好了，但身体还没有。像这样一个保存完好、无比神奇、漂漂亮亮的头颅……我们需要配一个合适的躯体。$b$b血顶部落的酋长甘祖拉恩靠他的蛮力赢得了宝座。要是他还活着，你就应该能在西边的祖昆达找到他。$b$b拿到他的身体可不容易，不过没什么是你这样强悍的$c搞不定的。得手之后就把它带过来。
text.progress: Gan'zulah was a brute and a tyrant.  I've got a feeling that this troll will be different.  This troll magic is easier than I thought it would be!
text.completion: You have done well, $r.  We have a head, a body, and some juju-voodoo-mojo nonsense.  Now, just a little shock of electricity to get things started, and...
text.completed: Return to Osborn Obnoticus at the Rebel Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.
text.giverWindow: 看……看那肌肉。

english.title: A Physical Specimen
english.objectives: Obtain Gan'zulah's Body from Zul'Kunda.
english.description: The soul is ready, but the body is not.  For a skull as well-formed, as marvelous, as beautiful as this... we will need a suitable body.$b$bThe chief of the Bloodscalps, Gan'zulah, won his throne with brute force.  If he still lives, you'll find him in Zul'Kunda, to the west.$b$bTaking his body won't be easy, but nothing a sturdy $c like yourself couldn't handle.  Bring it back here when you're done.
english.progress: Gan'zulah was a brute and a tyrant.  I've got a feeling that this troll will be different.  This troll magic is easier than I thought it would be!
english.completion: You have done well, $r.  We have a head, a body, and some juju-voodoo-mojo nonsense.  Now, just a little shock of electricity to get things started, and...
english.completed: Return to Osborn Obnoticus at the Rebel Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.
english.giverWindow: Just... just look at that musculature.

text.title: 血领主曼多基尔
text.objectives: 将破碎的鞭尾迅猛龙蛋交给反抗军营地的血领主曼多基尔。
text.description: $R。你刚刚让你最恐怖的噩梦复活了。你该不会以为我是你的朋友吧，$r？啊，哈哈，哈哈哈！$b$b你的价值已经体现了。我回到了生者的国度，而这都要感谢你。那么，我不杀你，而是和你做个交易。$b$b把迅猛龙交给我。$b$b你肯定已经知道她不是一般的迅猛龙了吧，我需要一头能代替奥根的坐骑。来吧，不然你和那侏儒都要尝尝我的厉害。
text.progress: All I ask is the raptor, $r.  Give it to me, and the gnome lives.
text.completion: I'm glad to see you've come to your senses. Come and visit us in Zul'Gurub sometime, $r.  I'll be watching...

english.title: Bloodlord Mandokir
english.objectives: Deliver the Lashtail Raptor Egg Fragment to Bloodlord Mandokir in the Rebel Camp.
english.description: $R.  You just resurrected your worst nightmare.  You didn't think I was a friend, did you, $r?  Ah, ha ha haaaa!$b$bYou've served your purpose.  I've returned to the realm of the living, and it's all thanks to you.  So, instead of killing you, I'm going to make you a deal instead.$b$bGive me that raptor.$b$bYou must already know that she's no normal raptor, and I need a replacement for Ohgan.  Do it, or both you and the gnome will taste my rage.
english.progress: All I ask is the raptor, $r.  Give it to me, and the gnome lives.
english.completion: I'm glad to see you've come to your senses. Come and visit us in Zul'Gurub sometime, $r.  I'll be watching...

text.title: 女祭司萨阿莉亚
text.objectives: 跟北荆棘谷利文斯顿营地的女祭司萨阿莉亚谈一谈。
text.description: 谢谢你，$n。我知道你没有必要救我的命，还有……好吧，我很感谢你。$b$b血领主曼多基尔的回归真是个坏消息。他多年前在祖尔格拉布被消灭，我们以为他是一族中最后一个了。祖尔格拉布的巨魔一直在尝试举行某种邪恶而可怕的仪式。如果曼多基尔活了过来，那么就有理由相信他不是唯一的一个。$b$b南边利文斯顿营地的探险者们或许知道得更多，去和他们的女祭司谈一谈。
text.completion: Mandokir is alive, yes. You are responsible, yes. You may be able to stop him still, yes.
text.completed: 跟北荆棘谷利文斯顿营地的女祭司萨阿莉亚谈一谈。

english.title: Priestess Thaalia
english.objectives: Speak with Priestess Thaalia at Fort Livingston in Northern Stranglethorn.
english.description: Thank you, $n.  I know you didn't have to save my life.$b$bThe return of Bloodlord Mandokir is ill news.  He was killed inside Zul'Gurub several years ago, and we thought we had seen the last of him and his kind.  The trolls of Zul'Gurub were attempting to perform a hideous, horrible ritual.  If Mandokir is alive, then it stands to reason that he is not the only one.$b$bThe explorers at Fort Livingston, far to the south, may know more.  Speak with their priestess.
english.completion: Mandokir is alive, yes. You are responsible, yes. You may be able to stop him still, yes.
english.completed: Speak with Priestess Thaalia at Fort Livingston in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 响应石母的召唤
text.objectives: 跟石母塞拉赞恩谈一谈。
text.description: 是时候了。石母要和你交谈。你可以在深岩之洲北部找到她的王座，就在侵蚀荒地的上方。
text.completion: So you've come. Fleshlings just like you killed my daughter... my only daughter. With no provocation. Not sated at stripping me of my family, more of you flocked to Deathwing to serve him in ravaging my home. You're quite arrogant to come before me asking for MY help. I'm tempted to crush you where you stand.

english.title: At the Stonemother's Call
english.objectives: Speak to Therazane, the Stonemother.
english.description: It is time. The Stonemother will speak with you. You can find her throne in northern Deepholm, above the Scoured Reach.
english.completion: So you've come. Fleshlings just like you killed my daughter... my only daughter. With no provocation. Not sated at stripping me of my family, more of you flocked to Deathwing to serve him in ravaging my home. You're quite arrogant to come before me asking for MY help. I'm tempted to crush you where you stand.

text.title: 巨魔人口控制
text.objectives: 杀死7名血顶秘法师、7名血顶猎人、7名血顶斥候，以及1名血顶兽王。
text.description: 我知道你就要出发前往祖昆达。你到那儿的时候，我有件小事要拜托你办。$b$b荆棘谷的巨魔数量失去了控制。西边的血顶，东边的劈颅……他们从废墟里蜂涌而出，来到丛林，干扰着地区的自然平衡。是该让平衡恢复的时候了。$b$b祖昆达是血顶巨魔的首都，你可以在那里发现血顶的高层人员。削减一下他们的数量，然后回来告诉我。
text.completion: Balance is restored - for now.  We may call on you again in the future, $n.
text.completed: Return to Sergeant Yohwa at the Rebel Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: Population Con-Troll
english.objectives: Slay 7 Bloodscalp Mystics, 7 Bloodscalp Hunters, 7 Bloodscalp Scouts, and 1 Bloodscalp Beastmaster.
english.description: I understand you may be headed to Zul'Kunda soon.  While you are there, I have a small task for you.$b$bThe trolls are outgrowing Stranglethorn.  The Bloodscalp in the West, the Skullsplitters in the East... they pour out of their ruins and into the jungle, disrupting the natural balance of the region.  It is time we restored that balance.$b$bZul'Kunda is the Bloodscalp capital.  Inside you will find the most high-ranking Bloodscalps.  Reduce their numbers, then return to me.
english.completion: Balance is restored - for now.  We may call on you again in the future, $n.
english.completed: Return to Sergeant Yohwa at the Rebel Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 觐见石母
text.objectives: 上殿觐见石母。
text.description: 呆在原地，勇者。我还没有决定如何处置你或你的大地之环。
text.completion: Ya've done well, brotha. Da Stonemother be listenin' and da World Pillar is not far from our reach.
text.completed: Speak to Earthcaller Torunscar at Therazane's Throne.

english.title: Audience with the Stonemother
english.objectives: Attend the Audience with the Stonemother.
english.description: Stay where you are, champion. I have not yet decided what to do with you or your Earthen Ring.
english.completion: Ya've done well, brotha. Da Stonemother be listenin' and da World Pillar is not far from our reach.
english.completed: Speak to Earthcaller Torunscar at Therazane's Throne.

text.title: 亡者的大厅
text.objectives: 在晨光之林墓穴中找到光铸弓。
text.description: <土地倾斜着，通向你面前墓穴的黑暗入口。>$B$B<你能感觉到光铸神器急切地在把你往里拽。也许另一块碎片就在其中？>
text.completion: <In the dirt of this alcove, your eye catches the shine of brilliant metal. You've found another piece of the artifact!>

english.title: The Halls of the Dead
english.objectives: Find the Lightforged Arch within the Dawning Woods Catacombs.
english.description: <In front of you, the bare earth slopes down towards the dark entrance to the crypts.>$B$B<You can feel the tug of the lightforged artifact urging you towards it. Perhaps the other piece is down there?>
english.completion: <In the dirt of this alcove, your eye catches the shine of brilliant metal. You've found another piece of the artifact!>

text.title: 摩本特的克星
text.objectives: 用摩本特的克星削弱摩本特·费尔，然后打败他。
text.description: <碎片组合好了，圣物恢复了原样，闪烁着神圣的光芒。它应该能让你制住摩本特·费尔的黑暗魔法。>$B$B<在通道更深的地方，传来阵阵可憎的笑声。那是巫妖肆无忌惮的大笑。摩本特·费尔就在前面！>
text.completion: May the disgusting monster stay dead this time! I'll head down there and scatter his remains to ash myself, $n. You've done a great thing; perhaps in time Duskwood can return to its former peaceful state.
text.completed: Return to Sven Yorgen at Raven Hill in Duskwood.

english.title: Morbent's Bane
english.objectives: Use Morbent's Bane to weaken Morbent Fel and defeat him.
english.description: <The pieces fit, and the holy artifact is restored, gleaming with sacred light. This should let you defeat Morbent Fel's dark magic.>$B$B<Further down the tunnel, away from the direction you came from, a heinous cackle rings out. It's the clattering laugh of a lich. Morbent Fel is just ahead!>
english.completion: May the disgusting monster stay dead this time! I'll head down there and scatter his remains to ash myself, $n. You've done a great thing; perhaps in time Duskwood can return to its former peaceful state.
english.completed: Return to Sven Yorgen at Raven Hill in Duskwood.

text.title: 阻止他们挺进前线
text.objectives: 轰翻30名真菌恐兽以及/或者石头穴居人增援。
text.description: 哦，真不错，你又带来一辆投石车！克莱或许比泥巴还老，但他的攻城器具倒是没话说。$B$B嘿，你把它一路带来可不是为了锻炼身体的，肉袋子。乘上一台投石车，把那些真菌恐兽和它们从针石熔渣场涌出来的增援轰烂。$B$B我们必须阻止它们朝前线挺进！
text.completion: That's a great start, $n, but we're going to need you to fly over into the town and stir up some trouble.
text.completed: Return to Pyrium Lodestone at Needlerock Spire in Deepholm.

english.title: Keep Them off the Front
english.objectives: Bombard 30 Fungal Terrors and/or Stone Trogg Reinforcements.
english.description: Oh good, you brought another catapult with you! Clay might be older than dirt, but he makes a mean war machine.$B$BWell, you didn't bring it all the way out here for your health, flesh bag. Get in one of those things and bombard the fungal terrors and reinforcements streaming out of Needlerock Slag.$B$BWe have to keep them off the front!
english.completion: That's a great start, $n, but we're going to need you to fly over into the town and stir up some trouble.
english.completed: Return to Pyrium Lodestone at Needlerock Spire in Deepholm.

text.title: 尼莎·影歌
text.objectives: 与尼莎·影歌谈一谈。
text.description: 我的朋友尼莎·影歌是鲁瑟兰村的一个渔业商人，她要把一只包裹送到黑海岸去，所以她正在找人帮忙。$B$B如果你感兴趣的话，那就去找尼莎吧。从达纳苏斯到鲁瑟兰村去的传送门就在神殿花园的西边。

english.title: Nessa Shadowsong
english.objectives: Speak with Nessa Shadowsong.
english.description: A friend of mine, Nessa Shadowsong, is a fishing merchant in Rut'theran Village.  She needs a parcel taken to Darkshore, and is looking for someone to help her.$B$BIf you're interested, then to reach Nessa you must take the portal in Darnassus to Rut'theran Village.  You will find the portal west of the Temple Gardens.

text.title: 泰达希尔的渔业
text.objectives: 将尼莎的货物交给维斯派塔斯。
text.description: 鲁瑟兰村周围水域中的鱼又大又肥，所以这里的渔业很昌盛。我希望把从这里捕获的鱼和卡里姆多的鱼进行比较，研究一下它们有何不同。$B$B我收集了一些鱼骨头和鳞片，想要把它们带到我在黑海岸的一个同事那里去。他的名字叫做莱尔德，是奥伯丁的鱼商。$B$B把我的东西拿到角鹰兽管理员维斯派塔斯那里去，跟他谈谈关于去奥伯丁的事宜。

english.title: The Bounty of Teldrassil
english.objectives: Bring Nessa's Collection to Vesprystus.
english.description: The fishermen of Rut'theran village do very well, for the fish here are extremely large and abundant.  I would like to compare the bounty here with that of the mainland.$B$BI have a collection of fish bones and scales that I would like taken to a colleague of mine in Darkshore.  His name is Laird, he is a fish vendor in the village of Auberdine.$B$BBring my collection to our hippogryph master, Vesprystus, and speak to him about traveling to Auberdine.

text.title: 飞往奥伯丁
text.objectives: 从角鹰兽管理员维斯派塔斯那里租用一只角鹰兽飞到奥伯丁，然后将尼莎的货物交给莱尔德。
text.description: 从鲁瑟兰村到奥伯丁去的方法有两种：乘船或者骑角鹰兽。这两种方式都很迅捷可靠，但是如果你没有搭乘过角鹰兽的话，我建议你试一下。$B$B另外，你最好和各个城镇中的角鹰兽管理员谈谈。一旦你和某地的角鹰兽饲养员打过了招呼，那么以后你就可以从其它城镇飞到那里去了。$B$B这里是尼莎的货物。如果你准备好了的话，就再次和我对话，然后把这包东西送到莱尔德那里。

english.title: Flight to Auberdine
english.objectives: Ride a hippogryph to Auberdine from the hippogryph master Vesprystus, then bring Nessa's Collection to Laird.
english.description: From Rut'theran, there are two methods of travel to Auberdine: by ferry and by hippogryph.  Both are quick and reliable, but if you have not yet flown to Auberdine by hippogryph, then I suggest you do.$B$BIt is sound advice to speak with the hippogryph master in every town that has one.  Once you speak to the master, you can then fly there from other towns.$B$BHere is Nessa's collection.  Speak with me again when you are ready to fly to Auberdine and deliver Nessa's collection to Laird.

text.title: 飞回泰达希尔
text.objectives: 将莱尔德的回信交给尼莎·影歌。
text.description: 我必须给尼莎回信，她应该会对这里的鱼跟泰达希尔沿岸的那些鱼的差异感兴趣。出现这种差异的原因……也许是世界之树在影响其周围的生物！$B$B请你帮我给尼莎捎个信。如果你想要乘坐角鹰兽回鲁瑟兰村的话，那就去跟角鹰兽管理员凯莱斯·月羽谈谈吧。如果你要搭船回去，西北面的码头那里有定时的航班。

english.title: Return to Nessa
english.objectives: Bring Laird's Response to Nessa Shadowsong.
english.description: I must send a response to Nessa.  She'll be very interested to know how different the fish here are from those along Teldrassil's coastline.  We can only guess the cause, but it is my suspicion that the world tree itself is affecting the wildlife around it!$B$BPlease, take this response to Nessa.  If you wish to take a hippogryph back to Rut'theran then speak with the hippogryph master Caylais Moonfeather.  If you wish to take the ferry, then one regularly departs from the dock to the northwest.

text.title: 异想天开
text.objectives: 旁观奥利弗·哈里斯和基特斯试图治疗潜伏的狼人。
text.description: 希望很乐观，但我们还是保持专业精神。对这一个来说，事情也是照往常一样。$B$B他算是上了断头台……要是炼金术不管用，他就难逃一劫。$B$B基特斯和我会处理好的。请你往后站，观看的时候保持安全距离。
text.progress: Excuse me, we're not done yet.
text.completion: Success... Finally! I can't thank you enough for giving me the chance to work the cure myself. Our new friend may be in need of some help as well. You might want to speak with him.
text.completed: Return to Oliver Harris at Raven Hill in Duskwood.

english.title: Cry For The Moon
english.objectives: Watch Oliver Harris and Jitters attempt to cure the Lurking Worgen.
english.description: I'm hopeful, but let's remain professional. It's business as usual for this one.$B$BInto the guillotine he goes... and if the alchemy doesn't take, he won't be getting back out of it.$B$BJitters and I will attend to this. Please, just stand back and watch from a safe distance.
english.progress: Excuse me, we're not done yet.
english.completion: Success... Finally! I can't thank you enough for giving me the chance to work the cure myself. Our new friend may be in need of some help as well. You might want to speak with him.
english.completed: Return to Oliver Harris at Raven Hill in Duskwood.

text.title: 王国的威胁
text.objectives: 向赤脊山湖畔镇的所罗门镇长报告。
text.description: 迪菲亚无疑对王国造成了威胁，我们显然不可能大大咧咧地走进他们的盗贼巢穴，然后指望事情就这么解决了。不，攻打迪菲亚的事情需要从长计议，我希望你把后勤就交给我。因为王国还有其他的敌人迫切需要解决！$B$B从东边出发，穿过艾尔文森林到赤脊山去，向湖畔镇的所罗门镇长报告。准备好攻打迪菲亚的时候我再叫你。
text.completion: I heard about the Defias making a return. Terrible news. I wish I had better news, but it would appear that Lakeshire is under attack! We are losing citizens left and right. Our own guards are spread far too thin to handle the situation. We need a hero to step up!

english.title: Threat to the Kingdom
english.objectives: Report to Magistrate Solomon at Lakeshire in Redridge.
english.description: There is no doubt that the Defias pose a great threat to the kingdom, but we certainly cannot enter their hideout and hope that everything will work itself out. No, an assault against the Defias is going to take time and planning. I want you to leave the logistics to me. Our kingdom has other threats that must be dealt with immediately!$B$BTravel east through Elwynn to Redridge and report to Magistrate Solomon in Lakeshire. I will call for you when we are ready to attack the Defias.
english.completion: I heard about the Defias making a return. Terrible news. I wish I had better news, but it would appear that Lakeshire is under attack! We are losing citizens left and right. Our own guards are spread far too thin to handle the situation. We need a hero to step up!

text.title: 重启魔像
text.objectives: 重启5具战争魔像。
text.description: 我们把一些战争魔像派进了针石熔渣场，可它们没一个回来的。我们知道肯定是石头穴居人秘法师动的手脚。$B$B我们担心的是秘法师会控制它们，让它们反戈一击，就好像那些真菌巨人一样。$B$B$n，到石头穴居人的城镇里去重启那些魔像。
text.completion: That was a nice bit of work, $n. With our constructs back up and running behind their main lines, it's only a matter of time now before we make the big push through and rescue the Stonefather.
text.completed: 去找深岩之洲针石熔渣场的燃钢·磁石。

english.title: Reactivate the Constructs
english.objectives: Reactivate 5 Deactivated War Constructs.
english.description: We sent a number of our war constructs north into Needlerock Slag, but none of them ever returned. We know that the stone trogg mystics have done something to them.$B$BWhat we're concerned about is that the mystics will control and turn them against us, like they have with the fungal giants.$B$B$n, go into the stone trogg town and reactivate the constructs.
english.completion: That was a nice bit of work, $n. With our constructs back up and running behind their main lines, it's only a matter of time now before we make the big push through and rescue the Stonefather.
english.completed: Return to Pyrium Lodestone at Needlerock Slag in Deepholm.

text.title: 风险投资公司矿业
text.objectives: 从纳菲瑞提湖附近风险投资公司的雇员身上收集5颗打磨过的水晶。
text.description: 要想修锅，就得有材料。要想拿到材料，你就可能不得不稍微开那么一点点杀戒，希望你不介意。$b$b风险投资公司卑鄙的地质学家们收集打磨过的水晶，它们正好符合我的需要。你可以在纳菲瑞提湖东边的营地附近找到他们。$b$b东西拿到就行，我可不管你用什么手段。
text.progress: Do you have those crystals?
text.completion: These will work fine.  Just a moment please. All fixed!
text.completed: Return to Krazek at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: Venture Company Mining
english.objectives: Obtain 5 Tumbled Crystals from Venture Co. forces near Lake Nazferiti.
english.description: If I'm going to repair this pot, I'm going to need reagents.  And to get them, you're going to have to do an eensy little bit of killing.  I hope you don't mind.$b$bThose dastardly Venture Company geologists have been collecting some tumbled crystals that will suffice for what I need.  You'll find them around their Base Camp, on the other side of Lake Nazferiti, to the east.$b$bI don't care what you have to do to get them.
english.progress: Do you have those crystals?
english.completion: These will work fine.  Just a moment please. All fixed!
english.completed: Return to Krazek at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: A New Low
text.objectives: Free 3 Enslaved Druids from the Venture Co. Base Camp.
text.description: You may notice that the Venture Company has completely clear-cut all the trees around their Base Camp to the east.  Not one to miss out an opportunity for profit, their foreman has enslaved druids, and is forcing them to re-grow the forest so they can chop it down again!$b$bPersonally, I find this abhorrent, and not just because I didn't think of it first.$b$bRelease a few of these druids from their captors.  I'm sure they'll appreciate it.
text.completed: Return to Krazek at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: A New Low
english.objectives: Free 3 Enslaved Druids from the Venture Co. Base Camp.
english.description: You may notice that the Venture Company has completely clear-cut all the trees around their Base Camp to the east.  Not one to miss out an opportunity for profit, their foreman has enslaved druids, and is forcing them to re-grow the forest so they can chop it down again!$b$bPersonally, I find this abhorrent, and not just because I didn't think of it first.$b$bRelease a few of these druids from their captors.  I'm sure they'll appreciate it.
english.completed: Return to Krazek at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 去找卡雷布下士
text.objectives: 把修理过的烹调锅带给北荆棘谷反抗军营地的卡雷布下士。
text.description: 来，锅子修好了。我甚至还多加了个蒸汽哨，瞧！底下有个新切肉刀，可以剁碎腿骨！$B$B是的是的，克拉兹克的烹调锅让你享受百分之百的烹调乐趣！我肯定它的主人这下子可以满意了。
text.progress: Hello, $n.  Did the goblin Krazek fix my pot??
text.completion: It's fixed!  This is great, now I can get dinner started!  Thanks so much, $n. I hope Krazek didn't give you too much trouble.
text.completed: Bring Krazek's Fixed Pot to Corporal Kaleb at the Rebel Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: Return to Corporal Kaleb
english.objectives: Bring Krazek's Fixed Pot to Corporal Kaleb at the Rebel Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.
english.description: So, this pot is fixed.  I even added an extra steam whistle, and look!  There's a new chopper at the bottom that'll cut through leg bones!$B$BYes yes, Krazek's Crock Pot is a 100% cook pleaser!  I'm sure its owner will be satisfied.
english.progress: Hello, $n.  Did the goblin Krazek fix my pot??
english.completion: It's fixed!  This is great, now I can get dinner started!  Thanks so much, $n. I hope Krazek didn't give you too much trouble.
english.completed: Bring Krazek's Fixed Pot to Corporal Kaleb at the Rebel Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 放长线，钓大鱼
text.objectives: 用米尔拉的小刀在死去的玉首蜥蜴身上获得5块蜥蜴肉排。
text.description: 想要抓住艾比希昂，我们只有一个机会，$n。别浪费了。$B$B我们将用雪玉岩床里最大的石巨龙来对陷阱进行测试。$B$B为了让石头龙母上钩，我们就得用上像样的饵料。$B$B拿上这把小刀，去割5块蜥蜴肉排来。按她的胃口，这些也都应该够了。
text.progress: Did you obtain the meat?
text.completion: That should be enough to lure the beast, $n.
text.completed: Return to Stormcaller Mylra at the Twilight Overlook in Deepholm.

english.title: Big Game, Big Bait
english.objectives: Use Mylra's Knife to obtain 5 Sides of Basilisk Meat from dead Jadecrest Basilisks.
english.description: We're only going to get one shot at capturing Abyssion, $n.  Let's make it count.$B$BWe'll test out the trap on the biggest of the stone dragons in the Alabaster Shelf.$B$BTo lure the stone matriarch, we're going to need to gather sufficient bait.$B$BTake this knife and carve 5 sides of basilisk meat.  That ought to be enough even for her appetite.
english.progress: Did you obtain the meat?
english.completion: That should be enough to lure the beast, $n.
english.completed: Return to Stormcaller Mylra at the Twilight Overlook in Deepholm.

text.title: 弄清楚如何制作任务
text.objectives: 制作一个索引任务。
text.description: 好耶！你要学会如何制作一个索引任务！现在想想下面该做什么。

english.title: Figuring out how to make quests
english.objectives: Make a breadcrumb quest.
english.description: Whee!  You get to make a breadcrumb quest!  Now figure out what to do next.

text.title: 捕龙
text.objectives: 从暮光巨龙猎手身上缴获巨龙圈捕器。
text.description: 敌人能想到把碎片交给巨龙守护，确实棋高一着。只要我们接近，它就可以不停地移动位置。$B$B抓捕艾比希昂将极为困难，但我有个计划或许能有所帮助。$B$B暮光之锤会用魔法陷阱把石幼龙困在地上，好汲取它们的能量。$B$B如果我们能弄到这样一个东西，或许也能将暮光之龙困住足够长的时间。$B$B到东边的雪玉岩床去，弄一个陷阱来。
text.progress: If the snares are good enough for stone drakes, they might work on Abyssion.
text.completion: Let's see if the snare can ground something larger than a drake.
text.completed: Return to Stormcaller Mylra at the Twilight Overlook in Deepholm.
text.giverWindow: 他们在用圈捕器抓石幼龙。

english.title: To Catch a Dragon
english.objectives: Obtain a Dragon Snare from the Twilight Dragonstalkers.
english.description: Having a dragon guard the fragment was a smart move on the enemy's part.  They can keep moving its location any time we get close to it.$B$BCatching Abyssion will be extremely difficult, but I have a plan that might help.$B$BThe Twilight's Hammer uses magical traps to bind stone drakes to the ground while they drain their energy.$B$BIf we can get our hands on one of these, we might be able to ground the Twilight Dragon for just long enough.$B$BGo east of here, to the Alabaster Shelf, and obtain a trap.
english.progress: If the snares are good enough for stone drakes, they might work on Abyssion.
english.completion: Let's see if the snare can ground something larger than a drake.
english.completed: Return to Stormcaller Mylra at the Twilight Overlook in Deepholm.
english.giverWindow: They're using snares to trap the stone drakes.

text.title: 激流之旅
text.objectives: 在棘齿城东北乘坐荷尔登·霍恩布洛尔的渡轮前往诺兹波特的哨站。
text.description: 好好享用你那份财宝吧，$n！$B$B我讨厌和人分账，但生意就是生意。还有那两面三刀的诺兹波特，这里面有一成得归他。你能到北边他的哨站跑一趟，帮我把这些送过去吗？$B$B他在河的上游有个小小的研究站。要是你从镇子往东北走，荷尔登·霍恩布洛尔可以让你免费搭乘他的渡轮。告诉他是我派你来的！
text.progress: Welcome, $c. Fresh off the boat from Ratchet? Any news?
text.completion: Gazlowe calls this 10%? You tell him I'm going to weigh these! I suppose he expects me to pay you a delivery fee, as well? Fine, fine. Have some spoils!
text.completed: Talk to Nozzlepot at Nozzlepot's Outpost in North Barrens.

english.title: Raging River Ride
english.objectives: Board Horton Hornblower's Riverboat northeast of Ratchet and get a riverboat ride to Nozzlepot's Outpost.
english.description: Enjoy your cut of the loot, $n!$B$BI hate to share, but business is business. And that double-dealer Nozzlepot is guaranteed a 10% cut of this treasure. Can you deliver this to him at his outpost in the north?$B$BHe's got a little research station upstream, along the river. If you travel just northeast of town here, Horton Hornblower can give you a free ride on one of his riverboats. Tell him I sent ya!
english.progress: Welcome, $c. Fresh off the boat from Ratchet? Any news?
english.completion: Gazlowe calls this 10%? You tell him I'm going to weigh these! I suppose he expects me to pay you a delivery fee, as well? Fine, fine. Have some spoils!
english.completed: Talk to Nozzlepot at Nozzlepot's Outpost in North Barrens.

objectiveDetails.description: 乘坐江轮抵达诺兹波特

text.title: 秘法大师
text.objectives: 消灭5名针石秘法师。
text.description: 针石秘法师控制了长在处于他们下方裂口里的真菌巨人。而现在他们想要控制我们的战争魔像。$B$B到北边的针石熔渣场去做些什么！你来不就是为这个的吗？
text.completion: A few less stone troggs is always a good thing. Glad to see that you're a decent $c after all. We'll soon know the exact location where they're keeping my father captive. Hope you survive until then.
text.completed: Return to Flint Oremantle at Needlerock Slag in Deepholm.

english.title: Mystic Masters
english.objectives: Slay 5 Needlerock Mystics.
english.description: The Needlerock mystics have taken control of the fungal giants that have sprouted in their chasm, down below. Now they seek to control our war constructs.$B$BGo north into Needlerock Slag and do something about it! Isn't that what you're here for?
english.completion: A few less stone troggs is always a good thing. Glad to see that you're a decent $c after all. We'll soon know the exact location where they're keeping my father captive. Hope you survive until then.
english.completed: Return to Flint Oremantle at Needlerock Slag in Deepholm.

text.title: 测试陷阱
text.objectives: 将诱捕蜥蜴肉放在雪玉岩床的西侧尽头。
text.description: 你现在得为龙母设下陷阱。$B$B到雪玉岩床的西侧尽头，去把诱捕蜥蜴肉放在进食场的中央。
text.completion: Well done, $n.  Here's to hoping the trap performs as well when we try it on Abyssion.
text.completed: Return to Stormcaller Mylra at the Twilight Overlook.

english.title: Testing the Trap
english.objectives: Place the trapped meat in the western end of the Alabaster Shelf.
english.description: You must set the trap for the matriarch now.$B$BGo to the western end of the Alabaster Shelf and place the trapped basilisk meat in the center of the feeding grounds.
english.completion: Well done, $n.  Here's to hoping the trap performs as well when we try it on Abyssion.
english.completed: Return to Stormcaller Mylra at the Twilight Overlook.

text.title: 心灵视界
text.objectives: 从北荆棘谷丛林捕猎者身上获得5根丛林捕猎者的羽毛。
text.description: 要了解曼多基尔，你必须看到曼多基尔。$b$b要看到曼多基尔，你必须使用迅猛龙之眼。$b$b你已经和奥根的女儿：奥根阿卡达成了契约。$b$b我们需要一些羽毛来加强契约。$b$b向东北走，你就会找到一些羽毛。
text.progress: Raptor named Ohgan'aka, still your friend.
text.completion: You bring feathers, yes. You can follow directions, yes.
text.completed: Return to Priestess Thaalia at Fort Livingston in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: Mind Vision
english.objectives: Obtain 5 Jungle Stalker Feathers from Jungle Stalkers in Northern Stranglethorn.
english.description: To know Mandokir, you must see Mandokir.$b$bTo see Mandokir, you must use eyes of raptor.$b$bYou have formed bond with raptor: Ohgan'aka: daughter of Ohgan.$b$bTo strengthen bond, we need feathers.$b$bYou will go northeast, and you will find the feathers, yes.
english.progress: Raptor named Ohgan'aka, still your friend.
english.completion: You bring feathers, yes. You can follow directions, yes.
english.completed: Return to Priestess Thaalia at Fort Livingston in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 看见迅猛龙
text.objectives: 跟利文斯顿营地的女祭司萨阿莉亚谈一谈，举行心灵视界仪式。
text.description: 我们有了羽毛。$b$b我们有了$c。$b$b准备好了就跟女祭司谈一谈。
text.completion: What did Priestess tell you? The raptor is daughter of Ohgan, heir to Mandokir's seat. Hah!
text.completed: Return to Priestess Thaalia at Fort Livingston in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: See Raptor
english.objectives: Speak with Priestess Thaalia at Fort Livingston to participate in the Mind Vision ritual.
english.description: We have the feathers, yes.$b$bWe have the $c, yes.$b$bSpeak with Priestess when you are ready.
english.completion: What did Priestess tell you? The raptor is daughter of Ohgan, heir to Mandokir's seat. Hah!
english.completed: Return to Priestess Thaalia at Fort Livingston in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 心灵控制
text.objectives: 从祖玛维的布拉多克那里获得他的魔精。
text.description: 心灵视界还不够，不。$b$b心灵控制，强大得多，是的。$b$b强大的魔法，需要强大的材料，巨魔的魔精就是强大的材料。$b$b祖玛维的布拉多克，非常聪明。$b$b去南方，试试看布拉多克的魔精。
text.progress: Extra-big spells need extra-big brains, yes.
text.completed: Return to Priestess Thaalia at Fort Livingston in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: Mind Control
english.objectives: Obtain Braddok's Big Brain from Braddok in Zul'Mamwe.
english.description: Mind Vision is not enough, no.$b$bMind Control, much more powerful magic, yes.$b$bPowerful magic needs powerful reagents, and troll brain is a powerful reagent.$b$bBraddok in Zul'Mamwe, very smart, yes.$b$bHead south, and check out the big brain on Braddok.
english.progress: Extra-big spells need extra-big brains, yes.
english.completed: Return to Priestess Thaalia at Fort Livingston in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 成为迅猛龙
text.objectives: 跟女祭司萨阿莉亚谈一谈，帮助被抓住的鞭尾幼龙逃出祖尔格拉布。
text.description: 心灵控制，非常强大。$b$b幸运的话，你可以帮助奥根阿卡逃离祖尔格拉布。$b$b然后，奥根阿卡将再度变成$n阿卡！$b$b跟女祭司谈一谈，是的，帮助$n阿卡逃出来。
text.completed: Return to Priestess Thaalia at Fort Livingston in Northern Stranglethorn.
text.giverWindow: 被困在祖尔格拉布！

english.title: Be Raptor
english.objectives: Speak with Priestess Thaalia, then help the Captured Lashtail Hatchling escape from Zul'Gurub.
english.description: Mind Control, very powerful, yes.$b$bWith luck, you can help Ohgan'aka escape from Zul'Gurub.$b$bThen, Ohgan'aka becomes $n'aka again!$b$bSpeak to Priestess, yes, and help $n'aka escape.
english.completed: Return to Priestess Thaalia at Fort Livingston in Northern Stranglethorn.
english.giverWindow: Trapped in Zul'Gurub!

text.title: 格哈利尼
text.objectives: 去找北荆棘谷利文斯顿营地的格哈利尼。
text.description: 女祭司的通用语不好说得，说得不好。$b$b也许你可以跟格哈利尼谈一谈，他就在那帐篷里。$b$b告诉他你在祖尔格拉布里什么看到了，看到了什么。
text.completion: It would seem that Jin'do has survived, and he is rallying his brothers to once again summon Hakkar into this world.  It was good of you to come to speak with me. There is not much we can do now but to wait, and watch.  Jin'do is weak, and prime for striking, but I must wait for word from Rastakhan before issuing orders.  Until then, you and your raptor will have to wait.
text.completed: 去找北荆棘谷利文斯顿营地的格哈利尼。

english.title: Ghaliri
english.objectives: Report to Ghaliri at Fort Livingston in Northern Stranglethorn.
english.description: Priestess is not very good at speaking Common, no.$b$bMaybe you go speak with Ghaliri, in front of that tent.$b$bTell him about what you've seen inside Zul'Gurub, yes.
english.completion: It would seem that Jin'do has survived, and he is rallying his brothers to once again summon Hakkar into this world.  It was good of you to come to speak with me. There is not much we can do now but to wait, and watch.  Jin'do is weak, and prime for striking, but I must wait for word from Rastakhan before issuing orders.  Until then, you and your raptor will have to wait.
english.completed: Report to Ghaliri at Fort Livingston in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 抚慰灵魂
text.objectives: 在腐草农场使用神圣香炉抚慰5名弃灵。
text.description: 这是一片悲惨的土地，有着暴力和绝望的历史。许多死人拖着肉体游荡，而有些则仅仅是迷失的灵魂，迷茫地徘徊。$B$B他们应该得到安息。$B$B这些灵魂大多都聚集在南边的腐草农场，在旅行者面前显现。带上这顶神圣香炉，在弃灵面前晃动，让其柔和的香气令它们安宁。
text.completion: You have brought peace to those who knew only misery, $n. Be proud.
text.completed: Return to Sister Elsington at Raven Hill in Duskwood.

english.title: Soothing Spirits
english.objectives: Use the Holy Censer to soothe 5 Forlorn Spirits at the Addle Stead.
english.description: This is a tragic land, with a history of violence and despair. While many of the dead roam in the flesh, some are simply lost souls, wandering in confusion.$B$BThey deserve to be put at ease.$B$BMany of these souls gather at the Addle Stead to the south, appearing before travelers. Take this censer of holy incense. Sway it before the forlorn spirits, and let the offering of its gentle scent give them peace.
english.completion: You have brought peace to those who knew only misery, $n. Be proud.
english.completed: Return to Sister Elsington at Raven Hill in Duskwood.

text.title: 亡者的哭泣
text.objectives: 在乌鸦岭墓地杀死20只任意种类的食尸鬼。
text.description: 你能听到吗，$n？它们有好多。它们游荡在坟墓边，蹒跚在满是腐烂肢体的冰冷大地上。$B$B死者在静谧的空气中哭喊。它们在自己的身躯中受苦，不得安睡！每晚我都要到坟场去，让它们安息，但这远远不够。$B$B帮助我，$n。让那些聚集在乌鸦岭墓地的食尸鬼摆脱痛苦。尽你能所将它们打倒。
text.completion: The cries grow softer for now. Light bless you, $n.
text.completed: Return to Sister Elsington at Raven Hill in Duskwood.

english.title: The Cries of the Dead
english.objectives: Kill 20 ghouls of any kind in Raven Hill Cemetery.
english.description: Can you hear them, $n? There's so many of them. They wander their graves, shuffling across the cold ground on rotting limbs.$B$BThe dead cry out in the still air. They suffer in their own flesh, forced from sleep! Every night I venture to the graveyard to put more of them to rest, but it's never enough.$B$BHelp me, $n. Put the ghouls that swarm Raven Hill Cemetery out of their misery. Strike down as many as you can.
english.completion: The cries grow softer for now. Light bless you, $n.
english.completed: Return to Sister Elsington at Raven Hill in Duskwood.

text.title: 祖玛维曼波
text.objectives: 杀死祖玛维里的16名劈颅巨魔。
text.description: 劈颅巨魔真是我们巨魔帝国的耻辱。他们为了鸡毛蒜皮的事情，就和血顶巨魔一起把北荆棘谷闹得鸡飞狗跳。暗矛巨魔和赞达拉巨魔欣欣向荣的时候，劈颅巨魔还在为争夺废墟斤斤计较。$b$b我被授权给愿意惩罚劈颅巨魔的雇佣兵提供奖赏。我建议你——以及你的朋友——到东部的祖玛维去，给那个任性的部族敲敲警钟。
text.completion: As promised, your reward.  You do the troll nation proud.
text.completed: Return to Ghaliri at Camp Livingston in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: Zul'Mamwe Mambo
english.objectives: Kill 16 Skullsplitter Trolls within Zul'Mamwe.
english.description: The Skullsplitters are an embarrassment to the troll empire.  Their petty squabbles with the Bloodscalps have torn Northern Stranglethorn apart.  Where tribes like the Darkspear and the Zandalari thrive, the Skullsplitters fight over ruins.$b$bI have been authorized to issue rewards to mercenaries who are willing to deliver punishment to the Skullsplitters.  I encourage you, and anyone you know, to travel east into Zul'Mamwe and cull their wayward tribe.
english.completion: As promised, your reward.  You do the troll nation proud.
english.completed: Return to Ghaliri at Camp Livingston in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 丛林之夜
text.objectives: 扑灭北荆棘谷祖玛维的8个祖玛维火盆。
text.description: 荆棘谷的夜晚十分美丽。天空点缀着群星，月光透过树叶的缝隙照在这里。我可以一整晚都看着星星。$b$b不幸的是，行走在祖玛维废墟里的巨魔干扰着我的观星。他们没日没夜地点着火盆，把夜空都照亮了。$b$b拜托你，$n……到东边的祖玛维去，将它们扑灭。
text.completion: I can see the difference already.  I can't wait until later tonight, when I get to perform my observations again!
text.completed: Return to Kinnel at Fort Livingston in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: Nighttime in the Jungle
english.objectives: Put out 8 Zul'Mamwe Braziers at Zul'Mamwe in Northern Stranglethorn.
english.description: Nighttime in Stranglethorn is a beautiful thing.  The skies fill with stars, and the moon casts its rays right between those leaves, right there.  I could stare at these skies all night.$b$bUnfortunately, the trolls that walk the ruins of Zul'Mamwe are interfering with my astronomy.  They burn braziers, day and night, which rob me of the darkness I need.$b$bPlease, $n... travel east into Zul'Mamwe and put them out.
english.completion: I can see the difference already.  I can't wait until later tonight, when I get to perform my observations again!
english.completed: Return to Kinnel at Fort Livingston in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 心灵之眼
text.objectives: 从麦佐斯那里获得心灵之眼。
text.description: 荆棘谷里的珍宝之一就位于附近，大漩涡的这一边。在东北边的莫什奥格食人魔山里，一名食人魔法师掌握着心灵之眼。据我所知，他不但邪恶，而且魔法强大。$B$B既然他拿着心灵之眼，那么他的魔法肯定是如虎添翼了。$B$B因此我也就无法接近他，更无法把东西抢过来。你能不能去试试？
text.progress: Do you have the Eye?
text.completion: You retrieved the eye!  Your might is the stuff of legends, $n! And to think my brother and sister said we wouldn't find anything of worth here in the Vale.  Hah!  And I'm just getting started!
text.completed: Return to Livingston Marshal at Fort Livingston in Northern Stranglethorn.
text.giverWindow: 尽管强大，麦佐斯依然懦弱，多半会藏在他的洞穴深处。

english.title: The Mind's Eye
english.objectives: Obtain the Mind's Eye from Mai'Zoth.
english.description: One of the Vale's many treasures lies nearby, on OUR side of the giant whirlpool.  The Mind's Eye is held by an ogre mage, in the Mosh'Ogg ogre mound just to the northeast.  His name is Mai'Zoth.  From what I understand, he is vicious, and his magic is strong.$B$BAnd if he has the Mind's Eye, then his magic will be stronger still.$b$bThus far I've been unable to get near enough to take it from him.  Will you give it a try?
english.progress: Do you have the Eye?
english.completion: You retrieved the eye!  Your might is the stuff of legends, $n! And to think my brother and sister said we wouldn't find anything of worth here in the Vale.  Hah!  And I'm just getting started!
english.completed: Return to Livingston Marshal at Fort Livingston in Northern Stranglethorn.
english.giverWindow: While powerful, Mai'Zoth is cowardly and will probably be hiding in the back of his cave.

text.title: 莫什奥格的馈赠
text.objectives: 从莫什奥格食人魔山后的废墟里获得莫什奥格的馈赠。
text.description: 最近北边的反抗军营地那里有些动静。我刚听一个叫做尼麦兹的士兵说，那里有一名$r$c，找到了令他们如此疯狂的关键所在。那人不会是你吧，啊？$b$b不管怎么说，他给我送来一份样本，看上去和我在东北边莫什奥格食人魔山那儿看到过的石头差不多。$b$b听说食人魔们守着山后面废墟里的一口箱子。说不定这里面有什么联系呢。想不想去帮我拿过来啊？
text.progress: Why is it that the OGRES always find the priceless artifacts?
text.completion: This... this is not like what I expected.  I had thought it would be a... a... Ahem!  I'm sorry.  I'm not sure what came over me.  I'll be sending this south, to the Explorers' League Digsite in the Cape.  Maybe they'll know what to do with it...
text.completed: Return to Wulfred Harrys at Fort Livingston in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: The Mosh'Ogg Bounty
english.objectives: Obtain the Mosh'Ogg Bounty from the ruins behind the Mosh'Ogg Ogre Mound.
english.description: There's been some activity up north, at the rebel camp.  I just heard from a soldier named Nimetz that some $r $c up there found the key to what's been driving them so crazy.  That wasn't you, was it?$b$bAnyhow, he sent a sample to me, and it looks just like the rocks I've been seeing over at the Mosh'Ogg Ogre Mound, to the northeast.$b$bI've heard that the ogres are guarding a chest up in some ruins behind their mound.  I suspect it may be related.  Care to fetch it for me?
english.progress: Why is it that the OGRES always find the priceless artifacts?
english.completion: This... this is not like what I expected.  I had thought it would be a... a... Ahem!  I'm sorry.  I'm not sure what came over me.  I'll be sending this south, to the Explorers' League Digsite in the Cape.  Maybe they'll know what to do with it...
english.completed: Return to Wulfred Harrys at Fort Livingston in Northern Stranglethorn.

That wasn't you, was it?$b$bAnyhow, he sent a sample to me, and it looks just like the rocks I've been seeing over at the Mosh'Ogg Ogre Mound, to the northeast.$b$bI've heard that the ogres are guarding a chest up in some ruins behind their mound.  I suspect it may be related.  Care to fetch it for me?

text.title: 泥浆与水
text.objectives: 消灭泥浆水元素以收集5颗漩涡之核。
text.description: 在高地充盈着元素之力，$n。这就是为什么暮光之锤把要塞建在这里的原因。$B$B使用得当，我们就能把这股能量引导到有建设性的事情上……比如说一道直通奥格瑞玛的传送门。$B$B西北方向，瓦拉尔河口处，水元素由于我们敌人在上游的所作所为而不安分起来。摧毁他们，收集5颗漩涡之核。你将不仅安抚河流，同时也将为我们的传送门提供能量。
text.progress: I hope the fighting within the river wasn't too dangerous.
text.completion: These are perfect! The restless waters of that troubled river will now do much more than move silt or stone... They'll move you across continents. Finish up the rest of your business here in Dragonmaw and then we should be able to proceed.
text.completed: Take the Cores to Artesh at Dragonmaw Port in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Muddied Waters
english.objectives: Slay Muddied Water Elementals to collect 5 Whirlpool Cores.
english.description: The elemental powers are strong here in the Highlands, $n. It is why the Twilight's Hammer chose to build their stronghold here.$B$BIn the right hands, we can channel this energy into something productive... like a portal directly to Orgrimmar.$B$BNorthwest of here, at the Verrall River Delta, water elementals have been stirred up by the actions of our foes upstream. Destroy them and gather 5 whirlpool cores. You'll not only calm the river, you'll power up our portal.
english.progress: I hope the fighting within the river wasn't too dangerous.
english.completion: These are perfect! The restless waters of that troubled river will now do much more than move silt or stone... They'll move you across continents. Finish up the rest of your business here in Dragonmaw and then we should be able to proceed.
english.completed: Take the Cores to Artesh at Dragonmaw Port in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 族群的一部分
text.objectives: 跟暮色森林夜色镇西边十字路口的学徒菲斯谈一谈。
text.description: 我一直在试着对夜色镇的人民隐藏我的真实身份……他们对狼人的态度不是很好。不过，这儿还有很多我们的人，就在城镇外面。一开始同我一道来的伙伴们，都在林子里寻找野生的狼人。他们相信其中那些征兆明显的狼人依然能够归于理智。$B$B我暂时还不打算加入他们，请到镇子西边的十字路口找学徒菲斯，告诉他我将在夜色镇再多待一会儿。
text.completion: Tobias is staying in town still? Master Harris warned him not to pursue his brother's fate. We all lead new lives now, after all. But the past is hard to let go of...

english.title: Part of the Pack
english.objectives: Speak to Apprentice Fess at the crossroads west of Darkshire in Duskwood.
english.description: I've been trying to keep my true self hidden away from the people of Darkshire... they seem to react poorly to worgen. There are more of us here, though, beyond the city.$B$BThe companions I first traveled here with search the woods for wild worgen. They believe some of them, ones with telltale signs, can still be returned to sanity.$B$BI'm not quite ready to rejoin them. Please send word to Apprentice Fess at the crossroads west of town that I'll be staying in Darkshire a while longer.
english.completion: Tobias is staying in town still? Master Harris warned him not to pursue his brother's fate. We all lead new lives now, after all. But the past is hard to let go of...

text.title: 确保滩头阵地
text.objectives: 同暮光高地龙喉哨站的阿泰什交谈。
text.description: 有些事还是让我担忧，$n。暮光龙族知道什么时候，在哪儿攻打我们的舰队。仿佛他们了解我们的计划一般。$B$B暮光的探子就潜伏在我们中间！$B$B我要带上一艘剩余的战舰返回奥格瑞玛清理门户。你得留在这里保障前线。龙喉萨满十分强大，我已让他们为我开启通往奥格瑞玛的传送门，你也要来帮忙。$B$B赶紧！
text.completion: Your Warchief is decisive, $n. He makes things happen. I like him. Let's talk about this portal that he wants!
text.completed: 同暮光高地龙喉哨站的阿泰什交谈。

english.title: Securing the Beach Head
english.objectives: Speak with Artesh at Dragonmaw Port in Twilight Highlands.
english.description: Something troubles me, $n. The twilight dragons knew just where and when to strike our airfleet. It's as if they knew our plans.$B$BTwilight spies cower within our midst!$B$BI'm going to take one of our remaining ships back to Orgrimmar to roll some heads. I need you to stay behind and secure this front. The Dragonmaw shaman are powerful; I have asked them to open up a portal to Orgrimmar, and I need you to help.$B$BSo. Start helping!
english.completion: Your Warchief is decisive, $n. He makes things happen. I like him. Let's talk about this portal that he wants!
english.completed: Speak with Artesh at Dragonmaw Port in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 熊脑子
text.objectives: 获得8副黑熊脑。
text.description: 我担心……好吧，我只是担心，不过我也很抱歉得让你帮另一个忙。$B$B哈里斯大师需要一些脑子。熊的脑子。显然它们是血清的一部分，至少是合理的替代品。$B$B西边的林子里和河岸边都有许多黑熊，但……我做不到！我太害怕了，不敢出去面对那些巨大的生物，拿着步枪也不行。求求你，让我付钱给你，你去帮我把东西弄来！
text.progress: Did you get them? Did you?
text.completion: Thank you! Oh, thank you. I never thought I'd be happy to smell those brains, but I am now that I didn't have to get them! Here's your reward as promised...
text.completed: Return to Jitters at Raven Hill in Duskwood.

english.title: Bear In Mind
english.objectives: Collect 8 Black Bear Brains.
english.description: I'm afraid that... well, I'm just plain afraid, but I'm also sorry to have to ask for another favor.$B$BMaster Harris needs brains. Bear brains. They're part of the serum apparently, or at least a proper substitute.$B$BThere's plenty of black bears in the woods to the west, and along the riverbank, but... I can't do it! I'm too terrified to go out there and face those huge things, even with a rifle. Please, let me pay you to bring back some!
english.progress: Did you get them? Did you?
english.completion: Thank you! Oh, thank you. I never thought I'd be happy to smell those brains, but I am now that I didn't have to get them! Here's your reward as promised...
english.completed: Return to Jitters at Raven Hill in Duskwood.

text.title: 巩固胜果
text.objectives: 收集10份瓦拉尔河淤泥。
text.description: 我们同龙喉的联盟已经建立，但港口还远未完工。这些轻飘飘的木头墙简直就是给酋长丢脸。$B$B当水元素淌过岩石，正如它们在瓦拉尔河中那样，一种特别的淤泥就产生了。这种淤泥抹起来很吃劲，干了以后却比最坚硬的石头还要牢，是大型工程的理想砂浆。$B$B去西北的河口收集一些瓦拉尔河淤泥来，一点点也够用很长时间了。
text.progress: Do you have the mud? Construction of the new walls has already begun!
text.completion: Now that's the stuff! I'll start mixing and diluting this with gravel and water. Just a few handfuls of this can enhance enough cement for an entire stone tower. We've got big plans for this port, $n. You'll see!
text.completed: Bring the Muck to Ornak at Dragonmaw Port in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Cementing Our Victory
english.objectives: Collect 10 piles of Verrall River Muck.
english.description: Our alliance with the Dragonmaw is secured, but this port is far from combat ready. These flimsy wooden walls are an embarrassment to the Warchief.$B$BWhen water elementals carve their way through rock, as they have in the Verrall River, they create a peculiar kind of muck. It spreads easily and dries harder than the hardest stone. It's the perfect mortar for large-scale construction.$B$BGo to the river delta northwest of here and collect some Verrall River muck. Even a little will go a long way.
english.progress: Do you have the mud? Construction of the new walls has already begun!
english.completion: Now that's the stuff! I'll start mixing and diluting this with gravel and water. Just a few handfuls of this can enhance enough cement for an entire stone tower. We've got big plans for this port, $n. You'll see!
english.completed: Bring the Muck to Ornak at Dragonmaw Port in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 不准拿斧頭!
text.objectives: 殺死五隻狗頭人。
text.description: <Name>，我們有個麻煩!我追蹤惡魔獵犬瑪格曼達到這片林地，但當我們休息時，一隊狗頭人拿走了我們的戰斧!我需要你幫忙取回它們，以免瑪格曼達趁我們不備時發動攻擊!趕快，牠隨時都可能會醒來!
text.completed: Return to Thrall in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: You no take axe!
english.objectives: Kill 5 Test Kobolds.
english.description: <Name>, we have a problem! I've tracked down the demon-hound Magmadar to this clearing, but when we resting a band of kobolds took our battle axes! I need you to retrieve them, lest Magmadar catch us off guard! Hurry, he could awaken at any moment!
english.completed: Return to Thrall in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: Magmadar Must Die!
text.objectives: Bring Magmadar's head to Thrall in Stonetalon Mountains.
text.description: There he is, <name>. The foolish beast fell asleep right out in the open! Good news for us, eh? Come, hero, we fight now! You can even have the honor of severing his head from his massive body. What's that? Too big for your bags? Why, carry it, of course! <Thrall grins.>
text.completed: Return to Thrall in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: Magmadar Must Die!
english.objectives: Bring Magmadar's head to Thrall in Stonetalon Mountains.
english.description: There he is, <name>. The foolish beast fell asleep right out in the open! Good news for us, eh? Come, hero, we fight now! You can even have the honor of severing his head from his massive body. What's that? Too big for your bags? Why, carry it, of course! <Thrall grins.>
english.completed: Return to Thrall in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 不准再种了
text.objectives: 启动并获得一具战争守护者，然后摧毁5朵巨蘑菇。
text.description: 石头穴居人秘法师在用北边的巨蘑菇培养真菌怪兽。$B$B我要你带上一具战争守护者去对付那些巨人和石头穴居人。你的目标是那些巨蘑菇，我和我的地卜师们会在秘法师有机会完成仪式之前把它们放倒。
text.completion: They won't have any more of those fungal giants to throw against us!
text.completed: Return to Slate Quicksand at Needlerock Chasm in Deepholm.

english.title: Sprout No More
english.objectives: Interact with and gain a War Guardian, and destroy 5 Giant Mushrooms.
english.description: The stone trogg mystics are creating those fungal monstrosities from the giant mushrooms to the north.$B$BI want you to take a war guardian to help deal with the giants and stone troggs. Make your way to the giant mushrooms and target them. I and my geomancers will sink them into the ground before the mystics have a chance to finish their ritual.
english.completion: They won't have any more of those fungal giants to throw against us!
english.completed: Return to Slate Quicksand at Needlerock Chasm in Deepholm.

text.title: 真菌怪兽
text.objectives: 消灭5个真菌怪兽。
text.description: 带上一具战争守护者，去摧毁那些真菌怪兽。
text.completion: Thank you, $n. We've never had such a problem in Deepholm before the destruction of the World Pillar. Your Earthen Ring must repair the damage before it's too late.
text.completed: Return to Slate Quicksand at Needlerock Chasm in Deepholm.

english.title: Fungal Monstrosities
english.objectives: Slay 5 Fungal Monstrosities.
english.description: Grab yourself a war guardian, and destroy those fungal monstrosities while you're out there.
english.completion: Thank you, $n. We've never had such a problem in Deepholm before the destruction of the World Pillar. Your Earthen Ring must repair the damage before it's too late.
english.completed: Return to Slate Quicksand at Needlerock Chasm in Deepholm.

text.title: 破旧的坟墓
text.objectives: 跟夜色镇的希拉·沃宁迪谈一谈。
text.description: 这座破旧的坟墓上仅仅写着几个字：$b$b摩根·拉迪莫尔$b$b<经过仔细的观察，你发现墓穴的泥土最近被人动过，很多泥土好像都翻开了……>
text.completion: 摩根·拉迪莫尔?$B$B啊，当然，他的故事可就说来话长了，而且还很悲惨。我认识他，他上了战场以後就再也没有回来过。他是个令人尊敬的好人，可惜结局很凄惨。$B$B我这儿有点东西可以让你对他有所了解，这样就不用我自己去艰难地回忆了……$B$B

english.title: The Weathered Grave
english.objectives: Speak with Sirra Von'Indi in Darkshire.
english.description: The weathered grave marker reads simply:$b$bMORGAN LADIMORE$b$b<Upon further examination, you notice that dirt over the grave has been recently disturbed, and that a good amount of the dirt seems to have been displaced...>
english.completion: Morgan Ladimore? Ahh, yes, of course. His was a long and sorrowful tale. I knew him, well, before he left for the war, but that was the last time I saw him. A noble and good man, he was, but he suffered a bad end. Here, I should have something here that can tell the tale better than my own recollections...

text.title: 摩根·拉迪莫尔
text.objectives: 跟夜色镇的指挥官阿尔泰娅·埃伯洛克谈一谈。
text.description: <他从架子上翻出一本皮质封面的书。>$b$b如果你想知道更多，就去问阿尔泰娅，她最近正在为摩根·拉迪莫尔的事情头疼……
text.completion: Morgan Ladimore? Never heard of... Oh, you mean Mor'Ladim! I guess you haven't heard the story? Well, I'll give you the short version. A powerful undead calling itself Mor'Ladim has been wandering Duskwood. From what we've gathered, it appears to be the undead body of Morgan Ladimore, of whom you apparently know. He's been causing us all sorts of problems, attacking Watchmen on patrol and killing people. You seem to be capable enough, maybe you could lay him to rest.

english.title: Morgan Ladimore
english.objectives: Speak with Commander Althea Ebonlocke in Darkshire.
english.description: <He searches through the shelves and comes up with a leatherbound book.>$b$bIf you would like to know more, you might ask Althea, she's been the one to handle the... trouble... with him of late.
english.completion: Morgan Ladimore? Never heard of... Oh, you mean Mor'Ladim! I guess you haven't heard the story? Well, I'll give you the short version. A powerful undead calling itself Mor'Ladim has been wandering Duskwood. From what we've gathered, it appears to be the undead body of Morgan Ladimore, of whom you apparently know. He's been causing us all sorts of problems, attacking Watchmen on patrol and killing people. You seem to be capable enough, maybe you could lay him to rest.

enders.name: 指挥官阿尔泰娅·埃伯洛克

text.title: 摩拉迪姆
text.objectives: 杀死摩拉迪姆，然后将他的徽记交给夜色镇的指挥官阿尔泰娅·埃伯洛克。
text.description: 我的探子说摩拉迪姆沿着一条穿过墓地的弯曲怪异的小路，在暮色森林中四处游荡。我们曾把他的尸体埋在山上那座小屋的后面，你知道在哪儿吧？$b$b除了祝你好运之外，我没什么能帮你的了。
text.progress: 就算你对付不了摩拉迪姆，我也不会责怪你的，$N。我们有很多最棒的守夜人都死在他手下。
text.completion: 你把他干掉了?这可不是件容易的事，$N!我代表夜色镇的人民和所有守夜人感谢你!$B$B啊……对了，还有一件小事……$B$B
text.completed: Return to Commander Althea Ebonlocke at Darkshire in Duskwood.

english.title: Mor'Ladim
english.objectives: Kill Mor'Ladim, then return his skull to Commander Althea Ebonlocke in Darkshire.
english.description: From what my scouts tell me, Mor'Ladim wanders throughout Duskwood, following a strange and meandering path through the cemetery. We buried him out past the house on the hill, you know where that is?$b$bThere isn't anything I can do to help you, but I wish you good luck.
english.progress: I don't blame you if you're having trouble with him, $n. Some of our strongest Watchers have been lost to Mor'Ladim.
english.completion: You killed him? That's no small accomplishment, $n! On behalf of the people of Darkshire and the Night Watch, I thank you. Ah... there is one small matter, however...
english.completed: Return to Commander Althea Ebonlocke at Darkshire in Duskwood.

starters.name: 指挥官阿尔泰娅·埃伯洛克

enders.name: 指挥官阿尔泰娅·埃伯洛克

text.title: 幸存的女儿
text.objectives: 跟夜色镇的守夜人莎拉·拉迪莫尔谈一谈。
text.description: 我应该早点告诉你的……$b$b该怎么说呢……$b$b摩根可能以为他的家人都死了，不过实际上他的女儿莎拉·拉迪莫尔还活着，她现在也是个守夜人。她一直在因为她父亲死了以后所发生的……那些事情而苦恼。我想，你可以把关于她父亲的最新消息带给她。
text.completion: Yes? My father... I wish... there was something I could have done for him... If only I had talked to him before he...

english.title: The Daughter Who Lived
english.objectives: Speak with Watcher Sarah Ladimore in Darkshire.
english.description: I should have told you this earlier...$b$bHow do I put this...$b$bMorgan may have believed that his family was all dead, but, in fact, his daughter Sarah Ladimore is now a Watcher. She's always been troubled by the... circumstances... surrounding her father's death. Perhaps you could go to bring the news to her.
english.completion: Yes? My father... I wish... there was something I could have done for him... If only I had talked to him before he...

starters.name: 指挥官阿尔泰娅·埃伯洛克

text.title: 女儿的爱
text.objectives: 把莎拉·拉迪莫尔的戒指拿到摩根·拉迪莫尔的坟墓上去。
text.description: 拿着这个，请把这个放到他的坟墓上。也许…也许这样他就可以知道我现在过得很好，而且我们也不会因为他所做的事责怪他。$b$b<她含着眼泪，把戴在右手上的一只戒指摘下放在你手里>$b$b还有……谢谢你，$n。
text.progress: 让我安息吧……
text.completion: <一个虚无缥缈的声音在风中响起……>$B$B这是……萨拉?她还活着吗?现在我肩上的重担终於可以卸下了……$B$B$N。拿走我的剑…拿走阿契厄斯吧……我再也不需要它了，因为我的灵魂终於可以安息了。我努力想要做一个好人，可是我不配再拿着这把剑，你可以继续带着这把光明的圣剑。$B$B莉丝，我的挚爱……$B$B

english.title: A Daughter's Love
english.objectives: Take Sarah Ladimore's ring to Morgan Ladimore's grave.
english.description: Here, take this and lay it on his grave. Maybe... somehow, he'll know that I'm okay, and that none of us hold him responsible for what happened.$b$b<There are tears in her eyes now, as she slides a ring from her right hand, and presses it into your hands.>$b$bAnd... thank you, $n.
english.progress: Leave me be...
english.completion: This is...? Sarah? Could it be she's still alive? The weight is removed from my shoulders... $n. Take my sword, Archeus. As my soul is put to rest, I have no more need for it. It was forged to do good, and though I have proved myself unworthy to hold it, perhaps you will carry on the Light through it. Lys, my love...

text.title: 萨鲁法尔会很高兴的
text.objectives: 使用龙喉哨站的传送门前往奥格瑞玛，向萨鲁法尔大王报告。
text.description: 传送门准备好了！$B$B它还不够强大，无法传送一支军队，不过我们可以维持足够长的时间，让重要的人物畅通无阻。$B$B萨鲁法尔需要知道我们在这里的进展，用传送门前往奥格瑞玛，向他汇报情况。
text.completion: $c, you've returned from Dragonmaw. The portal is functioning then? Good. Before you return to your work there, we've got some dirty business to clean up right here in Orgrimmar...
text.completed: 使用龙喉哨站的传送门前往奥格瑞玛，向萨鲁法尔大王报告。

english.title: The Warchief Will be Pleased
english.objectives: Use the portal in Dragonmaw Port to go to Orgrimmar and report to Garrosh Hellscream.
english.description: The portal is ready!$B$BIt's not powerful enough to transport an army, but we can maintain the connection long enough to allow important individuals to pass back and forth.$B$BThe Warchief will want to know about our progress here. Walk through the portal to Orgrimmar, then deliver the news to Garrosh Hellscream.
english.completion: $c, you've returned from Dragonmaw. The portal is functioning then? Good. Before you return to your work there, we've got some dirty business to clean up right here in Orgrimmar...
english.completed: Use the portal in Dragonmaw Port to go to Orgrimmar and report to Garrosh Hellscream.

text.title: 不可拯救的死者
text.objectives: 消灭6个无脑的僵尸。
text.description: 瓦格里每天都会唤醒成百上千的尸体。比如你，不久之前刚被阿加莎复活。但并不是所有人的运气都和你一样好。$b$b有些人保持了自由的意志，却陷入了无休止的恐惧和疑惑之中。他们通常会逃进森林里，凝视着自己的倒影瑟瑟发抖。$b$b另一些则彻底失去了心智，蹒跚着脚步漫无目的地游荡。他们时常会变得富有攻击性，必须消除这些危险的行尸。$b$b这就是你的任务，$n，消灭他们，即使他们以前可能是我们的兄弟姐妹。
text.progress: You will not go far in this new life if you are unable to kill even the weakest, most brainless creatures, $n. Do not return untill you have success to report.
text.completion: Not even the power of the val'kyr was enough to save these creatures.  They were doomed from the beginning. I have obtained some equipment for you, $n.  It's not much, but it will help.  Please, take your pick.
text.completed: Return to Undertaker Mordo at the Deathknell Graves in Tirisfal Glades.

english.title: Those That Couldn't Be Saved
english.objectives: Kill 6 Mindless Zombies.
english.description: The val'kyr raise hundreds of corpses every day.  Agatha raised you just a few moments ago.  Not all are as lucky as you, however.$b$bSome maintain their free will, but live in constant fear and confusion.  They usually run off into the woods, cowering at their own reflections.$b$bOthers lose their minds completely, shambling about aimlessly.  They often turn to violence, and must be destroyed.$b$bThis is your task, $n.  Destroy them, our former brothers and sisters though they might be.
english.progress: You will not go far in this new life if you are unable to kill even the weakest, most brainless creatures, $n. Do not return untill you have success to report.
english.completion: Not even the power of the val'kyr was enough to save these creatures.  They were doomed from the beginning. I have obtained some equipment for you, $n.  It's not much, but it will help.  Please, take your pick.
english.completed: Return to Undertaker Mordo at the Deathknell Graves in Tirisfal Glades.

text.title: 清扫战场
text.objectives: 在丧钟镇及其周边地区找到6具血色十字军尸体，然后指指它们，让达内尔去搬运。
text.description: 我们从四面八方运来尸体，银松森林、希尔斯布莱德……啊，反正是到处搜刮。不过，我们也不能忽视了坐在我们眼皮底下的尸体。$B$B血色十字军的最后一支残部在提瑞斯法林地游荡。我们从丧钟镇击退了他们，东边和北边留下了不少他们的尸体。$B$B去找到他们……把达内尔也带上一起去。他好像挺壮的，可以搬几具尸体。
text.progress: Have you managed to scavenge up some corpses?
text.completion: Great work $n.  I knew you weren't useless. Here, take one of these.  We deathguards have piles of these things just sitting around.
text.completed: Return to Deathguard Saltain at Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades.

english.title: Recruitment
english.objectives: Search Deathknell and the vicinity for 6 Scarlet Corpses, then point at them so Darnell can pick them up.
english.description: We've been shipping in dead bodies from Silverpine, Hillsbrad... hell, anywhere we can get them from.  We can't, however, afford to ignore the bodies which are sitting right on our front doorstep.$b$bThe last vestiges of the Scarlet Crusade roam here in Tirisfal Glades.  While we've managed to push them from Deathknell, several of their bodies litter the buildings to the north and the east.$b$bGo find them... and bring that Darnell fellow with you.  He looks strong enough to carry a few corpses.
english.progress: Have you managed to scavenge up some corpses?
english.completion: Great work $n.  I knew you weren't useless. Here, take one of these.  We deathguards have piles of these things just sitting around.
english.completed: Return to Deathguard Saltain at Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades.

text.title: 境内的天灾
text.objectives: 在丧钟镇外消灭8个亡灵。无脑的食尸鬼和断骨骷髅都算数。
text.description: 如果你要为被遗忘者做点贡献，就得先学习如何战斗。没有比那些整天骚扰我们的天灾军团喽啰更适合练手的目标了。$B$B无脑的食尸鬼和断骨骷髅在北边和东边游荡，它们曾是天灾军团的士兵。对你这样的菜鸟$c来说正是势均力敌。$b$b别耽搁时间——当你完成任务后，就来找我谈谈。
text.progress: Those who dally in this task might as well end up wandering about aimlessly like our fallen brothers and sisters in the village.  Let's hope you will fare better than them, yes?
text.completion: You're growing in strength, $n.  I've seen your type before.  You will be moving out of Deathknell and on to greater things before long.  Just make sure you don't lose sight of where you started. You have much to accomplish, $c.
text.completed: Return to Shadow Priest Sarvis at Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades.

english.title: Scourge on our Perimeter
english.objectives: Kill 8 undead outside of Deathknell.  You may kill either Wretched Ghouls or Rattlecage Skeletons.
english.description: If you're going to be an asset to the Forsaken, you need to learn how to fight.  And there's no better target than the Scourge minions that continue to pester us.$B$BThe wretched ghouls and Rattlecage skeletons that roam the north and to the east are former troopers of the fallen Scourge.  They should prove to be an even match for a fledgling $c like you.$b$bDo not tarry - when you are done, speak to me again.
english.progress: Those who dally in this task might as well end up wandering about aimlessly like our fallen brothers and sisters in the village.  Let's hope you will fare better than them, yes?
english.completion: You're growing in strength, $n.  I've seen your type before.  You will be moving out of Deathknell and on to greater things before long.  Just make sure you don't lose sight of where you started. You have much to accomplish, $c.
english.completed: Return to Shadow Priest Sarvis at Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades.

objectiveDetails.description: 杀死丧钟镇的天灾士兵

text.title: 被诅咒者
text.objectives: 收集4只食腐狼的爪子和4只夜行蝙蝠翼。
text.description: 看看你的护甲，$c简直是一团糟。$b$b毫无疑问，你肯定想让自己完整无缺。也许我能帮你的忙。如果你能帮我弄一些狼爪和蝙蝠翅膀的话，我会帮你找几件铠甲。在这里的西方和北方可以找到大群的狼和蝙蝠。
text.progress: 在我给你铠甲之前，千万别不小心挂掉了。
text.completion: 谢谢你，$N。这件铠甲应该对你有用。$B$B但愿比起前一个穿着它的人，你能活得更久一些……$B$B
text.completed: Return to Executor Arren at Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades.

english.title: The Damned
english.objectives: Obtain 4 Scavenger Paws and 4 Duskbat Wings.
english.description: First of all, look at your armor.  You're a mess, $c.$b$bIf you'd like to stay in one piece--and I've no doubt you do--perhaps I can help.  If you can gather some paws and wings from the wolves and bats nearby, maybe I'll find some armor for you.  You'll find the creatures to the north and to the west of here.
english.progress: Do try your best to keep yourself unharmed until I get you some armor.
english.completion: Thank you, $n. This armor should help you out. Hopefully, it should do you more good than the last one to wear it...
english.completed: Return to Executor Arren at Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades.

text.title: 迟到的报告
text.objectives: 与奥格瑞玛的双足飞龙管理员多拉斯谈一谈。
text.description: 萨鲁法尔是个聪明人，而且他的本意是好的。总有一天，他会意识到你们是部落的重要盟友。$B$B我在等待联盟最近在杜隆塔尔的活动报告，不过到现在都没有消息。你愿意亲自去一趟剃刀岭，找他拿一下报告吗？前往那里的最便捷途径是搭乘双足飞龙。多拉斯是奥格瑞玛的双足飞龙管理员，你可以花一点钱向他租用双足飞龙。到力量谷北边的高地去找他吧。
text.completion: So you need to get to Razor Hill in a hurry? That's no problem at all. One of my wind riders will get you there very quickly and it only costs a few coins to hire one.

english.title: Missing Reports
english.objectives: Talk to Orgrimmar's wind rider master, Doras.
english.description: Garrosh is brash and speaks harshly, but his intentions are good. In time, he will grow to see your people as a valuable ally.$B$BI am awaiting reports about recent Alliance activity in Durotar, but they haven't arrived yet. Would you be willing to visit Razor Hill and ask him for the reports in person? The easiest way to get there is by wind rider. Doras, Orgrimmar's wind rider master will let you use one of his wind riders for a small fee. Look for him on the rise north of the Valley of Strength.
english.completion: So you need to get to Razor Hill in a hurry? That's no problem at all. One of my wind riders will get you there very quickly and it only costs a few coins to hire one.

text.title: 飞往剃刀岭
text.objectives: 与多拉斯交谈，租用一只双足飞龙前往剃刀岭。抵达之后，去找加索克。
text.description: 等你准备好乘坐双足飞龙前往剃刀岭了，就跟我说一声。到了那里之后，直接去找加索克。他负责撰写最近联盟在杜隆塔尔的活动情况报告。
text.completion: Eitrigg sent you? The warchief must be getting anxious to read my reports. I'd've sent them long ago, but each day we discover more about the Alliance's plans for invading Durotar.

english.title: Flight to Razor Hill
english.objectives: Speak to Doras to purchase a wind rider ride to Razor Hill. Once you arrive, speak with Gar'Thok.
english.description: When you're ready to take the wind rider down to Razor Hill, simply speak with me again. When you get there, waste no time in finding Gar'Thok. He's the one responsible for preparing reports on recent Alliance activity in Durotar.
english.completion: Eitrigg sent you? The warchief must be getting anxious to read my reports. I'd've sent them long ago, but each day we discover more about the Alliance's plans for invading Durotar.

text.title: 去海角！
text.objectives: 跟罗伯特·洛德斯谈一谈，飞往荆棘谷海角的探险者协会挖掘场。
text.description: 探险者协会正在壮大，$n。他们不仅吸纳了像我这样的狼人成员，也在扩大搜索范围寻找神器。我们中最出色的一位，布朗温·斧击，在南边建立了一个营地，据称那里藏着一件泰坦时代的文物。$b$b布朗温把我指派到这里来，其中一个任务就是甄别有潜力的新人。你看来资质还不错，去跟飞行管理员罗伯特·洛德斯谈谈，他会把你送过去的。路费算布朗温的。
text.completion: Wulfred has a good eye.  I think you'll do just fine here at my camp.
text.completed: 跟罗伯特·洛德斯谈一谈，飞往荆棘谷海角的探险者协会挖掘场。

english.title: To the Cape!
english.objectives: Speak with Robert Rhodes to obtain a flight to the Explorers' League Digsite in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
english.description: The Explorers' League is growing, $n.  Not only have they taken in worgen like me, but they have expanded their range in search of artifacts.  One of our best, Bronwyn Hewstrike, has set up a camp in the south, where he believes an item of titan origin may be hidden.$b$bBronwyn asked me to perform some duties here in the north, one of which was to identify potential recruits.  You seem to be made of the right stuff.  Talk to Robert Rhodes, the flight master, and he'll send you down there.  Bronwyn's treat.
english.completion: Wulfred has a good eye.  I think you'll do just fine here at my camp.
english.completed: Speak with Robert Rhodes to obtain a flight to the Explorers' League Digsite in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

text.title: 送往奥格瑞玛的报告
text.objectives: 将加索克的报告交给剃刀岭的波洛克。
text.description: 伊崔格看到我已经完成的这部分报告之后，一定会很高兴的。告诉他，我还会陆续发给他更多报告。$B$B<加索克把一摞粗略叠起来的文件递给你。>$B$B部署在北方岗哨的联盟部队正在持续获得增援，详细情况都已经写在这些报告里了。请代我向伊崔格道歉，告诉他，我们一直在忙着保持剃刀岭的安全和补给，实在抽不出身。等你准备返回奥格瑞玛的时候，就去找波洛克租一只双足飞龙。
text.progress: Are you ready to return to Orgrimmar?
text.completion: Ready to return to Orgrimmar with those reports? I can arrange a flight for you right away.

english.title: Reports to Orgrimmar
english.objectives: Take Gar'Thok's Reports to Burok at Razor Hill.
english.description: Eitrigg will have to be happy with the part of the report that I've finished. Tell him to expect more in the future.$B$B<Gar'Thok hands you a stack of roughly folded papers.>$B$BThis should cover the most important details of the increase in Alliance forces working out of Northwatch. Please apologize to Eitrigg for me and let him know that we've had our hands full here, trying to keep Razor Hill secure and supplied. When you're ready to return to Orgrimmar, simply speak to Burok and hire a wind rider.
english.progress: Are you ready to return to Orgrimmar?
english.completion: Ready to return to Orgrimmar with those reports? I can arrange a flight for you right away.

text.title: 向伊崔格复命
text.objectives: 与波洛克交谈，租用双足飞龙回到奥格瑞玛。抵达奥格瑞玛之后，将加索克的报告交给力量谷中的伊崔格。
text.description: 既然你已经跟多拉斯聊过了，就可以在这里租一只双足飞龙，直接飞回奥格瑞玛。每当你抵达新的城镇，都别忘了找当地的飞行管理员聊聊。那样的话你就可以借助飞行管理员的服务，方便快捷地旅行啦。$B$B等你准备飞回奥格瑞玛的时候，就跟我说一声。抵达之后，把这些报告交给力量谷的伊崔格。
text.progress: Did you bring those reports?
text.completion: The Alliance has grown bolder than we'd thought! I'll talk to the warchief about sending reinforcements right away. Thank you for getting these reports to me so quickly. I hope this coin is enough to cover your travel expenses.

english.title: Return to Eitrigg
english.objectives: Speak with Burok and purchase a flight back to Orgrimmar. Once in Orgrimmar, bring Gar'Thok's Reports to Eitrigg in the Valley of Strength.
english.description: Since you've already spoken to Doras, you'll be able to hire a wind rider to take you right back to Orgrimmar. Each time you arrive in a new town, be sure to speak with the town's flight master. After that, you'll be able to use the flight master's services to travel quickly.$B$BSpeak to me again when you're ready to purchase a return flight to Orgrimmar. Bring those reports to Eitrigg in the Valley of Strength once you've landed.
english.progress: Did you bring those reports?
english.completion: The Alliance has grown bolder than we'd thought! I'll talk to the warchief about sending reinforcements right away. Thank you for getting these reports to me so quickly. I hope this coin is enough to cover your travel expenses.

text.title: 梅维克
text.objectives: 把琳兹的礼物给探险者协会挖掘场的祖达萨的梅维克带去。
text.description: <琳兹貌似心头烦恼。>$b$b你知道，有只巨魔藏在那堆盒子后面。她不出来，跟谁都不说话，一定是非常伤心。$b$b<琳兹在方巾里搁了一些海蛇草扎起来。>$b$b给，把这个给她拿去。它们可软了，也许能让她觉得好受些。
text.progress: Care to explain yourself, $c?
text.completion: You have my thanks.  You may tell your young dwarven friend that I am not sad.  I am waiting.  For you. I have identified you as the most promising $r here in this strange town.  I have a task for you, if you would be willing to take it.

english.title: Maywiki
english.objectives: Bring Linzi's Gift to Maywiki of Zuldazar at the Explorers' League Digsite.
english.description: <Linzi looks troubled.>$b$bYou know, there's a troll hiding behind that pile of boxes.  She must be awfully sad, if she doesn't want to come out and talk to anyone.$b$b<Linzi places some of the Akiris reeds in a kerchief and ties it together.>$b$bHere, give these to her.  They're very soft, and that maybe they will make her feel a little more comfortable back there.
english.progress: Care to explain yourself, $c?
english.completion: You have my thanks.  You may tell your young dwarven friend that I am not sad.  I am waiting.  For you. I have identified you as the most promising $r here in this strange town.  I have a task for you, if you would be willing to take it.

text.title: 幕后交易
text.objectives: 将古拉巴什熏香放在希里克图腾前，然后听取赞吉尔的阴谋。
text.description: 我的目标，是被古拉巴什部落放逐的流亡者赞吉尔。最近，我听兄弟们说他打算重返部族，并打算往劈颅派遣使者。这可不是好消息。$b$b我要你去刺探赞吉尔眼下的计划。带上这焚香，把它放在北边朱布瓦尔废墟的蝙蝠图腾前。希里克会指引你去那里。
text.completion: It is as I suspected.  Zanzil is too haughty to interfere with the squabbles between the Bloodscalps and the Skullsplitters.  No, he is playing a part in a grander scheme... Jin'do the Hexxer is using him to help bring Hakkar back to Zul'Gurub. It's good that we found this out now, because it offers us a simple solution.
text.completed: Return to Maywiki at the Explorers' League Digsite in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

english.title: Backdoor Dealings
english.objectives: Place the Gurubashi Incense in front of the Totem of Hir'eek, then listen to Zanzil's plot.
english.description: Zanzil the Outcast, an exile from the Gurubashi tribe, is my quarry.  Recently, I have heard tales from my brothers in the north about his planned reentry into society, starting with the emissary he sent to the Skullsplitters.  This is not good news.$b$bI want you to peer into Zanzil's current plans.  Take this incense, and place it in front of the bat totem in the Ruins of Jubuwal, to the north.  Hir'eek will guide you from there.
english.completion: It is as I suspected.  Zanzil is too haughty to interfere with the squabbles between the Bloodscalps and the Skullsplitters.  No, he is playing a part in a grander scheme... Jin'do the Hexxer is using him to help bring Hakkar back to Zul'Gurub. It's good that we found this out now, because it offers us a simple solution.
english.completed: Return to Maywiki at the Explorers' League Digsite in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

objectiveDetails.description: 将焚香放在希里克图腾前

text.title: 消灭流亡者
text.objectives: 前往荆棘谷海角阿博拉兹废墟对付流亡者赞吉尔。
text.description: 你得去杀掉赞吉尔。希里克的翅膀带你飞翔，希里克的双眼为你所及。去把他杀掉。$b$b哦，对了$r：要是我们走散了，你可以使用这尊神像。它只在荆棘谷有效，不过却可以迅速把你传送到我这里来。$b$b祝你好运，$r。赞吉尔可不是一般的对手。
text.giverWindow: 他搅合药剂的日子结束了。

english.title: Eliminate the Outcast
english.objectives: Travel to the Ruins of Aboraz in the Cape of Stranglethorn and deal with Zanzil the Outcast.
english.description: You are to kill Zanzil.  You rode on Hir'eek's wings and saw through Hir'eek's eyes; you know where Zanzil hides within the Ruins of Aboraz.  Travel there and kill him.$b$bOh, and $r: if we become separated, you should use this fetish.  It only works within Stranglethorn, but it will transport you back here to me should you need to return switfly.$b$bGood luck, $r.  Zanzil is no ordinary opponent.
english.giverWindow: His potion-mixing days are at an end.

text.title: 穿过巨魔洞
text.objectives: 用赞吉尔的传送门进入祖尔格拉布。$b$b假如你迷路了或者需要回到祖尔格拉布，去跟探险者协会挖掘场的梅维克交谈。
text.description: 看来赞吉尔前往祖尔格拉布的传送门还开着。祖尔格拉布是个危险的地方，但梅维克觉得你能胜任。$b$b传送门就在前面正等着你呢。

english.title: Through the Troll Hole
english.objectives: Use Zanzil's Portal and enter Zul'Gurub.$b$bIf you become lost or need to return to Zul'Gurub, speak with Maywiki at the Explorers' League Digsite.
english.description: It looks like Zanzil's portal into Zul'Gurub is still open.  Zul'Gurub is a dangerous place, but Maywiki entrusted this task to you.$b$bThe portal lies in wait in front of you.

text.title: 高阶祭司耶克里克
text.objectives: 在赞吉尔复活他之前消灭高阶祭司耶克里克。$b$b假如你迷路了或者需要回到祖尔格拉布，去跟探险者协会挖掘场的梅维克交谈。
text.description: 你的前方涌现出一条坡道，通向城市众多平台之一。前面蝙蝠形状的图腾表明这是的追随者，高阶祭司耶克里克的领域。$b$b耶克里克是众多崇拜哈卡的祭司之一，赞吉尔正打算复活他。假如你动作快，或许可以阻止他的复活！
text.giverWindow: 蝙蝠之灵希里克的追随者。

english.title: High Priestess Jeklik
english.objectives: Destroy High Priestess Jeklik's body before Zanzil can resurrect her.$b$bIf you become lost or need to return to Zul'Gurub, speak with Maywiki at the Explorers' League Digsite.
english.description: Ahead of you looms a ramp up to one of the city's many terraces.  The bat-shaped totems ahead of you indicate that this is the domain of High Priestess Jeklik, a follower of Hir'eek.$b$bJeklik was one of the Hakkar-worshipping priests that Zanzil was planning to resurrect.  Perhaps if you hurry, you can stop the resurrection!
english.giverWindow: Follower of Hir'eek, the bat loa.

objectiveDetails.description: 消灭高阶祭司耶克里克的肉身

text.title: 身陷祖尔格拉布
text.objectives: 穿过赞吉尔的传送门。$b$b假如你迷路了或者需要回到祖尔格拉布，去跟探险者协会挖掘场的梅维克交谈。
text.description: 流亡者赞吉尔再次从另一道传送门逃了。追上他！

english.title: Plunging Into Zul'Gurub
english.objectives: Pass through Zanzil's Portal.$b$bIf you become lost or need to return to Zul'Gurub, speak with Maywiki at the Explorers' League Digsite.
english.description: Zanzil the Outcast has once again escaped through one of his portals.  Follow him!

text.title: 高阶祭司温诺希斯
text.objectives: 对付流亡者赞吉尔和高阶祭司温诺希斯。$b$b假如你迷路了或者需要回到祖尔格拉布，去跟探险者协会挖掘场的梅维克交谈。
text.description: 温诺希斯是赞吉尔打算复生的两名祭司之一。你已经成功地摧毁了高阶祭司耶克里克的肉身……温诺希斯将是下一个。
text.completion: I ask you to slay Zanzil the Outcast, a lowly, hermetic exile of the Gurubashi, and what do you do?  You dash headfirst into the Gurubashi capital and eliminate one of their High Priests!  Very nearly two!  Only one word suffices to explain such a rash and foolhardy endeavor: Heroism. Jin'do the Hexxer still walks within Zul'Gurub's walls, but he lost one of his legs when you crushed Jeklik.  Today's battle is ours.
text.completed: Return to Maywiki at the Explorers' League Digsite in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
text.giverWindow: 盘蛇之灵赫希斯的追随者

english.title: High Priest Venoxis
english.objectives: Deal with Zanzil the Outcast and High Priest Venoxis.$b$bIf you become lost or need to return to Zul'Gurub, speak with Maywiki at the Explorers' League Digsite.
english.description: Venoxis was the second of the two priests that Zanzil planned to bring back from the dead.  You have already succeeded in destroying the body of High Priestess Jeklik... Venoxis must be the next.
english.completion: I ask you to slay Zanzil the Outcast, a lowly, hermetic exile of the Gurubashi, and what do you do?  You dash headfirst into the Gurubashi capital and eliminate one of their High Priests!  Very nearly two!  Only one word suffices to explain such a rash and foolhardy endeavor: Heroism. Jin'do the Hexxer still walks within Zul'Gurub's walls, but he lost one of his legs when you crushed Jeklik.  Today's battle is ours.
english.completed: Return to Maywiki at the Explorers' League Digsite in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
english.giverWindow: Follower of Hethiss, the snake loa.

objectiveDetails.description: 对付高阶祭司温诺希斯

text.title: 赞吉尔的秘密
text.objectives: 获取5瓶赞吉尔的药剂。
text.description: 多年前，古拉巴什将一名自己人逐出了祖尔格拉布：那个巨魔名叫赞吉尔。原因为何不是很清楚，但我想多半是因为他倾向对所有人都投与一种强大的行为控制药剂有关。不管怎么说，古拉巴什的祭司们和他们的血神已经被消灭了，但流亡者赞吉尔却幸存了下来……$b$b……还有他那强大的行为控制药剂。$b$b我接下来的实验需要他的药剂。去北边的僵尸身上找找看。
text.progress: Excellent... you're not a zombie yet.  That's good.$b$bOh, umm... nothing.  It's just that... that was a potential risk.  Did I forget to warn you?
text.completion: This mixture is... PERFECT!  Let's see what it does to your potentially-titan artifact here!
text.completed: Return to Dask "The Flask" Gobfizzle at the Explorers' League Digsite in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

english.title: Zanzil's Secret
english.objectives: Obtain 5 vials of Zanzil's Mixture.
english.description: Years ago, the Gurubashi exiled one of their own from Zul'Gurub: a troll by the name of Zanzil.  The reasons why aren't all that clear, but I'd guess it had something to do with his tendency to administer powerful, behavior-altering drugs to anyone he saw.  Anyhow, the Gurubashi priests and their blood god have been slain, but Zanzil the Outcast remains...$b$b...as do his powerful, behavior-altering drugs.$b$bI need his mixture for my next test.  Check the zombies to the north.
