text.title: 安多哈尔之战
text.objectives: 向西瘟疫之地安多哈尔城里的库尔迪拉·织亡者报告。
text.description: 快，$n……没时间浪费了。$b$b安多哈尔城正处于三方混战，被遗忘者、联盟，还有天灾军团。希尔瓦娜斯女士已经派她最精良的一名死亡骑士上前线督阵，但我敢肯定他肯定不介意多些人手帮忙。阿尔萨斯死后，被遗忘者夺取安多哈尔的最好时机已经来临了。$b$b你准备好了以后就去找蝙蝠管理员提摩西·卡宁汉，他会把你送上头趟航班。
text.completion: It's about time you arrived, $c.
text.completed: 向西瘟疫之地安多哈尔城里的库尔迪拉·织亡者报告。

english.title: The Battle for Andorhal
english.objectives: Report to Koltira Deathweaver within Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.
english.description: Hurry, $n... there isn't time to waste.$b$bThe city of Andorhal is in the middle of a three-way war between the Forsaken, the Alliance, and the Scourge.  Lady Sylvanas has sent one of her best death knights to lead the charge for her cause, but I'm sure he can use all the help he can get.  With Arthas dead, now is the perfect time for the Forsaken to take Andorhal.$b$bSpeak with the bat handler, Timothy Cunningham, when you are ready, and he will put you on the first flight out there.
english.completion: It's about time you arrived, $c.
english.completed: Report to Koltira Deathweaver within Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.

text.title: 先是天灾……再是联盟
text.objectives: 杀死安多哈尔城里的15名枯骨天灾战士。
text.description: 诅咒教派的黑暗院长加丁率领天灾军团进攻安多哈尔。我的老对头，萨萨里安指挥着联盟部队。若想拿下安多哈尔，我们得把他们都打败，但兵分两路必不能成事。$b$b我很了解萨萨里安，他会先对付天灾军团。我们也一样。$b$b先把天灾军团的寡兵弱将干掉，减少它们的兵力。联盟可以稍后再来对付。
text.completion: You may not act quickly, but at least you do not fail me. Very well.  I will have a more important task for you, $n, when the time is right.
text.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.

english.title: Scourge First... Alliance Later
english.objectives: Slay 15 Desiccated Scourge within Andorhal.
english.description: Darkmaster Gandling of the Cult of the Damned leads the Scourge offensive here in Andorhal.  My old counterpart, Thassarian, leads the Alliance forces.  If we're to win Andorhal, we'll have to defeat both, but we will certainly fail if we take on both at once.$b$bI know Thassarian well enough to know that he will focus on the Scourge first.  We will do the same.$b$bTake out the weaker, desiccated Scourge to reduce their numbers.  The Alliance will have to wait to taste our wrath.
english.completion: You may not act quickly, but at least you do not fail me. Very well.  I will have a more important task for you, $n, when the time is right.
english.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.

text.title: 源源不绝
text.objectives: 用杰尔的手榴弹消灭5具拾骨狂战士，摧毁天灾骨堆法阵。
text.description: 召唤者阿拉基单单用骷髅来给天灾军团固防……这支军队贵多不贵精。他在安多哈尔北塔中架设了骨堆法阵，正以惊人的速度暴骷髅。但我自有妙计！$b$b<杰尔交给你一大把手榴弹。>$b$b很简单的。把手榴弹朝骨堆法阵扔过去……或者，你也可以丢到一堆骷髅当中……就能把它们炸成齑粉。
text.completion: These grenades are all explosives, nothing more.  Even as a member of the Royal Apothecary Society, I recognize that some problems are not solved by throwing more plague at them.
text.completed: Return to Jearl Donald at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.

english.title: The Endless Flow
english.objectives: Use Jearl's Hand Grenades to kill 5 Stickbone Berserkers and to destroy a Scourge Bone Animus.
english.description: Araj the Summoner is bolstering the Scourge defenses with simple skeletons... an army of weaklings that will overwhelm you before it overpowers you.  He has assembled animi within Andorhal's northern towers that spew these skeletons out at an alarming rate.  But I've got the solution!$b$b<Jearl passes you a handful of grenades.>$b$bTheir function is simple.  Throwing these grenades at a bone animus... or, for that matter, a mob of skeletons... will reduce them to splinters.
english.completion: These grenades are all explosives, nothing more.  Even as a member of the Royal Apothecary Society, I recognize that some problems are not solved by throwing more plague at them.
english.completed: Return to Jearl Donald at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.

text.title: 战争机器
text.objectives: 在安多哈尔摧毁6只缝腹巨怪。
text.description: 你们这些蠢货，放着那些憎恶一辈子也别想打赢天灾军团。库尔迪拉尽扯些什么此消彼长的淡话——天灾军团在安多哈尔最好的武器就是这些将亡灵卫兵玩弄于股掌间的大家伙。$b$b我可不吃这套，$n，上战场给我把那些怪物干掉。
text.completion: With the behemoths out of the way, our victory against the Scourge is inevitable. Our current chances against the Alliance aren't quite as favorable... but that's no concern of yours.  Not yet, anyhow.
text.completed: Return to Lindsay Ravensun at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.

english.title: War Machines
english.objectives: Destroy 6 Opengut Behemoths in Andorhal.
english.description: You fools will never defeat the Scourge with those abominations running around.  Koltira blathers on about reducing their numbers, but the Scourge's best weapon here in Andorhal can be found in those lumbering brutes that are throwing my deathguards around like ragdolls.$b$bI won't have it.  $n, enter the battlefield and destroy those monsters.
english.completion: With the behemoths out of the way, our victory against the Scourge is inevitable. Our current chances against the Alliance aren't quite as favorable... but that's no concern of yours.  Not yet, anyhow.
english.completed: Return to Lindsay Ravensun at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.

text.title: 通灵学院
text.objectives: 击败安多哈尔城内的黑暗院长加丁。
text.description: 通灵学院是天灾在索多里尔河西岸少数的几个据点之一。通灵学院的院长是黑暗院长加丁，这名教徒首领最近亲自来到了战场督战。$b$b你可以在镇子南边的广场上找到加丁，去同他交手，我会帮你击败他的。
text.completion: Excellently done, $n.  And now, with the leader of the Scourge forces eliminated from Andorhal, we bide our time.
text.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.
text.giverWindow: 通灵学院的院长，安多哈尔天灾的首领。

english.title: Scholomancer
english.objectives: Kill Darkmaster Gandling within Andorhal.
english.description: The Scholomance is one of the few Scourge holdouts remaining west of the Thondroril.  The headmaster of Scholomance, a cultist by the name of Darkmaster Gandling, has made an appearance on the battlefield.$b$bThis will be his final mistake.$b$bYou will find Gandling in a square near the southern end of town.  I want you to fight and weaken Gandling.  I will join you to help finish him off.
english.completion: Excellently done, $n.  And now, with the leader of the Scourge forces eliminated from Andorhal, we bide our time.
english.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.
english.giverWindow: Master of the Scholomance, leader of the Scourge in Andorhal.

text.title: 召唤者阿拉基
text.objectives: 杀掉召唤者阿拉基。你可以用杰尔的手榴弹消灭拾骨狂战士。
text.description: 畸体被摧毁之后，下一步棋就是要对付阿拉基本人，并取得一块他的护命匣碎片。他出没于城镇中心的喷泉附近，说不定你已经见过他了。$b$b带上我的手榴弹，它们对付不了阿拉基，但是要是他打算召唤骷髅，你可以把它们再炸回去。
text.progress: Araj is a formidable opponent.  Be prepared.
text.completion: Araj dead... this is good.  The Royal Apothecary Society has done its part.  As have you, $n.
text.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.
text.giverWindow: 记住，使用我的手雷来招呼他的骷髅们！

english.title: Araj the Summoner
english.objectives: Kill Araj the Summoner.  You may use Jearl's Hand Grenades to destroy Stickbone Berserkers.
english.description: With the animus destroyed, the next logical step is to take out Araj himself, and to take a shard of his phylactery.  You've probably already seen him, lurking at the fountain in the center of town.$b$bTake my grenades with you.  They won't do anything to Araj, but if he decides to summon any of those skeletons, you can use them to blow them away.  Again.
english.progress: Araj is a formidable opponent.  Be prepared.
english.completion: Araj dead... this is good.  The Royal Apothecary Society has done its part.  As have you, $n.
english.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.
english.giverWindow: Remember, use my grenades to take care of his skeletons!

text.title: 暂时的胜利
text.objectives: 到提瑞斯法林地的亡灵壁垒去，向高级执行官德灵顿报到。
text.description: 被遗忘者大获全胜，我们依然兵强马壮。按正常的战略来讲，趁联盟还在恢复元气，我们现在就该打它个出其不意。但是，我另有计较……$b$b我们按兵不动。等时机成熟，再对萨萨里安进行攻击。与此同时，你要与朗达·莫维尔交谈，飞往瘟疫之地西部边境的亡灵壁垒，在那里高级执行官德灵顿会告诉你下一步该怎么做。$b$b等安多哈尔需要你时我自会派人找你。
text.completion: Word arrived shortly before you did, $n.  With the Scourge ejected from Andorhal, the Forsaken has cemented its foothold in Lordaeron.
text.completed: 到提瑞斯法林地的亡灵壁垒去，向高级执行官德灵顿报到。

english.title: Victory, For Now
english.objectives: Report to High Executor Derrington at the Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.
english.description: The Forsaken are victorious, and our forces are still strong.  Military strategy dictates that we attack the Alliance now, while they are recovering and unaware.  I have other plans, however...$b$bWe will wait.  We attack Thassarian and his troops when the time is right.  In the meantime, speak with Rhonda Molver and take a flight to the Bulwark, on the Plaguelands' western border.  High Executor Derrington will give you your next assignment.$b$bYou will hear from me when you are needed again in Andorhal.
english.completion: Word arrived shortly before you did, $n.  With the Scourge ejected from Andorhal, the Forsaken has cemented its foothold in Lordaeron.
english.completed: Report to High Executor Derrington at the Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.

text.title: 突然，鱼人来了！
text.objectives: 跟凯娜莉·桶杯谈一谈。
text.description: 穴居人在替狗头人干活，而狗头人在替豺狼人干活。豺狼人一定是从湿地迁徙过来的。$B$B我怎么知道的？是这样，他们带来了朋友，因为洛克湖里到处都是以前从未出现过的蓝鳃鱼人。$B$B害虫就是害虫，但这种利害关系让人担忧。我要你去和凯娜莉·桶杯谈一谈。她是这里最好的猎人之一，她知道如何对付鱼人，如果你能让她把酒杯子搁下的话。
text.completion: Murlocs? Sure, I've hunted murlocs.$B$BAnd every single stinkin' one of them deserved what they got! You hear me?

english.title: Suddenly, Murlocs!
english.objectives: Speak with Cannary Caskshot.
english.description: So we've got troggs working for kobolds, and kobolds working for gnolls. The gnolls must've moved in from the Wetlands.$B$BHow do I know? Well, they brought friends, because what's left of the Loch is swarming with Bluegill murlocs that were never there before.$B$BPests are pests, but this coordination is worrying. I need you to talk to Cannary Caskshot. She's one of the best hunters in these parts, and she'll know how to handle murlocs, if you can pull her away from her mug long enough.
english.completion: Murlocs? Sure, I've hunted murlocs.$B$BAnd every single stinkin' one of them deserved what they got! You hear me?

text.title: 闻起来像是个计划
text.objectives: 从洛克湖的蓝鳃鱼人身上获得7副鱼人臭腺。
text.description: 鱼人和豺狼人同流合污？太好笑了！现在，光杀掉他们是没有用的。混账东西实在太多了。$B$B但瞧，我有一个计划，用老办法。这些鱼人，他们有种味道，什么东西沾上了，让别的鱼人闻到，就能让他们发狂！对他们而言是相当不错的鱼饵。$B$B总之，他们有一种小小的腺体会散发那个味道。你得去给我弄些来。
text.progress: Now don't you stink all to high hell! I'm assumin' that's because of the murlocs, but it's hard to tell.
text.completion: Phew! Ain't that a stench.$B$BNow you prepare yourself, because I'm about to wow you with what's left of my mental faculties.
text.completed: Return to Cannary Caskshot at Thelsamar in Loch Modan.

english.title: Smells Like A Plan
english.objectives: Collect 7 Murloc Scent Glands from any Bluegill Murloc in The Loch.
english.description: Murlocs workin' with gnolls? That's a laugh! Now, just killin' them won't get you anywhere. Too many of the buggers.$B$BBut I've got a plan, usin' the old noggin, see. Those murlocs, they have this smell, they get that smell on stuff, and when another murloc smells it, they go all crazy! Makes great bait for 'em.$B$BAnyway, they've got little glands that have that smell in 'em. You go and get me a bunch of those.
english.progress: Now don't you stink all to high hell! I'm assumin' that's because of the murlocs, but it's hard to tell.
english.completion: Phew! Ain't that a stench.$B$BNow you prepare yourself, because I'm about to wow you with what's left of my mental faculties.
english.completed: Return to Cannary Caskshot at Thelsamar in Loch Modan.

text.title: 一群鳄鱼
text.objectives: 获得6块鳄鱼颌骨。
text.description: 你在外头四处奔波，忙活自己事情的时候，是否介意帮我一个忙？$B$B瞧，我以前时常会到洛克湖边去猎鳄鱼，但现在，呃，出于某些原因，我这边抽不出时间。你真有礼貌，没对我的胡说八道发火，谢谢！$B$B看你这位$g绅士:女士;这么好，为什么不帮我弄一些鳄鱼颌骨来呢，作为回报，我会给你些还算是不错的报酬。
text.progress: So did you get those crocolisk things or did I make that up?
text.completion: Mighty kind of you to help out an ol' fool like me. Here's your reward as promised an' all.
text.completed: Return to Cannary Caskshot at Thelsamar in Loch Modan.

english.title: A Load of Croc
english.objectives: Collect 6 Crocolisk Jaws.
english.description: Now while you're runnin' around doin' whatever the heck it is that you do, would you mind helpin' me out a bit?$B$BSee, I usually go out huntin' crocolisks down in the loch, but given certain circumstances, I'd rather sit here right now. Mighty polite of you not to give me grief over it, thanks!$B$BSo seein' as how you're such a $ggentleman:lady;, why don't you bring me back some crocolisk jaws and I'll give you some mostly-clean money in return.
english.progress: So did you get those crocolisk things or did I make that up?
english.completion: Mighty kind of you to help out an ol' fool like me. Here's your reward as promised an' all.
english.completed: Return to Cannary Caskshot at Thelsamar in Loch Modan.

text.title: 追杀十字军
text.objectives: 侦察西瘟疫之地费尔斯通农场东边的血色十字军营地。
text.description: 我们的胜利步步在望，$n。长期迫害被遗忘者的血色十字军，如今也是日暮残阳。尽管他们还盘踞在提瑞斯法的修道院里，可不管是壁炉谷，还是远至东边的提尔之手均已收复。$b$b就在上个星期，报告说血色十字军在费尔斯通农场东边的一个小营地里有所活动，但我有理由相信他们也被消灭了。到那儿帮我去证实一下这个消息。
text.completion: Burning bodies?  No survivors?  I guessed correctly. All the better!  We're better off without the Scarlet taint upon Lordaeron.  They epitomized all the worst things about humans.
text.end: 侦察血色十字军营地
text.completed: Return to High Executor Derrington at the Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.

english.title: After the Crusade
english.objectives: Scout the Scarlet Crusade camp located east of Felstone Field in Western Plaguelands.
english.description: Our victories are quickly piling up, $n.  The Scarlet Crusade, which has long persecuted the Forsaken, is on its last legs.  While they still hold their monastery here in Tirisfal, they no longer occupy Hearthglen, or Tyr's Hand, far to the east.$b$bAs recently as last week, there have been reports of Scarlet Crusade activity at a small camp east of Felstone Field, but I have reason to believe that they too have been eliminated.  Travel there, and verify this information for me.
english.completion: Burning bodies?  No survivors?  I guessed correctly. All the better!  We're better off without the Scarlet taint upon Lordaeron.  They epitomized all the worst things about humans.
english.completed: Return to High Executor Derrington at the Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.

text.title: 狐狸和猎犬
text.objectives: 在西瘟疫之地杀死4名联盟猎狐人、4条斗牛猎犬，以及4只白尾狐。
text.description: 联盟在瘟疫之地如入无人之境，好像这儿是他们的一样。决不！这片土地正当归属于黑暗女王！$b$b安多哈尔之战接近尾声，占据瘟疫之地的联盟部队也一团散沙。东边就有一些，正在打狐狸。叫他们明白这是被遗忘者的领土。$b$b把猎人杀了，把猎犬杀了。把他们猎的狐狸也给杀了，算是搭头。
text.completion: It's a relief to have those hunters out of the way.  We're not done killing Alliance, however...
text.completed: Return to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.

english.title: Foxes and Hounds
english.objectives: Kill 4 Alliance Fox Hunters, 4 Bullmastiffs, and 4 Whitetail Foxes in Western Plaguelands.
english.description: These Alliance forces walk around the Plaguelands like they own the place.  Well, they don't!  This land rightfully belongs to the Dark Lady!$b$bAs the battle for Andorhal drew to a close, the Alliance forces occupying the Plaguelands scattered.  Several of them can be found just east of here, hunting foxes.  Prove to them that this is Forsaken territory.$b$bKill the hunters.  Kill their hunting dogs.  And kill the foxes they hunt, for good measure.
english.completion: It's a relief to have those hunters out of the way.  We're not done killing Alliance, however...
english.completed: Return to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.

text.title: 秃鹫滚开
text.objectives: 杀死8只洛克鹫。
text.description: 巨石水坝决堤的时候，把附近的湖水都排干了。可怕的生态灾害。$B$B你别以为就和我们矮人没关系！我们不仅断绝了渔获，满地死亡的蛇颈龙还在太阳暴晒下腐烂。秃鹫闻风而来，也把各种疾病和污染传播到了镇郊。$B$B我不可能叫你把它统统打扫干净，但至少你能不能将秃鹫干掉？就算杀掉几只也是好的。
text.completion: That should help prevent disease and illness from spreading into our remaining water. Many thanks, $n.
text.completed: Return to Mountaineer Kadrell at Thelsamar in Loch Modan.

english.title: Buzz Off
english.objectives: Kill 8 Loch Buzzards.
english.description: When the Stonewrought Dam burst, it drained near the entire loch. Horrible ecological devastation.$B$BAnd don't you go thinking it didn't really affect us dwarves! Not only are we plumb out of fish, but there's acres of dead threshadons out there left to rot in the sun. The buzzards are after them, and they're spreading all manner of filth and disease right on the outskirts of town.$B$BI can't ask you to clean it all up, but could you deal with the buzzards? Killin' even just a few will help.
english.completion: That should help prevent disease and illness from spreading into our remaining water. Many thanks, $n.
english.completed: Return to Mountaineer Kadrell at Thelsamar in Loch Modan.

text.title: 敌人第一
text.objectives: 消灭费尔斯通农场里的9名联盟劳工。
text.description: 在费尔斯通农场里耕地的不是什么农夫，是士兵。$b$b萨萨里安的部队需要粮草，所以他派部分联盟的人从安多哈尔北上，兵屯费尔斯通农场。安多哈尔之战或许结束了，但另一场战争又在酝酿……被遗忘者对人类的战争。消灭那些费尔斯通的士兵，这会给黑暗女王的部队带来决定性的优势。
text.completion: Ha ha!  I hope that they come back as zombies.
text.completed: Return to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.

english.title: Foes Before Hoes
english.objectives: Kill 9 Alliance Laborers on Felstone Field.
english.description: The men who till Felstone Field are no farmers.  They're soldiers.$b$bThassarian's forces needed food, so he sent some of the Alliance north from Andorhal, to tend Felstone Field.  The battle for Andorhal may be over, but another battle looms... Forsaken versus human.  Killing those soldiers that work at Felstone will give the Dark Lady's forces a decided advantage.
english.completion: Ha ha!  I hope that they come back as zombies.
english.completed: Return to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.

text.title: 潜在疾病
text.objectives: 在西瘟疫之地消灭生病的黑熊，然后采集20团长在它们尸体旁的疫病之团。
text.description: 我需要瘟疫草来……来作实验。可是，银色黎明和可恶的塞纳里奥德鲁伊把瘟疫之地治疗了个差不离，我不走远点儿根本找不到合适的样本。$b$b好在有些当地的野生动物还残留着瘟疫感染。杀死一只生病的黑熊，把长在它腐烂尸体旁的植株收集起来。不是最好的办法，不过聊胜于无。
text.progress: Animal tissue holds onto disease so much better than plant tissue, doesn't it?
text.completion: Glorious!  This is the last bit I need. Actually, stick around, $n.  Let me tell you a little bit more about our plan.
text.completed: Return to Apothecary Dithers at The Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.

english.title: Latent Disease
english.objectives: Kill Diseased Black Bears in Western Plaguelands, then loot 20 Plague Tangles that grow near their corpses.
english.description: I need plagued grass for an... an experiment, of sorts.  Those Argent Crusaders and those infernal Cenarion druids have done too good a job of healing the plaguelands, however... and I can't find proper reagents within a reasonable walking distance.$b$bSome of the local wildlife retain the plague's touch, however.  Kill a diseased black bear, then retrieve the grass that grows where its decaying body lies.  It's not optimal, but it'll do.
english.progress: Animal tissue holds onto disease so much better than plant tissue, doesn't it?
english.completion: Glorious!  This is the last bit I need. Actually, stick around, $n.  Let me tell you a little bit more about our plan.
english.completed: Return to Apothecary Dithers at The Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.

text.title: 北山伐木场
text.objectives: 向西瘟疫之地北山伐木场的纳萨尼尔·杜马报告。
text.description: 我们不是瘟疫之地唯一的银色黎明十字军。我们的总部壁炉谷，位于北方。再稍近一点地方有一座我们控制的小伐木场。$b$b纳萨尼尔·杜马是那里的主要联系人。我希望你能和他谈谈，他应该就在林子里。
text.completion: Welcome to Northridge, $c.
text.completed: 向西瘟疫之地北山伐木场的纳萨尼尔·杜马报告。

english.title: Northridge Lumber Mill
english.objectives: Report to Nathaniel Dumah at the Northridge Lumber Mill in Western Plaguelands.
english.description: We are not the only Argent Crusaders here in the plaguelands.  Our headquarters, Hearthglen, lies to the north.  Even nearer to the north is a small lumber mill which we also control.$b$bNathaniel Dumah is my main contact at the lumber mill.  I encourage you to speak with him, should you find yourself in that part of the woods.
english.completion: Welcome to Northridge, $c.
english.completed: Report to Nathaniel Dumah at the Northridge Lumber Mill in Western Plaguelands.

text.title: 捂住耳朵
text.completion:
Felstone is cleared and the bombs are set.  I hope you're ready.  I recommend covering your ears.



<Derrington looks down and places his finger on an ignition switch.>



EVERYBODY, PREPARE FOR IGNITION!  IN 3...



2....



1...

english.title: Lower the Boom
english.completion:
Felstone is cleared and the bombs are set.  I hope you're ready.  I recommend covering your ears.



<Derrington looks down and places his finger on an ignition switch.>



EVERYBODY, PREPARE FOR IGNITION!  IN 3...



2....



1...

text.title: 光是死还不够
text.objectives: 杀死8名联盟劳工，让归降的瓦格里将他们变为被遗忘者。
text.description: 德灵顿和他的人不知道，就是我下令污染费尔斯通农场的。我们需要这片地区来进行实践操作。要想赢得安多哈尔的战争，那么我们就必须借助最新式、最牢靠的武器：$b$b瓦格里。$b$b把我那归降的瓦格里带上，$n，把那些还留在费尔斯通傻呵呵的联盟渣滓杀掉。一旦他们死了，她就可以把他们作为我们的一员……带回阳间。$b$b被遗忘者生生不息！
text.completion: I am able to communicate with you through the Val'kyr, $n.  You have done well. Remain on Felstone Field.  We must now teach these newly-converted Forsaken how to fight.
text.completed: Return to Lindsay Ravensun at the Charred Outpost in Western Plaguelands.

english.title: When Death is Not Enough
english.objectives: Kill 8 Alliance Laborers on Felstone Field so your Enthralled Val'kyr can convert them into Forsaken.
english.description: Derrington and his men don't know it, but it was I who ordered the plaguing of Felstone Field.  We need this area for practice.  If we're to win this war for Andorhal, we need to use our newest, most versatile weapon:$b$bVal'kyr.$b$bTake my enthralled val'kyr with you, $n, and kill the simpering Alliance scum that remain on Felstone.  Once they are dead, she will bring them back to this world... as one of us.$b$bThe Forsaken shall not die out!
english.completion: I am able to communicate with you through the Val'kyr, $n.  You have done well. Remain on Felstone Field.  We must now teach these newly-converted Forsaken how to fight.
english.completed: Return to Lindsay Ravensun at the Charred Outpost in Western Plaguelands.

text.title: 战斗训练
text.objectives: 使用归降的瓦格里的战斗的召唤技能集结费尔斯通农场中5名被遗忘者步兵。然后杀死费尔斯通谷仓里的缝腹憎恶。
text.description: 瓦格里的天性就是服从，而这一只服从于你。我现在让你可以全面控制她，$n。$b$b在农场外围，你可以找到刚被你转化的被遗忘者。我要你用瓦格里至少集结五个。一旦完成，带上你的新建小分队，到费尔斯通的谷仓那儿，杀掉里面的畜牲。今天，他们要学习的是为黑暗女王作战的意义。
text.completion: When Koltira gives his word, I will bring these val'kyr into Andorhal.  We will win.  And yet another piece of Lordaeron will fall to the might of the Forsaken.
text.completed: Return to Lindsay Ravensun at the Charred Outpost in Western Plaguelands.

english.title: Combat Training
english.objectives: Use your Enthralled Val'kyr's Call to Arms ability to mobilize 5 Forsaken Troopers on Felstone Field.  Then slay the Opengut Abomination inside Felstone's barn.
english.description: A val'kyr's only purpose is to serve, and this one serves you.  I am now giving you full control over her abilities, $n.$b$bRoaming around the farm's outskirts, you should find several of the Forsaken that you just created.  I want you to use your val'kyr to gather at least five of them.  Once you have done so, take your newly-formed band of soldiers, bring them into Felstone's barn, and kill the beast inside.  Today, they will learn what it means to fight for the Dark Lady.
english.completion: When Koltira gives his word, I will bring these val'kyr into Andorhal.  We will win.  And yet another piece of Lordaeron will fall to the might of the Forsaken.
english.completed: Return to Lindsay Ravensun at the Charred Outpost in Western Plaguelands.

objectiveDetails.description: 赋予被遗忘者步兵行动力

text.title: 地龙特攻队
text.objectives: 杀死粘性辐射尘。
text.description: 你怎么跑到这里来的？$B$B哦，无所谓。我是侏儒战队的莫多克。我们是精锐中的精锐，誓要夺回诺莫瑞根！$B$B在无人可用的情况下，大工匠找到并雇用了我们。$B$B但我们无法独自完成任务！你现在是地龙特攻队的荣誉特种兵了，$n。$B$B拿着这包降落伞，直接跳到下面的齿轮大厅里去，干掉粘性辐射尘。完成这个任务之后，到西边的走廊去找特种兵“坏脾气”巴拉克斯报告。我敢说，你们两个肯定很合得来。
text.completion: I hope that wasn't too much for you. The mission is far from over!
text.completed: Report to Commando B.E Barechus.

english.title: The G-Team
english.objectives: Kill the Viscous Fallout.
english.description: How did you get in here?$B$BOh, it doesn't matter. I'm Murd Doc of the G-Team. We're the best there is, and we're here to retake Gnomeregan!$B$BWhen nobody else could help him, the High Tinker found and hired us.$B$BBut we simply can't do this alone! You're an honorary G-Team Commando now, $n.$B$BTake this parachute, jump down straight ahead into the Hall of Gears, and kill the Viscous Fallout. After you're done, report to Commando B.E Barechus by the west hallway. You two will get along great, I'm sure.
english.completion: I hope that wasn't too much for you. The mission is far from over!
english.completed: Report to Commando B.E Barechus.

text.title: Frost Nova
text.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Frost Nova. Look for a Training Dummy near, and practice using it twice.
text.description: We are the heirs to a legacy of arcane magic and your path will not be an easy one. Many still hold us responsible for the actions of our forebears, but our talents are needed.$b$bThough you must be cautious, it is important to develop your powers, as that will deepen your connection to the arcane and grant you access to new spells. Go - get more experience with your spells, and demonstrate what you learn for me.
text.completion: I knew you would master this lesson quickly. You are a credit to the highborn and to all our kin. Remember, as you grow in power, return to me and will instruct you further.
text.completed: Return to Rhyanda in Aldrassil.

english.title: Frost Nova
english.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Frost Nova. Look for a Training Dummy near, and practice using it twice.
english.description: We are the heirs to a legacy of arcane magic and your path will not be an easy one. Many still hold us responsible for the actions of our forebears, but our talents are needed.$b$bThough you must be cautious, it is important to develop your powers, as that will deepen your connection to the arcane and grant you access to new spells. Go - get more experience with your spells, and demonstrate what you learn for me.
english.completion: I knew you would master this lesson quickly. You are a credit to the highborn and to all our kin. Remember, as you grow in power, return to me and will instruct you further.
english.completed: Return to Rhyanda in Aldrassil.

objectiveDetails.description: Reach level 3 to learn Frost Nova

text.title: 地龙特攻队
text.objectives: 杀死电刑器6000型。
text.description: 那个莫多克是个疯子，$c。绝对绝对不要跟这个疯侏儒乘坐同一架飞机。$B$B鬼鬼祟祟的做法不是我擅长的风格，显然也不该是你的。沿着这条走廊前往发射台，除掉电刑器6000型。$B$B电刑器是负责管理飞机的……$B$B……而我讨厌飞机。我绝对不会乘坐任何一种飞机！$B$B解决它之后，就用这包降落伞跳下去，找特种兵费斯接你的下一个任务。
text.completion: Took you long enough. Get behind the pillar with me before you blow our cover!
text.completed: Report to Commando Face.

english.title: The G-Team
english.objectives: Kill the Electrocutioner 6000.
english.description: That Murd Doc is crazy, $c. Never, ever, let you find yourself in an aircraft with that gnome.$B$BStealth usually isn't my thing, and it's certainly not going to be yours. Go down this hallway to the Launch Bay and dispose of the Electrocutioner 6000.$B$BThe Electrocutioner is in charge of the aircraft...$B$B...and I hate aircraft. I'm not getting in any sort of aircraft!$B$BUse this parachute to drop down afterwards and speak with Commando Face for your next job.
english.completion: Took you long enough. Get behind the pillar with me before you blow our cover!
english.completed: Report to Commando Face.

text.title: 地龙特攻队
text.objectives: 杀死机械师瑟玛普拉格。
text.description: 我要跟“坏脾气”巴拉克斯和莫多克保持距离，他俩都出奇地不靠谱。$B$B不过，你很靠谱，那就派你去干活吧！顺着这条隧道往下走，一直到工匠议会。希望你知道如何对付机械师瑟玛普拉格。$B$B我们的领队，特种兵汉尼巴尔就在那里的某处等着你。他会重重奖赏你的出色表现。$B$B应该是这样吧。
text.completion: I'd love for you to come aboard as a full G-Team Commando, but you have other adventures to pursue. I'm sure we'll meet again, and I hope you'll have considered joining by then. Here's something for your trouble.
text.completed: Report to Commando Hann Ibal.
text.giverWindow: 当心他的炸弹！

english.title: The G-Team
english.objectives: Kill Mekgineer Thermaplugg.
english.description: I'd keep my distance from B.E Barechus and Murd Doc, neither is terribly stable.$B$BYou are, though, so let's get you to work! Go down into this tunnel until you get to Tinkers' Court. Hopefully you'll know what to do when you meet Mekgineer Thermaplugg.$B$BOur leader, Commando Hann Ibal waits somewhere in there. He'll reward you handsomely for all your work.$B$BProbably.
english.completion: I'd love for you to come aboard as a full G-Team Commando, but you have other adventures to pursue. I'm sure we'll meet again, and I hope you'll have considered joining by then. Here's something for your trouble.
english.completed: Report to Commando Hann Ibal.
english.giverWindow: Watch out for his bombs!

text.title: 侏儒之家
text.objectives: 与莫多克交谈。
text.description: 我在铁炉堡的小日子过得有滋有味，直到我被撵出去替侏儒们收拾残局。$B$B他们有一大堆的机器和装置，但就是顶不住一小撮石腭怪！而我却要为他们的无能付出代价？$B$B不行，朋友。不能再这样了。$B$B到诺莫瑞根去找特种兵莫多克。当然了，他是个侏儒，但他的团队，他们称之为S.A.F.E的那个，打算把诺莫瑞根夺回来。$B$B去吧！我想要回自己的房子！
text.completion: Never thought I'd see a $r like you down here. Any particular reason you're risking life and limb?

english.title: Home Sweet Gnome
english.objectives: Speak to Murd Doc.
english.description: I used t' have quite the home back in Ironforge. That is, I did until I was booted out to make way for the Gnomes.$B$BThey couldn't stop a bunch of troggs with all them gizmos and machines! An' I have to pay for their weakness?$B$BNo, sir. No longer.$B$BGo to Gnomeregan and talk to Commando Murd Doc. Sure, he's a Gnome, but his crew, S.A.F.E. I think they call 'em, are going to take Gnomeregan back.$B$BGo! I want my house back!
english.completion: Never thought I'd see a $r like you down here. Any particular reason you're risking life and limb?

text.title: 探索诺莫瑞根
text.objectives: 与莫多克交谈。
text.description: 侏儒的首都诺莫瑞根已经沦陷很久了。我很清楚失去家园是个什么滋味。$B$B请你前往诺莫瑞根，找特种兵莫多克谈谈，他是S.A.F.E的一员。如果你有办法帮助他们夺回家园，我建议你不遗余力地去帮忙。那地方隐藏着很多黑暗的秘密。
text.completion: Never thought I'd see a $r like you down here. Any particular reason you're risking life and limb?

english.title: Exploring Gnomeregan
english.objectives: Speak to Murd Doc.
english.description: The Gnomish capital, Gnomeregan, hasn't been under their control for some time now. I know what it feels like to lose a home.$B$BPlease, venture inside Gnomeregan and speak to Commando Murd Doc, a member of S.A.F.E. If there's anything at all that you can do to help them take their home, I urge you to do so. There are dark secrets in those halls.
english.completion: Never thought I'd see a $r like you down here. Any particular reason you're risking life and limb?

text.title: 学习新技能
text.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Charge. Look for a Training Dummy and practice using Charge.
text.description: As you overcome the challenges before you, you'll begin to learn new techniques.$b$bGo, get more experience, and learn a new skill. Then demonstrate it for me on one of the training dummies.
text.completion: You've proven a capable student. When it is time to resume your training, return to me and I will show you other techniques.
text.completed: Return to Alyissia in Teldrassil.

english.title: Learning New Techniques
english.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Charge. Look for a Training Dummy and practice using Charge.
english.description: As you overcome the challenges before you, you'll begin to learn new techniques.$b$bGo, get more experience, and learn a new skill. Then demonstrate it for me on one of the training dummies.
english.completion: You've proven a capable student. When it is time to resume your training, return to me and I will show you other techniques.
english.completed: Return to Alyissia in Teldrassil.

text.title: 潜行者的优势
text.objectives: Reach Level 3 and Learn Eviscerate. Look for a Training Dummy southeast of Aldrassil and practice using Eviscerate 3 times.
text.description: I'm certain that by now, you've mastered using Sinister Strike against your enemies. But, as you learn more and advance as a rogue, you'll start to figure out new techniques. One you should figure out soon is called Eviscerate. It can be a strong way to end a combination of attacks.$b$bI want you to get some more experience, figure it out, then try it on a training dummy near the southeastern edge of Aldrassil.
text.completion: You've learned quickly. If you are as sharp as you seem to be, you may prove to be one of my best students yet. Return to me when you are in need of further training.
text.completed: Return to Frahun Shadewhisper in Teldrassil.

english.title: A Rogue's Advantage
english.objectives: Reach Level 3 and Learn Eviscerate. Look for a Training Dummy southeast of Aldrassil and practice using Eviscerate 3 times.
english.description: I'm certain that by now, you've mastered using Sinister Strike against your enemies. But, as you learn more and advance as a rogue, you'll start to figure out new techniques. One you should figure out soon is called Eviscerate. It can be a strong way to end a combination of attacks.$b$bI want you to get some more experience, figure it out, then try it on a training dummy near the southeastern edge of Aldrassil.
english.completion: You've learned quickly. If you are as sharp as you seem to be, you may prove to be one of my best students yet. Return to me when you are in need of further training.
english.completed: Return to Frahun Shadewhisper in Teldrassil.

text.title: 林中的训练
text.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Steady Shot. Look for a Training Dummy southeast of Aldrassil, and practice using Steady Shot 5 times
text.description: When most people think of the kaldorei, they conjure visions of druids and sentinels, but the way of the hunter is just as ancient and just as venerable.$b$bI've been observing you, and you've had quite a bit of experience handling that bow. As you gain more, you'll start to learn some new abilities.$b$bI want you to go out, get some more experience, and figure out how to do something new. Then go use it on a training dummy near the southeastern edge of Aldrassil.
text.completion: You are a quick study in our ways. I look forward to continuing your training in the future. Return to me when the time is right.
text.completed: Return to Ayanna Everstride in Aldrassil.

english.title: A Woodsman's Training
english.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Steady Shot. Look for a Training Dummy southeast of Aldrassil, and practice using Steady Shot 5 times
english.description: When most people think of the kaldorei, they conjure visions of druids and sentinels, but the way of the hunter is just as ancient and just as venerable.$b$bI've been observing you, and you've had quite a bit of experience handling that bow. As you gain more, you'll start to learn some new abilities.$b$bI want you to go out, get some more experience, and figure out how to do something new. Then go use it on a training dummy near the southeastern edge of Aldrassil.
english.completion: You are a quick study in our ways. I look forward to continuing your training in the future. Return to me when the time is right.
english.completed: Return to Ayanna Everstride in Aldrassil.

objectiveDetails.description: Reach Level 3 to Learn Steady Shot

text.title: 月火术
text.objectives: 将等级提升至3级，学习月火术。然后对奥达希尔的一个训练假人施放月火术。
text.description:
德鲁伊在我们的社会中扮演着重要的角色，但是就在我们消极地沉睡的同时，这个世界也在不断改变。$B$B事实是，尽管如此，我们还得积极地训练，深入这个纷乱的世界并加强我们与自然之间的联系。

那么去吧，多积累一些经验。你会发现你与自然的联系更加紧密，从而悟出新技能。学会第一招后回来展示给我看。
text.completion: You have mastered the basics of the healing ways quickly, $n. I have no doubt that your healing skills will often come in handy. Return to me when you need further training.
text.completed: Return to Mardant Strongoak in Aldrassil.

english.title: Moonfire
english.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Moonfire. Use it on a training dummy in Aldrassil.
english.description: Druids play an important role in our society, but all too often we are seen as passive dreamers in a world that is changing around us.$B$BThe truth is, though, we must actively practice and go out onto the world to develop our connection to nature. So go, get some more experience. You will begin to feel your connection deepen, learning new skills. Demonstrate the first you learn for me.
english.completion: You have mastered the basics of the healing ways quickly, $n. I have no doubt that your healing skills will often come in handy. Return to me when you need further training.
english.completed: Return to Mardant Strongoak in Aldrassil.

text.title: Learning the Word
text.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Shadow Word: Pain, then use it 5 times on training dummies.
text.description: As you venture out into the world and develop your skills, you will begin to learn new abilities that you never knew you had within you. I'd like you to go out, get some more experience, and then show me the first new ability you learn.
text.completion: You will find no lack of allies in need of healing. Return to me when you need further training.
text.completed: Return to Shanda in Aldrassil.

english.title: Learning the Word
english.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Shadow Word: Pain, then use it 5 times on training dummies.
english.description: As you venture out into the world and develop your skills, you will begin to learn new abilities that you never knew you had within you. I'd like you to go out, get some more experience, and then show me the first new ability you learn.
english.completion: You will find no lack of allies in need of healing. Return to me when you need further training.
english.completed: Return to Shanda in Aldrassil.

objectiveDetails.description: Reach Level 3 to Learn Shadow Word: Pain

text.title: 圣光的黑暗面
text.objectives: 杀死审讯员韦沙斯和血法师萨尔诺斯。
text.description: 血色十字军向年轻的战士许下消灭亡灵的承诺，引诱他们加入组织。但是他们看不到这个组织的幕后有多么黑暗。$B$B审讯员韦沙斯是我见过的最残忍的人——当天灾瘟疫刚刚爆发时，他严刑拷打我的母亲以获取情报。无情的血法师萨尔诺斯监管着他们的墓地。$B$B血色十字军的狂热使他们看不到自己的黑暗面。让他们为这伪善的嘴脸付出代价吧。
text.completion: What do you mean Thalnos was an undead? That's impossible. This is a holy place, the Scarlet Crusade would never allow... Take this as a reward, and get some rest. The crypts must have gotten the best of your nerves.
text.completed: Return to Dark Ranger Velonara.
text.giverWindow: 該死的怪物。

english.title: The Dark Side of the Light
english.objectives: Kill Interrogator Vishas and Bloodmage Thalnos.
english.description: The Scarlet Crusade lures in anxious young warriors with their promise to eradicate the undead. What they don't see is the dark underbelly of the entire operation.$B$BInterrogator Vishas is the cruelest man I've ever had the displeasure to meet - he 'extracted' information from my mother during the initial outbreak of the plague. The merciless Bloodmage Thalnos watches over their graveyard.$B$BThe crusaders' zealous holy rage blinds them from their own darkness. Make them regret their hypocrisy.
english.completion: What do you mean Thalnos was an undead? That's impossible. This is a holy place, the Scarlet Crusade would never allow... Take this as a reward, and get some rest. The crypts must have gotten the best of your nerves.
english.completed: Return to Dark Ranger Velonara.
english.giverWindow: Damned monster.

text.title: 清扫回音岛
text.objectives: 收集8个褪魔的蒂基面具。
text.description: 夺取回音群岛的战役让我们付出了沉重的代价。但这样的牺牲是值得的，$c。伟大的祖灵邦桑迪帮助我们的战士击败了邪恶的扎拉赞恩。他让这座岛的灵魂保护了我们的战士。但这些灵魂之中有不少都在战斗中消亡了。请帮我让这些灵魂得到安息。在回音群岛上，你会找到一些面具，收集它们，将它们交给我。
text.progress: Have you gathered the masks, $c?
text.completion: Thanks, $c.  The spirits can rest now.  As long as we show them respect they will bless us and our new home for a long time.  Spirits be with you, $n.
text.completed: Return to Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.

english.title: Cleanup on Isle E.
english.objectives: Gather 8 Disenchanted Tiki Masks.
english.description: The Battle to reclaim the Echo Isles was a costly one.  But well worth it, $c.  The great spirit, Bwonsamdi, helped our warriors defeat the foul Zalazane.  He protected our warriors with spirits from the island.  But some of those spirits fell in battle.  Help put those spirits to rest.  On the Echo Isles, you will find masks laying about gather them and bring them here.
english.progress: Have you gathered the masks, $c?
english.completion: Thanks, $c.  The spirits can rest now.  As long as we show them respect they will bless us and our new home for a long time.  Spirits be with you, $n.
english.completed: Return to Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.

text.title: 治愈者营地
text.objectives: 向西瘟疫之地治愈者营地的战地特工卡尔缇舍报告。
text.description: 被遗忘者在亡灵壁垒的所作所为我有点看不下去。炸弹，天灾之锅，不必要的流血……这些可不是银色黎明十字军的信条。再说，我也不喜欢他们用你这样的雇佣兵。$b$b不是针对你，$c。只是你的能耐不该浪费在这种事情上。要是你志在治愈瘟疫之地，而不是继续污染这片土地，那么去东边的治愈者营地向战地特工卡尔缇舍报告。
text.completion: Welcome, $c.  As you can see, our camp is a joint expedition between Argent Crusade members and Cenarion Circle druids, but we welcome all who wish to help heal the land.
text.completed: 向西瘟疫之地治愈者营地的战地特工卡尔缇舍报告。

english.title: The Menders' Stead
english.objectives: Report to Field Agent Kaartish at the Menders' Stead in Western Plaguelands.
english.description: I don't like the looks of what the Forsaken are doing here at the Bulwark.  Bombs, cauldrons, needless bloodshed... none of these embody that which the Argent Crusade stands for.  Furthermore, I don't like the fact that they employ mercenaries like yourself.$b$bNothing against you personally, $c.  It's just that you could be doing so much more for yourself.  If you're interested in healing the plaguelands, rather than re-plaguing them, then report to Field Agent Kaartish at the Menders' Stead to the east.
english.completion: Welcome, $c.  As you can see, our camp is a joint expedition between Argent Crusade members and Cenarion Circle druids, but we welcome all who wish to help heal the land.
english.completed: Report to Field Agent Kaartish at the Menders' Stead in Western Plaguelands.

text.title: 德鲁伊，赞吉吉
text.objectives: 陪着赞吉吉杀死20只染上瘟疫的野生动物。你可以杀掉的有：巨大的瘟疫熊、生病的狼、毒雾潜伏者，或天灾潜伏者。$b$b假如你和赞吉吉走散了，就回到治愈者营地去。
text.description: 我乃阿德林·韧皮，塞纳里奥议会的一名德鲁伊。多亏了我们治疗大地，不然这里就只有死亡。$b$b我们接受任何愿意踏上德鲁伊之路的志愿者，无关种族、阵营，或天赋。偶尔这就意味着我们招募的德鲁伊比别人更需要帮助。$b$b我想让你见一下赞吉吉。他刚来不久，还在修行中。你不会介意带他出去转转吧？你可以用附近身染瘟疫的动物练习一下战斗技巧。
text.completion: It looks like Zen'Kiki is still having a little bit of trouble with his shapeshifting.
text.completed: Return to Adrine Towhide at the Menders' Stead in Western Plaguelands.

english.title: Zen'Kiki, the Druid
english.objectives: Kill 20 plagued wildlife with Zen'Kiki by your side.  You may kill Hulking Plaguebears, Diseased Wolves, Venom Mist Lurkers, or Plague Lurkers.$b$bReturn to the Menders' Stead if you become separated from Zen'Kiki.
english.description: I am Adrine Towhide, a druid of the Cenarion Circle.  You can thank us for healing this land, where once there was only death.$b$bWe accept all who choose to follow the druidic path, regardless of race, faction, or talent.  Occasionally that means we enlist a druid who needs more help than others.$b$bI'd like you to meet Zen'Kiki.  He's pretty new, and he's still learning his craft.  Would you mind taking him out with you for a while?  You can practice combat on the plagued animals that roam nearby.
english.completion: It looks like Zen'Kiki is still having a little bit of trouble with his shapeshifting.
english.completed: Return to Adrine Towhide at the Menders' Stead in Western Plaguelands.

objectiveDetails.description: 陪赞吉吉杀死的野生动物

text.title: 另有高招
text.objectives: 把赞吉吉带到治愈者营地东边的山上去，用他召唤并杀死7头生病的鹰。
text.description: 先不说别的，赞吉吉还真得好好练练准头。我打这儿都能瞧见他的自然之怒漫天乱窜！事实上，你们在林子走到哪一步我都能靠这个知道。$b$b也许我们可以把赞吉吉派上用场。带他到东边的山上去，那些生病的鹰在山顶盘旋，消灭它们。让赞吉吉去射它们，就算他打不中，也是一种干扰，这时候你就可以把它们都收拾掉。
text.completion: Now we're getting somewhere.  How many birds did Zen'Kiki end up killing? None?  You killed them all yourself? Alright, I suppose we'll have to find another use for him then.  I will let you know when the time is right.
text.completed: Return to Adrine Towhide at the Menders' Stead in Western Plaguelands.

english.title: A Different Approach
english.objectives: Bring Zen'Kiki to the top of the hill east of the Menders' Stead, then use him to summon and kill 7 Diseased Hawks.
english.description: Among other things, Zen'Kiki needs to work on his spell accuracy.  I could see his wrath spells spiraling out of control even from here!  In fact, I used them as a marker to follow your progress through the woods.$b$bPerhaps we can use Zen'Kiki another way.  Take him up to the top of the hill just to our east.  The diseased hawks that circle above that hill must be destroyed.  Ask Zen'Kiki to shoot at these hawks.  Even if he can't hit them, he will distract them so you can finish them off.
english.completion: Now we're getting somewhere.  How many birds did Zen'Kiki end up killing? None?  You killed them all yourself? Alright, I suppose we'll have to find another use for him then.  I will let you know when the time is right.
english.completed: Return to Adrine Towhide at the Menders' Stead in Western Plaguelands.

text.title: 赞吉吉和诅咒教徒
text.objectives: 把赞吉吉带到西瘟疫之地的玛丽希亚前哨站，释放6只被困住的疫病熊，让赞吉吉来治疗。
text.description: 你不在的时候，我替咱们的朋友赞吉吉又想了一个高招。我相信他有成为治疗者的潜质。主要是因为治疗法术从不失手。$b$b我从战地特工卡尔缇舍那儿听说受瘟疫感染的动物都是打东边的诅咒教徒营地来的。希望你不介意护送赞吉吉去那儿……也许他可以把营地里的动物治好。
text.completion: By the grace of the Earthmother, he's done it!  Thank you, $n! I admit, I had nearly given up hope on Zen'Kiki.  It is only due to your patience and diligence that he has come into his own as a druid and member of the Cenarion Circle.  And that's without even mentioning the good you've done for nature. You have my admiration and respect.
text.completed: Return to Adrine Towhide at the Menders' Stead in Western Plaguelands.

english.title: Zen'Kiki and the Cultists
english.objectives: Bring Zen'Kiki to the Malicia Outpost in Western Plaguelands, then break 4 Captive Plaguebears out of their cages and allow Zen'Kiki to heal them.
english.description: While you've been away, I've been trying a different approach on our friend Zen'Kiki.  I believe he may have a future as a healer.  This is mainly because healing spells never miss.$b$bI hear from Field Agent Kaartish that the cultist camp to the east is where the plagued animals are coming from.  I hope you don't mind escorting Zen'Kiki over there... perhaps he can help heal some of the plagued animals within the camp.
english.completion: By the grace of the Earthmother, he's done it!  Thank you, $n! I admit, I had nearly given up hope on Zen'Kiki.  It is only due to your patience and diligence that he has come into his own as a druid and member of the Cenarion Circle.  And that's without even mentioning the good you've done for nature. You have my admiration and respect.
english.completed: Return to Adrine Towhide at the Menders' Stead in Western Plaguelands.

objectiveDetails.description: 释放并治疗被困住的疫病熊

text.title: 我可没说你是个种地的……
text.objectives: 在西瘟疫之地的达尔松之泪除掉6株坏玉米，4只烂苹果，以及3只看上去坏掉的南瓜。
text.description: $R！真高兴有人来帮我了。我们塞纳里奥德鲁伊重新开垦了达尔松之泪，我身后就是。地肥水美，庄稼长势也喜人……按说是这样。$b$b有几株好像还是受到了地里瘟疫的感染。也许是因为根扎得太深，也许是因为种子不好……我说不准。我只能说我需要像你这样的$c帮我把坏庄稼都除掉，免得殃及良株。
text.completion: Thank you for your help, $n.  I know that picking vegetables isn't the most heroic task imaginable, but even the humblest tasks have their rewards.
text.completed: Return to Selyria Groenveld at the Menders' Stead in Western Plaguelands.

english.title: I Ain't Sayin' You a Gourd-Digger...
english.objectives: Remove 6 Bad Corn, 4 Rotten Apples, and 3 Unhealthy-Looking Pumpkins from Dalson's Farm in Western Plaguelands.
english.description: $R!  I'm glad someone's here to help me out.$b$bWe Cenarion druids have re-cultivated Dalson's Farm, immediately behind me.  The land has flourished and our crops have been successful... mostly.$b$bA few plants seem to still be infected by the plague that ran through this land.  Perhaps their roots were too deep, perhaps the seeds were weak... I cannot say.  All I can say is that I need an able $c like you to help me remove the bad plants from the good ones.
english.completion: Thank you for your help, $n.  I know that picking vegetables isn't the most heroic task imaginable, but even the humblest tasks have their rewards.
english.completed: Return to Selyria Groenveld at the Menders' Stead in Western Plaguelands.

objectiveDetails.description: 除掉看上去坏掉的南瓜

text.title: 漫漫归乡路
text.objectives: 同西瘟疫之地治愈者营地的德尔·盖罗恩汇合。
text.description: 我一生去过无数的地方，我的$c。我曾参加过安其拉之战，穿过黑暗之门前往外域，在冰冷的诺森德加入了抵抗天灾军团的银色黎明十字军。$b$b但在此之前，我只是洛丹伦的一个农夫而已。而我现在身处壁炉谷，背井离乡。是该回去看看的时候了。$b$b返乡之前我还要去治愈者营地逛逛，到那儿后我们再见也不迟。
text.completion: It would appear that I arrived before you, $n. Field Agent Kaartish gave me the details about my old home.  It seems my battles with the Scourge aren't quite over yet.
text.completed: 去西瘟疫之地的治愈者营地与德尔·盖罗恩会合。

english.title: The Long Trip Home
english.objectives: Reconvene with Del Gahrron at the Menders' Stead in Western Plaguelands.
english.description: I've been many places in my life, good $c.  I fought the battle for Ahn'Qiraj, passed through the Dark Portal into Outland, and joined the Argent Crusade to beat down Scourge in coldest Northrend.$b$bBut before it all, I was a farmer here in Lordaeron.  Now I find myself here in Hearthglen, a scant few miles from home.  It's time I paid my respects.$b$bI'm headed to the Menders' Stead before I return home.  I wouldn't mind meeting up with you again once I get there.
english.completion: It would appear that I arrived before you, $n. Field Agent Kaartish gave me the details about my old home.  It seems my battles with the Scourge aren't quite over yet.
english.completed: Reconvene with Del Gahrron at the Menders' Stead in Western Plaguelands.

text.title: 你的第一课
text.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Charge. Find a Training Dummy on the northwest side of the Crash Site and practice using Charge.
text.description: Let's start your training right away. As you get more experience in combat, you'll start to develop new techniques.$b$bGo, get some more experience, learn something new, and demonstrate it on the dummies to the northwest.
text.completion: Keep that technique handy, $n. I find myself using it all the time. Return when you're ready for further training.
text.completed: Return to Kore at the Crash Site.

english.title: Your First Lesson
english.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Charge. Find a Training Dummy on the northwest side of the Crash Site and practice using Charge.
english.description: Let's start your training right away. As you get more experience in combat, you'll start to develop new techniques.$b$bGo, get some more experience, learn something new, and demonstrate it on the dummies to the northwest.
english.completion: Keep that technique handy, $n. I find myself using it all the time. Return when you're ready for further training.
english.completed: Return to Kore at the Crash Site.

text.title: 瓦解防线
text.objectives: 杀死驯犬者洛克希和奥法师杜安。
text.description: 我们必须先瓦解血色修道院的防备力量，然后再发动总攻。到他们的图书馆里面去，刺杀驯犬者洛克希和奥法师杜安。他们维系着强大的防御体系，保护着自己的同志。$B$B我的魔法可以保证你的行动不被修道院中的其他区域察觉。等你干掉他们之后，我可以召唤增援部队，协助我们发起进攻。$B$B我们必须取胜，$n，黑暗女王不会容忍哪怕一丁点的失败。
text.completion: I knew I could count on you! These fools will never know what hit them.
text.completed: Return to Dark Ranger Velonara.
text.giverWindow: 尽快收拾掉他。

english.title: Stripping Their Defenses
english.objectives: Eliminate Houndmaster Loksey and Arcanist Doan.
english.description: We need to eliminate the Scarlet Monastery's defenses before a true invasion can begin. Venture deep into here, their library, and assassinate Houndmaster Loksey and Arcanist Doan. They maintain the powerful defenses that protect their comrades.$B$BMy own magic will ensure your actions go undetected by the rest of the monastery. Once they are dead, I can summon in additional reinforcements to aid in our attack.$B$BWe must be successful, $n, the Dark Lady will not tolerate failure in the slightest.
english.completion: I knew I could count on you! These fools will never know what hit them.
english.completed: Return to Dark Ranger Velonara.
english.giverWindow: He needs to die quickly.

text.title: 王子，我的儿子
text.objectives: 向暴风城堡里的安度因王子自我介绍，互相认识后再同乌瑞恩国王交谈。
text.description: 我的儿子生来就责任重大，恐怕随着时日增长，这些负担有增无减。$B$B呆在城堡里如何能修习帝王之术，无人护卫我又于心难安。$B$B$n，你在大灾变后的作为已经被奉为传奇。你若能担任年轻王子安度因的导师再好不过。$B$B请前去与他相见。城中事务迫切，你俩可一同为我分忧。
text.completion: Excellent, Anduin will learn a lot by shadowing you. Remember, stay within the city's borders. Keep him out of trouble. And above all else, guard him with your life. Anduin, no adventures! Stay close to $n and return to the keep should you see any trouble.
text.completed: Speak with King Wrynn in Stormwind Keep.

english.title: My Son, the Prince
english.objectives: Introduce yourself to Prince Anduin in Stormwind Keep. Speak with King Wrynn once you are both acquainted.
english.description: Great burdens have been placed on my son's shoulders in his short lifetime, and I fear his responsibilities are only going to grow.$B$BHe will never learn leadership confined to the keep, but I am loath to send him forth without escort.$B$B$n, your deeds in the wake of this cataclysm are already legendary. You would be an excellent mentor for young Prince Anduin.$B$BPlease, introduce yourself to him. There is some pressing city business that you both can attend to for me.
english.completion: Excellent, Anduin will learn a lot by shadowing you. Remember, stay within the city's borders. Keep him out of trouble. And above all else, guard him with your life. Anduin, no adventures! Stay close to $n and return to the keep should you see any trouble.
english.completed: Speak with King Wrynn in Stormwind Keep.

text.title: 收集石像
text.objectives: 将8尊小石像带给铁环挖掘场的麦格玛尔·落斧。
text.description: 最近，就在穴居人出现在挖掘场之前，我们出土了大量奇怪的石像。可还没有能够进行研究，穴居人就把我们赶出了废墟！那些石像会对穴居人产生一种奇怪的作用。它让他们狂暴！$B$B给我带8尊来——我要研究它们，而且不能让它们落在穴居人手里！你可以在滋扰挖掘场的穴居人身上找到石像。
text.progress: 你拿到那些塑像了吗?我们得研究它们，并把结果报告给铁炉堡!
text.completion: 你拿到了!干得好，$N!$B$B这个任务对你来说似乎并不困难，周围这麽多疯狂的穴居人都没能把你怎麽样。我会关注你的……你看起来挺有前途的。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Magmar Fellhew at Ironband's Excavation.

english.title: Gathering Idols
english.objectives: Bring 8 Carved Stone Idols to Magmar Fellhew at Ironband's Excavation.
english.description: Recently, just before the troggs surfaced within the site, we had uncovered a large number of strange, carved idols. But we didn't have the chance to study them, for soon after their discovery the troggs chased us away from the ruins! And those idols have a strange effect on the troggs. It makes them go berserk!$B$BBring me 8 idols - I want to study them, and I want them out of trogg hands!  You can find the idols on the troggs infesting the site.
english.progress: Do you have those idols?  We must study them and report our findings to Ironforge!
english.completion: You got them!  Nicely done, $n!$B$BAnd you don't look too worse for wear, even with those berserk troggs about.  I'm going to keep my eye on you...you show some promise.
english.completed: Return to Magmar Fellhew at Ironband's Excavation.

text.title: 瓦解他们的攻势
text.objectives: 杀死赫洛德。
text.description: 正如你所见，$N，我们对军械库发动的第一轮突袭不是很顺利。我们攻占了旁边的庭院，但血色勇士赫洛德又把它夺了回去。$B$B我们必须继续进攻。绝对不能允许血色十字军再训练出一名战士来，更不能让他们对幽暗城发动攻击。$B$B你的任务简单明了，去干掉这个血色勇士。
text.completion: Herod is slain! The Armory will fall!
text.completed: Return to Dark Ranger Velonara.
text.giverWindow: The Scarlet Champion

english.title: Stripping Their Offense
english.objectives: Kill Herod.
english.description: As you can see, $n, our first assault on the Armory did not go as planned. We had taken the nearby courtyard until the Scarlet Champion, Herod, showed up.$B$BWe must continue our assault. The Scarlet Crusade will never be allowed to train another warrior here, let alone launch an attack on the Undercity.$B$BYour task should be obvious. Down the Scarlet Champion.
english.completion: Herod is slain! The Armory will fall!
english.completed: Return to Dark Ranger Velonara.
english.giverWindow: The Scarlet Champion

text.title: 稳固射击
text.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Steady Shot. Find a Training Dummy on the northwest side of the Crash Site and practice using Steady Shot 5 times.
text.description: Let's start your training right away. It's going to be a struggle to survive here, and you'll play an important role in making sure our people are safe and well-supplied.$b$bAs you become more experiened, you'll begin to discover new abilities. Go ahead and go out, learn something new, and try it out. Return to me when you think you've mastered it.
text.completion: Keep that technique handy, $n. I find myself using it all the time. Return when you're ready for further training.
text.completed: Return to Keilnei at the Crash Site.

text.title: 大酋长的命令：银松森林！
text.objectives: 去找银松森林被遗忘者统帅部的大执行官摩尔图斯。
text.description: 所有身强力壮的部落成员，从此刻起都要听候银松森林被遗忘者统帅部的大执行官摩尔图斯差遣。$B$B现在，为了终止敌人对这一地区的侵害，为了征服吉尔尼斯港口，我们比任何时候都需要你的帮助！$B$B想要前往被遗忘者统帅部，你必须向南穿过提瑞斯法林地，进入银松森林。到达以后，沿着路往南，直到你抵达被遗忘者统帅部。$B$B前进吧，$g兄弟:姐妹;！命运在召唤！
text.completion: Most excellent! A new recruit has arrived. There is much to do... much to do I say.

english.title: Warchief's Command: Silverpine Forest!
english.objectives: Report to Grand Executor Mortuus at Forsaken High Command in Silverpine Forest.
english.description: All able-bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Grand Executor Mortuus at Forsaken High Command in Silverpine Forest.$B$BNow, more than ever, your help is needed in routing the enemy infestation of the region and conquering the port of Gilneas!$B$BTo reach Forsaken High Command you must travel south through Tirisfal Glades and enter Silverpine Forest. From there, follow the road south until you reach Forsaken High Command.$B$BOnward, $g brother:sister;! Destiny calls!
english.completion: Most excellent! A new recruit has arrived. There is much to do... much to do I say.

text.title: 酋长驾到
text.objectives: 准备迎接加尔鲁什·地狱咆哮酋长的到来。
text.description: 你来得正是时候，菜鸟$n。是菜鸟$n，对吧？$B$B<大执行官摩尔图斯拿起一张纸看了一眼。>$B$B没错，文件上就是这么写的：“菜鸟$n”。$B$B<大执行官摩尔图斯指着纸上你的名字。>$B$B我说到哪儿了？哦，对了，你来得正是时候！酋长随时都会抵达，同我们的领袖和救世主，黑暗女王本人见面。做好准备，仪态端正点。我指望着等检阅结束了，我们都能获得嘉奖！
text.completion: Well that was unexpected. I am not one to doubt our Warchief, but... Nevermind! We have work to do. I'm sure the Dark Lady and the Warchief will get this all worked out.
text.completed: Speak with Grand Executor Mortuus at Forsaken High Command in Silverpine Forest.
text.objective1: 准备迎接加尔鲁什·地狱咆哮酋长的到来。

english.title: The Warchief Cometh
english.objectives: Stand by for Warchief Garrosh Hellscream's arrival.
english.description: You're just in time, $nnub. It is $nnub, right?$B$B<Grand Executor Mortuus looks at a sheet of paper.>$B$BYes, that's what the paperwork says: "$nnub."$B$B<Grand Executor Mortuus points to your name on the sheet of paper.>$B$BWhere was I? Oh yes, you're just in time! The Warchief should be arriving at any moment to meet with our leader and savior, the Dark Lady herself. Just stand by and be at your best behavior. I expect that when this demonstration is over we will all receive commendations!
english.completion: Well that was unexpected. I am not one to doubt our Warchief, but... Nevermind! We have work to do. I'm sure the Dark Lady and the Warchief will get this all worked out.
english.completed: Speak with Grand Executor Mortuus at Forsaken High Command in Silverpine Forest.
english.objective1: Stand by for Warchief Garrosh Hellscream's arrival

objectiveDetails.description: 准备迎接加尔鲁什·地狱咆哮酋长的到来

text.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Seal of Command. Apply Seal of Command, find a Training Dummy on the northwest side of the Crash Site and hit it with an attack.
text.description: As a paladin, you're no stranger to the Light that touches all of us. But you also have the unique power to call upon the Light to help you in battle.$b$bAs you gain more experience, you'll grow even closer to the Light and be able to call upon new powers in battle. Go, grow in experience until you have learned a new power, and then demonstrate it for me.
text.progress: Have you practiced using your seal and your judgement?
text.completion: You've proven yourself a quick learner, $n. I look forward to training you again when the time is right.
text.completed: Return to Aurelon at the Crash Site.

english.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Seal of Command. Apply Seal of Command, find a Training Dummy on the northwest side of the Crash Site and hit it with an attack.

english.completion: You've proven yourself a quick learner, $n. I look forward to training you again when the time is right.

text.title: 血色修道院之战
text.objectives: 杀死血色十字军指挥官莫格莱尼和大检察官怀特迈恩。
text.description: 看吧，被遗忘者的力量！黑暗女王那无坚不摧的意志在我们体内流淌！$B$B十字军的残部大多逃命去了，但仍有一些人在负隅顽抗。$B$B你在这场大捷中出了不少力，希尔瓦娜斯将消灭最后一股顽抗之敌的荣耀留给了你，$n。$B$B不要手下留情。
text.completion: Yes! The Scarlet Monastery now belongs to the Forsaken! None can escape our wrath! You've completed your task with the precision of a true champion. Take this as a reward, courtesy of the Banshee Queen.
text.completed: Return to Dark Ranger Velonara.
text.giverWindow: 让她吃点苦头，勇士。

english.title: Battle for the Scarlet Monastery
english.objectives: Kill Scarlet Commander Mograine and High Inquisitor Whitemane.
english.description: Behold the might of the Forsaken! The unstoppable will of the Dark Lady flows through our bodies! $B$BThe vast majority of the crusade's remaining forces have fled. Some, however, remain defiant.$B$BYou have been instrumental in this campaign's success. Sylvanas extends the honor of slaying her last remaining enemies to you, $n.$B$BShow no mercy.
english.completion: Yes! The Scarlet Monastery now belongs to the Forsaken! None can escape our wrath! You've completed your task with the precision of a true champion. Take this as a reward, courtesy of the Banshee Queen.
english.completed: Return to Dark Ranger Velonara.
english.giverWindow: Make her suffer, champion.

text.title: Frost Nova
text.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Frost Nova. Find a Training Dummy on the northwest side of the Crash Site and practice using it 2 times.
text.description: In your future as a mage, you'll want to master a wide variety of spells. To do so, you need to deepen your connection by the arcane by growing in power. Go, get more experience as a mage, and demonstrate what you learn for me.
text.completion: You've mastered the use of this new spell quickly, $n. I only wish all of my students were as talented. Return to me when you find yourself in need of further training.
text.completed: Return to Valaatu at the Crash Site.

text.title: 根源打击
text.objectives: 将等级提升至3级，学习根源打击。然后在坠毁点西北侧找一个训练假人，对其使用3次根源打击。
text.description:
元素之力将伴随你走遍天涯海角。随着你的力量不断提升，你会开始领悟出新技能。

让我们以一场简单而极具价值的课程来开启你的旅途吧。

学习根源打击的奥义，然后到坠毁点西北侧找训练假人，用你学会的新技能练练手。当你完成后，记得回来找我。
text.completion: It is a pleasure to teach such a capable student. As long as you continue the traditons faithfully, the shamanic arts will never be lost to our people again. Return to me when you need further training.
text.completed: Return to Firmanvaar at the Crash Site.

english.title: Primal Strike
english.objectives: Learn Primal Strike by reaching Level 3, and then find a Training Dummy on the northwest side of the Crash Site and practice using Primal Strike 3 times.
english.description: Your walk with the elemental powers will take you to many places. As you grow in power, you will begin to learn new abilities. Let us start your journey with a simple, but useful, lesson. Learn the secret of Primal Strike, and then practice your new skill using the training dummies to the northwest of the Crash Site. Return to me when you are finished.
english.completion: It is a pleasure to teach such a capable student. As long as you continue the traditons faithfully, the shamanic arts will never be lost to our people again. Return to me when you need further training.
english.completed: Return to Firmanvaar at the Crash Site.

objectiveDetails.description: 升到3级并学习根源打击

text.title: Learning the Word
text.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Shadow Word: Pain, then use it 5 times on target dummies near the crash site.
text.description: As a priest, one of your most important duties is to use the Light's power to aid the wounded. Another is to use your power offensively, to protect them. As you grow more experienced, you will begin to uncover new abilities that you can use in your charge. Go, gain more experience, and then demonstrate the abilities you have learned to me.
text.completion: You'll often find your skills as a healer in demand, $n. Do not hesitate to return when you need more training.
text.completed: Return to Zalduun at the Crash Site.

text.title: 大地的誓缚
text.objectives: 杀死高阶女祭司洛苏娜。
text.description: 神殿主厅的一阵噪音吸引了你的注意。你听到一阵熟悉的大笑……是洛苏娜。她回来干扰仪式了——你必须阻止她！
text.completion: Maruut said when all dis started dat he would gladly give his life ta see our task done. He would be proud of dis success... of dis death. Da rift be closed on dis side. Deepholm should calm down a bit. It'll be takin' time for Thrall to mend da wound in Azeroth, and we'll be needin' to remain until he finishes. Thank you for all ya've done. I don't tink we could have been accomplishin' dis so soon without you.
text.completed: Speak to Earthcaller Torunscar in the Temple of Earth.
text.giverWindow: 深岩之洲残余暮光之锤教徒的领袖。

english.title: The Binding
english.objectives: Kill High Priestess Lorthuna.
english.description: A noise in the main chamber of the temple draws your attention. You hear a familiar laugh... Lorthuna. She's returned to interrupt the ritual - you must stop her!
english.completion: Maruut said when all dis started dat he would gladly give his life ta see our task done. He would be proud of dis success... of dis death. Da rift be closed on dis side. Deepholm should calm down a bit. It'll be takin' time for Thrall to mend da wound in Azeroth, and we'll be needin' to remain until he finishes. Thank you for all ya've done. I don't tink we could have been accomplishin' dis so soon without you.
english.completed: Speak to Earthcaller Torunscar in the Temple of Earth.
english.giverWindow: Leader of the remaining Twilight's Hammer in Deepholm.

text.title: 圣光的黑暗面
text.objectives: 杀死审讯员韦沙斯和血法师萨尔诺斯。
text.description: 当我还是一名渴望净化一切邪恶的年轻圣骑士的时候，就加入了血色十字军。当时我对这些狂热之徒的黑暗真相一无所知。$B$B审讯员韦沙斯和血法师萨尔诺斯是这座墓地的主管。他们乐此不疲、永不停歇地折磨新兵，以确保他们是“纯净”的。这是对圣光的侮辱，$C！$B$B我不能继续待在这个堕落的组织里了。你必须把他们两个都干掉，这样其他人就不会再承受我所承受的痛苦折磨了。
text.completion: What do you mean Thalnos was an undead? That's impossible. The entire mission of the Scarlet Crusade is to destroy the undead! There's just no way... You have muddied my thoughts. Please take this reward for your achievement and leave me to rest.
text.completed: Return to Joseph the Awakened.

english.title: The Dark Side of the Light
english.objectives: Kill Interrogator Vishas and Bloodmage Thalnos.
english.description: I joined the Scarlet Crusade as a young paladin, eager to cleanse the world of evil. Little did I know of the dark truth to these fanatics.$B$BInterrogator Vishas and Bloodmage Thalnos oversee this graveyard. They take great pleasure in torturing new recruits endlessly to ensure that they are 'pure'. It is an affront to the light, $c!$B$BNo longer can I be a part of this corrupt organization. You're going to have to kill them both, so that others will never endure the same pain I did.
english.completion: What do you mean Thalnos was an undead? That's impossible. The entire mission of the Scarlet Crusade is to destroy the undead! There's just no way... You have muddied my thoughts. Please take this reward for your achievement and leave me to rest.
english.completed: Return to Joseph the Awakened.

text.title: 唯一正确的道路
text.objectives: 杀死驯犬者洛克希和奥法师杜安。
text.description: 我觉得十字军堕落的根源就在这里。奥法师杜安管理着图书馆，向新学员传授奥术知识。$B$B圣光才是唯一正确的道路！你必须杀掉他，$c，拯救这场光荣的运动！$B$B<醒悟的约瑟夫紧张地改变了语气。>$B$B另外，你还要除掉洛克希。他的猎犬好像不认同我们崇高的理想。
text.completion: Good work! I just know the Light shines favorably upon us for our work. Our cause is righteous!
text.completed: Return to Joseph the Awakened.
text.giverWindow: 他以铁腕统治着血色图书馆。

english.title: The Only True Path
english.objectives: Eliminate Houndmaster Loksey and Arcanist Doan.
english.description: I think that the root of the crusade's corruption can be found here. Arcanist Doan watches over the library, and teaches many young recruits to wield the arcane arts.$B$BThe Light is the only true path! You must kill him, $c, and redeem this glorious movement!$B$B<Joseph the Awakened shifts nervously.>$B$BYou'll want to dispose of Loksey as well. His hounds seem to disapprove of our noble intent.
english.completion: Good work! I just know the Light shines favorably upon us for our work. Our cause is righteous!
english.completed: Return to Joseph the Awakened.
english.giverWindow: He rules the Scarlet Library with an iron shush.

text.title: 冒牌勇士
text.objectives: 杀死赫洛德。
text.description: 我们……我们必须杀掉他们！他们冲过来了！$B$B你是相信我的，对吧？$B$B赫洛德不是血色十字军里真正的头号勇士。我才是！他夺走了本该属于我的东西！$B$B你必须杀了他。他是……一个威胁！他训练那些士兵杀死一切活物，而不仅仅是亡灵！$B$B我会给你重赏的……
text.completion: So he's really dead? That means...I, Joseph, am the new Scarlet Champion!!! Take this. I don't have a need for such possessions anyways! I'm the Scarlet Champion, after all.
text.completed: Return to Joseph the Crazed.
text.giverWindow: 肮脏的小偷！

english.title: The False Champion
english.objectives: Kill Herod.
english.description: We...we...we had to kill them! They were coming right for us!$B$BYou believe me, don't you $n?$B$BHerod is not the true champion of the Scarlet Crusade. I am! He took what was rightfully mine!$B$BYou should kill him. He's...a menace! Trains the soldiers to kill anyone instead of just the undead!$B$BI'll reward you handsomely...
english.completion: So he's really dead? That means...I, Joseph, am the new Scarlet Champion!!! Take this. I don't have a need for such possessions anyways! I'm the Scarlet Champion, after all.
english.completed: Return to Joseph the Crazed.
english.giverWindow: A dirty thief!

text.title: 舰队动员
text.objectives: 护送安度因王子前往暴风城码头，并同供应军士格雷夫斯交谈。假如你同王子走散了，可以在暴风城王座找到他。
text.description: 我正组织舰队准备攻打暮光高地，消灭死亡之翼的爪牙。我的人马已经备好，但舰队却迟迟未能就位。$B$B码头上的人需要激励。安度因王子如若能亲自驾临，则必将振奋军民士气。$B$B陪同安度因王子前往码头，同供应军士格雷夫斯交谈。我想让安度因学学一个天生的领袖是如何处理问题的。
text.completion: Please understand your highness, the men are working double-shifts. The scale of your father's operation is enormous. But we will endeavor to wrap things up. I give you my word.
text.end: 将安度因王子护送到格雷夫斯处。
text.completed: Talk to Supply Sergeant Graves at Stormwind Harbor.

english.title: Rallying the Fleet
english.objectives: Escort Prince Anduin to the Stormwind Docks and talk to Supply Sergeant Graves. If you get separated from the Prince, you'll find him in the Stormwind throne room.
english.description: I am amassing a warfleet to assault Twilight Highlands and bring an end to Deathwing's lackeys. My soldiers are ready but fleet preparations lag behind.$B$BMy men at the docks need some inspiration and motivation. A visit from the Prince here should lift their spirits and remind them of the bright future they're fighting for.$B$BTake Prince Anduin to the docks with you and speak with Supply Sergeant Graves. I want Anduin to observe how a natural leader handles the situation.
english.completion: Please understand your highness, the men are working double-shifts. The scale of your father's operation is enormous. But we will endeavor to wrap things up. I give you my word.
english.completed: Talk to Supply Sergeant Graves at Stormwind Harbor.

text.title: 血色修道院之战
text.objectives: 杀死血色十字军指挥官莫格莱尼和大检察官怀特迈恩。
text.description: 哦，很高兴再见到你，$N！恐怕我正巧需要你的帮助。$B$B你瞧，莫格莱尼和大检察官怀特迈恩是这里的头儿，他们跟我说，我不是新的血色勇士！当然了，我跟我的伙计们可不是好糊弄的。$B$B我们打算夺取血色修道院，重建这个组织，让事情回到正轨上——也就是一切都由我说了算的状态！我会好好对付被遗忘者和天灾军团的。$B$B帮老朋友一个忙吧？
text.completion: Yes! The Scarlet Monastery is ours! You're a real friend. Take this as a reward, and feel free to visit again once I've taken the Undercity too. It'll be a Scarlet Paradise!
text.completed: Return to Joseph the Insane.
text.giverWindow: Take her out!

english.title: Battle for the Scarlet Monastery
english.objectives: Kill Scarlet Commander Mograine and High Inquisitor Whitemane.
english.description: Oh, it's great to see you again $n! I'm afraid I'm going to need your help.$B$BYou see, Mograine's the Commander here along with High Inquisitor Whitemane, and they tried telling me that I wasn't really the new Scarlet Champion! 'Course, the boys and I didn't take kindly to that.$B$BWe're taking the Scarlet Monastery for our own and re-establishing the order as it always should have been - with me at the head of things! I'll take care of the Forsaken and the Scourge for good.$B$BHelp an old friend out?
english.completion: Yes! The Scarlet Monastery is ours! You're a real friend. Take this as a reward, and feel free to visit again once I've taken the Undercity too. It'll be a Scarlet Paradise!
english.completed: Return to Joseph the Insane.
english.giverWindow: Take her out!

text.title: 调查暮光
text.objectives: 同暴风城堡里的萨缪尔森少校交谈。
text.description: 暮光之锤的煽动让城里一片混乱。他们掠夺农民，教唆我们最重要的市民。我们得弄明白这个阴谋到底有多大。$B$B我已任命暴风城卫兵队的萨缪尔森少校着手调查。他就在王座这儿，看看你是不是能帮什么忙。
text.completion: Hmmm, yes? My investigation of the Twilight's Hammer. Of course. Your assistance will be valuable.
text.completed: 同暴风城堡里的萨缪尔森少校交谈。

english.title: Twilight Investigation
english.objectives: Speak with Major Samuelson in Stormwind Keep.
english.description: The city is still reeling from the seditious acts of the Twilight's Hammer in recent months. They prey on peasant fears and corrupt our most important citizens. We need to find out how deep the conspiracy runs.$B$BI've tasked Major Samuelson of the Stormwind City Guard to head up an investigation. He's right here in the throne room. See if you can assist his efforts.
english.completion: Hmmm, yes? My investigation of the Twilight's Hammer. Of course. Your assistance will be valuable.
english.completed: Speak with Major Samuelson in Stormwind Keep.

text.title: 谁还要天灾之锅啊？
text.objectives: 将迪瑟斯的疫病之鼓放置在费尔斯通农场的磨坊、粮库、矮房和谷仓处。
text.description: 你查看过费尔斯通农场的情况吗？安多哈尔的联盟军控制了那片地区，然后他们用它来……来……种庄稼！$b$b我反倒更喜欢天灾控制的时候，至少他们还很有品味在田里搁上一口巨大的天灾之锅。$b$b我们得从那些人类手里把地给夺回来，$n。带上这些鼓，把它们放置在地里的关键位置上，我就在亡灵壁垒等你的消息。
text.completion: The drums are placed?  In their positions? Very well then, I will give the word to the High Executor.  When the time is ready, he will be the one to press the ignition switch.
text.completed: Return to Apothecary Dithers at The Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.

english.title: Who Needs Cauldrons?
english.objectives: Place Dithers' Plague Drums near the Windmill, the Grain Silos, the Ranch House, and the Barn at Felstone Field.
english.description: Have you seen the condition of Felstone Field?  The Alliance forces at Andorhal have taken the area, and they're using it to... to... to grow CROPS!$b$bI almost liked it better when the Scourge held the area.  At least they had the sense to put a giant plague cauldron in the middle of the field.$b$bWe're going to take that farm back from these humans, $n.  Take these drums and place them at key locations around the field.  I'll be waiting here at the Bulwark.
english.completion: The drums are placed?  In their positions? Very well then, I will give the word to the High Executor.  When the time is ready, he will be the one to press the ignition switch.
english.completed: Return to Apothecary Dithers at The Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.

text.title: 奇怪的新面孔
text.objectives: 向西瘟疫之地被烧毁的前哨站的琳塞·鸦日报告
text.description: 现在费尔斯通是我们的了。地皮也好，死尸也好，皆为我等所用。我收到了高层的命令说让你去负责这件事。$b$b你也许在安多哈尔的战场上见过琳塞·鸦日。我以前从没见过她，但她好像在高层有不少朋友，因为费尔斯通的行动现在归她管了。你将在被烧掉的血色营地同她会面……就是之前你去侦察的那个。
text.completion: $n.  The Dark Lady watches over you.
text.completed: 向西瘟疫之地被烧毁的前哨站的琳塞·鸦日报告

english.title: Strange New Faces
english.objectives: Report to Lindsay Ravensun at the Charred Outpost in Western Plaguelands.
english.description: Now that Felstone is ours, we can use its acreage - and any dead bodies we find - for our own purposes.  I've received orders from higher up that you are going to be helping out in this process.$b$bYou may have met Lindsay Ravensun on the battlefield in Andorhal.  I've never met her before, but she seems to have made some friends in high places, because she's taking over operations at Felstone.  You're to meet her at the charred Scarlet camp... the one you scouted out earlier.
english.completion: $n.  The Dark Lady watches over you.
english.completed: Report to Lindsay Ravensun at the Charred Outpost in Western Plaguelands.

text.title: 飞轮工作站
text.objectives: 同米奈希尔港北部飞轮工作站的史拉·硬凿交谈。
text.description: 你的表现不错，$n。让你去扛沙包实在是太屈才了，我宁可把你派到更能发挥作用的地方去。$B$B沼泽北部有我们一个小哨所，是以建造它的地精飞轮命名的，不过你可以去找史拉·硬凿为铁炉堡尽一份力。$B$B我承认，她是个漂亮妞……但要是我就不会对她动手动脚！他们家叫硬凿可是有道理的。
text.completion: Stoutfist sent you, eh? He's a good captain, runs his men well. Just wish he'd stop starin' at my midriff. Don't let me catch you doin' it either. We've work to take care of here!

english.title: Swiftgear Station
english.objectives: Speak with Shilah Slabchisel at Swiftgear Station, north of Menethil Harbor.
english.description: You've done good work here, $n. Askin' you to haul sandbags would be a waste, to be honest; I'd rather send you along where your skills are needed.$B$BWe've got a small outpost up north in the marsh. Swiftgear's the gnome that built it, but you'll want to talk to Shilah Slabchisel and help her with Ironforge matters.$B$BI'll admit, she's a looker... but I wouldn't make the mistake of getting fresh with her! They don't call their family Slabchisel for nothing.
english.completion: Stoutfist sent you, eh? He's a good captain, runs his men well. Just wish he'd stop starin' at my midriff. Don't let me catch you doin' it either. We've work to take care of here!

text.title: 维尔加居所
text.objectives: 同飞轮工作站东南维尔加居所里的勘察员维尔加交谈。
text.description: 勘察员维尔加带着一支考古队在东南边的山里工作了有一阵子了。他总是不堪迅猛龙的骚扰，不过最近情况好多了。$B$B有一天，我听说他们又不得不撤离挖掘现场。我不知道具体发生了什么，不过我倒是能想象，大灾变之后那儿肯定不如从前安全。$B$B在那儿干活的都是些不错的家伙，$n。能不能麻烦你去看看出了什么事，好歹搭把手？
text.completion: Well met, $c. We've got raptor problems for sure... sort of. More like the entire dig site deciding to attack us. I've never seen rocks and fossils get so upset!

english.title: Whelgar's Retreat
english.objectives: Speak with Prospector Whelgar at Whelgar's Retreat, southeast of Swiftgear Station.
english.description: Prospector Whelgar's been leading an excavation in the mountains southeast of here for quite some time. He had some raptor problems back in the day, but things were going better recently.$B$BJust the other day, we got word he had to evacuate the entire digsite again. I'm not sure what's going on there, but I can't imagine the cataclysm making a quarry any safer than it was before.$B$BThere's good dwarves working there, $n. Would you go see what's wrong there, and maybe lend a hand?
english.completion: Well met, $c. We've got raptor problems for sure... sort of. More like the entire dig site deciding to attack us. I've never seen rocks and fossils get so upset!

text.title: 血色修道院
text.objectives: 拜访醒悟的约瑟夫。
text.description: 提瑞斯法林地的那座修道院现在是血色十字军的地盘，但那里以前是我们训练圣骑士的基地。眼下，幽暗城中的被遗忘者对它虎视眈眈，那些十字军却不允许我们用它来训练士兵，对抗被遗忘者！$B$B听着，我不相信这个醒悟的约瑟夫，但他正在墓地里等着呢。去跟他聊聊——尽管他是一个十字军成员，但他说自己已经起义了，这也许是我们夺回修道院的好机会。
text.completion: Captain Nials sent you? I haven't seen her in ages! How is she? Did she get my letter? Oh, you're not here for that. Well then, let's get down to business!
text.completed: 去找醒悟的约瑟夫。

english.title: The Scarlet Monastery
english.objectives: Visit Joseph the Awakened.
english.description: The same Monastery in Tirisfal Glades that the Scarlet Crusaders now occupy used to be a major training ground for our paladins. Now the Forsaken loom over it from the Undercity and the Crusade prevents us from utilizing it to train the very soldiers we need to deal with the Forsaken!$B$BLook, I don't trust him, but Joseph the Awakened waits inside the graveyard. Go speak with him - although he is a crusader, he says he now rebels against them, providing us with an opportunity to take back what's ours.
english.completion: Captain Nials sent you? I haven't seen her in ages! How is she? Did she get my letter? Oh, you're not here for that. Well then, let's get down to business!
