english.description: The gyreworms infest the rock, eating away at it until our home will one day collapse. For every one that is killed, twice as many burst forth to follow, but we must carry on the fight. They must be extinguished.$B$BGo to the Crumbling Depths and slaughter any worms that you can find.
english.completion: You wage a war that we cannot. Thank you for your help.
english.completed: Return to Felsen the Enduring at Therazane's Throne.

text.title: 尘
text.objectives: 收集10份钙铝石微尘。
text.description: 一些最稀有的水晶只在最危险的地方形成。在碎岩之渊，你可以发现钙铝石——比你们种族所崇拜的黄金要好多了。$B$B作为一名血肉之躯，拥有一副矮小的身体，你可以进入碎岩之渊为我收集钙铝石之尘。你愿意为我冒这个险吗？
text.progress: Painite is one of the most valuable materials to us, particularly due to our inability to reach most of the deposits on our own.
text.completion: Well done, $r. These will do well.
text.completed: Return to Felsen the Enduring at Therazane's Throne.

english.title: Motes
english.objectives: Recover 10 Motes of Painite.
english.description: Some of the rarest crystals form in the most dangerous places. In the Crumbling Depths, you will find painite formations - much better than the gold that your races cherish so much.$B$BAs a being of flesh and a being of small stature, you can enter the Crumbling Depths to retrieve motes of painite for me. Would you undergo that danger on my behalf?
english.progress: Painite is one of the most valuable materials to us, particularly due to our inability to reach most of the deposits on our own.
english.completion: Well done, $r. These will do well.
english.completed: Return to Felsen the Enduring at Therazane's Throne.

text.title: 地下经济
text.objectives: 使用莉吉特的炸弹安放器收集3块深岩雪花石晶簇、3块深岩天青石晶簇和3块深岩血榴石晶簇。
text.description: 嘿！我得找些人来帮忙收集水晶。元素生物愿意为这些玩意付大价钱……如果你帮我收集各种各样的水晶，我就分你一点利润。$B$B用这些炸弹从大块水晶上炸一些下来。$B$B我的炸弹有点猛，你多加小心啊。
text.progress: Boom?
text.completion: Well played! I've got this pretty sweet deal going. A bunch of shmucks go up there to Therazane's Throne and give all kinds of gold to D'lom for who-knows-what kinda crap. He forks all that cash over to me for these crystals. I go home freakin' rich for a couple chunks of rock. Don't tell no one though. I don't want no competition springin' up. Think you can come back later to help me get another load of crystals out?
text.completed: Speak to Ricket just inside the Crumbling Depths in Deepholm.

english.title: Underground Economy
english.objectives: Use Ricket's Tickers to gather 3 Deep Alabaster Crystals, 3 Deep Celestite Crystals, 3 Deep Amethyst Crystals, and 3 Deep Garget Crystals.
english.description: Hey! I need some help gatherin' crystals. The elementals trade top dollar for these things... if you help me gather all the different kinds, I'll cut you in on the profits.$B$BUse these bombs to blow out chunks from the bigger formations.$B$BI've got a nasty habit of packin' the explosives a bit thick. Mind the kick.
english.progress: Boom?
english.completion: Well played! I've got this pretty sweet deal going. A bunch of shmucks go up there to Therazane's Throne and give all kinds of gold to D'lom for who-knows-what kinda crap. He forks all that cash over to me for these crystals. I go home freakin' rich for a couple chunks of rock. Don't tell no one though. I don't want no competition springin' up. Think you can come back later to help me get another load of crystals out?
english.completed: Speak to Ricket just inside the Crumbling Depths in Deepholm.

text.title: 软岩
text.objectives: 杀死8头真菌巨兽。
text.description: 赤红岩床的侵蚀还没有平息。摧毁那些在我们土地上喷污撒秽的真菌巨兽。要是它们再长出来，我们还会把它们干掉。
text.completion: Once the growth starts, it is near impossible to stomp back into submission. Through persistence our realm will one day be cleansed.
text.completed: Return to Gorsik the Tumultuous at Therazane's Throne.

english.title: Soft Rock
english.objectives: Kill 8 Fungal Behemoths.
english.description: The corruption of the Crimson Expanse has not subsided. Destroy the Fungal Behemoths that shower their filth upon our realm. If they continue to rise, we will continue to destroy them.
english.completion: Once the growth starts, it is near impossible to stomp back into submission. Through persistence our realm will one day be cleansed.
english.completed: Return to Gorsik the Tumultuous at Therazane's Throne.

text.title: 真菌之怒
text.objectives: 消灭10个萌芽的赤红蘑菇。
text.description: 有什么东西在赤红岩床一直刺激着这恶心的生长。新的菌菇正在长出来，我们要在蔓延之前除掉它们。
text.completion: You are proficient at stepping on things. You would make an excellent giant.
text.completed: Return to Gorsik the Tumultuous at Therazane's Throne.

english.title: Fungal Fury
english.objectives: Destroy 10 of the newly sprouted mushrooms in the Crimson Expanse.
english.description: Something upon the Crimson Expanse continues to spur disgusting growths upon the rock. New fungi are rising, and they need to be crushed before they can spread.
english.completion: You are proficient at stepping on things. You would make an excellent giant.
english.completed: Return to Gorsik the Tumultuous at Therazane's Throne.

text.title: 坚持不懈
text.objectives: 去赤红岩床获取一包维罗克的神奇增长素。
text.description: 戈洛普是给杀掉了，但穴居人并没有被驱散。他的仆从们重新获得了留下的生长媒介，继续在赤红岩床播撒侵蚀的种子。$B$B把它们找出来，将你能找到的维罗克的神奇增长素都带回来，必须把它们处理掉。
text.progress: Have you done as I've asked of you? We must weed out the whatever growth agent remains within their possession.
text.completion: Thank you, $r. We will weed the rest out of their possession in time.
text.completed: Return to Ruberick at Therazane's Throne.

english.title: Through Persistence
english.objectives: Retrieve a Bag of Verlok Miracle-Grow from the Verloks upon the Crimson Expanse.
english.description: The troggs did not disperse after you killed Glop. His servants recovered the growth agent that was left behind and continue to sow the seeds of corruption across the Crimson Expanse.$B$BHunt them down and recover any of the remaining Verlock Miracle-Grow that you find. It must be disposed of.
english.progress: Have you done as I've asked of you? We must weed out the whatever growth agent remains within their possession.
english.completion: Thank you, $r. We will weed the rest out of their possession in time.
english.completed: Return to Ruberick at Therazane's Throne.

text.title: Lingering Twilight
text.objectives: Hunt down a Twilight Drakerider on a Crystalwing Stone Drake.
text.description: Twilight drake riders remain in Deepholm. They are scattered. Defeated. Yet they remain.$B$BTake wing with Aeosera's flight and hunt them down. The stone drakes await you on the ledge to the southeast.$B$BWe will destroy every last one of the Twilight. In the Stonemother's name.
text.completed: Return to Terrath the Steady at Therazane's Throne in Deepholm.

english.title: Lingering Twilight
english.objectives: Hunt down a Twilight Drakerider on a Crystalwing Stone Drake.
english.description: Twilight drake riders remain in Deepholm. They are scattered. Defeated. Yet they remain.$B$BTake wing with Aeosera's flight and hunt them down. The stone drakes await you on the ledge to the southeast.$B$BWe will destroy every last one of the Twilight. In the Stonemother's name.
english.completed: Return to Terrath the Steady at Therazane's Throne in Deepholm.

text.title: 盖罗恩农场之锅
text.objectives: 前往西瘟疫之地的盖罗恩农场，找到并击败护锅者，用它的钥匙打开大锅。
text.description: 分析完成了！让动物们受罪的不是什么老毛病。不，它是新出现的一种什么东西……我想我知道是怎么回事。$b$b诅咒教派在盖罗恩农场架起了一口天灾之锅。$B$B农场就在东南，东瘟疫之地边上。我需要一份锅里的样本来证实我的猜测。$b$b消灭护锅者拿到它的钥匙，然后你就可以去打开大锅拿到我的样本了。
text.progress: 瘟疫之锅的控制板仍然被牢牢地锁着。要想打开它，你就得先找到钥匙。
text.completion: Cauldron Lord Soulwrath's key disintegrates as it touches the lock on the access panel at the base of the cauldron's platform.  A slight clanking noise is heard within, and the access panel swings open to reveal more viscous toxins within the cauldron's framework. There is a small spigot that the bottle fits well enough under, allowing you to draw a sample for Field Agent Kaartish back at the Menders' Stead.
text.completed: Examine the Scourge Cauldron at Gahrron's Withering in Western Plaguelands.
text.giverWindow: 从护锅者身上弄到钥匙，然后激活大锅。

english.title: Gahrron's Withering Cauldron
english.objectives: Go to Gahrron's Withering in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron.
english.description: My analysis is complete!  The blight that affects the animals here is no residual disease.  No, it is something new... and I think I know what it is.$b$bThe Cult of the Damned maintains a plague cauldron on a farm called Gahrron's Withering.$B$BThis farm is due southeast of us, close to where the Eastern Plaguelands begin.  I need a sample from this cauldron to verify my suspicions.$b$bEliminate the cauldron lord present there for its key.  You will then be able to access the cauldron and obtain my sample.
english.progress: An access panel to the cauldron remains securely fastened.  In order to open it, you will need to find the key.
english.completion: Cauldron Lord Soulwrath's key disintegrates as it touches the lock on the access panel at the base of the cauldron's platform.  A slight clanking noise is heard within, and the access panel swings open to reveal more viscous toxins within the cauldron's framework. There is a small spigot that the bottle fits well enough under, allowing you to draw a sample for Field Agent Kaartish back at the Menders' Stead.
english.completed: Examine the Scourge Cauldron at Gahrron's Withering in Western Plaguelands.
english.giverWindow: Get the key from the cauldron lord, then activate the cauldron.

text.title: 铤而走险
text.objectives: 杀死讲师玛丽希亚，缴获她的教派命令书。
text.description: 诅咒教派在东边设立了一个小营地，玛丽希亚前哨站，可以用来在通灵学院外进行野战训练。我们放任他们太久了。$b$b如果教派真的在用瘟疫毒害动物，那么我们就在玛丽希亚前哨站来一次消毒。$b$b讲师玛丽希亚是那儿的主管，找到她把她干掉，顺便查一查她是在为谁工作。
text.progress: You take a look at the paperwork Malicia was carrying...
text.completion: The orders in Malicia's possession incriminate Darkmaster Gandling of the Scholomance, but they also conceal another important bit of information.
text.completed: Return to Field Agent Kaartish at the Menders' Stead in Western Plaguelands.
text.giverWindow: 她声称在战场上训练教徒，但我还有些其他的怀疑。

english.title: Desperate Acts
english.objectives: Kill Instructor Malicia and obtain her Cult Orders.
english.description: The Cult of the Damned maintains a small camp to the east, Malicia Outpost, which they use for field training outside of the Scholomance.  We may have allowed them to proceed unchecked with this training for too long.$b$bIf cultists are truly using this plague to inoculate the wildlife, then Malicia Outpost must be where the inoculation is occurring.$b$bInstructor Malicia runs the outpost.  Find her, slay her, and find out who she's taking orders from.
english.progress: You take a look at the paperwork Malicia was carrying...
english.completion: The orders in Malicia's possession incriminate Darkmaster Gandling of the Scholomance, but they also conceal another important bit of information.
english.completed: Return to Field Agent Kaartish at the Menders' Stead in Western Plaguelands.
english.giverWindow: She claims to be training cultists in the field, but I have other suspicions.

text.title: 卡斯迪诺夫的学生们
text.objectives: 在西瘟疫之地的哭泣之洞里消灭2名卡斯迪诺夫的学徒，2名血钉蛮兵，2名血钉撕裂者，以及4个邪恶凝血球。
text.description: 教派手令表明盖罗恩农场的天灾之锅有两个用处。第一，在瘟疫之地的动物身上散播疾病，这你已经知道了。$b$b余下的瘟疫药剂被运往哭泣之洞，玛丽希亚前哨站北边的一个洞窟里，用来进行某种黑暗实验。通灵学院的学生们将用这些药剂唤起亡灵！$b$b他们必须被阻止。
text.completion: You have gone above and beyond, $n.  Not only have we set back the Cult of the Damned in their crusade to re-plague the plaguelands, but you have uncovered another set of dire plans: they continue to re-animate the dead! Your name will definitely be mentioned when this information is presented to Highlord Fordring, $n.  You have my thanks, and the blessing of the Argent Crusade.
text.completed: Return to Field Agent Kaartish at the Menders' Stead in Western Plaguelands.

english.title: Students of Krastinov
english.objectives: Kill 2 Krastinovian Disciples, 2 Flesh-Cobbled Brutes, 2 Flesh-Cobbled Rippers, and 4 Unholy Corpuscles within the Weeping Cave in Western Plaguelands.
english.description: The Cult orders state that the plague from the cauldron at Gahrron's Withering is in fact being used for TWO purposes.  The first is the practice of spreading disease through the animals of the plaguelands, which you already knew about.$b$bThe remainder of the plague is being shipped to the Weeping Cave, a cavern north of Malicia's Outpost, for use in some dark experiments.  Students of the Scholomance are using this plague to re-animate the dead!$b$bCertainly they must be stopped.
english.completion: You have gone above and beyond, $n.  Not only have we set back the Cult of the Damned in their crusade to re-plague the plaguelands, but you have uncovered another set of dire plans: they continue to re-animate the dead! Your name will definitely be mentioned when this information is presented to Highlord Fordring, $n.  You have my thanks, and the blessing of the Argent Crusade.
english.completed: Return to Field Agent Kaartish at the Menders' Stead in Western Plaguelands.

text.title: 贝尔蒙特的报告
text.objectives: 把贝尔蒙特的报告交给银松森林被遗忘者统帅部的希尔瓦娜斯·风行者。
text.description: <贝尔蒙特交给你一份封好的信。>$B$B把这份报告交给希尔瓦娜斯·风行者。里面是我基于你和尤瑞克的实际调查，对银松地区的形势评估。$B$B如果不把狼人叛乱分子们剿除，他们就会在我们头上动土。现在就是行动的时候！
text.progress: Kneel before your queen, $n.
text.completion: Crowley... A gnat. An insect, waiting to be crushed beneath my boot heel. So he thinks to rouse the feral worgen of Silverpine? We shall show him and his allies the might of the Forsaken! But first we must clean up the mess made by the Warchief's fleet. Without their aid we may lose this war.

english.title: Belmont's Report
english.objectives: Deliver Belmont's Report to Lady Sylvanas Windrunner at Forsaken High Command in Silverpine Forest.
english.description: <Belmont hands you a sealed envelope.>$B$BDeliver this report to Lady Sylvanas Windrunner. It is my assessment of the situation in Silverpine based upon your and Yorick's field work.$B$BIf we do not stamp out the worgen insurgents, they will overrun us. The time to act is now!
english.progress: Kneel before your queen, $n.
english.completion: Crowley... A gnat. An insect, waiting to be crushed beneath my boot heel. So he thinks to rouse the feral worgen of Silverpine? We shall show him and his allies the might of the Forsaken! But first we must clean up the mess made by the Warchief's fleet. Without their aid we may lose this war.

starters.name: 死亡猎手指挥官贝尔蒙特

text.title: 返回农场
text.objectives: 将盖罗恩农场的样本瓶带回给到西瘟疫之地治愈者营地的战地特工卡尔缇舍。
text.description: 你小心地拧开面板上的龙头，看着天灾之锅里腐败的浓汁流进空瓶。$B$B东西已经到手，是时候该回治愈者营地的战地特工卡尔缇舍那儿去了。
text.progress: Gahrron's Withering houses a viciously potent plague cauldron.  Once we have a sample of the plague it spews forth, we will be able to determine whether the Cult of the Damned is truly responsible for continuing to poison the land.
text.completion: Good work.  One moment please... Yes, this appears to be the same corruption that is affecting the wildlife.  With this knowledge, and with your combat expertise, we may have the power to stop this.
text.completed: Bring the Filled Gahrron's Withering Bottle to Field Agent Kaartish at the Menders' Stead in Western Plaguelands.

english.title: Return to the Stead
english.objectives: Bring the Filled Gahrron's Withering Bottle to Field Agent Kaartish at the Menders' Stead in Western Plaguelands.
english.description: You carefully close the spigot in the control panel, watching the cauldron's putrid ichors drip into the empty bottle.$B$BWith the poison in hand, it is time to return to Field Agent Kaartish at the Menders' Stead.
english.progress: Gahrron's Withering houses a viciously potent plague cauldron.  Once we have a sample of the plague it spews forth, we will be able to determine whether the Cult of the Damned is truly responsible for continuing to poison the land.
english.completion: Good work.  One moment please... Yes, this appears to be the same corruption that is affecting the wildlife.  With this knowledge, and with your combat expertise, we may have the power to stop this.
english.completed: Bring the Filled Gahrron's Withering Bottle to Field Agent Kaartish at the Menders' Stead in Western Plaguelands.

text.title: 错误的序列
text.objectives: 使用界门控制器输入错误的启动序列，从而摧毁界门。
text.description: 必须阻止暮光之锤使用界门。只有一个办法。$B$B输入错误的启动序列并摧毁它。$B$B嗯，让我看看。没错，这儿就有一个，能通往火元素位面火焰之地的爆破深度。应该可以成功。
text.completion: You did it! You found out what the Twilight's Hammer were up to and you stopped them dead in their tracks! Now I'm certain that I have something around here for you.
text.completed: Return to Explorer Mowi at the Temple of Earth in Deepholm.

english.title: The Wrong Sequence
english.objectives: Use the Waygate Controller to punch in the wrong activation sequence, thereby destroying the Waygate.
english.description: The Twilight's Hammer must be stopped from using the Waygate. There's only one thing to do.$B$BPunch in the wrong activation sequence and destroy it.$B$BHmm, let's see. Yes, here's one that opens upon the explosive depths of the Firelands, the elemental plane of fire. That should do nicely.
english.completion: You did it! You found out what the Twilight's Hammer were up to and you stopped them dead in their tracks! Now I'm certain that I have something around here for you.
english.completed: Return to Explorer Mowi at the Temple of Earth in Deepholm.

text.title: 错误的序列
text.objectives: 使用界门控制器输入错误的启动序列，从而摧毁界门。
text.description: 必须阻止暮光之锤使用界门。只有一个办法。$B$B输入错误的启动序列并摧毁它。$B$B嗯，让我看看。没错，这儿就有一个，能通往火元素位面火焰之地的爆破深度。应该可以成功。
text.completion: You did it! Excellent work, my boy. You found out what the Twilight's Hammer were up to and you stopped them dead in their tracks! Now I'm certain that I have something around here for you.
text.completed: Return to Examiner Rowe at the Temple of Earth in Deepholm.

english.title: The Wrong Sequence
english.objectives: Use the Waygate Controller to punch in the wrong activation sequence, thereby destroying the Waygate.
english.description: The Twilight's Hammer must be stopped from using the Waygate. There's only one thing to do.$B$BPunch in the wrong activation sequence and destroy it.$B$BHmm, let's see. Yes, here's one that opens upon the explosive depths of the Firelands, the elemental plane of fire. That should do nicely.
english.completion: You did it! Excellent work, my boy. You found out what the Twilight's Hammer were up to and you stopped them dead in their tracks! Now I'm certain that I have something around here for you.
english.completed: Return to Examiner Rowe at the Temple of Earth in Deepholm.

text.title: 不洁之牛
text.objectives: 护送安度因·乌瑞恩沿着血迹从沃勒顿的农场前往犯罪现场。确保安度因的安全。假如你同他走散了，可以在暴风城王座找到他。
text.description: <沃勒顿试图恢复镇静。>$B$B牛？您是说失踪的牲畜一事？$B$B平常我就将牛放养在房子北边。突然有一只走丢了，留下一道血迹。谁会做那样的事情？$B$B我是不敢沿着血迹去找……暴风城里有些病态的东西！
text.completion: That was a close one! I can't believe you stood your ground against so many at once. It looks like this site was used for some kind of twisted Twilight's Hammer initiation ritual. They're definitely active in Stormwind. What's this? This badge shows a crossed axe and hammer. It looks old. If we keep poking around, we might figure out what it means...
text.completed: Speak with Prince Anduin Wrynn. If he's no longer with you, find him in Stormwind Keep.

english.title: Unholy Cow
english.objectives: While escorting Anduin Wrynn, follow the trail of gore from Farmer Wollerton's Stead to the crime scene. Keep Anduin alive. If he's not with you, he will be waiting in Stormwind Keep.
english.description: <Farmer Wollerton tries to pull himself together.>$B$BCows? You're asking about the missing livestock?$B$BI normally just let the cows graze north of the house here. Occasionally one gets spirited away. Leaves a trail of gore. Who would do such a thing?$B$BI'm afraid to follow that trail myself... something sick is happening in Stormwind!
english.completion: That was a close one! I can't believe you stood your ground against so many at once. It looks like this site was used for some kind of twisted Twilight's Hammer initiation ritual. They're definitely active in Stormwind. What's this? This badge shows a crossed axe and hammer. It looks old. If we keep poking around, we might figure out what it means...
english.completed: Speak with Prince Anduin Wrynn. If he's no longer with you, find him in Stormwind Keep.

text.title: 暮光瞭望台
text.objectives: 跟深岩之洲暮光瞭望台的风暴召唤者米尔拉谈一谈。
text.description: 他们所提到的龙就是艾比希昂，$n。要想从他手里拿到碎片可不容易。$B$B再去找米尔拉。她在暮光瞭望台附近行动。$B$B她会告诉你我们的下一步是什么。
text.completion: So we're going to have to take on Abyssion to get the fragment?  This operation just got a whole lot more difficult all of a sudden.
text.giverWindow: 米尔拉已经占领了暮光瞭望台。去找她。

english.title: The Twilight Overlook
english.objectives: Speak to Stormcaller Mylra at the Twilight Overlook in Deepholm.
english.description: The dragon they're speaking of is Abyssion, $n.  It's not going to be easy to get the fragment off of him.$B$BMeet with Mylra again.  She is operating nearby at the Twilight Overlook.$B$BShe will tell you what our next move will be.
english.completion: So we're going to have to take on Abyssion to get the fragment?  This operation just got a whole lot more difficult all of a sudden.
english.giverWindow: Mylra has taken the Twilight Overlook.  Meet with her.

text.title: 潜伏的威胁
text.objectives: 到剃刀高地去找帮手。
text.description: 剃刀高地的野猪人似乎和天灾联起手来了。这对我们来说真是黑暗的消息，$c。我们要应付恐怖图腾就已经焦头烂额，若是天灾攻来，我们将无力招架。前往东边的剃刀高地，看是不是能够找人帮你，在他们决定攻打这里之前阻止他们。
text.completion: You seem an able warrior. Perhaps you can help me put an end to the terrible evil here.

english.title: Looming Threat
english.objectives: Find help in Razorfen Downs.
english.description: The Quilboar in Razorfen Downs seem to have allied with the Scourge. This is dark news for us, $c. We have dire enough problems dealing with these Grimtotem, we won't be able to handle an attack by the Scourge. Venture into Razorfen Downs, east of here, and see if you can find anyone that may be able to help you stop them before they decide to attack here.
english.completion: You seem an able warrior. Perhaps you can help me put an end to the terrible evil here.

text.title: 潜伏的威胁
text.objectives: 到剃刀高地去找帮手。
text.description: 天灾对自然而言是一种公然的冒犯。他们成功地腐化了剃刀高地的野猪人，如今又威胁要进一步扩张到千针石林，我恐怕，他们最终会西进菲拉斯。你必须到那里去，尽一切所能把他们控制住。也许你可以在当地找些帮手？风的低语声称那里有一个强大的存在。
text.completion: You seem an able warrior. Perhaps you can help me put an end to the terrible evil here.

english.title: Looming Threat
english.objectives: Find help in Razorfen Downs.
english.description: The Scourge are a direct affront to nature. They have managed to corrupt the Quilboar in Razorfen Downs and now threaten to spread further into Thousand Needles and eventually, I fear, west into Feralas. You must go there and do anything you can to confine them. Perhaps you can find someone in the area to help you? The winds whisper of a powerful presence in the area.
english.completion: You seem an able warrior. Perhaps you can help me put an end to the terrible evil here.

text.title: 他瞒着我们
text.objectives: 护送安度因·乌瑞恩前往暴风城旧城区军情七处总部三楼。假如你同他走散了，可以在暴风城王座找到他。
text.description: $n，看来萨缪尔森是故意要浪费我们的时间。码头工人什么都不知道。更重要的是，暴风城港口丢了炸药！$B$B知道我在想什么吗？我打赌萨缪尔森所知的要比他告诉我们得多。他可能已经有了暮光之锤的头绪，想把功劳独吞。$B$B我们应该偷偷查查他在军情七处总部的档案，看看他到底知道些什么。带我过去，他们应该拦不住我。
text.completion: This is REALLY suspicious, $n! Samuelson doesn't have a shred of info here about the Twilight Hammer - it's almost like he's not investigating them. Yet he's got a complete catalog of the missing explosives. And I found this funny badge with a symbol on it: A crossed axe and hammer. It all means something, but what?
text.completed: Speak with Anduin Wrynn. If he is no longer with you, you can find Anduin in Stormwind Keep.

english.title: He's Holding Out on Us
english.objectives: Escort Anduin Wrynn to the third floor of SI:7 Headquarters in the Old Town district of Stormwind. If he is no longer with you, you can find Anduin in Stormwind Keep.
english.description: $n, it almost seems like Samuelson is trying to intentionally waste your time. The dockworkers don't know anything. More importantly, explosives are missing from Stormwind Harbor!$B$BYou know what I think? I bet Samuelson knows more than he's letting on. He probably has a lead on Twilight's Hammer and wants all the credit and glory for himself.$B$BWe should peek through his records at the SI:7 headquarters. Take me there and I should be allowed to look at his files and find out what he really knows.
english.completion: This is REALLY suspicious, $n! Samuelson doesn't have a shred of info here about the Twilight Hammer - it's almost like he's not investigating them. Yet he's got a complete catalog of the missing explosives. And I found this funny badge with a symbol on it: A crossed axe and hammer. It all means something, but what?
english.completed: Speak with Anduin Wrynn. If he is no longer with you, you can find Anduin in Stormwind Keep.

objectiveDetails.description: 让安度因检查萨缪尔森的档案

text.title: 酋长的舰队
text.objectives: 去找银松森林被遗忘者后卫军的飞斧上将。
text.description: 昨晚我们的援军从卡利姆多抵达。三艘满载着补给、武器和士兵的兽人炮艇。三艘兽人炮艇就这样败给了该死的血牙狼人。$B$B一整支兽人舰队怎么会输给了连攻城武器都没有的战斗小分队？这是一个重要的问题，你得帮我找到答案。$B$B收拾行装，去西南边的被遗忘者后卫军找兽人上将战斧。$B$B让那些兽人行动起来，$n。$B$B我等着你的全面报告。
text.completion: This fiasco may go down as one of the biggest embarrassments in the history of naval warfare. How did this happen? Drunk happened. That's how.

english.title: The Warchief's Fleet
english.objectives: Report to Admiral Hatchet at the Forsaken Rear Guard in Silverpine Forest.
english.description: Our reinforcements from Kalimdor arrived last night. Three orc gunships full of supplies, weapons and soldiers. Three orc gunships lost to Bloodfang's damned worgen.$B$BHow could an entire orc fleet lose to a small band of enemy combatants that lack any siege weaponry? An important question that you will answer for me.$B$BGather your gear and report to the orc admiral, Hatchet, at the Forsaken Rear Guard, southwest of here.$B$BGet those orcs operational, $n.$B$BI await your full report.
english.completion: This fiasco may go down as one of the biggest embarrassments in the history of naval warfare. How did this happen? Drunk happened. That's how.

text.title: Learning the Word
text.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Shadow Word: Pain. Practice using it 5 times on Training Dummies in Camp Narache.
text.description: As you become more skilled, your skills will expand, and you will gain access to many new powers. Go - get some experience out there, and come back to me when you've learned something new. You can demonstrate on the training dummies nearby.
text.completion: Thank you for your help in seeing to the wounded braves. I'm sure that you will often find your healing skills in demand. Return to me when you need further instruction.
text.completed: Return to Seer Ravenfeather at Camp Narache.

english.title: Learning the Word
english.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Shadow Word: Pain. Practice using it 5 times on Training Dummies in Camp Narache.
english.description: As you become more skilled, your skills will expand, and you will gain access to many new powers. Go - get some experience out there, and come back to me when you've learned something new. You can demonstrate on the training dummies nearby.
english.completion: Thank you for your help in seeing to the wounded braves. I'm sure that you will often find your healing skills in demand. Return to me when you need further instruction.
english.completed: Return to Seer Ravenfeather at Camp Narache.

objectiveDetails.description: Reach Level 3 to Learn Shadow Word: Pain

text.title: Moonfire
text.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Moonfire. Practice using it on a Training Dummy in Camp Narache.
text.description: As you develop your skills, druid, you will begin to feel your connection to the Earthmother deepening. You will begin to understand new secrets of nature, and learn to cast new spells. Go now, get more experience, and return to me when you've learned a new spell. Demonstrate what you've learned.
text.completion: You have a knack for the druidic arts, $n. Wherever you go, your skills as a healer will be in demand. Return to me when you are ready for more training.
text.completed: Return to Gart Mistrunner at Camp Narache.

english.title: Moonfire
english.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Moonfire. Practice using it on a Training Dummy in Camp Narache.
english.description: As you develop your skills, druid, you will begin to feel your connection to the Earthmother deepening. You will begin to understand new secrets of nature, and learn to cast new spells. Go now, get more experience, and return to me when you've learned a new spell. Demonstrate what you've learned.
english.completion: You have a knack for the druidic arts, $n. Wherever you go, your skills as a healer will be in demand. Return to me when you are ready for more training.
english.completed: Return to Gart Mistrunner at Camp Narache.

text.title: 乌克兹·沙顶
text.objectives: 杀死乌克兹·沙顶。
text.description: 好好看看，伙计。事情就是这样，一桩背叛接着一桩。我为了宝剑在你背后捅刀子，乌克兹酋长也为了它在背后对我下更黑的手。$B$B那就是生活，没错！或者说曾经是……$B$B现在，我知道你对玛佐加没有什么好感。不过我也知道你反正要去那儿。帮我杀掉他，伙计。让沙子里再多浸一点血，让乌克兹·沙顶获得每一个沙怒都应得的下场……血腥的死亡。$B$B如果你干成了的话，也许我可以在动身前留一些没被诅咒过的财物给你，如何？
text.completion: He's gone? Did he have the sword? Nah...don't tell me. Don't matter no more. Mazoga don't care. I'm off now, mon. De consequences of my actions await me. Take whatever I was holdin'... I don't need it where I'm goin'...
text.completed: Return to Mazoga's Spirit in Zul'Farrak.
text.giverWindow: 替我把他杀掉，伙计。

english.title: Chief Ukorz Sandscalp
english.objectives: Kill Chief Ukorz Sandscalp.
english.description: Take a good look, mon. Dis is how it goes, betrayal after betrayal. I backstab you for the sword, and den Chief Ukorz go and backstab me even better for it.$B$BThat's life, yah! Or was...$B$BNow, I know you don't got no love for Mazoga. But I know you goin' in der anyway. Kill him for me, mon. Spill more blood on the sand, an' give Chief Ukorz Sandscalp what every one of de Sandfury deserves...a gory death.$B$BMaybe I leave some of my belongin's without a curse before passin' on if you do, yah?
english.completion: He's gone? Did he have the sword? Nah...don't tell me. Don't matter no more. Mazoga don't care. I'm off now, mon. De consequences of my actions await me. Take whatever I was holdin'... I don't need it where I'm goin'...
english.completed: Return to Mazoga's Spirit in Zul'Farrak.
english.giverWindow: Kill him good for me, mon.

text.title: 钢雷
text.objectives: 收集5个水手的箱子。$B$B如果你跟兽人海军新兵失散了，可以跟飞斧上将谈谈，他会再指派一个给你。
text.description: 我们也许不用背着战败的耻辱渡过下半生了，$n。因为酋长多半会把我们统统处决。$B$B要是我们不战而溃，那我就太混账了。尽管整个滩头到处都是血牙狼人，但还是有希望的。我要你陪着我们的一名海军新兵到西边的滩头上去，拿回我们的补给。到他拿不下的时候，就回来找我。
text.completion: Within these crates are held STEEL THUNDER! With our weaponry returned we might have a chance to redeem ourselves.
text.completed: Return to Admiral Hatchet at the Forsaken Rear Guard in Silverpine Forest.

english.title: Steel Thunder
english.objectives: Recover 5 Sea Dog Crates.$B$BSpeak with Admiral Hatchet to get another Orc Sea Pup if you unexpectedly lose yours.
english.description: We may not have to live down the shame of this defeat, $n. The Warchief will likely have us all executed instead.$B$BI'll be damned if we don't go down without a fight. Although the whole beachhead is overrun by Bloodfang worgen, there may still be hope. I want you to accompany one of our sea pups to the Beachhead, directly west of here, and recover our supplies. Return to me when the pup can carry no more.
english.completion: Within these crates are held STEEL THUNDER! With our weaponry returned we might have a chance to redeem ourselves.
english.completed: Return to Admiral Hatchet at the Forsaken Rear Guard in Silverpine Forest.

text.title: 徒劳无益
text.objectives: 获得深渊皇冠和加兹瑞拉充电的鳞片。
text.description: 我听说这里有个巨魔，她的名字好像叫水占师维蕾萨，她拥有一件稀有、华丽而且力量强大的珠宝，名叫深渊皇冠。她用它控制了强大的半神加兹瑞拉，据说它的鳞片上都充满着能量。你知道这意味着什么吗，$r？$B$B我需要它！杀掉维蕾萨，夺走深渊皇冠，把加兹瑞拉也除掉，获得它的一片鳞片。把这些东西火速带回来给我！我会重重奖赏你的。
text.progress: Do you have what I need?
text.completion: Excellent! This Tiara will grant me complete control of the water around here, and the Electrified Scale will serve to power all the machines I need to use it all to my advantage! You're going to make me a very rich and powerful goblin! You can have this, it's nothing compared to what I'll have soon.
text.completed: Return to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle.

english.title: A Fool's Errand
english.objectives: Obtain the Tiara of the Deep and Gahzrilla's Electrified Scale.
english.description: I heard that a troll in here, Hydromancer Velratha I think she was called, has come into the possession of a very rare, beautiful, and powerful piece of jewelry called the Tiara of the Deep. She uses it to control the powerful demigod Gahz'rilla, whose very scales are said to crackle with energy. Do you know what all of that means, $r?$B$BI need it! Kill Velratha, take the Tiara of the Deep, and kill Gahz'rilla for one of his scales. Bring them all back to me pronto! I'll reward you handsomly.
english.progress: Do you have what I need?
english.completion: Excellent! This Tiara will grant me complete control of the water around here, and the Electrified Scale will serve to power all the machines I need to use it all to my advantage! You're going to make me a very rich and powerful goblin! You can have this, it's nothing compared to what I'll have soon.
english.completed: Return to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle.

starters.name: 首席工程师沙克斯·比格维兹

enders.name: 首席工程师沙克斯·比格维兹

text.title: 沙怒之怒
text.objectives: 杀死殉教者塞卡、巫医祖穆拉恩、安图苏尔，以及卢兹鲁。
text.description: 沙怒巨魔是一个能屈能伸的部族。他们从长年的沙尘暴，还有被沙子常年覆盖的其他东西中活了下来。要是以为这里唯一的部队就只有巨魔，那可就太愚蠢了。我们一直在驯化圣甲虫，喂养苏利萨斯，还把我们的死者复活成僵尸永世征战。$B$B乌克兹·沙顶的左右手卢兹鲁正计划为了沙怒帝国，用这些来收复塔纳利斯。想要活命的话，你最好杀掉负责指挥的巨魔，伙计。
text.completion: You killed dem? All of dem? And you return alive? Take what you want off my body, den. It's mostly curse-free, Mazoga promises.
text.completed: Return to Mazoga's Spirit.

english.title: Wrath of the Sandfury
english.objectives: Kill Theka the Martyr, Witch Doctor Zum'rah, Antu'sul, and Ruuzlu.
english.description: De Sandfury are a resilient tribe. Dey have survived sandstorms an' years an' years of other tings long covered by da sands. It would be foolish to assume that the only forces here are da trolls. We been tamin' da scarabs, breedin' da sul'lithuz, an' raisin' our dead to keep on fightin' for all eternity as zombies.$B$BRuuzlu, da right hand of Chief Ukorz Sandscalp, be plannin' to use dem to retake Tanaris for de Sandfury empire. You best be killin' da trolls in charge of dis if you want to live, mon.
english.completion: You killed dem? All of dem? And you return alive? Take what you want off my body, den. It's mostly curse-free, Mazoga promises.
english.completed: Return to Mazoga's Spirit.

text.title: 旧兵营
text.objectives: 前往旧兵营杀死6名发疯的异教徒，找到杰克·伯登。
text.description: 我记得这徽章是死亡之翼攻击城市之前的东西，属于旧兵营的士兵。那地方就在城西，俯瞰港口。$B$B你来的正是时候，我手下最棒的探员杰克·伯登正在暮光之锤教派中做卧底。昨晚他失去消息了。如果你和安度因是对的，那些邪教徒就窝藏在旧兵营里。时间不多了！攻击旧兵营，解决教徒，救出杰克·伯登。
text.completion: $c? What are you doing here? I'm SI:7 Agent Jack Bauden. This is the longest day of my life.
text.completed: Talk to Jack Bauden within the Old Barracks in Stormwind.

english.title: The Old Barracks
english.objectives: Go to the Old Barracks and slay 6 Crazed Cultists, then locate Jack Bauden.
english.description: I recognize the symbol on these badges from before Deathwing's attack on the city. It belonged to soldiers in the old barracks, west of town overlooking the harbor.$B$BYour timing couldn't be better. One of my top agents, Jack Bauden, has been trying to infiltrate the Twilight's Hammer cult for me. Last night he went missing. If you and Anduin are right, the cultists are holed up in the old barracks. Time is urgent! Assault the old barracks, take out those cultists, and rescue Jack Bauden.
english.completion: $c? What are you doing here? I'm SI:7 Agent Jack Bauden. This is the longest day of my life.
english.completed: Talk to Jack Bauden within the Old Barracks in Stormwind.

text.title: 让他们尝尝苦头
text.objectives: 杀掉10个血牙清除者。
text.description: 都是地精的错，$r！$B$B<嗝！>$B$B你瞧，我们从艾萨拉的锈水港出发，前往银松森林。那就是一个天大的错误！我们伟大的帝国里就没有一处像这样罪恶腐败的窝点。那些该死的地精把我们所有的不道德都煽动起来，让我们带着满是啤酒的酒桶出航。$B$B<嗝！>这份耻辱比任何伤痕留下的疤都要深。我们必须找回荣誉！杀掉伏击我们的血牙狼人。他们正在西南边打捞残骸。
text.completion: Looks as if you really gave those worgen a beating and, in the process, lifted the "shame haze" they cast over us. Perhaps the sea dogs will quit drinkin' now. Who am I kidding? Hah!
text.completed: Return to Warlord Torok at the Forsaken Rear Guard in Silverpine Forest.

english.title: Give 'em Hell!
english.objectives: Kill 10 Bloodfang Scavengers.
english.description: It's the goblins' fault, $r!$B$B<hic!>$B$BYou see, we set off for Silverpine from Bilgewater Harbor, over in Azshara. Huge mistake that was! Never has such a den of inequity and sin existed in our great empire. Those damnable goblins fueled our every vice and set us off to sail with barrels full of ale. $B$B<hic!>$B$BThe shame of it all leaves a mark greater than any scar. Honor must be restored! Kill the Bloodfang worgen that ambushed us. They're scavenging the wreckage to the southwest.
english.completion: Looks as if you really gave those worgen a beating and, in the process, lifted the "shame haze" they cast over us. Perhaps the sea dogs will quit drinkin' now. Who am I kidding? Hah!
english.completed: Return to Warlord Torok at the Forsaken Rear Guard in Silverpine Forest.

text.title: 对抗暮光之锤
text.objectives: 去跟洛克莫丹莫格罗什要塞附近的阿什兰·暗石谈一谈。
text.description: 你完成我本以为不可能的事情！我已经消沉够了。该当个顶天立地的侏儒了。$B$B我得去找我的父亲。但是你！不要把时间浪费在我的身上。你要继续对抗这些邪教徒。$B$B去跟东边的阿什兰·暗石谈谈。他正在试图阻止暮光之锤，但独力难支。你是他唯一的希望！$B$B不要放弃，$n。我也不会。
text.completion: You hit the twilight camp at the center of the lake? Not bad, lad! If you're ready to take the fight right to their doorstep, I've got your chance.

english.title: Fight the Hammer
english.objectives: Talk to Ashlan Stonesmirk near Mo'grosh Stronghold in Loch Modan.
english.description: You've done what I thought was impossible! I'm done moping around here. It's time to gnome up.$B$BI've got to find my father. But you! Don't bother yourself with me any longer. You've got to keep fighting these cultists.$B$BGo talk to Ashlan Stonesmirk to the east. He's trying to stop the Twilight's Hammer, but he has nobody to help him. You're his only hope!$B$BDon't give up, $n. I won't.
english.completion: You hit the twilight camp at the center of the lake? Not bad, lad! If you're ready to take the fight right to their doorstep, I've got your chance.

text.title: 古加尔的奴仆
text.objectives: 在莫格罗什要塞杀掉7只莫格罗什食人魔。
text.description: 暮光之锤起初是野蛮的部落氏族之一。他们的首领古加尔慢慢地将他的食人魔们变成一个死亡邪教，接纳任何愿意终结所有存在的疯子。正如你所见，他们中还有很多食人魔，神经错乱，狂热无比，而且和以前一样强壮。$B$B这些粗蛮的怪物居然胆敢来到这里，在我们的土地上散布他们的污秽。你把他们杀掉得越多，洛克莫丹就会变得越好，$n。
text.completion: It may look grim, but we'll win with your help, $n. They won't keep the dwarves down.
text.completed: Return to Ashlan Stonesmirk near the Mo'grosh Stronghold in Loch Modan.

english.title: Servants of Cho'gall
english.objectives: Kill 7 Mo'grosh ogres in the Mo'grosh Stronghold.
english.description: The Twilight's Hammer started as a clan of the savage Horde. Their leader, Cho'gall, slowly turned his band of ogres into a death cult, welcoming anyone insane enough to wish for the end of all existence. As you can see, there's still plenty of ogres among their ranks; deranged, fanatical, and just as strong as before.$B$BThese crude monsters have the gall to come here and spread their filth across our land. The more you kill, the better off Loch Modan will be, $n.
english.completion: It may look grim, but we'll win with your help, $n. They won't keep the dwarves down.
english.completed: Return to Ashlan Stonesmirk near the Mo'grosh Stronghold in Loch Modan.

text.title: 破门而入
text.objectives: 解救维格利，杀掉耐克鲁姆和暗影祭司塞瑟斯。
text.description: 我的一个好弟兄维格利，和布莱中士和他哨站的人马一起攻打祖尔法拉克，要将传说中的苏萨斯弄到手。自然，他们小瞧了沙怒巨魔，如今都被抓住，等着遭受处决，以取悦他们的半神加兹瑞拉！$B$B要是你能把他救出来，他可以帮你炸出一条通往乌克兹私人大厅的路，宝剑的最后一部分就被放在那里。$B$B抓他的人是耐克鲁姆和暗影祭司塞瑟斯，把他们杀掉一雪前耻……我会付你报酬的。
text.completion: Wow! I knew I could count on you! Here's something for your troubles.
text.completed: Return to Tran'rek.

english.title: Breaking and Entering
english.objectives: Free Weegli Blastfuse and kill Nekrum Gutchewer and Shadowpriest Sezz'ziz.
english.description: A good buddy of mine, Weegli Blastfuse, joined up with Sergeant Bly and his group of outcasts to invade Zul'farrak and claim the legendary Sul'thraze as their prize. Of course, they underestimated the Sandfury tribe and now they're all trapped awaiting execution to please their demigod, Gahz'rilla!$B$BIf you free him, he'll help you blast your way to Ukorz's private chamber where he keeps at least part of the blade.$B$BKill his captors, Nekrum Gutchewer and Shadowpriest Sezz'ziz as revenge...I'll repay ya.
english.completion: Wow! I knew I could count on you! Here's something for your troubles.
english.completed: Return to Tran'rek.

text.title: 攫住混沌
text.objectives: 从莫格罗什要塞的地上拔起10根初生源质之刺。
text.description: 暮光之锤的邪教徒用他们的力量从大地深处采取源质锭。他们把它制成邪恶的尖刺，用来搭建他们的建筑，好深深植根在被污染的大地里。$B$B这里的食人魔好像正在进行这方面的作业，我们要在他们将其扭曲成形的时候出击。$B$B趁它们还柔韧，把尖刺从地上拔出来，带回来给我！我们一寸土地都不能让这些无赖夺走。
text.progress: Did you tear up the spikes?
text.completion: Shame that these half-formed things are too brittle and warped to be used for some weapons of our own. But it's thanks to you that we had the chance to get them out before they set. I'm not about to complain.
text.completed: Return to Ashlan Stonesmirk near Mo'grosh Stronghold in Loch Modan.

english.title: Clutching at Chaos
english.objectives: Pull up 10 Nascent Elementium Spikes from the ground of the Mo'grosh Stronghold.
english.description: The cultists of the Twilight's Hammer use their powers to draw elementium metal from deep beneath the earth. They coax it out into twisted spikes to form their buildings, rooted right into the defiled ground.$B$BThe ogres here seem to be in the middle of weaving the stuff, and we need to strike while they're still twisting it into shape.$B$BTear the spikes right out of the ground while they're still pliable, and bring them back to me! We're not going to give these curs a single inch of our land.
english.progress: Did you tear up the spikes?
english.completion: Shame that these half-formed things are too brittle and warped to be used for some weapons of our own. But it's thanks to you that we had the chance to get them out before they set. I'm not about to complain.
english.completed: Return to Ashlan Stonesmirk near Mo'grosh Stronghold in Loch Modan.

text.title: 戈克雷什
text.objectives: 击败戈克雷什。
text.description: 留下来看管这些粗野蠢货的，是个叫做戈克雷什的食人魔。他在这些蛮兵中，也算是身高马大、狡诈多端的了。绝不要以为食人魔就一定愚蠢，他们就是靠这个才让你轻敌。$B$B如果你把他干掉，我们就能让暮光之锤知道，洛克莫丹不是他们的踏板。奋勇杀掉戈克雷什，把这些蠢货赶回高地去！
text.completion: You've done it! We may not have stopped the cult dead, but we've shown them we're not easy pickings and given them a welt to prove it. Take this with my gratitude, and try not to blush if anyone in Thelsamar calls you "hero"!
text.completed: Return to Ashlan Stonesmirk near Mo'grosh Stronghold in Loch Modan.
text.giverWindow: 暮光之锤在我们的湖畔没有立锥之地。

english.title: Gor'kresh
english.objectives: Defeat Gor'kresh.
english.description: The ogre left to watch over these crude fools goes by the name of Gor'kresh. He's big enough to boss even these brutes around, and cunning to boot. Never assume an ogre's stupid, that's when they'll get you.$B$BIf you take him out, we'll show the Twilight's Hammer that Loch Modan isn't a stepping stone for them. Stand strong against Gor'kresh and drive these fools back into the highlands!
english.completion: You've done it! We may not have stopped the cult dead, but we've shown them we're not easy pickings and given them a welt to prove it. Take this with my gratitude, and try not to blush if anyone in Thelsamar calls you "hero"!
english.completed: Return to Ashlan Stonesmirk near Mo'grosh Stronghold in Loch Modan.
english.giverWindow: The Twilight's Hammer has no place here in our Loch.

text.title: [DEPRECATED]Trusting the Traitor
text.objectives: Speak with Mazoga.
text.description: These two are useless. Can I at least count on you to get some work done around here, young adventurer? We've come into contact with Mazoga, a traitor to the Sandfury. He says he can help us find the legendary blade Sul'thraze so we can use it to kick out the Sandfury forever!$B$BWe'll probably sell it afterward to the highest bidder, honestly. This place doesn't pay for itself. Go do what he wants...just keep an eye on him. A traitor's a traitor all the same. He's at our camp just east of Zul'Farrak.

english.title: [DEPRECATED]Trusting the Traitor
english.objectives: Speak with Mazoga.
english.description: These two are useless. Can I at least count on you to get some work done around here, young adventurer? We've come into contact with Mazoga, a traitor to the Sandfury. He says he can help us find the legendary blade Sul'thraze so we can use it to kick out the Sandfury forever!$B$BWe'll probably sell it afterward to the highest bidder, honestly. This place doesn't pay for itself. Go do what he wants...just keep an eye on him. A traitor's a traitor all the same. He's at our camp just east of Zul'Farrak.

text.title: 肮脏的游戏
text.objectives: 从疯狂的巨熊和疯狂的座狼身上获取8份染病的脏器。
text.description: 你有没有看见过游荡在森林里巨大而笨重的双头魔？那些被诅咒的生物来自吉尔尼斯。如今他们漫游在这片土地上，寻找着下一顿可口的美餐。我们成功降服了一些，让他们为我们拉车，但其他的……好吧，他们必须被杀掉！$B$B不幸的是，我们手头没有多余的士兵来做这件事。这时候你就得派上用场了，$c！$B$B我有一个计划，但是需要一些材料。到营地附近的森林里去，收集一些染病的野兽器官来。
text.progress: We are Forsaken! This is how we do it, $c.
text.completion: Excellent! Now to prepare the "meal."
text.completed: Return to Apothecary Wormcrud at the Forsaken Rear Guard in Silverpine Forest.

english.title: Playing Dirty
english.objectives: Collect 8 Diseased Organs from Giant Rabid Bears and Rabid Worgs.
english.description: Have you seen the huge lumbering ettins roaming the forests? Cursed things came from Gilneas. Now they wander the land searching for their next juicy meal. We've managed to subjugate and utilize some of them to haul our wagons, but the others... well, they must be killed!$B$BUnfortunately, we can't spare any soldiers to do the job. That's where you come in, $c!$B$BI have a plan, but it's going to require some materials. Head out into the forests around this base and collect diseased beast organs.
english.progress: We are Forsaken! This is how we do it, $c.
english.completion: Excellent! Now to prepare the "meal."
english.completed: Return to Apothecary Wormcrud at the Forsaken Rear Guard in Silverpine Forest.

text.title: 战斗又打响了！
text.objectives: 向西瘟疫之地安多哈尔城的库尔迪拉·织亡者报告。
text.description: 安多哈尔来消息了，$n。战斗又打响了。$b$b貌似在被遗忘者中你这初阵大捷的英雄已经妇孺皆知了。库尔迪拉要你马上前去。
text.completion: Thassarian and the humans made their move.  I thought I had an agreement with Thassarian... but I suppose this will do.
text.completed: 向西瘟疫之地安多哈尔城的库尔迪拉·织亡者报告。

english.title: The Battle Resumes!
english.objectives: Report to Koltira Deathweaver at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.
english.description: Word is in from Andorhal, $n.  The battle has resumed.$b$bIt has become somewhat well-known among the Forsaken that you are a hero of the first battle of Andorhal.  Koltira has requested your presence immediately.
english.completion: Thassarian and the humans made their move.  I thought I had an agreement with Thassarian... but I suppose this will do.
english.completed: Report to Koltira Deathweaver at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.

text.title: 农夫义勇军
text.objectives: 对安多哈尔城中6名义勇民兵使用黑锋石像鬼颈圈。
text.description: 战斗是这么开始的，他们趁我不备，攻我后防空虚。一队武装低劣的农夫和民兵从嚎哭鬼屋插进了我们的侧翼。$b$b他们或许装备并不精良，可放任不管的话，我们也要寡不敌众。$b$b林塞的宠物憎恶可以处理肉搏战。你带上这个项圈，呆在后面，用它把黑锋石像鬼释放到那些农夫的头上去。
text.completion: Merely a dent in their numbers... but the sight of their fellow men falling from the skies surely weakened their resolve.
text.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.

english.title: The Farmers' Militia
english.objectives: Use the Ebon Gargoyle Collar on 6 Provincial Militiamen within Andorhal.
english.description: The battle started when they attacked us from the rear.  I let my guard down, and a group of poorly-armed farmers and militiamen swung into our flank from the Writhing Haunt.$b$bThey may be weak, but unchecked, they threaten to overwhelm us with their numbers.$b$bLindsay's pet abominations can handle the melee combat.  You take this collar, stay in the rear, and use it to release my ebon gargoyle upon these farmers.
english.completion: Merely a dent in their numbers... but the sight of their fellow men falling from the skies surely weakened their resolve.
english.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.

text.title: 支援部队
text.objectives: 消灭15名安多哈尔防御者。
text.description: 这些农民的确来势汹汹，但我们也不能忘了联盟的主力部队。$b$b到安多哈尔西侧消灭同我们的亡灵卫兵作战的人类士兵。我们用得上每一个人手。
text.completion: You fight well, $n.  I wish I had your ability... and your bravery.
text.completed: Return to Jearl Donald at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.

english.title: Supporting the Troops
english.objectives: Slay 15 Andorhal Defenders.
english.description: While it is true that these farmers threaten to overrun us, we still cannot forget about the Alliance's main forces.$b$bTravel west into Andorhal and slay the human soldiers that are fighting with our deathguards.  We need all the help we can get.
english.completion: You fight well, $n.  I wish I had your ability... and your bravery.
english.completed: Return to Jearl Donald at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.

text.title: 尘归尘
text.objectives: 杀死3名安多哈尔战地指挥官。
text.description: 在西边，联盟扼守的安多哈尔城中，你能找到他们的指挥官。这些人不参加战斗，而是在马背上发号施令。$b$b把他们找出来杀掉，$n。人类胜算渺茫。
text.completion: Well done.  With them out of the way, I have no more excuses. Soon, I must battle Thassarian, for honor and for Andorhal.
text.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.

english.title: Ashes to Ashes
english.objectives: Slay 3 Andorhal Force-Commanders.
english.description: To the west, deep within Alliance-held Andorhal, you will find their commanders.  They do not fight, but call out orders from horseback.$b$bHunt down and slay these commanders, $n.  The humans won't stand a chance.
english.completion: Well done.  With them out of the way, I have no more excuses. Soon, I must battle Thassarian, for honor and for Andorhal.
english.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.

text.title: 琳塞·鸦日，现身
text.objectives: 去西瘟疫之地的安多哈尔找琳塞·鸦日。
text.description: 我被告知那个没用的女人琳塞·鸦日，会在这次战斗中支援我。可目前为止她除了窝在我身后的大厅地下室里就什么也没干。这反而好，我想。她精神有点不正常的。$b$b但是，我不能姑息这种忤逆之举。把她找到，带来见我。
text.completion: You won't be taking me anywhere, $n. While Koltira prances about with his playmate, Thassarian, I plan to win this battle.  Then I'll make Koltira suffer for his weakness. Don't believe me?  Fine, I'll let you in on a little secret...
text.completed: 去西瘟疫之地的安多哈尔找琳塞·鸦日。

english.title: Lindsay Ravensun, Revealed
english.objectives: Report to Lindsay Ravensun at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.
english.description: I was informed that that worthless woman, Lindsay Ravensun, would be here to support me in this battle, but so far, she's done nothing but brood within the basement of the greathall behind me.  All the better, I suppose.  She was a bit of a distraction.$b$bStill, I cannot and will not stand for insubordination.  Find her, and bring her to me.
english.completion: You won't be taking me anywhere, $n. While Koltira prances about with his playmate, Thassarian, I plan to win this battle.  Then I'll make Koltira suffer for his weakness. Don't believe me?  Fine, I'll let you in on a little secret...
english.completed: Report to Lindsay Ravensun at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.

text.title: 你摄取的不过是毒素
text.objectives: 用变异的灌木小鸡杀掉森林双头魔。
text.description: 拿上这只笼子，$c。里面装了一只我创造的变异灌木小鸡，不过动了一些小小的手脚。这只灌木小鸡的屁股里插着一管炸药，里面加了点粘液，是从你带给我的染病的脏器里弄出来的。$B$B带上笼子，到周围的森林里去，找到四处徘徊的森林双头魔。把鸡放出来，然后就坐下观赏我的杰作吧。随后的爆炸将足以杀死双头魔，或大幅将其削弱，让你好把它结果掉。
text.completion: Was there ever any doubt? An ettin is no match for science!
text.completed: Return to Apothecary Wormcrud at the Forsaken Rear Guard in Silverpine Forest.

english.title: It's Only Poisonous if You Ingest It
english.objectives: Use the Mutant Bush Chicken to kill the Forest Ettin.
english.description: Take this cage, $c. I've placed inside it one of my own mutant bush chickens, with a few slight modifications. Within the butt of this bush chicken is a stick of dynamite laced with gunk from the diseased organs you brought me.$B$BTake the cage out into the surrounding forest and locate the wandering forest ettin. Release the chicken and sit back as my masterwork does its job. The ensuing explosion should be sufficient to kill the ettin or greatly weaken it, allowing you to finish it off.
english.completion: Was there ever any doubt? An ettin is no match for science!
english.completed: Return to Apothecary Wormcrud at the Forsaken Rear Guard in Silverpine Forest.

text.title: 王牌降临
text.objectives: 在归降的瓦格里的陪同下杀死5名惊恐的义勇民兵，将他们转化为被遗忘者步兵。然后去安多哈尔西边找萨萨里安。
text.description: 你不知道我看着库尔迪拉让战事从手中溜走，还得忍气吞声这到底有多难。直到现在，那些可恨的农夫还打算以众博寡。都是因为他拒绝大义灭亲。$b$b再把我的瓦格里带上，$n。有她陪同，杀掉那些农民，把它们转化成被遗忘者，然后赋予他们行动力。带着他们前往联盟占据的安多哈尔西侧，追杀这个死亡骑士萨萨里安。$b$b我们还是会赢得这场战争的。
text.completion: This is the body of Lurid, Thassarian's trusted knight.  With Thassarian nowhere to be found, it would seem that the Alliance forces have withdrawn. The Forsaken have won the battle for Andorhal.
text.completed: Investigate Lurid's body within Andorhal in Western Plaguelands..

english.title: Ace in the Hole
english.objectives: With the Enthralled Val'kyr by your side, kill 5 Frightened Provincial Minutemen, then use your Call to Arms ability to turn them into Forsaken Troopers.  Then find Thassarian in western Andorhal.
english.description: You have no idea how difficult it was to stay disguised while I watched Koltira let this war slip away from us.  Even now, those infernal farmers threaten to overwhelm us.  All because he refused to slay a friend.$b$bTake my val'kyr again, $n.  With her by your side, kill these farmers, convert them to Forsaken, and mobilize them.  Then take a group of them into Alliance-held western Andorhal and hunt down this death knight, Thassarian.$b$bWe will win this war yet.
english.completion: This is the body of Lurid, Thassarian's trusted knight.  With Thassarian nowhere to be found, it would seem that the Alliance forces have withdrawn. The Forsaken have won the battle for Andorhal.
english.completed: Investigate Lurid's body within Andorhal in Western Plaguelands..

objectiveDetails.description: 杀死并转化惊恐的义勇民兵
赋予被遗忘者步兵行动力

text.title: 安多哈尔，彻底了结
text.objectives: 向西瘟疫之地安多哈尔城的希尔瓦娜斯·风行者复命。
text.description: 得把萨萨里安撤离安多哈尔的消息报告希尔瓦娜斯。你决定回到被遗忘者驻地。
text.completion: See?  All it took was a little help from the val'kyr.  These creatures are turning to be much more helpful than I had first thought. Now, on to other matters.
text.completed: 向西瘟疫之地安多哈尔城的希尔瓦娜斯·风行者复命。

english.title: Andorhal, Once and For All
english.objectives: Report to Lady Sylvanas Windrunner at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.
english.description: Sylvanas will want to know about Thassarian's departure from Andorhal.  You resolve to return to the Forsaken-held side of town.
english.completion: See?  All it took was a little help from the val'kyr.  These creatures are turning to be much more helpful than I had first thought. Now, on to other matters.
english.completed: Report to Lady Sylvanas Windrunner at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.

text.title: 冲啊！
text.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Charge. Locate a Training Dummy outside the Sunspire and practice using Charge.
text.description: Good. You are off to a bright start. This road will be long, and as you become more accomplished, you will begin to discover that you can do things you could never have imagined before.$b$bGo, get more experience, and learn a new technique. Once you have, demonstrate it on one of the training dummies.
text.completion: I think you've mastered the basics of the charge, $n. Don't forget to return when you need more training.
text.completed: Return to Delios in the Sunspire on Sunstrider Isle.

english.title: Charge!
english.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Charge. Locate a Training Dummy outside the Sunspire and practice using Charge.
english.description: Good. You are off to a bright start. This road will be long, and as you become more accomplished, you will begin to discover that you can do things you could never have imagined before.$b$bGo, get more experience, and learn a new technique. Once you have, demonstrate it on one of the training dummies.
english.completion: I think you've mastered the basics of the charge, $n. Don't forget to return when you need more training.
english.completed: Return to Delios in the Sunspire on Sunstrider Isle.

text.title: 陵墓惊变
text.objectives: 进入光明大教堂地下陵墓。杀掉黑主教，熄灭附近的炸药堆。
text.description: 别担心我，$c。我发现了暮光之锤的阴谋。他们一直在偷窃并通过暴风城港口运输囤积炸药。不知是怎么回事，他们打通了光明大教堂下面的墓道。我听人提到什么“黑主教”。$B$B通知警卫已经来不及了，$n！你必须赶快赶到墓室去，拆除炸弹，快！赶紧去！否则成千上万的人都难逃一死！
text.completion: <3 ... 2 ... 1 ...> Underneath the powder kegs you find a heap of notes and papers. Apparently the cultists were trying to destroy the evidence behind them.>
text.completed: Get to the explosives in the catacombs beneath the Cathedral of Light!
text.giverWindow: 我认出了一个异教的首领。小心，他的行踪很诡秘。

english.title: Cataclysm in the Catacombs
english.objectives: Enter the Cathedral of Light and descend into the catacombs below. Slay the Black Bishop and disarm the Pile of Explosives nearby.
english.description: Don't worry about me, $c. I've uncovered the Twilight's Hammer plot. They've been stealing and stockpiling explosives coming into Stormwind harbor. Somehow, they've gotten access to the catacombs underneath the Cathedral of Light. I've heard talk of someone called "The Black Bishop."$B$BThere's no time to warn the guard, $n! You've got just minutes to get into the catacombs and disarm that bomb. Go! Now! Or THOUSANDS of PEOPLE will DIE!
english.completion: <3 ... 2 ... 1 ...> Underneath the powder kegs you find a heap of notes and papers. Apparently the cultists were trying to destroy the evidence behind them.>
english.completed: Get to the explosives in the catacombs beneath the Cathedral of Light!
english.giverWindow: I've identified one of the cult ringleaders. Careful; he moves in mysterious ways.

text.title: 迷失在黑暗中
text.objectives: 从粘丝洞里救出6名兽人水兵。
text.description: 有人会说我们活着算是走运的。那些人都是白痴。至少死了的话，我们就不用面对酋长的愤怒。哎，木已成舟了！现在我们必须想办法重获失去的荣誉。$B$B舰队里的第三条船沉在了西北方的粘丝洞海滩外。游上岸的人很快发现自己被这一地区的巨型蜘蛛所包围，并被蛛网包裹了起来。$B$B如果还有幸存者，那我们就一定要把他们救出来！去吧，$n！到粘丝洞里去！
text.completion: Lok'tar, $n! Once the ale wears off my orcs will be ready!
text.completed: Return to Admiral Hatchet at the Forsaken Rear Guard in Silverpine Forest.

english.title: Lost in the Darkness
english.objectives: Rescue 6 Orc Sea Dogs from the Skittering Dark.
english.description: Some would say that we are lucky to be alive. Those people would be idiots. At least had we died we would not have had to face the Warchief's wrath. Alas, what's done is done! Now we must attempt to regain our lost honor.$B$BThe third ship in our fleet sank off the coast of the Skittering Dark, northwest of here. Those that made it to shore quickly found themselves swarmed by the giant spiders of the area and encased in webbing.$B$BIf there are survivors we must free them! Go, $n! To the Skittering Dark!
english.completion: Lok'tar, $n! Once the ale wears off my orcs will be ready!
english.completed: Return to Admiral Hatchet at the Forsaken Rear Guard in Silverpine Forest.

text.title: 黑暗的更深处
text.objectives: 杀死掠网蛛后。
text.description: 掠网蛛后就在附近！杀了她，你就能终止这些粘丝的威胁！到粘丝洞的深处去找到蜘蛛之母，把她消灭掉！
text.completion: You rescued our orcs and killed the Skitterweb matriarch? We owe you a great debt of gratitude. You've saved us all from certain execution, $n. I'm sure we can rouse these drunken idiots now.
text.completed: Return to Warlord Torok at the Forsaken Rear Guard in Silverpine Forest.
text.giverWindow: 十分致命！

english.title: Deeper into Darkness
english.objectives: Kill the Skitterweb Matriarch.
english.description: The Skitterweb matriarch is nearby! You can put an end to the Skitterweb menace by killing her!$B$BFind the brood mother at the end of the cave in the Skittering Dark and destroy her!
english.completion: You rescued our orcs and killed the Skitterweb matriarch? We owe you a great debt of gratitude. You've saved us all from certain execution, $n. I'm sure we can rouse these drunken idiots now.
english.completed: Return to Warlord Torok at the Forsaken Rear Guard in Silverpine Forest.
english.giverWindow: Deadly!

text.title: 粘丝的威胁
text.objectives: 杀死12只掠网蜘蛛。
text.description: 一定要复仇，$n！我们第三艘船沉在了西北方的粘丝洞海滩外。逃出来的人不是被该地区的掠网蜘蛛抓住，就是被它们杀掉了。为此，这些蜘蛛必须得死！它们全部都得死！$B$B到粘丝洞去碾碎那些虫子！$B$B要留心它们的蛛后。或许只要找到了她，我们就能永远地结束这个威胁。
text.completion: The root of this evil must be found and destroyed! The Skitterweb matriarch must be nearby. No doubt hiding in the nearby cave!
text.completed: Return to Warlord Torok at the Forsaken Rear Guard in Silverpine Forest.

english.title: Skitterweb Menace
english.objectives: Kill 12 Skitterweb Spiders.
english.description: Vengeance is all consuming, $n! Our third ship sank off the coast of the Skittering Dark, northwest of here. The men that made it off that boat were either captured or killed by the Skitterweb spiders of the region. For that, the spiders must die! ALL OF THEM!$B$BTravel to the Skittering Dark and crush those insects!$B$BBe on the lookout for their matriarch. Perhaps if we find her we can end this menace forever!
english.completion: The root of this evil must be found and destroyed! The Skitterweb matriarch must be nearby. No doubt hiding in the nearby cave!
english.completed: Return to Warlord Torok at the Forsaken Rear Guard in Silverpine Forest.

text.title: 兽人准备就绪
text.objectives: 把将军的推荐信交给银松森林被遗忘者统帅部的希尔瓦娜斯·风行者。
text.description: <飞斧上将递给你一封印有部落标记的信。>$B$B这是你的推荐信。在这种情况下，我能为你做的也只有这些了。$B$B带着信去找希尔瓦娜斯·风行者，把我们的状况告诉她。让她知道我们做好了进军的准备，随时听她号令。$B$B再见了，$n。你是一位出色的战士。$B$B向东北方去吧，$g小伙子:女士;。到被遗忘者统帅部去！
text.progress: And the orcs?
text.completion: So the orcs are in order? Recovered their supplies? Killed a dozen worgen? Toppled an ettin? Freed their soldiers and destroyed the Skitterweb matriarch? I say this rarely, $n, but I am impressed. Perhaps your ability matches your aspirations. We shall see, for now you will be tested!

english.title: Orcs are in Order
english.objectives: Deliver the Admiral's Commendation Letter to Lady Sylvanas Windrunner at Forsaken High Command in Silverpine Forest.
english.description: <Admiral Hatchet hands you an envelope sealed with the mark of the Horde.>$B$BThis is your commendation letter. It's the least I could do for you given the circumstances.$B$BReturn to Lady Sylvanas Windrunner with the letter and inform her of our status. Let her know that we will be ready to march on her command.$B$BGoodbye, $n. You are an excellent soldier.$B$BNortheast, $g lad:ma'am;. To Forsaken High Command!
english.progress: And the orcs?
english.completion: So the orcs are in order? Recovered their supplies? Killed a dozen worgen? Toppled an ettin? Freed their soldiers and destroyed the Skitterweb matriarch? I say this rarely, $n, but I am impressed. Perhaps your ability matches your aspirations. We shall see, for now you will be tested!

text.title: 崛起吧，被遗忘者
text.objectives: 在芬里斯岛击败15名人类，并使他们效忠黑暗女王。
text.description: 芬里斯岛挑衅般地坐落在洛丹米尔湖中央——那是一段久远而痛苦的记忆。$B$B尽管它不再被豺狼人所滋害，一个新的威胁却浮现了出来。人类难民从希尔斯布莱德的家园中被赶了出来，逃到了芬里斯岛，希望能够逃脱败在我们手上的命运。对他们而言真是致命的错误。$B$B你要带上阿加莎，到芬里斯岛去击败那些人类。阿加莎能能赋予那些倒下的人以新生，将他们变成新的被遗忘者，从而壮大我们的部队。$B$B不要让我失望，$n。
text.completion: I see everything, $n. Through Agatha all is known to me.
text.completed: Speak with Lady Sylvanas Windrunner at Forsaken High Command in Silverpine Forest.
text.turninWindow: 成为被遗忘者之后他们能更好地服务。

english.title: Rise, Forsaken
english.objectives: Raise 15 Forsaken by killing humans on Fenris Isle.
english.description: Fenris Isle stands defiantly at the heart of Lordamere Lake - a cruel memory of a time long since passed.$B$BThough no longer infested by gnoll vermin, a new threat has emerged.  Human refugees, driven from their holdings in Hillsbrad, have fled to Fenris Isle in hopes of escaping defeat at our hands. A critical error on their part.$B$BYou are to take Agatha with you to Fenris Isle and slaughter all humans. She will raise the fallen as Forsaken, bolstering our forces in the process.$B$BDo not fail me, $n.
english.completion: I see everything, $n. Through Agatha all is known to me.
english.completed: Speak with Lady Sylvanas Windrunner at Forsaken High Command in Silverpine Forest.
english.turninWindow: The humans will fare better in the afterlife as Forsaken.

text.title: 洛丹伦
text.objectives: 陪伴希尔瓦娜斯·风行者前往银松森林的瑟伯切尔。
text.description: 与我一同前往瑟伯切尔，$n。我还有很多事要同你讨论。让你了解洛丹伦的历史和被遗忘者的困境将至关重要。
text.completion: Do you now understand the importance of our mission here? Crowley and his Alliance dogs must be stopped!

english.title: Lordaeron
english.objectives: Accompany Lady Sylvanas Windrunner to the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.
english.description: Ride with me to the Sepulcher, $n. There are many things I wish to discuss with you. It is imperative that you understand the history of Lordaeron and the plight of the Forsaken.
english.completion: Do you now understand the importance of our mission here? Crowley and his Alliance dogs must be stopped!

objectiveDetails.description: 陪伴希尔瓦娜斯·风行者前往瑟伯切尔

text.title: 无处可逃
text.objectives: 在芬里斯岛找到难民领袖。
text.description: 你必须打击他们的领导力量，$n。他们就坚守在旧城堡里。杀进去，找到那些顽固分子！为了你的女王，把他们变过来！$B$B没人能够逃脱得了被遗忘者强大的掌控！
text.completion: It would seem that Crowley is more formidable than I anticipated. Still, he is a man - flesh and bone - full of secrets. Secrets that I know all about... You have served me well, $n. I could use someone of your ability at the Sepulcher. I have a plan to deal with Crowley and his insurgents once and for all. Will you help?
text.completed: Report to Lady Sylvanas Windrunner at Forsaken High Command in Silverpine Forest.
text.giverWindow: 在二楼找到指挥室。

english.title: No Escape
english.objectives: Find the Refugee Leadership inside Fenris Keep.
english.description: You must strike at their leaders, $n. You will find them holed up in the old keep. Battle your way inside and find the holdouts! Turn them for your queen!$B$BNone shall escape the mighty grasp of the Forsaken!
english.completion: It would seem that Crowley is more formidable than I anticipated. Still, he is a man - flesh and bone - full of secrets. Secrets that I know all about... You have served me well, $n. I could use someone of your ability at the Sepulcher. I have a plan to deal with Crowley and his insurgents once and for all. Will you help?
english.completed: Report to Lady Sylvanas Windrunner at Forsaken High Command in Silverpine Forest.
english.giverWindow: Find the command room on the second floor.

text.title: 暮光调查
text.objectives: 从上层银沼的水银软泥怪身上获得4份暮光调查笔记。
text.description: 你找到的这本书上详细描述了由一个暮光之锤成员所进行的、某种形式的研究。$B$B它在某些方面涉及到了软泥怪，不过有好几页不见了。$B$B如果你能找到其它几页，也许就能弄明白是怎么回事。
text.progress: <You scroll through the notes, trying to put them in order.>
text.completion: The notes deal with High Cultist Maziel's research on the elemental properties of quicksilver. His obsession with the subject borders on the insane.

english.title: Twilight Research
english.objectives: Obtain 4 Twilight Research Notes from Mercurial Oozes in the Upper Silvermarsh.
english.description: The book you found appears to detail some form of research carried out by a member of the Twilight's Hammer.$B$BIt deals with the oozes in some way, but there are multiple pages missing.$B$BPerhaps if you found additional notes you might be able to make sense of it.
english.progress: <You scroll through the notes, trying to put them in order.>
english.completion: The notes deal with High Cultist Maziel's research on the elemental properties of quicksilver. His obsession with the subject borders on the insane.

text.title: 玛兹尔的发现
text.objectives: 在深岩之洲下层银沼找到玛兹尔的日志。
text.description: 笔记继续描述了玛兹尔对水银特性及水银软泥怪毫无章法的研究。$B$B他似乎有一个重大的发现。他提到自己把日志藏在了西南边的下层银沼那里。
text.completion: Maziel's journal appears to be undamaged by the mercury.

english.title: Maziel's Revelation
english.objectives: Find Maziel's Journal at the Lower Silvermarsh in Deepholm.
english.description: The notes continue Maziel's rambling research into the properties of quicksilver and mercurial oozes.$B$BHe appears to have made a major discovery.  He mentions hiding his journal in the Lower Silvermarsh to the southwest.
english.completion: Maziel's journal appears to be undamaged by the mercury.

text.title: 玛兹尔的支配
text.objectives: 击败深岩之洲银光洞穴里的玛兹尔。
text.description: 玛兹尔的日志记载了一种可以将他的身体变化成纯水银的支配仪式。$B$B该仪式会在下层银沼附近的洞穴里举行，在那里，玛兹尔需要摄取水银软泥怪，直到获得全部力量为止。$B$B想要阻止他的疯狂行径，也许还为时不晚。
text.completion: You've disposed of an enemy before he could grow more powerful.  By eliminating Maziel you've also ensured that his powers will not be used against the Earthen Ring.
text.giverWindow: 终结他的疯狂。

english.title: Maziel's Ascendancy
english.objectives: Slay Maziel inside the Silverlight Cave in Deepholm.
english.description: Maziel's journal chronicles a ritual of ascendancy that would transfigure his body to one of pure quicksilver.$B$BThe ritual would take place in the cave near the Lower Silvermarsh, where Maziel would feed upon the mercurial oozes until achieving full strength.$B$BPerhaps it is not too late to put an end to his madness.
english.completion: You've disposed of an enemy before he could grow more powerful.  By eliminating Maziel you've also ensured that his powers will not be used against the Earthen Ring.
english.giverWindow: End his madness.

text.title: 魔藤碎片
text.objectives: 使用净化之匣封印一块魔藤碎片。
text.description: 在埃雷萨拉斯的这一区域中，那个名叫荒野变形者奥兹恩的萨特正在散播着自己的堕落力量。奥兹恩身边应该有一些丰饶之果，它们已经被堕落的力量腐蚀，变成了魔藤。它也许是净化这座古老城市的关键。$B$B在你干掉这个萨特之后，采集一块魔藤的精华，把它装在净化之匣里，然后带回来交给我。$B$B祝你好运，塞纳留斯保佑你。
text.progress: With the Sealed Reliquary of Purity in our possession, it will be possible not only to remove a corrupting threat from the world but also to study it under our judicious watch.  Perhaps we can even devise new means to combat the taint of corruption that ever threatens Azeroth.
text.completion: You have done well, $c, and for that I am forever in your debt.  Though the war is far from over, a great battle has been won against those who would bring about our doom. Please - accept this gold as a token of my enduring gratitude.  If we ever cleanse Dire Maul, know that you will be welcomed here as a hero. Thank you.
text.completed: Return to Furgus Warpwood.

english.title: Shards of the Felvine
english.objectives: Use the Reliquary of Purity to capture a Felvine Shard.
english.description: The satyr Alzzin the Wildshaper has exerted his corrupt dominion over this part of Eldre'Thalas.  The Fruit of Fertility, now corrupted as the Felvine, should be close to Alzzin. It may be the key to purify this ancient place.$B$BWhen the great satyr falls, capture whatever essence of the Felvine you can.  Seal it in this Reliquary of Purity, and bring it to me.$B$BGood luck, and Cenarius' speed.
english.progress: With the Sealed Reliquary of Purity in our possession, it will be possible not only to remove a corrupting threat from the world but also to study it under our judicious watch.  Perhaps we can even devise new means to combat the taint of corruption that ever threatens Azeroth.
english.completion: You have done well, $c, and for that I am forever in your debt.  Though the war is far from over, a great battle has been won against those who would bring about our doom. Please - accept this gold as a token of my enduring gratitude.  If we ever cleanse Dire Maul, know that you will be welcomed here as a hero. Thank you.
english.completed: Return to Furgus Warpwood.

text.title: 荒野变形者奥兹恩
text.objectives: 杀死瑟雷姆·刺蹄和荒野变形者奥兹恩。
text.description: 要为你面前这片废墟负责的怪物，名唤荒野变形者奥兹恩。但是，要接近他的话，你必须先杀掉瑟雷姆·刺蹄，那个萨特控制着高贵的古树埃隆巴克。$B$B一旦埃隆巴克获得了自由，他就会帮助你制造出通往荒野变形者奥兹恩所在之处的入口。去毫不留情地杀掉他，除此之外没有别的路可走。
text.completion: Ah, very well done indeed. You've made an old spirit very happy this day. You deserve proper thanks for the risks you've taken.
text.completed: Return to Furgus Warpwood.
text.giverWindow: 奥兹恩邪恶无比、狡诈多端。

english.title: Alzzin the Wildshaper
english.objectives: Kill Zevrim Thornhoof and Alzzin the Wildshaper.
english.description: The monster responsible for the ruin you see before you is called Alzzin the Wildshaper. To reach him, however, you will need to also slay Zevrim Thornhoof, the satyr who currently holds the still noble ancient Old Ironbark in his grasp.$B$BOnce Ironbark is free, he will help you make an entrance into Alzzin's domain. Enter and slay him without mercy, for there is no other way.
english.completion: Ah, very well done indeed. You've made an old spirit very happy this day. You deserve proper thanks for the risks you've taken.
english.completed: Return to Furgus Warpwood.
english.giverWindow: Alzzin is a foul trickster.

text.title: 不速之客
text.objectives: 获得海多斯博恩精华。
text.description: 厄运之槌里充斥着许多自然和奥术元素。但是，有人发现该区域里来了一只水元素。请把它的精华拿来给我。我很好奇它那种元素是怎么会到这里来的，而它又对埃雷萨拉斯的自然元素有些什么打算。
text.progress: Do you carry the essence, or did the task prove too difficult?
text.completion: It is very troublesome that a water elemental was here, let alone one that powerful. Take this as my thanks for your efforts. I must examine this essence for any knowledge it may contain.
text.completed: Return to Furgus Warpwood.

english.title: An Unwelcome Guest
english.objectives: Collect the Hydrospawn Essence.
english.description: You will find that Dire Maul is filled with many nature and arcane elementals. Somehow, a water elemental has found its way into this area. Please gather its essence and take it to me. I am curious as to how one of their kind got here, and what sort of agenda it may have against the natural elements of Eldre'Thalas.
english.progress: Do you carry the essence, or did the task prove too difficult?
english.completion: It is very troublesome that a water elemental was here, let alone one that powerful. Take this as my thanks for your efforts. I must examine this essence for any knowledge it may contain.
english.completed: Return to Furgus Warpwood.

text.title: 揭露黑手
text.objectives: 在暴风城堡王座揭露萨缪尔森上校的真面目并将他就地处决。
text.description: <你发现了一份暴风城暮光之锤教徒成员名单。>$B$B<更重要的是，你找到了一封萨缪尔森上校写给同伙的信，信内详述了整个阴谋。王子是对的：萨缪尔森才是真正的坏人，用他在卫兵中的指挥地位来掩护邪教的活动。>$B$B<是回到暴风城堡，将萨缪尔森绳之以法的时候了！>
text.completion: Samuelson - corrupted by the Twilight's Hammer? This must have been going on for years. Right here in my very keep! I am grateful that you and my son were able to get to the bottom of this before my city was brought to harm. I've underestimated how much Anduin has grown - his command of the holy light just saved my life, if not the entire kingdom. As for you - words alone can't do justice to your heroism this day. Thank you, $c.
text.completed: Speak with King Varian Wrynn at Stormwind Keep in Stormwind.
text.giverWindow: 他一直待在暴风城的王座厅，就在国王右手边！

english.title: A Villain Unmasked
english.objectives: Unmask and slay Major Samuelson in the Stormwind Keep Throne Room.
english.description: <You find a complete list of all the Twilight's Hammer cultists in Stormwind.>$B$B<More importantly, you discover a letter from Major Samuelson to his compatriots outlining this entire scheme. The Prince was right: Samuelson is the real villain here, using his connections as commander of the city guard to disguise cult activity.>$B$B<It's time to return to Stormwind Keep and bring Samuelson to justice!>
english.completion: Samuelson - corrupted by the Twilight's Hammer? This must have been going on for years. Right here in my very keep! I am grateful that you and my son were able to get to the bottom of this before my city was brought to harm. I've underestimated how much Anduin has grown - his command of the holy light just saved my life, if not the entire kingdom. As for you - words alone can't do justice to your heroism this day. Thank you, $c.
english.completed: Speak with King Varian Wrynn at Stormwind Keep in Stormwind.
english.giverWindow: He's been in the Stormwind throne room this entire time. Right next to the king!

text.title: 窃贼普希林
text.objectives: 说服普希林把咒术之书交给你。
text.description: 我就打了个盹，快手快脚的混账小鬼就把书拿走了！达戈索尔需要书来遵从命令，主人需要书来征服！呀！$B$B你这个$r帮我从小鬼那里拿回书，我就给你亮闪闪的东西。去吧，小鬼就在左边！杀！
text.progress: $R has book?
text.completion: Now you watch Master use book to kill stupid trees and stupid goat men! YAR!
text.completed: Return to "Ambassador" Dagg'thol.

english.title: Pusillin The Thief
english.objectives: Convince Pusillin to give up the Book of Incantations.
english.description: Me take quick nap earlier and stupid fast imp take book! Dagg'thol need book to follow orders and Master need book to conquer! Gah!$B$BYou $r help me get book from imp, and I give you shiny something. Go, imp right there to da left! KILL!!!
english.progress: $R has book?
english.completion: Now you watch Master use book to kill stupid trees and stupid goat men! YAR!
english.completed: Return to "Ambassador" Dagg'thol.

text.title: 蕾瑟塔蒂丝的网
text.objectives: 获得蕾瑟塔蒂丝的网。
text.description: 血精灵蕾瑟塔蒂丝有一张网，可以捕捉这里的魔法。她只自己用，但主人想要为整个世界而用！你从蠢精灵那里弄来网，不光是达戈索尔奖励你，还可以看到主人怎么更好地用它！
text.progress: $n, you have stupid elf's web?
text.completion: This web have lots of magic! Master will be very happy now! And you make Dagg'thol happy, $r. Take this so you believe how happy you make Dagg'thol!
text.completed: Return to "Ambassador" Dagg'thol.

english.title: Lethtendris's Web
english.objectives: Obtain Lethtendris's Web.
english.description: Blood Elf Lethtendris has web to catch magic here. She use for herself, but Master want to use for good of whole world! You help get web from stupid elf and not only will Dagg'thol reward you, you see how Master use it way better!
english.progress: $n, you have stupid elf's web?
english.completion: This web have lots of magic! Master will be very happy now! And you make Dagg'thol happy, $r. Take this so you believe how happy you make Dagg'thol!
english.completed: Return to "Ambassador" Dagg'thol.

text.title: 扭曲的防御者
text.objectives: 杀死特迪斯·扭木。
text.description: 埃隆巴克和扭木曾是埃雷萨拉斯的防御者。看看他们变成了什么样子！最终，他们的命运被我和其他的上层精灵给永远改变了。我们曾肆无忌惮地滥用自己的力量，$r。$B$B但是你，你可以纠正我们犯下的错误！去让特迪斯·扭木安息吧。他曾是这里最强大的卫士，也是最后一名卫士。他的灵魂理应得到安息。多加小心，如果你在挑战特迪斯之前不先清理掉那些埃隆巴克保护者的话，他会呼唤他们来帮忙的。
text.completion: Your work here was noble. Fret not, for Tendris' soul was crying to be put to rest. He is thankful.
text.completed: Return to the Shen'dralar Watcher.

english.title: The Warped Defender
english.objectives: Kill Tendris Warpwood.
english.description: The Ironbark and Warpwood were once the mighty protectors of Eldre'Thalas. Look at how they have fallen! Ultimately, their fate lies at the hands of myself and my fellow Highborne. We were reckless with our power, $r.$B$BBut you, you can right the wrongs here! Venture forth and put Tendris Warpwood to rest. He was the mightiest and last defender of this area, and deserves spiritual release. Be wary, for if you do not dispose of the Ironbark Protectors prior to engaging Tendris, he will call them to assist.
english.completion: Your work here was noble. Fret not, for Tendris' soul was crying to be put to rest. He is thankful.
english.completed: Return to the Shen'dralar Watcher.

text.title: 伊莫塔尔的疯狂
text.objectives: 你必须消灭5座水晶塔周围的守卫，那5座水晶塔维持着关押伊莫塔尔的监狱。一旦水晶塔的能量被削弱，伊莫塔尔周围的能量力场就会消散。$B$B进入伊莫塔尔的监狱，干掉站在中间的那个恶魔。最后，在图书馆挑战托塞德林王子。$B$B当任务完成之后，到庭院中去找辛德拉古灵。
text.description: 这种疯狂必须得到遏制，永生的岁月早已过去了。摧毁五座水晶塔周围的守卫，削弱能量力场的保护作用，然后杀死伊莫塔尔。此时王子的力量将被大大削弱，趁机解决他，让这座城市中的灵魂得到安息，冒险者，让王子为他的错误付出代价。
text.completion: 我们感谢你，英雄。$B$B
text.completed: Return to the Shen'dralar Ancient.
text.giverWindow: 王子的力量之源。

english.title: The Madness Within
english.objectives: You must destroy the guardians surrounding the 5 Pylons that power the Prison of Immol'thar. Once the Pylons have powered down, the force field surrounding Immol'thar will have dissipated.$B$BEnter the Prison of Immol'thar and eradicate the foul demon that stands at its heart.
