Finally, confront Prince Tortheldrin in Athenaeum.$B$BReturn to the Shen'dralar Ancient in the courtyard should you complete this quest.
english.description: This madness must come to an end. The age of the immortals has long since passed. Destroy the guardians surrounding the five pylons to lower the force field. When this is done, destroy Immol'thar. With the Prince's power greatly reduced from the demon's demise, attack and end him as well. Lay the spirits of this city to rest, adventurer, and make the Prince pay for his wrongdoings.
english.completion: We thank you, hero.
english.completed: Return to the Shen'dralar Ancient.
english.giverWindow: The source of the Prince's powers.

text.title: 辛德拉的宝藏
text.objectives: 返回图书馆去找到辛德拉的宝藏。拿取你的奖励吧！
text.description: 你可以在图书馆的楼梯下方找到一只古老的箱子，从中拿取你所需的东西吧。
text.completion: 你打开了箱子，发现了……

english.title: The Treasure of the Shen'dralar
english.objectives: Return to the Athenaeum and find the Treasure of the Shen'dralar. Claim your reward!
english.description: In the library, Athenaeum, you will find an ancient chest hidden beneath the stairway. Take from it that which you desire.
english.completion: You open the chest to find...

text.title: 被诅咒的灵魂
text.objectives: 杀死卡雷迪斯镇长和伊琳娜·暗木。
text.description: 有一些残存的敌人对我们夺回这座圣城产生了直接威胁。卡雷迪斯镇长和伊琳娜·暗木都是极端危险的敌人，必须尽快消灭。$B$B小心行事，可供伊莫塔尔吞噬的残存能量如此之少，他们肯定会变得比当初出现时更加强大。
text.progress: Did you slay those abominations?
text.completion: Your dedication will make this all that much easier.
text.completed: Return to Estulan.

english.title: The Cursed Remains
english.objectives: Kill Magister Kalendris and Illyana Ravenoak.
english.description: There are remaining beings here that pose a direct threat to us ever reclaiming this sacred city. Magister Kalendris and Illyana Ravenoak are both extremely dangerous and need to be disposed of as quickly as possible.$B$BExercise caution, for with there being so few remaining feeding off of Immol'thar's energies, they are likely to be stronger than they first appear.
english.progress: Did you slay those abominations?
english.completion: Your dedication will make this all that much easier.
english.completed: Return to Estulan.

text.title: 辛德拉古灵
text.objectives: 与辛德拉古灵交谈。
text.description: 这里的某些生灵奇迹般地逃过了肆虐于此的黑暗力量。在上层精灵庭院的第二层，有一位辛德拉古灵。找到它，也许它仍拥有丰富的智慧，甚至了解如何解放埃雷萨拉斯的秘密。
text.completion: Our meeting is no coincidence, $n.

english.title: The Shen'dralar Ancient
english.objectives: Speak to the Shen'dralar Ancient.
english.description: Some beings here have miraculously managed to remain free of the darkness that runs so rampant. On the second story of the Court of the Highborne rests a Shen'dralar Ancient. Seek it out, it may hold a wealth of wisdom, perhaps even the secret to freeing Eldre'Thalas.
english.completion: Our meeting is no coincidence, $n.

text.title: 戈多克好酒
text.completion: You da big boss now, so you get free sample of my better brews!  These drinks boost you up AND give you good buzz!  These are da good ones, chief... you try and tell Kreeg yourself!

english.title: The Gordok Taste Test
english.completion: You da big boss now, so you get free sample of my better brews!  These drinks boost you up AND give you good buzz!  These are da good ones, chief... you try and tell Kreeg yourself!

text.title: 安多的召唤
text.objectives: 跟安多·雷管谈一谈。
text.description: 你在这里做得很好，$n。你不在的时候，那个叫安多的年轻人来找过你，说了些什么关于一只金属鸟的事情。$B$B你也许愿意回到洛克湖岸去看看他有什么需要。
text.completion: It's working! My father brought it!

english.title: Ando's Call
english.objectives: Talk to Ando Blastenheimer.
english.description: You've done great work here, $n. While you were out, that young Ando fellow was here looking for you. Said something about a metal bird.$B$BYou might want to go back to the shores of the Loch and see what he wanted.
english.completion: It's working! My father brought it!

text.title: 洛克莫丹的风
text.objectives: 乘天行者前往奥加兹岗哨，然后跟巡山人雷矛谈一谈。
text.description: 父亲把天行者完成了。真了不起！等我们把害虫除干净，我就要乘它高飞，去伸张正义，就像你一样。$B$B我知道你要离开，去帮助其他人，做个大英雄……但骑一程如何？天行者即将进行它的处子航，如果有你加入，我将十分荣幸。我会把你在奥加兹岗哨放下来。$B$B你怎么说？
text.completion: What in blazes WAS that? A flying mechanostrider? You know what, I don't want to know. I'm just going to pretend that didn't happen, and we'll be all nice and businesslike.

english.title: The Winds of Loch Modan
english.objectives: Ride the Skystrider to Algaz Station and then speak with Mountaineer Stormpike.
english.description: Father finished the Skystrider. It's amazing! Once we get the bugs worked out, I'm going to use it to fight for justice, just like you.$B$BI know you've got to move on, and help other people, being a hero and all, but how about a ride? I'm about to take the Skystrider on its first flight, and I'll be honored if you join me. I'll drop you off at Algaz Station.$B$BWhat do you say?
english.completion: What in blazes WAS that? A flying mechanostrider? You know what, I don't want to know. I'm just going to pretend that didn't happen, and we'll be all nice and businesslike.

text.title: 蛮力
text.objectives: 杀死安多哈尔城内的拉文尼亚。
text.description: 加丁命其副手拉文尼亚随侍左右。这个凶蛮的野兽比你在战场上所遭遇的其他天灾更加危险……甚过憎恶。$b$b你可以在镇子南端的一座塔边找到拉文尼亚。我建议你在挑战他之前做好完全准备，$n。他可不是好对付的。
text.completion: Excellently done, $n.
text.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.
text.giverWindow: 在通灵学院外，拉文尼亚被削弱了…但依然强大。

english.title: Brute Strength
english.objectives: Kill the Ravenian within Andorhal.
english.description: Gandling has brought his lieutenant, the Ravenian, with him.  This lumbering brute is far more dangerous than any of the other Scourge you will find upon the battlefield... even the abominations.$b$bYou will find the Ravenian within a tower near the southern end of town.  I recommend caution before fighting him, $n.  He will not be a pushover.
english.completion: Excellently done, $n.
english.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.
english.giverWindow: Outside of Scholomance, the Ravenian is weakened... but still powerful.

text.title: 破碎的陷阱
text.completion: A large, broken trap lies before you.  From the looks of it, the ogres have tried to repair the trap but to no avail.$B$BA hastily written note lies next to the trap, and strangely enough it details exactly how to repair it: just a few simple adjustments ought to do it.  Were the trap repaired, an ogre passing near it might get trapped, and could be avoided.$B$BClearly, it would seem fortuitous that very few ogres know how to read.$B$BClearly.
text.completed: Return to Broken Trap in Alterac Mountains.

english.title: A Broken Trap
english.completion: A large, broken trap lies before you.  From the looks of it, the ogres have tried to repair the trap but to no avail.$B$BA hastily written note lies next to the trap, and strangely enough it details exactly how to repair it: just a few simple adjustments ought to do it.  Were the trap repaired, an ogre passing near it might get trapped, and could be avoided.$B$BClearly, it would seem fortuitous that very few ogres know how to read.$B$BClearly.
english.completed: Return to Broken Trap in Alterac Mountains.

text.title: 戈多克食人魔装
text.objectives: 把一份食人魔鞣酸交给诺特·希姆加克。
text.description: 如果你想要和那个戈多克国王作战，那么首先你必须通过克罗卡斯那一关。好吧，你当然可以杀了他，但实际上你也可以留他一条命。$B$B你问我该怎么做？嗯，你真好运，我想我知道！你需要一件可以把你伪装成食人魔的服装！$B$B你只需要从楼上给我弄一份食人魔鞣酸来，我就给你做一件。你看我这样子，反正也哪里都去不了……
text.progress: Just get me that Ogre Tannin, and I'll whip you up an ogre suit that will fool Captain Kromcrush into thinking you're one of his men.
text.completion: Yeah, this will do the trick.  Just a slip here, and tuck here... heh - this is going to work out just fine!   Here you go, you're all set.  Remember- this isn't the most securely fashioned item in the world.  You'll have ten minutes of use before it falls apart, and then you're not going to fool anybody!  Try using it just before you approach him to make sure it lasts as long as you're going to need it.
text.completed: Return to Knot Thimblejack.

english.title: The Gordok Ogre Suit
english.objectives: Bring an Ogre Tannin to Knot Thimblejack.
english.description: If you're going to fight the king of the Gordok then you're going to need to get by Captain Kromcrush.  Now, you can get by him by killing him, sure.  You might actually want to leave him alive.$B$BHow, you ask? I think I know! An ogre suit!$B$BI'll make you one if you bring me an Ogre Tannin from upstairs.  I'm not going anywhere like this...
english.progress: Just get me that Ogre Tannin, and I'll whip you up an ogre suit that will fool Captain Kromcrush into thinking you're one of his men.
english.completion: Yeah, this will do the trick.  Just a slip here, and tuck here... heh - this is going to work out just fine!   Here you go, you're all set.  Remember- this isn't the most securely fashioned item in the world.  You'll have ten minutes of use before it falls apart, and then you're not going to fool anybody!  Try using it just before you approach him to make sure it lasts as long as you're going to need it.
english.completed: Return to Knot Thimblejack.

text.title: 戈多克食人魔装
text.completion: 好了，$N─穿上这个，你就变成一个巨魔啦!祝你好运!$B$B哦，对了，如果你碰巧找到可以打开这个镣铐的钥匙，无论如何都要告诉我!!!$B$B
text.completed: Return to Knot Thimblejack.

english.title: The Gordok Ogre Suit
english.completion: Here ya go $n - put this thing on, and you'll have ten minutes to do whatever.  Good luck! Oh, and if you happen to find a key to get me out of here, BY ALL MEANS LET ME KNOW!!!
english.completed: Return to Knot Thimblejack.

text.title: 逃出生天！
text.completed: Return to Knot Thimblejack in Alterac Mountains.

english.title: Free Knot!
english.completed: Return to Knot Thimblejack in Alterac Mountains.

text.title: 小心火灾，谨慎前进
text.objectives: 杀死弗莱拉斯总大使，并将胜利消息告知铁炉堡的指挥官峭拳。
text.description: 制造这些灾难的是那些黑铁矮人和拉格纳罗斯的火焰飓风。这一定是暮光之锤那帮疯狂的邪教徒策划的阴谋！$B$B现在我们要做的就是彻底粉碎他们对铁炉堡的进攻。当我们胜利凯旋的时候，一定要告诉指挥官峭拳这里发生的一切。我还需要继续努力工作，好让这座城市和她的好市民们回归正常秩序。
text.completion: Dark Iron dwarves and Ragnaros the Firelord, ye say? At the behest of the Cult o' Twilight's Hammer? Well done! Ironforge is in yer debt.
text.completed: Inform Commander Cragfist in Ironforge of Grand Ambassador Flamelash's death.

english.title: Fired Up and Not So Good To Go.
english.objectives: Slay Grand Ambassador Flamelash and inform Commander Cragfist in Ironforge.
english.description: Leave it to the Dark Irons to work with Ragnaros' toadies and worse. You can bet that insane Twilight's Hammer cult is behind the lot of this!$B$BTime to end their attacks on Ironforge once and for all. Oh, and tell Commander Cragfist what's happened here when we return; I'll need to work on getting the city and its good people back in order.
english.completion: Dark Iron dwarves and Ragnaros the Firelord, ye say? At the behest of the Cult o' Twilight's Hammer? Well done! Ironforge is in yer debt.
english.completed: Inform Commander Cragfist in Ironforge of Grand Ambassador Flamelash's death.

text.title: 深岩之洲，土地的国度
text.objectives: 跳上阿格娜的双足飞龙，飞进大漩涡的缺口。到达另一侧后跟玛鲁特·缚石谈一谈。
text.description: 我就知道你会回应我们的召唤，$n。当死亡之翼第一次被其他龙族首领击败后，就撤退到了土地的国度，深岩之洲。$B$B死亡之翼的归来，在艾泽拉斯和深岩之洲之间留下了一个洞开的裂隙。$B$B如果我们对其缺口置之不理，大地就会分崩离析。$B$B我们已经尽全力在裂隙的这一侧将损害控制住。阿格娜会带你通过裂隙，以使你能够在另一侧协助修复工作。$B$B准备好了以后，就骑到她的双足飞龙上去。
text.completion: You've arrived just in time, $n.  All our resources are tied up keeping the rift stable. We need someone like you to help us recover the fragments of the World Pillar.

english.title: Deepholm, Realm of Earth
english.objectives: Jump on Aggra's Wyvern and fly into the breach at the Maelstrom.  Once you're on the other side, speak to Maruut Stonebinder.
english.description: I knew you'd heed our call, $n.  When Deathwing was first defeated by the other dragon aspects, he retreated to Deepholm, the realm of earth.$B$BDeathwing's return to our world left a rift open between Azeroth and Deepholm.$B$BIf we don't mend the breach, this land will be torn asunder.$B$BWe're doing our best to contain the damage on this side of the rift.  Aggra will take you through the rift so you can help repair the damage from the other side.$B$BGet on her wyvern when you're ready.
english.completion: You've arrived just in time, $n.  All our resources are tied up keeping the rift stable. We need someone like you to help us recover the fragments of the World Pillar.

text.title: 未完的戈多克事务
text.objectives: 与厄运之槌的卫兵摩尔达交谈。
text.description: 现在你是大王，你可以从卫兵摩尔达手里拿回厉害的戈多克神器了！你前一任的大王从来不听，从古代戈多克大王那时候就是！$B$B这个神器叫做戈多克力量护手。传说只有真正的戈多克大王才能把它拿回来。如果你找到它，它就会变成你永远使用的厉害手套！真的！
text.completion: Wow... you ARE da true king! Old king never even ask about da gauntlet! Look - this mark on da gauntlet an old old OLD timey magic mark, older than da Gordok they say.  Well, I learn one thing as little ogre - how to make mark come to life and give power back to gauntlet! I do it for you, king!  Here, take da gauntlet and rule FOREVER!
text.completed: Return to Captain Kromcrush at Gordok's Seat in Dire Maul.

english.title: Unfinished Gordok Business
english.objectives: Speak to Guard Mol'dar in Dire Maul.
english.description: Now you da king, so maybe you get prized Gordok artifact back from Guard Mol'dar!  Da king before you never listened, just like all da other kings since da old timey Gordok king!$B$BArtifact is called da Gauntlet of Gordok Might.  Old timey stories say only da one true king da Gordok can get it back.  You find it and it will become mighty gauntlet you wear forever!  Yar, I show you!
english.completion: Wow... you ARE da true king! Old king never even ask about da gauntlet! Look - this mark on da gauntlet an old old OLD timey magic mark, older than da Gordok they say.  Well, I learn one thing as little ogre - how to make mark come to life and give power back to gauntlet! I do it for you, king!  Here, take da gauntlet and rule FOREVER!
english.completed: Return to Captain Kromcrush at Gordok's Seat in Dire Maul.

text.title: 戈多克的国王
text.objectives: 杀死戈多克大王。
text.description: 在戈多克食人魔社会中，最强壮的战士就可以当国王。如果任何人，无论是食人魔还是别的种族，能杀死现任国王，他们就会推举他为新的国王。$B$B新国王可以从所有仍然存活的卫兵、克罗卡斯和克雷格那里收到贡品。找到戈多克大王并杀死他，尽可能少杀掉其他的领导者。这样一来，你不但有可观的收获，而且可以运用国王的权力让戈多克食人魔停止入侵，不费一兵一卒！
text.completion: Yes! I can see that you were indeed successful. You have received your tribute, the Gordok advance will exist no longer, and the Gordok are blissfully ignorant! This is a true winner's scenario, $n.
text.completed: Return to the Druid of the Talon.
text.giverWindow: 窃取他的宝座！

english.title: King of the Gordok
english.objectives: Kill King Gordok.
english.description: In Gordok society, their king is simply their strongest warrior. If anyone, ogre or otherwise, kills the current king, they are automatically hailed as the new one.$B$BThe new king receives tribute from any living guards, Stomper Kreeg, and Captain Kromcrush. Find and kill King Gordok while killing as few of their other leaders as possible, and not only will your reward be great, you will be able to use your power as king to halt the Gordok invasion without conflict!
english.completion: Yes! I can see that you were indeed successful. You have received your tribute, the Gordok advance will exist no longer, and the Gordok are blissfully ignorant! This is a true winner's scenario, $n.
english.completed: Return to the Druid of the Talon.
english.giverWindow: Steal his throne!

text.title: 火急快递
text.objectives: 给深岩之洲碎裂前线的皮克·磨石送去投石车零件。
text.description: 皮克·磨石的队伍耽搁在西边了。$B$B你觉得你能帮上忙，赶紧给他们送些零件过去吗，$r？
text.progress: Are those spare parts you have there?
text.completion: I can't thank you enough, $c. Now, let's see if we can get this catapult moving again.

english.title: Rush Delivery
english.objectives: Deliver the Catapult Parts to Peak Grindstone on the Fractured Front in Deepholm.
english.description: Peak Grindstone's team broke down somewhere out there to the west.$B$BThink you can make yourself useful for a change and rush some parts out to them, $r?
english.progress: Are those spare parts you have there?
english.completion: I can't thank you enough, $c. Now, let's see if we can get this catapult moving again.

text.title: 小心火灾，谨慎前进
text.objectives: 杀死弗莱拉斯总大使，并将胜利消息告知奥格瑞玛的血卫士康恩。
text.description: 黑铁矮人？古加尔？我们要让他们知道，攻击奥格瑞玛的下场会是什么。$B$B我们要立刻发动反攻！把他们扔进熔岩里。看样子，他们很喜欢那些熔岩。$B$B等我们取得胜利之后，你要告诉血卫士康恩这里发生的一切。毫无疑问，我需要用很长时间来组织这座城市的修复工作……
text.completion: Dark Iron dwarves and Ragnaros the Firelord, you say? At the behest of the Cult of Twilight's Hammer? Well done! Orgrimmar is in your debt.
text.completed: Inform Blood Guard Kang in Orgrimmar of Grand Ambassador Flamelash's death.

english.title: Fired Up and Not So Good To Go.
english.objectives: Slay Grand Ambassador Flamelash and inform Blood Guard Kang in Orgrimmar.
english.description: Dark Irons? Cho'gall?! We'll show them what becomes of those who attack Orgrimmar.$B$BLet us attack! We'll hurl their limbless corpses into the magma they so adore.$B$BYou'll tell Blood Guard Kang what's happened here when we're done, yes? Doubtless I'll need to spend time organizing the repair of the city...
english.completion: Dark Iron dwarves and Ragnaros the Firelord, you say? At the behest of the Cult of Twilight's Hammer? Well done! Orgrimmar is in your debt.
english.completed: Inform Blood Guard Kang in Orgrimmar of Grand Ambassador Flamelash's death.

text.title: 戈多克的国王
text.objectives: 杀死戈多克大王。
text.description: 你杀掉戈多克的头儿，你就是新食人魔国王。如果你是国王，像克罗卡斯和克雷格这样的食人魔头目——只要他们活着，就会给你很多贡品，你还可以阻止戈多克食人魔的攻势。如果你成功了，我就是高兴的食人魔，因为我们为部落占领了厄运之槌！！！$B$B去吧，小$r！杀掉丑陋的戈多克食人魔国王，也许这里就是新的石槌要塞了！呀哈！
text.completion: Little $r did it! Now Horde more powerful than ever! YAR!
text.completed: Return to the Stonemaul Ogre.
text.giverWindow: 窃取他的宝座！

english.title: King of the Gordok
english.objectives: Kill King Gordok.
english.description: You kill Gordok leader, you new ogre king. If you king, then ogre leaders like Kromcrush and Kreeg that survive pay you big tribute and you stop Gordok invasion. If you do that, then me very happy ogre and we take Dire Maul FOR DA HORDE!!!$B$BGo, little $r! Kill ugly Gordok ogre king and maybe dis be new Stonemaul Hold! Yar!
english.completion: Little $r did it! Now Horde more powerful than ever! YAR!
english.completed: Return to the Stonemaul Ogre.
english.giverWindow: Steal his throne!

text.title: 拯救扭木
text.objectives: 与费尔古斯·扭木交谈。
text.description: 在厄运之槌的东区里面，有一位仍未被腐蚀的扭木古树——费尔古斯·扭木。你必须到那边去，帮助他驱逐强占该地的可怕生物。占领厄运之槌是为我们的同胞夺回菲拉斯的重要环节。$B$B你可以在这里的东南边找到厄运之槌。
text.completion: Have you been in contact with a druid of the talon recently, $c? I can feel the lingering presence of one.

english.title: Saving Warpwood
english.objectives: Speak to Furgus Warpwood.
english.description: Just inside the eastern wing of Dire Maul one of the warpwood ancients, Furgus Warpwood, still lives uncorrupted. You must travel there and help him drive out the terrible creatures that have taken it as their own. Taking Dire Maul would be a major step in reclaiming Feralas for our people.$B$BYou can find Dire Maul to the southeast of here.
english.completion: Have you been in contact with a druid of the talon recently, $c? I can feel the lingering presence of one.

text.title: 拯救扭木
text.objectives: 与费尔古斯·扭木交谈。
text.description: 在厄运之槌的东区里面，有一位仍未被腐蚀的扭木古树——费尔古斯·扭木。你必须到那边去，帮助他驱逐强占该地的可怕生物，免得他们开始打莫沙彻营地的主意。也许我们甚至还可以争取到他的帮助，让我们在强敌环伺的菲拉斯站稳脚跟。
text.completion: Your face shows signs of desperate conflict. I honor your presence, brave $c.

english.title: Saving Warpwood
english.objectives: Speak to Furgus Warpwood.
english.description: Just inside the eastern wing of Dire Maul one of the warpwood ancients, Furgus Warpwood, still lives uncorrupted. You must travel there and help him drive out the terrible creatures that have taken it as their own before they set their sights on Camp Mojache. Perhaps we can even enlist his aid afterward to ensure we maintain our presence in Feralas with enemies on so many sides.
english.completion: Your face shows signs of desperate conflict. I honor your presence, brave $c.

text.title: 上层精灵
text.objectives: 与埃斯图兰交谈。
text.description: 一个强大且未被腐蚀的上层精灵——埃斯图兰，设法进入了厄运之槌的西区，并希望我们帮助他净化那个区域。不管你是否认为上层精灵是有罪的，为了菲拉斯的大局着想，我必须支持他的行动。希望你尽快去找他。$B$B厄运之槌就在东南方。
text.completion: I sensed your coming all the way from Dreamer's Rest. Your assistance would be most welcome.

english.title: The Highborne
english.objectives: Speak to Estulan.
english.description: Estulan, a powerful and uncorrupt Highborne, has managed to enter the western wing of Dire Maul and has asked for assistance in cleansing it. Regardless of your personal convictions of the Highborne, it is an effort I must support for the good of Feralas. May the wind carry your spirit there with great swiftness.$B$BYou will find Dire Maul to the southeast.
english.completion: I sensed your coming all the way from Dreamer's Rest. Your assistance would be most welcome.

text.title: 上层精灵
text.objectives: 与埃斯图兰交谈。
text.description: 一个强大且未被腐蚀的上层精灵——埃斯图兰，设法进入了厄运之槌的西区，并希望我们帮助他净化那个区域。不管你认为他们的族群是否有罪，为了我们自己的利益着想，我必须支持他的行动。我们需要在菲拉斯占据尽可能多的立足点。$B$B厄运之槌就在西边。
text.completion: I sensed your coming all the way from Camp Mojache. Your assistance would be most welcome.

english.title: The Highborne
english.objectives: Speak to Estulan.
english.description: Estulan, a powerful and uncorrupt Highborne, has managed to enter the western wing of Dire Maul and has asked for assistance in cleansing it. Regardless of your personal convictions of his kind, it is an effort I must support for our own good. Please hurry, we need every foothold in Feralas that we can get.$B$BYou will find Dire Maul to the west.
english.completion: I sensed your coming all the way from Camp Mojache. Your assistance would be most welcome.

text.title: 空中的眼睛
text.objectives: 与猛禽德鲁伊交谈。
text.description: 我们在菲拉斯面临的最可怕、最有组织性的威胁，就是厄运之槌北区的戈多克食人魔。我已经请一位猛禽德鲁伊去那边侦察情况了。如果他还活着，就跟他谈谈，他将作为你的指挥官，在戈多克食人魔发动攻势之前阻止他们。$B$B这是命令，$c。
text.completion: Speak softly, $n. The Gordok may not be intelligent, but they are still dangerous warriors.

english.title: Eyes in the Sky
english.objectives: Speak to the Druid of the Talon.
english.description: The most dire, and most organized, threat to us in Feralas are the Gordok ogres in the northern wing of Dire Maul. I requested a druid of the talon to go there and scout it out. If he still lives, speak with him and he will act as your commander to stop the Gordok before they decide to attack.$B$BThat's an order, $c.
english.completion: Speak softly, $n. The Gordok may not be intelligent, but they are still dangerous warriors.

text.title: 战场的食人魔
text.objectives: 与石槌食人魔交谈。
text.description: 我们在菲拉斯面临的最可怕、最有组织性的威胁，就是厄运之槌北区的戈多克食人魔。如果我们把他们都除掉，为部落占领厄运之槌，我们就可以在这一地区获得一座坚不可摧的堡垒，以及大量珍贵的古物。我已经派一小队石锤食人魔去那边了——如果还有人活着，就跟他们谈谈，把活干完。$B$B这是命令，$c。
text.completion: These ogres no pushovers. I need you help me finish Orhan's task, $r.

english.title: Ogre in the Field
english.objectives: Speak to the Stonemaul Ogre.
english.description: The most dire, and most organized, threat to us in Feralas are the Gordok ogres in the northern wing of Dire Maul. If we eradicate them and take Dire Maul for the Horde, we will possess a heavily fortified seat of power in this region with numerous artifacts to sweeten the deal. I sent in a small army of Stonemaul Ogres inside earlier - if any have survived, speak with them and finish the job.$B$BThat's an order, $c.
english.completion: These ogres no pushovers. I need you help me finish Orhan's task, $r.

text.title: 能点着的
text.objectives: 获得灼燃之心。
text.description: 好吧，我们需要什么东西能让复合物来上一记，“砰”的！$B$B我的火药都用光了，但我想我知道能用什么代替……我的火元素之心！$B$B来，拿上我的火焰图腾，到鲜血之痕的东边去。随便找一处熔岩池把开关打开，熔岩之牙就会被召唤出来了。把它的心带来，咱们才能干正事。
text.progress: You have the heart yet?
text.completion: Uh oh. Sounds like he wasn't very happy about the situation. How was I to know? I'm just an initiate after all. Anyway, I'll worry about Magmatooth later.
text.completed: Return to Initiate Goldmine at the Quartzite Basin in Deepholm.
text.giverWindow: 金矿说弄到他的灼燃之心不会有什么问题，那大概就是不会有问题吧……

english.title: Something that Burns
english.objectives: Obtain the Burning Heart.
english.description: Alright, we need something that's going to make the compound go, "Boom"!$B$BI'm all out of gun powder, but I think I know what we can use instead... the heart of my fire elemental!$B$BHere, take my fire totem east to the Blood Trail. Just flip the switch on it near any of the lava pools over there and Magmatooth should be summoned. Bring back his heart and we'll be in business.
english.progress: You have the heart yet?
english.completion: Uh oh. Sounds like he wasn't very happy about the situation. How was I to know? I'm just an initiate after all. Anyway, I'll worry about Magmatooth later.
english.completed: Return to Initiate Goldmine at the Quartzite Basin in Deepholm.
english.giverWindow: Goldmine said it was okay to get his Burning Heart, so I guess it's okay....

text.title: 元素能量
text.objectives: 在能量枯竭的图腾附近摧毁8个充能的晶簇或磁石元素。
text.description: 在没有世界之柱的情况下，我们要使尽每一分力量，才能让这个领域保持稳定。$B$B作为萨满祭司，我们可以直接汲取居住在深岩之洲里的元素生物的能量，治疗裂隙所造成的伤害。$B$B把这根图腾插在外面的地上。在它附近摧毁充能晶簇或磁石元素，就能把我们需要的能量填充到里面去。
text.completion: Thank you, $n.  We need all the power we can muster to keep Deepholm stable.
text.completed: Return to Seer Kormo at the Temple of Earth in Deepholm.

english.title: Elemental Energy
english.objectives: Destroy 8 Energized Geodes or Lodestone Elementals near the Depleted Totem.
english.description: It's taking every ounce of our power to keep this realm stable in the absence of the World Pillar.$B$BAs shaman we can tap directly into the energies of the elementals that inhabit Deepholm and use them to heal the damage that the rift is causing.$B$BTake this totem and place it on the ground outside.  Any energized geodes or lodestone elementals destroyed in its proximity will fill it with the energy we require.
english.completion: Thank you, $n.  We need all the power we can muster to keep Deepholm stable.
english.completed: Return to Seer Kormo at the Temple of Earth in Deepholm.

text.title: 大地女孩，殊难伺候
text.completion: Ol' Theradras was behind all the movin' amd shakin', ye say?$B$BAnd the Cult o' Twilight's Hammer put her up to it?$B$BWell done! Ironforge is in yer debt.

english.title: Earth Girls Aren't So Easy
english.completion: Ol' Theradras was behind all the movin' amd shakin', ye say?$B$BAnd the Cult o' Twilight's Hammer put her up to it?$B$BWell done! Ironforge is in yer debt.

text.title: 大地女孩，殊难伺候
text.completion: Theradras wreaking havoc for the Cult of Twilight's Hammer, eh? And she's in pieces, now?$B$BWell done! Orgrimmar is in your debt.

english.title: Earth Girls Aren't So Easy
english.completion: Theradras wreaking havoc for the Cult of Twilight's Hammer, eh? And she's in pieces, now?$B$BWell done! Orgrimmar is in your debt.

text.title: 霍巴特需要你
text.objectives: 跟失落群岛胶囊镇的霍巴特·钩锤谈一谈。
text.description: 嗨，头儿，霍巴特·钩锤想跟你谈一谈。他说有紧急的事情要你帮忙。
text.completion: There you are, my boy. I have something very important for you to do!

english.title: Hobart Needs You
english.objectives: Speak with Hobart Grapplehammer at the Town-In-A-Box on the Lost Isles.
english.description: Heya, boss, Hobart Grapplehammer's wants to speak with you. He says it's a matter of some urgency.
english.completion: There you are, my boy. I have something very important for you to do!

text.title: 阿莱克斯的谋略
text.objectives: 将阿莱克斯的谋略箱放在观察室里，然后杀死维克图斯和玛杜克。
text.description: 我需要你的帮助，$c。找到这里深处的亡灵法师维克图斯和战士玛杜克。他们负责天灾军团的瘟疫之龙相关的计划，因此你必须除掉他们。$B$B把这个谋略箱放在观察室里，一切顺利的话，它会与他们手下的爪牙发生反应，并彻底地消灭他们！$B$B哦，当然，在这之后顺便干掉维克图斯和玛杜克对你来说根本不是问题，对吧？
text.completion: You did it!  They are defeated!  And the Gambit... did it work? Very interesting. You've done well, $n.
text.completed: Return to Alexi Barov.

english.title: Alexi's Gambit
english.objectives: Place the Gambit in the Viewing Room and slay Vectus and Marduk.
english.description: I require your assistance, $c. Find the undead mage Vectus and the warrior Marduk deep within here. They run the scourge's plagued dragon operation and must be destroyed.$B$BPlace this Gambit in the viewing room where they are located. Hopefully, it will react with their forces and utterly destroy them!$B$BOh, defeating Vectus and Marduk afterward shouldn't be a problem.  Right?
english.completion: You did it!  They are defeated!  And the Gambit... did it work? Very interesting. You've done well, $n.
english.completed: Return to Alexi Barov.

text.title: 炸裂
text.objectives: 在卡塔图陵墓里协助哈里森·琼斯。
text.description: 了不起的发现！$b$b就在这里……正像我的笔记所说得那样。$b$b运气够好的话，在这座大厅里就能找到传说中的应许约柜所在的关键。$b$b没错，$n。它不单单是神话。我相信它的确存在。$b$b我稍后再解释。现在，帮我处理一下这些炸药。
text.completion: Shake it off, kid. Happens to me all the time...
text.completed: Speak with Harrison Jones at the Obelisk of the Stars.

english.title: Premature Explosionation
english.objectives: Assist Harrison Jones at the Khartut's Tomb.
english.description: What a find!$b$bRight here... exactly where my notes predicted it would be.$b$bWith any luck, inside this chamber will lie clues to the location of the legendary Coffer of the Promise.$b$bThat's right, $n. It's not just a myth. I believe it truly exists.$b$bI'll explain more later. For now, just give me a hand with these explosives.
english.completion: Shake it off, kid. Happens to me all the time...
english.completed: Speak with Harrison Jones at the Obelisk of the Stars.

objectiveDetails.description: 在卡塔图陵墓里协助哈里森·琼斯

text.title: 巫妖莱斯·霜语
text.objectives: 消灭莱斯·霜语。
text.description: 克尔苏加德最信任的学生之一正在监管通灵学院的运作。你必须前往巫妖莱斯·霜语的老巢，并向他发起挑战。只有在你杀死黑暗院长加丁之后，从观察室通往巫妖房间的大门才会打开。$B$B消灭他，$n。将他的存在彻底抹消掉，这样才能确保他不再重返我们的世界。
text.completion: 上万个灵魂在齐声尖啸，$N!你对天谴军团和他们的主人进行了致命的一击。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Alexi Barov.

english.title: The Lich, Ras Frostwhisper
english.objectives: Destroy Ras Frostwhisper.
english.description: One of Kel'Thuzad's most trusted students oversees the operations in Scholomance. You must confront the lich, Ras Frostwhisper, in his lair. The door to his chamber is adjacent to the viewing room.$B$BDestroy him, $n. Leave no trace of his existence so that he may never again bring such horrors into our world.
english.completion: Ten thousand souls cry out in unison, $n! You have struck a mortal blow to the Scourge and their masters.
english.completed: Return to Alexi Barov.

text.title: 巴罗夫家族的宝藏
text.objectives: 取回凯尔达隆地契、布瑞尔地契、塔伦米尔地契，以及南海镇地契。
text.description: 通灵学院中藏着巴罗夫家族的遗产。我和阿莱克斯是这个家族硕果仅存的两名后嗣。$B$B不过呢，我是巴罗夫家唯一的活人，所以我们家族的庞大帝国现在就是我的啦！去帮我找到凯尔达隆、布瑞尔、塔伦米尔和南海镇的地契，我会好好奖赏你的。巴罗夫家道中兴的日子就要来临了！
text.progress: 向我行礼鞠躬，你这低贱的$R。我是身出名门的贵族，而你只不过是个一文不值的农夫。
text.completion: Excellent work, $r. Alexi deserves nothing for his foolishness.
text.completed: Return to Weldon Barov.

english.title: Barov Family Fortune
english.objectives: Recover The Deed to Caer Darrow, The Deed to Brill, The Deed to Tarren Mill, and The Deed to Southshore.
english.description: Within Scholomance lays the Barov family fortune. Alexi and I are the last two Barovs in existence.$B$BHowever, I am the only living Barov, so our family's vast empire belongs to me! Find me the deeds to Caer Darrow, Brill, Tarren Mill, and Southshore and I will repay you generously. The Barov estate will be reborn at long last!
english.progress: Bow your head in my presence, $r. I am a noble, after all, and you are a copperless peasant.
english.completion: Excellent work, $r. Alexi deserves nothing for his foolishness.
english.completed: Return to Weldon Barov.

text.title: 清算
text.objectives: 在希尔瓦娜斯·风行者同库尔迪拉·织亡者交谈时待命。
text.description: 你的表现无可挑剔，士兵。你让被遗忘者自豪，相比之下我们的将军库尔迪拉·织亡者可不怎么样。$b$b我要和那个死亡骑士谈谈。他给自己和他的志向蒙羞。
text.completion: I have nothing against the Knights of the Ebon Blade, but Koltira needs to be reminded who he works for now.  His loyalty must lie with the Horde. Or, more specifically, the Forsaken. I wouldn't plan on seeing Koltira anytime soon.  Now that I have him... you can rest assured that any bonds he may have had with that Alliance scum will be thoroughly broken.
text.completed: Return to Lady Sylvanas Windrunner at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.

english.title: The Reckoning
english.objectives: Stand by as Lady Sylvanas Windrunner speaks with Koltira Deathweaver.
english.description: Your performance was admirable, soldier.  You make the Forsaken proud, which is more than I can say for our general, Koltira Deathweaver.$b$bI intend to have a word with that death knight.  He has shamed himself and his cause.
english.completion: I have nothing against the Knights of the Ebon Blade, but Koltira needs to be reminded who he works for now.  His loyalty must lie with the Horde. Or, more specifically, the Forsaken. I wouldn't plan on seeing Koltira anytime soon.  Now that I have him... you can rest assured that any bonds he may have had with that Alliance scum will be thoroughly broken.
english.completed: Return to Lady Sylvanas Windrunner at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.

text.title: 瘟疫之龙
text.objectives: 杀死血骨傀儡和10只天灾龙崽。
text.description: 这里进行的若干“项目”之一就是瘟疫之龙。谢天谢地，它们眼下还只是小龙崽子，但是如果我们袖手旁观，它们就会变成天灾军团最强大的武器之一，对艾泽拉斯造成巨大的威胁，尤其是我家的地产！$B$B去干掉十只小龙崽子，顺便也把血骨傀儡除掉。它就在那些幼龙所在房间的下方，为它们准备着成长所需的食品。快一点……趁它们还没长大！
text.completion: 干得好，$N!他们再培养下一批龙还需要花费很长时间。$B$B……好吧，至少我希望如此!$B$B
text.completed: Return to Weldon Barov.

english.title: Plagued Hatchlings...For Now
english.objectives: Kill 10 Plagued Hatchlings and Rattlegore.
english.description: One of the 'projects' underway here is the plagued dragonflight. Thankfully, they're only hatchlings right now, but if we wait much longer they will become one of the scourge's most powerful weapons and a major threat to all of Azeroth, especially my family's land!$B$BSlay ten of their whelps and be sure to take care of Rattlegore as well. He is in the small space beneath where the whelps are housed and prepares supplements to catalyze their growth. Hurry...before they get any bigger!
english.completion: Well done, $n!  It'll be a long time before they can grow another clutch of dragons. ...At least, I hope it will!
english.completed: Return to Weldon Barov.

text.title: 瑟尔林·卡斯迪诺夫教授
text.objectives: 消灭瑟尔林·卡斯迪诺夫教授，并烧毁艾瓦·萨克霍夫和卢森·萨克霍夫的遗体。
text.description: 瑟尔林·卡斯迪诺夫教授杀死了数千条生命。他的绰号“屠夫”就是由于他非常乐于此道而得的。他必须得到惩罚，正义必须得到伸张。$B$B找到他，让他也尝尝他给那些无辜者带来的痛苦，包括我和我的丈夫。在他死掉之后，烧毁我们的遗体，让它们都化为灰烬，$n。让我们悲伤的灵魂得到安息。
text.completion: I can feel my spirit healing, $n. You have done my husband and I a great service.
text.completed: Return to Eva Sarkhoff.
text.objective2: 烧毁卢希恩·萨克霍夫的遗骸
text.objective3: 烧毁卢森·萨克霍夫的遗骸

english.title: Doctor Theolen Krastinov, the Butcher
english.objectives: Destroy Doctor Theolen Krastinov, then burn the Remains of Eva Sarkhoff and the Remains of Lucien Sarkhoff.
english.description: Doctor Theolen Krastinov is responsible for the deaths of thousands. His nickname, The Butcher, is well earned for the atrocities he takes joy in executing. He must be punished, justice must be meted out.$B$BFind him and exact upon him the agony he has inflicted upon countless innocents, including me and my husband. Once he is destroyed, burn our remains. Turn them to ashes, $n. Release our grieving souls.
english.completion: I can feel my spirit healing, $n. You have done my husband and I a great service.
english.completed: Return to Eva Sarkhoff.

objectiveDetails.description: 烧毁艾瓦·萨克霍夫的遗体
烧毁卢森·萨克霍夫的遗体

text.title: 传令官基尔图诺斯
text.objectives: 杀死基尔图诺斯。
text.description: 鲜血将唤来基尔图诺斯，鲜血亦将毁灭基尔图诺斯。$B$B前往召唤大厅，将一滴你自己的鲜血滴入火盆中。基尔图诺斯会出现的——他无法抵抗这血液的诱惑。当他出现时，释放出那些愤怒的无辜者的魂。$B$B如果你成功的话，你所能得到的不仅仅是我们的感激之情。
text.completion: With the death of Kirtonos, a chapter in the horrible tale of Scholomance comes to a close. You have my deepest, everlasting gratitude for your bravery.
text.completed: Return to Eva Sarkhoff.

english.title: Kirtonos the Herald
english.objectives: Destroy Kirtonos.
english.description: With blood, Kirtonos may be summoned. It is with blood, then, that Kirtonos must be destroyed.$B$BWithin the Chamber of Summoning, you will find a brazier, upon which you shall place a drop of your own blood. Kirtonos will come - he cannot resist. When he appears, unleash the fury and wrath of a thousand innocent deaths upon him.$B$BShould you succeed, you will earn more than just our gratitude.
english.completion: With the death of Kirtonos, a chapter in the horrible tale of Scholomance comes to a close. You have my deepest, everlasting gratitude for your bravery.
english.completed: Return to Eva Sarkhoff.

text.title: 永久休课
text.objectives: 杀死黑暗院长加丁。
text.description: 黑暗院长加丁是通灵学院的领导者，因此他必须为死在他的学生手上的无数生命负责，得到应有的惩罚。$B$B他不会轻易现身。你必须把他手下的六名教授全部干掉，他们的房间全都与院长的书房相连。这样一来，他就会被引诱出来。你要多加小心，当最后一名教授倒下时，他就会出现，并且会怒不可遏地使用强大的魔法。不要让他活着走出这里。
text.completion: Without a headmaster, the school will descend into chaos. It will not put forth any more of its vile 'students' into the field. Thank you.
text.completed: Return to Lucien Sarkhoff.
text.giverWindow: 不要对他存有任何怜悯。

english.title: School's Out Forever
english.objectives: Kill Darkmaster Gandling.
english.description: Darkmaster Gandling serves as headmaster of Scholomance, and is therefore responsible for countless deaths at the hands of his students. For that he must be punished.$B$BHe will not come out easily. Lure him out by slaying his six professors whose rooms connect to the Headmaster's Study. Be wary, for when the last falls he will come, and he will come infuriated with vast magic backing his assault. Don't let him make it out of here alive.
english.completion: Without a headmaster, the school will descend into chaos. It will not put forth any more of its vile 'students' into the field. Thank you.
english.completed: Return to Lucien Sarkhoff.
english.giverWindow: Have no mercy on him.

text.title: 诅咒学院
text.objectives: 与通灵学院里的维尔顿·巴罗夫交谈。
text.description: 你好！正如你所见，西瘟疫之地几乎要彻底摆脱天灾军团的威胁了。但是，他们的亡灵巫术学校——通灵学院，却仍然充斥着想要成为天灾巫师的迷途青年！如果我们不阻止这批新鲜而且强大的亡灵巫师，那我们的努力可就算是白费了。$B$B到东南方的通灵学院去，找到维尔顿·巴罗夫。他是曾拥有这片土地的巴罗夫家族的唯一幸存者，也是我们的线人。

english.title: School of the Damned
english.objectives: Speak to Walden Barov in Scholomance.
english.description: Greetings! As you can see, the Western Plaguelands is very nearly free of the last remnants of the scourge. However, their school of necromancy, Scholomance, still sits full of lost young souls training to become scourge sorcerers! Our work here will be for naught if we do not stop this flow of fresh, not to mention very powerful, necromancers.$B$BTravel southeast to Scholomance and find Weldon Barov. He is the last living member of the Barov line that once owned all these lands and is our current contact.

text.title: 治愈者营地
text.objectives: 向西瘟疫之地治愈者营地的战地特工卡尔缇舍报告。
text.description: It's likely that the battle for Andorhal will start up again soon.  In the meantime, you could probably stand to practice your skills as a $c.$b$bEast of here is a large farm that has been taken over by the Argent Dawn and the Cenarion Circle.  I don't doubt that they'll have some work for you.
text.completed: Report to Field Agent Kaartish at the Menders' Stead in Western Plaguelands.

english.title: The Menders' Stead
english.objectives: Report to Field Agent Kaartish at the Menders' Stead in Western Plaguelands.
english.description: It's likely that the battle for Andorhal will start up again soon.  In the meantime, you could probably stand to practice your skills as a $c.$b$bEast of here is a large farm that has been taken over by the Argent Dawn and the Cenarion Circle.  I don't doubt that they'll have some work for you.
english.completed: Report to Field Agent Kaartish at the Menders' Stead in Western Plaguelands.

text.title: 泰兰·弗丁的遗产
text.objectives: 杀死10头赤松强夺者。
text.description: 你好。你好吗？我叫达莉亚。$b$b我是一名保卫壁炉谷和平的牧师。我的职责之一是维护沿壁炉谷东南往下的高塔。这座塔对大领主有着与众不同的私人意义。他的儿子就是在那里被杀的。$b$b但随着最近豺狼人的入侵，维护工作变得困难起来了。你能不能帮我除掉那些放肆的豺狼人，我好履行自己的职责。
text.completion: I must admit, $n... I have been using my mind vision spell to keep tabs on you.  And I must say... the number of gnolls you found on the trail is truly staggering!
text.completed: Return to Daria L'Rayne at Hearthglen in Western Plaguelands.
text.turninWindow: 对不起哦，我对你用了心灵视界，但愿你别介意。

english.title: Taelan Fordring's Legacy
english.objectives: Kill 10 Redpine Looters.
english.description: Greetings.  How do you do?  My name is Daria.$b$bI am one of the priests in charge of preserving the peace here in Hearthglen.  One of my duties involves maintaining the tower down the trail to the southeast of Hearthglen.  This particular tower is of personal importance to the Highlord.  It's the place where his son was killed.$b$bWith the recent incursion of gnolls, however, maintenance of the tower has grown difficult.  Will you help me rid the trail of some of these gnoll vandals, so I can do my duty?
english.completion: I must admit, $n... I have been using my mind vision spell to keep tabs on you.  And I must say... the number of gnolls you found on the trail is truly staggering!
english.completed: Return to Daria L'Rayne at Hearthglen in Western Plaguelands.
english.turninWindow: Sorry, I hope you don't mind if I use Mind Vision on you.

text.title: 行为反常……即便是豺狼人
text.objectives: 沿着西瘟疫之地途径壁炉谷的小路调查豺狼人藏身地。
text.description: 让我集中一下注意力。$b$b<你感到达莉亚的心灵视野离开了一会儿，然后又回到了你的身上。>$b$b沿着路走，泰兰之塔的南边，豺狼人在大路的东边开辟了一小块碰头区。有什么不对头……我吃不准。我们应该调查调查。我来看看有什么地方反常……你保护好自己就行了。
text.completion: Gnolls and necromancy... what a surprise!  And I thought that, here in the Western Plaguelands, we had put these dark days behind us. Wait... what is THAT?
text.end: 调查豺狼人营地
text.completed: Return to Daria L'Rayne at Hearthglen in Western Plaguelands.
text.giverWindow: 豺狼人也叫人头痛啊。
text.turninWindow: 你看见了吗？那个瓶子，那些补给，就在那地上！

english.title: Unusual Behavior... Even For Gnolls
english.objectives: Investigate the gnoll hideout along the trail to Hearthglen in Western Plaguelands.
english.description: Allow me to concentrate for a moment.$b$b<You feel Daria's mind vision travel elsewhere, then it returns to you.>$b$bFurther down the trail, south of Taelan's Tower, the gnolls have carved out a small meeting area to the east of the main road.  Something is happening there... I'm not certain what.  We should investigate.  I will look for anything out of the ordinary... you just protect yourself.
english.completion: Gnolls and necromancy... what a surprise!  And I thought that, here in the Western Plaguelands, we had put these dark days behind us. Wait... what is THAT?
english.completed: Return to Daria L'Rayne at Hearthglen in Western Plaguelands.
english.giverWindow: Gnolls can be such a headache.
english.turninWindow: Do you see that?  That bottle, those supplies, on the ground!

text.title: 壁炉谷的好人
text.objectives: 同壁炉谷的莫里斯·凡特、物资官门德勒夫、布雷·铁枷和高阶牧师阿尔法斯交谈。
text.description: 看见那儿的药剂了吗？还有这儿的补给？这些东西属于银色黎明十字军。$b$b豺狼人以好偷著称，而据我所知，壁炉谷自从赤松来了之后就没遭过劫。$b$b我知道几个壁炉谷的人可以帮上忙：莫里斯·凡特、物资官门德勒夫、布雷·铁枷和高阶牧师阿尔法斯。他们都值得信任，而且人脉广泛。问问他们，看是不是能找到丢失的补给的线索。
text.completion: Did you notice, $n?  Many names were mentioned, but one name was mentioned far more than the others. Bisp.
text.completed: Return to Daria L'Rayne at Hearthglen in Western Plaguelands.
text.giverWindow: 你得回城收集情报。

english.title: The Good People of Hearthglen
english.objectives: Speak with Morris Vant, Outfitter Mendelev, Bree Ironstock, and High Cleric Alphus within Hearthglen.
english.description: See those reagents over there?  And these supplies right here?  Those belong to the Argent Crusade.$b$bGnolls are known for thievery, but as far as I know, Hearthglen hasn't had any incursions since the Redpine came.  Very suspicious.$b$bI know a few helpful folks within Hearthglen: Morris Vant, Outfitter Mendelev, Bree Ironstock, and High Cleric Alphus.  All can be trusted, and are well-connected.  Question them, to find out if they know anything about these lost supplies.
english.completion: Did you notice, $n?  Many names were mentioned, but one name was mentioned far more than the others. Bisp.
english.completed: Return to Daria L'Rayne at Hearthglen in Western Plaguelands.
english.giverWindow: You'll want to head back to town to gather information.

objectiveDetails.description: 同物资官门德勒夫交谈
同高阶牧师阿尔法斯交谈

text.title: 追捕毕斯普
text.objectives: 同壁炉谷法师塔顶的魔导师毕斯普交谈。
text.description: 魔导师毕斯普是壁炉谷最杰出的奥术师之一。他会和豺狼人勾搭……还迷上了死灵法术？不可想象。$b$b你可以在壁炉谷主门附近的法师塔顶找到他。但愿他对此能有一个解释。如若不然……要是我就不会毫无防备地上塔，$n。
text.completion: I suppose that we can take his aggression as an admission of guilt.  You alright, $n?
text.completed: Return to Daria L'Rayne at Hearthglen in Western Plaguelands.
text.giverWindow: 但愿我们能和毕斯普避免冲突，他很能打。
text.turninWindow: 毕斯普，豺狼人和死灵法师……哦，天啊。

english.title: Bagging Bisp
english.objectives: Speak with Magus Bisp atop the mage tower in Hearthglen.
english.description: Magus Bisp is one of Hearthglen's most preeminent arcanists.  To imagine that he would be interacting with gnolls... and dabbling in necromancy?  Unthinkable.$b$bYou'll find him atop the tower near Hearthglen's main gate.  Hopefully he'll have an explanation for all of this.  If not, well... I wouldn't go to the top of that tower unprepared, $n.
english.completion: I suppose that we can take his aggression as an admission of guilt.  You alright, $n?
english.completed: Return to Daria L'Rayne at Hearthglen in Western Plaguelands.
english.giverWindow: Hopefully we can avoid combat with Bisp.  He's quite skilled.
english.turninWindow: Bisp, gnolls and necromancy... oh my.

text.title: 自首吧
text.objectives: 向西瘟疫之地壁炉谷的大领主提里奥·弗丁报告。
text.description: 那么说……你在壁炉谷里，杀掉了一名银色黎明十字军。通常这不是什么能让人乐得起来的事情，即便是自卫。$b$b我建议你回到玛登霍尔德城堡，向大领主弗丁自首。但愿他能听进你的辩解，并且同情你的遭遇。希望我没能给你惹上麻烦。
text.completion: I'm already aware of your actions, $n.  I welcome you into my town, give you my blessing, and what do you do? You slay the traitor that we've been hunting down for weeks.  Well done.  Your heroism is budding much earlier than even I had anticipated.
text.completed: 向西瘟疫之地壁炉谷的大领主提里奥·弗丁报告。
text.giverWindow: 你真的应该和提里奥谈谈，趁他还不知道你干了些什么。

english.title: Turning Yourself In
english.objectives: Report to Highlord Tirion Fordring at Hearthglen in Western Plaguelands.
english.description: So... you killed a member of the Argent Crusade, inside of Hearthglen.  Usually that's not smiled upon, even in self-defense.$b$bI recommend you come back to Mardenholde Keep, and turn yourself in to Highlord Fordring.  Hopefully he will hear you out, and will be sympathetic with your situation.  I hope I haven't gotten you in any trouble.
english.completion: I'm already aware of your actions, $n.  I welcome you into my town, give you my blessing, and what do you do? You slay the traitor that we've been hunting down for weeks.  Well done.  Your heroism is budding much earlier than even I had anticipated.
english.completed: Report to Highlord Tirion Fordring at Hearthglen in Western Plaguelands.
english.giverWindow: You should really speak with Tirion, before he finds out what you did.

text.title: 是时候了！
text.objectives: 挑战并击败7名壁炉谷新兵。
text.description: 你可算到了！赶紧开工！$b$b我的人同这些木制训练假人玩得够久了，真正的战斗需要真正的对手。$b$b唔……我问他们要的是一个更精干的人，不过我猜细胳膊腿儿的$r$c也凑合。$b$b现在去教教我的人怎么战斗！
text.completion: I'm just looking over my paperwork here, and it says that we were expecting a FEMALE $r $c.  You're not, umm... Never mind.  It would appear that you are not the person that I originally hired, but you did a good job.  So I'm going to pay you anyhow.
text.completed: Return to Lieutenant Myner at Hearthglen in Western Plaguelands.

english.title: It's About Time!
english.objectives: Challenge and defeat 7 Hearthglen Trainees.
english.description: Finally!  You're here!  Get to work!$b$bMy men have been sparring with these wooden practice dummies for far too long.  Sure, you can learn how to swing a sword by practicing with a dummy, but real combat requires a real combatant.$b$bHmmm... I had asked for them to send me someone imposing, but I suppose a skinny-armed $r $c will have to do.$b$bNow get in there and teach my men how to fight!
english.completion: I'm just looking over my paperwork here, and it says that we were expecting a FEMALE $r $c.  You're not, umm... Never mind.  It would appear that you are not the person that I originally hired, but you did a good job.  So I'm going to pay you anyhow.
english.completed: Return to Lieutenant Myner at Hearthglen in Western Plaguelands.

objectiveDetails.description: 挑战并击败壁炉谷新兵

text.title: 苦工啊……<叹气>
text.objectives: 杀死壁炉谷内矿洞里的沙德利。
text.description: 啥，我没能记住你的名字。$n？很高兴认识你，$n。$b$b我手上不只一个问题要解决，而你的表情看上去就是在喊“我天生就是解决问题的”。$b$b壁炉谷北翼有个小矿洞，镇子所需的矿石都打那儿产。通常我的苦工在那儿干得都不错。$b$b不幸的是，好像有一只高出平均大小的蜘蛛把矿洞当成了老巢。你能帮忙把它给清出去么？
text.completion: Nice work!  In retrospect, I'm glad that other $r $c never showed up... you've proven to be all the help I need.
text.completed: Return to Lieutenant Myner at Hearthglen in Western Plaguelands.
text.giverWindow: 我给他们付钱不是来害怕蜘蛛的……是来干活的。

english.title: Drudges... <Sigh>
english.objectives: Kill Shadril within the mine inside Hearthglen.
english.description: Say, I never caught your name.  $n?  Pleased to meet you, $n.$b$bI've got one more problem that needs fixing, and you have a look about you that just screams "I'm a problem-fixer".$b$bThere's a small mine on the northern edge of Hearthglen, where we get most of the ore that the town needs.  My drudges who work the mine normally do a decent job.$b$bUnfortunately, it seems that a larger-than-average spider has taken up residence within this cave.  Think you can clear things up for me?
english.completion: Nice work!  In retrospect, I'm glad that other $r $c never showed up... you've proven to be all the help I need.
english.completed: Return to Lieutenant Myner at Hearthglen in Western Plaguelands.
english.giverWindow: I'm not paying them to be afraid of spiders... I'm paying them to work.

text.title: 安多哈尔战争
text.objectives: 向西瘟疫之地安多哈尔城的萨萨里安报告。
text.description: 快，$n……没时间浪费了。$b$b安多哈尔城正处于三方混战，被遗忘者、联盟，还有天灾军团。乌瑞恩国王孤注一掷，派了一名死亡骑士指挥冲锋，但我敢肯定他肯定不介意多些人手帮忙。随着阿尔萨斯的死，是该联盟收复洛丹伦了。$b$b你准备好了以后就去找狮鹫管理员比比尔法兹，他会把你送上头趟航班。
text.completion: It's about time you arrived, $c.
text.completed: 向西瘟疫之地安多哈尔城的萨萨里安报告。

english.title: The Battle for Andorhal
english.objectives: Report to Thassarian within Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.
english.description: Hurry, $n... there isn't time to waste.$b$bThe city of Andorhal is in the middle of a three-way war between the Forsaken, the Alliance, and the Scourge.  King Wrynn has rolled the dice and sent a death knight to lead the charge for his cause, but I'm sure he can use all the help he can get.  With Arthas dead, now is the time for the Alliance to start to retake Lordaeron.$b$bSpeak with the gryphon master, Bibilfaz Featherwhistle, when you are ready, and he will put you on the first flight out there.
english.completion: It's about time you arrived, $c.
english.completed: Report to Thassarian within Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.

starters.name: 指挥官阿什拉姆·瓦罗菲斯特

text.title: 先是天灾……再是部落
text.objectives: 杀死安多哈尔城里的15名枯骨天灾战士。
text.description: 诅咒教派的黑暗院长加丁率领天灾军团进攻安多哈尔。我的老对头，库尔迪拉指挥着被遗忘者部队。若想拿下安多哈尔，我们得把他们都打败，但兵分两路必不能成事。$b$b我很了解库尔迪拉，他会先对付天灾军团。我们也一样。$b$b先把天灾军团的寡兵弱将干掉，减少它们的兵力。被遗忘者可以稍后再来对付。
text.completion: You may not act quickly, but at least you do not fail me. Very well.  I will have a more important task for you, $n, when the time is right.
text.completed: Return to Thassarian at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.

english.title: Scourge First... Horde Later
english.objectives: Slay 15 Desiccated Scourge within Andorhal.
english.description: Darkmaster Gandling of the Cult of the Damned leads the Scourge offensive here in Andorhal.  My old counterpart, Koltira, leads the Forsaken forces.  If we're to win Andorhal, we'll have to defeat both, but we will certainly fail if we take on both at once.$b$bI know Koltira well enough to know that he will focus on the Scourge first.  We will do the same.$b$bTake out the weaker, desiccated Scourge to reduce their numbers.  The Forsaken will have to wait to taste our wrath.
english.completion: You may not act quickly, but at least you do not fail me. Very well.  I will have a more important task for you, $n, when the time is right.
english.completed: Return to Thassarian at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.

text.title: 战争机器
text.objectives: 摧毁安多哈尔的6具缝腹巨怪。
text.description: 干瘪的天灾……弱。憎恶……强。$b$b我们打败强悍的憎恶……我们就赢了。
text.completion: Abominations... strong. $n... stronger.
text.completed: Return to Lurid at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.

english.title: War Machines
english.objectives: Destroy 6 Opengut Behemoths in Andorhal.
english.description: Dried-up Scourge... weak.  Abominations... strong.$b$bWe defeat strong abominations... we win war.
english.completion: Abominations... strong. $n... stronger.
english.completed: Return to Lurid at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.

text.title: 源源不绝的兵力
text.objectives: 用朗格的手榴弹消灭5具拾骨狂战士，摧毁天灾骨堆法阵。
text.description: 召唤者阿拉基单单用骷髅来给天灾军团固防……这支军队贵多不贵精。他在安多哈尔北翼制造了骨堆法阵，正以惊人的速度暴骷髅。但我自有妙计！$b$b<朗格递给你一大把手榴弹。>$b$b它们的功能很简单。把手榴弹朝骨堆法阵扔过去……或者，你也可以丢到一堆骷髅当中……就能把它们炸成齑粉。
text.completion: These grenades are all explosives, nothing more.  I may not be a goblin engineer... but I still understand the value of being able to just explode things every once in a while.
text.completed: Return to Lang Loosegrip at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.

english.title: The Endless Flow
english.objectives: Use Lang's Hand Grenades to kill 5 Stickbone Berserkers and to destroy a Scourge Bone Animus.
english.description: Araj the Summoner is bolstering the Scourge defenses with simple skeletons... an army of weaklings that will overwhelm you before it overpowers you.  He has assembled animi within Andorhal's northern towers that spew these skeletons out at an alarming rate.  But I've got the solution!$b$b<Lang passes you a handful of grenades.>$b$bTheir function is simple.  Throwing these grenades at a bone animus... or, for that matter, a mob of skeletons... will reduce them to splinters.
english.completion: These grenades are all explosives, nothing more.  I may not be a goblin engineer... but I still understand the value of being able to just explode things every once in a while.
english.completed: Return to Lang Loosegrip at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.

text.title: 通灵学院
text.objectives: 杀死安多哈尔城内的黑暗院长加丁。
text.description: 通灵学院是天灾在索多里尔河西岸少数的几个据点之一。通灵学院的院长，名唤黑暗院长加丁的邪教徒，最近亲临战场。$b$b这将是他犯下的最后一个错误。$b$b你可以在镇子南头的一个广场上找到加丁，去同他交手，我会帮你把他干掉的。
text.completion: Excellently done, $n.  And now, with the leader of the Scourge forces eliminated from Andorhal, we bide our time.
text.completed: Return to Thassarian at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.
text.giverWindow: 通灵学院的院长，安多哈尔天灾的首领。

english.title: Scholomancer
english.objectives: Kill Darkmaster Gandling within Andorhal.
english.description: The Scholomance is one of the few Scourge holdouts remaining west of the Thondroril.  The headmaster of Scholomance, a cultist by the name of Darkmaster Gandling, has made an appearance on the battlefield.$b$bThis will be his final mistake.$b$bYou will find Gandling in a square near the southern end of town.  I want you to fight and weaken Gandling.  I will join you to help finish him off.
english.completion: Excellently done, $n.  And now, with the leader of the Scourge forces eliminated from Andorhal, we bide our time.
english.completed: Return to Thassarian at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.
english.giverWindow: Master of the Scholomance, leader of the Scourge in Andorhal.

text.title: 蛮力
text.objectives: 杀死安多哈尔城内的血骨傀儡。
text.description: 加丁命其副手血骨傀儡随侍左右。这个铮铮可怖之物比你在战场上所遭遇的其他天灾更加危险……甚过憎恶。$b$b你可以在镇中央的镇公所边找到血骨傀儡。我建议你在挑战他之前做好完全准备，$n。他可不是好对付的。
text.completion: Excellently done, $n.
text.completed: Return to Thassarian at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.
text.giverWindow: 通灵学院外，血骨傀儡被削弱了……但依然力量强大。

english.title: Brute Strength
english.objectives: Kill Rattlegore within Andorhal.
english.description: Gandling has brought his lieutenant, Rattlegore, with him.  This clattering horror is far more dangerous than any of the other Scourge you will find upon the battlefield... even the abominations.$b$bYou will find Rattlegore within an old town-hall building, near the center of town.  I recommend caution before fighting him, $n.  He will not be a pushover.
english.completion: Excellently done, $n.
english.completed: Return to Thassarian at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.
english.giverWindow: Outside of Scholomance, Rattlegore is weakened... but still powerful.

text.title: 召唤者阿拉基
text.objectives: 杀掉召唤者阿拉基。你可以用朗格的手榴弹消灭拾骨狂战士。
text.description: 心像被摧毁之后，下一步棋就是要对付阿拉基本人，并取得一块他的护命匣碎片。他出没于城镇中心的喷泉附近，说不定你已经见过他了。$b$b带上我的手榴弹，它们对付不了阿拉基，但是要是他打算召唤骷髅，你可以把它们再炸回去。
text.progress: Araj is a formidable opponent.  Be prepared.
text.completion: Araj dead... this is good.  That gnome has done his part in winning this war.  As have you, $n.
text.completed: Return to Thassarian at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.
text.giverWindow: 记住，用我的手榴弹对付他的骷髅！

english.title: Araj the Summoner
english.objectives: Kill Araj the Summoner.  You may use Lang's Hand Grenades to destroy Stickbone Berserkers.
english.description: With the animus destroyed, the next logical step is to take out Araj himself, and to take a shard of his phylactery.  You've probably already seen him, lurking at the fountain in the center of town.$b$bTake my grenades with you.  They won't do anything to Araj, but if he decides to summon any of those skeletons, you can use them to blow them away.  Again.
english.progress: Araj is a formidable opponent.  Be prepared.
english.completion: Araj dead... this is good.  That gnome has done his part in winning this war.  As have you, $n.
english.completed: Return to Thassarian at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.
english.giverWindow: Remember, use my grenades to take care of his skeletons!

text.title: 暂时的胜利
text.objectives: 向西瘟疫之地寒风营地的指挥官阿什拉姆·瓦罗菲斯特报告。
text.description: 联盟大获全胜，我们依然兵强马壮。按兵书，趁被遗忘者还在恢复元气，我们现在就该打它个出其不意。但是，我另有计较……$b$b我们按兵不动。等时机成熟，再对库尔迪拉进行攻击。与此同时，同金妮·古德温交谈并飞往南边的寒风营地。指挥官阿什拉姆·瓦罗菲斯特会告诉你下一步该怎么做。$b$b等安多哈尔需要你时我自会派人找你。
text.completion: Word arrived shortly before you did, $n.  With the Scourge ejected from Andorhal, we are one step closer to retaking Lordaeron.
text.completed: 向西瘟疫之地寒风营地的指挥官阿什拉姆·瓦罗菲斯特报告。

english.title: Victory, For Now
english.objectives: Report to Commander Ashlam Valorfist at Chillwind Camp in Western Plaguelands.
english.description: The Alliance are victorious, and our forces are still strong.  Military strategy dictates that we attack the Forsaken now, while they are recovering and unaware.  I made a deal, however...$b$bWe will wait.  We attack Koltira and his troops when the time is right.  In the meantime, speak with Ginny Goodwin and take a flight to the Chillwind Camp, to our south.  Commander Ashlam Valorfist will give you your next assignment.$b$bYou will hear from me when you are needed again in Andorhal.
english.completion: Word arrived shortly before you did, $n.  With the Scourge ejected from Andorhal, we are one step closer to retaking Lordaeron.
english.completed: Report to Commander Ashlam Valorfist at Chillwind Camp in Western Plaguelands.

starters.name: 指挥官阿什拉姆·瓦罗菲斯特

enders.name: 指挥官阿什拉姆·瓦罗菲斯特

text.title: 捡羽毛！
text.objectives: 收集9根棕色尾羽。
text.description: 我们必须时刻备战，$n。不管是同安多哈尔的被遗忘者，还是同东边的天灾军团，抑或是那些未知的敌人。已知的是，我们必须时刻绷紧神经。$b$b我们目前箭支短缺，我能搞到箭杆和箭头，但还需要羽毛。栖息在西北的鸟儿们这时正好在换羽毛。你是不是能过去帮我们收集一些来呢？
text.progress: It's good to see you back, $n.
text.completion: I will have my fletchers get to work on these. I'm glad to see you being so useful right away, $n.  Perhaps later I will have some more exciting tasks for you.
text.completed: Return to Ashlam Valorfist at Chillwind Camp in Western Plaguelands.

english.title: Go Fletch!
english.objectives: Obtain 9 Brownfeather Quills.
english.description: We must always be prepared for battle, $n.  Whether that battle is against the Forsaken in Andorhal, against the Scourge in the east, or against some yet-unknown foe is unknown.  What is known, is that we must be ready.$b$bWe are low on arrows.  I can obtain the shafts and heads, but I still need feathers.  The birds that circle to the northwest typically molt this time of year.  Would you mind traveling out into the field and gathering some of these feathers for our camp?
english.progress: It's good to see you back, $n.
english.completion: I will have my fletchers get to work on these. I'm glad to see you being so useful right away, $n.  Perhaps later I will have some more exciting tasks for you.
english.completed: Return to Ashlam Valorfist at Chillwind Camp in Western Plaguelands.

starters.name: 指挥官阿什拉姆·瓦罗菲斯特

enders.name: 指挥官阿什拉姆·瓦罗菲斯特

text.title: 大饥荒
text.objectives: 从西瘟疫之地的蓬毛黑熊身上割下5块熊肉。
text.description: 我打西部荒野来，遥远的南边……这些同我一起的人也是。我们是农民，仅此而已。$b$b我听说洛丹伦恢复元气，百废待兴。可是，这个“指挥官”却告诉我们继续前进太危险。他说前头在打仗，而且瘟疫之地也没有痊愈。$b$b不管怎么说，我得先弄些吃的来填饱我的人。什么都行。勉为其难就来点儿熊肉吧。
text.progress: We've traveled a long way.  Anything you can spare would be appreciated.
text.completion: You hunt like a true $c.  Even if we can't set up our homesteads... at least we can still eat.
text.completed: Return to Thurman Grant at Chillwind Camp in Western Plaguelands.

english.title: A Mighty Hunger
english.objectives: Obtain 5 Sides of Bear Meat from Shaggy Black Bears in Western Plaguelands.
english.description: I hail from Westfall, far to the south... as do these men that travel with me.  We are farmers, and nothing more.$b$bI had been told that Lordaeron had been healed, and that it was ready for tilling.  However, this "Commander" now tells me that it's too dangerous to proceed.  He says that there's a war going on, and that the plaguelands still aren't healed.$b$bBefore anything else, I need to get some food in my men's stomachs.  Anything will do.  Bear seems to be plentiful.
english.progress: We've traveled a long way.  Anything you can spare would be appreciated.
english.completion: You hunt like a true $c.  Even if we can't set up our homesteads... at least we can still eat.
english.completed: Return to Thurman Grant at Chillwind Camp in Western Plaguelands.

text.title: 无法释怀的鬼魂
text.objectives: 对悔恨岭上的12个沉默的灵魂使用神圣焚香，要是有什么异常就消灭他们。
text.description: 悔恨岭，沿着路朝东北方向走，曾是银色黎明和塞纳里奥议会头一处治愈的地方。如今那里再也没有天灾了。$b$b只是，不知为何，过去的幽灵还在，没能前往来世。也许他们在哀悼，也许他们有未竟的挂念……也许他们只是迷失了。$b$b带上我的香炉，用神圣焚香超度他们。不管怎么说，我们都要帮助他们的灵魂步入下一个位面。
text.completion: Hopefully most of them passed on peacefully.  I thank you, $n.
text.completed: Return to High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Camp in Western Plaguelands.

english.title: Those That Couldn't Let Go
english.objectives: Use the Holy Thurible on 12 Withdrawn Spirits in Sorrow Hill, and slay them if they react negatively.
english.description: Sorrow Hill, up the road to the northeast, was one of the first places that the Argent Crusaders and Cenarion Circle were able to heal.  The area is now freed of the Scourge.$b$bHowever, there are still many specters of the past that, for some reason, have not passed on into the next world.  They may be mourning, they may have unfinished business... or they may just be lost.$b$bTake my thurible and use it to douse them with holy incense.  One way or another, we will help them move onto the next plane.
english.completion: Hopefully most of them passed on peacefully.  I thank you, $n.
english.completed: Return to High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Camp in Western Plaguelands.

text.title: 乌瑟尔的祝福
text.objectives: 进入乌瑟尔之墓，在他的塑像前使用寒风贡品。
text.description: 这些来自南方的农民想要收回农场，但我不能让他们毫无准备就进入瘟疫之地。就算天灾不在了，被遗忘者的威胁依然。不，我们必须先备战……咱们的新客人也是一样。$b$b不过，在行动之前，我建议你前往乌瑟尔之墓，把这份贡品放在他的雕像前，请求他的祝福。结束后同照看陵墓的牧师谈谈。
text.completion: You and the humans at Chillwind Camp wish to re-take Andorhal?  I wish you luck.
text.completed: Report to High Priest Thel'danis at Uther's Tomb in Western Plaguelands.
text.giverWindow: 他是洛丹伦有史以来最伟大的圣骑士之一。

english.title: Uther's Blessing
english.objectives: Enter Uther's Tomb, and use the Chillwind Tribute before his statue.
english.description: These farmers from the south wish to take these farms, but I can't let them enter the plaguelands unprepared.  Even with the Scourge gone, danger still looms in the form of the Forsaken.  No, we must be ready to fight... and that includes our new visitors.$b$bBefore doing anything else, however, I would recommend that you travel to Uther's Tomb, to the east, and place this tribute before his statue to ask for his blessing.  Speak with the priest that tends to the tomb when you are finished.
english.completion: You and the humans at Chillwind Camp wish to re-take Andorhal?  I wish you luck.
english.completed: Report to High Priest Thel'danis at Uther's Tomb in Western Plaguelands.
english.giverWindow: He was one of the greatest paladins Lordaeron had ever known.

starters.name: 指挥官阿什拉姆·瓦罗菲斯特

text.title: 被遗弃的墓穴
text.objectives: 在西瘟疫之地的墓穴深处找到武器箱。
text.description: 假如你真的想为安多哈尔打这一仗……好吧，也许我可以帮助你。$b$b东边有个大墓穴，最底层曾经用来储藏武器和装甲……直到天灾来犯。现在亡灵都走了，你也就可以去拿武器了。$b$b大多数可能不是烂了就是锈了，不过总好过农耕服和草叉吧？
text.completion: Scattered all over the bottom level of the crypt, you find shattered crates that once held weapons and armor. It appears that somebody got here before you did.
text.completed: 在西瘟疫之地的墓穴深处找到武器箱。

english.title: The Abandoned Crypt
english.objectives: Find the Weapons Crate at the bottom of the Crypt in Western Plaguelands.
english.description: If you truly intend to move forward in this battle for Andorhal... well, perhaps I can help.$b$bTo the east lies a large crypt.  The bottom level of the crypt was once used for storage of weapons and armor... until the Scourge came.  Now that the undead have left, the weapons are free for the taking.$b$bMost of the weapons are probably rusted and rotten by now, but they will serve better than tunics and pitchforks.
english.completion: Scattered all over the bottom level of the crypt, you find shattered crates that once held weapons and armor. It appears that somebody got here before you did.
english.completed: Find the Weapons Crate at the bottom of the Crypt in Western Plaguelands.

text.title: 有埋伏！
text.objectives: 获取4件陈旧的胸甲和4把生锈的长剑。
text.description: 你回过身，在楼梯上瞥见骷髅蹒跚的轮廓。$b$b亡灵并没有离开墓穴，他们在守株待兔！而且，它们的装备看起来就是你要找的那些。$b$b你必须逃出去。在路上，你想拿多少装备就拿多少。
text.progress: What happened at Uther's Tomb, $n?
text.completion: Attacked by ghosts?  Strange.  I suppose that crypt wasn't fully healed after all. You just missed Thurman Grant... you remember, that oaf of a farmer that was here earlier.  He took his men with him and traveled to the nearest farm... against my orders.
text.completed: Return to Commandor Ashlam Valorfist at Chillwind Point in Western Plaguelands.

english.title: Ambushed!
english.objectives: Obtain 4 Time-Worn Breastplates and 4 Rusted Swords.
english.description: As you turn around, you see the silhouettes of shambling skeletons on the stairs.$b$bThe undead aren't gone from this crypt.  They were lying in wait!  Furthermore, they appear to be armed with the weapons that you came looking for.$b$bYou'll have to escape from the crypt.  On your way out, you should gather as many pieces of equipment as you can.
english.progress: What happened at Uther's Tomb, $n?
english.completion: Attacked by ghosts?  Strange.  I suppose that crypt wasn't fully healed after all. You just missed Thurman Grant... you remember, that oaf of a farmer that was here earlier.  He took his men with him and traveled to the nearest farm... against my orders.
english.completed: Return to Commandor Ashlam Valorfist at Chillwind Point in Western Plaguelands.

enders.name: 指挥官阿什拉姆·瓦罗菲斯特

text.title: 嚎哭鬼屋
text.objectives: 将破旧的武器和盔甲带给西瘟疫之地嚎哭鬼屋的瑟尔曼·格兰特。
text.description: 农民们过了河，前往东北方一处叫做嚎哭鬼屋的旧农场去了。得有人照看他们。$b$b把你发现的这些锈兵器和盔甲带去。我们可不能让他们挺着草叉打仗。
text.progress: Did Valorfist send you?  He doesn't know when to let up, does he?
text.completion: Well, now that you're here, we'll gladly take that armor off your hands. You can keep the weapons, though.  These men wouldn't know which end to hold.
text.completed: Report to Thurman Grant at the Writhing Haunt in Western Plaguelands.

english.title: The Writhing Haunt
english.objectives: Bring the Battered Weapons and Armor to Thurman Grant at the Writhing Haunt in Western Plaguelands.
english.description: The farmers traveled to the Writhing Haunt, an old farm to the northeast, across the river.  Someone needs to keep an eye on them.$b$bBring them those rusty weapons and armor you found.  We can't have them fighting with pitchforks.
english.progress: Did Valorfist send you?  He doesn't know when to let up, does he?
english.completion: Well, now that you're here, we'll gladly take that armor off your hands. You can keep the weapons, though.  These men wouldn't know which end to hold.
english.completed: Report to Thurman Grant at the Writhing Haunt in Western Plaguelands.

starters.name: 指挥官阿什拉姆·瓦罗菲斯特

text.title: 这就是我们的军队
text.objectives: 消灭10名被遗忘者前锋。
text.description: 我告诉瓦罗菲斯特指挥官我们能照顾好自己。来的时候我跟死亡骑士将军萨萨里安谈了一会儿。我们农民有自己的打算。$b$b先把这块农场拿下，开始耕田种地……然后等安多哈尔的战斗打响，我们就从后面打被遗忘者一个出其不意。$b$b但首先，我们得除掉那些被遗忘者前锋。杀了他们，再回来找我。
text.completion: You fight well, $r.  My men could stand to learn a few moves from an experienced $c like you.
text.completed: Return to Thurman Grant at the Writhing Haunt in Western Plaguelands.

english.title: This Is Our Army
english.objectives: Kill 10 Forsaken Outriders.
english.description: I told Commander Valorfist that we could hold our own, and we intend to.  I had a little conversation with the death knight general, Thassarian, on my way over here.  We farmers plan to help in our own way.$b$bWe will take control of this farm, begin to cultivate the land... and then when the battle for Andorhal commences, we will attack the Forsaken from the rear.  They'll never expect it.$b$bFirst, we need to get rid of these Forsaken outriders.  Kill some, then return to me.
english.completion: You fight well, $r.  My men could stand to learn a few moves from an experienced $c like you.
english.completed: Return to Thurman Grant at the Writhing Haunt in Western Plaguelands.

text.title: 战斗训练
text.objectives: 同嚎哭鬼屋的血肚交谈，向他挑战。
text.description: 事实上，你说不定可以帮着训练我的人。你也许注意到外面的憎恶了。本来我们想把它干掉，可他没还手。看起来它想帮我们。$b$b带上一组四个拓荒者，跟这个憎恶比试比试。他或许挺强，但一对五的话，我想你们还是有胜算的。
text.completion: We can handle things from here.  I thank you for your help, $n. I assume that when we next meet, it will be in battle.  Take care of yourself until then.  We'll need all the help we can get.
text.completed: Return to Thurman Grant at the Writhing Haunt in Western Plaguelands.

english.title: Combat Training
english.objectives: Speak with Gory at the Writhing Haunt and challenge him to combat.
english.description: In fact, you might still be able to help train some of my men.  You probably noticed the abomination outside.  We initially tried to fight him, but he didn't fight back.  He seems to want to help out on the farm.$b$bTake a group of four settlers and challenge this abomination to combat.  He seems to be pretty tough, but with one of him and five of you, I think you'll have a chance at beating him.
english.completion: We can handle things from here.  I thank you for your help, $n. I assume that when we next meet, it will be in battle.  Take care of yourself until then.  We'll need all the help we can get.
english.completed: Return to Thurman Grant at the Writhing Haunt in Western Plaguelands.

text.title: 治愈者营地
text.objectives: 向西瘟疫之地治愈者营地的战地特工卡尔缇舍报告。
text.description: 寒风营地的这些男女有着崇高的目标，但最终的手段还是战争。我有一个提议，可以有机会用更和平的手段来解决问题。$b$b在饱受战乱涂炭的安多哈尔前方的治愈者营地，银色黎明十字军和塞纳里奥议会进行了联合。他们意图从瘟疫中治愈这片土地。$b$b你也想要参加进来吗，$c?
text.completion: Welcome, $c.  As you can see, our camp is a joint expedition between Argent Crusade members and Cenarion Circle druids, but we welcome all who wish to help heal the land.
text.completed: 向西瘟疫之地治愈者营地的战地特工卡尔缇舍报告。

english.title: The Menders' Stead
english.objectives: Report to Field Agent Kaartish at the Menders' Stead in Western Plaguelands.
english.description: These men and women here at Chillwind Camp have noble goals, but their ultimate purpose is war.  I would like to offer you an opportunity to pursue more peaceful goals.$b$bAt the Menders' Stead, beyond war-torn Andorhal to the north, the Argent Crusade has joined forces with the Cenarion Circle.  Together, we work on healing this land from the plague that used to reign here.$b$bAre you interested in joining our cause, $c?
english.completion: Welcome, $c.  As you can see, our camp is a joint expedition between Argent Crusade members and Cenarion Circle druids, but we welcome all who wish to help heal the land.
english.completed: Report to Field Agent Kaartish at the Menders' Stead in Western Plaguelands.

starters.name: 银色黎明军官普尔哈特

text.title: 奇特的圆盘
text.objectives: 获得苏丹之杖，然后用精致的圆盘制作辰星之柄。
text.description: 这件物体表面镌刻的纹路显示，它来源古老，而且没有磨损的迹象。$b$b它的边上有一个小洞，里面全是碎木屑，表明它应该装在某种木制的长棍上端。$b$b在把它给琼斯博士过目之前，你决定先找到和它搭配的另一部分。
text.progress: 嗯，$N?
text.completion: Let's have a look at this. Shall we?
text.completed: Bring the Staff of the Stars to Harrison Jones at the Obelisk of the Stars.

english.title: Just the Tip
english.objectives: Obtain the Sultan's Staff, then use the Elaborate Disc to create the Shaft of the Stars.
english.description: The etching around the surface of this object indicates that it is of ancient origins, and yet no signs of wear can be detected.$b$bA hole on its edge, full of splintered wood, assures you that it is meant to be mounted on a wooden pole of some sort.$b$bBefore showing this find to Doctor Jones, you set off to find the missing staff.
english.progress: Yes, $n?
english.completion: Let's have a look at this. Shall we?
english.completed: Bring the Staff of the Stars to Harrison Jones at the Obelisk of the Stars.

text.title: 打捞行动
text.objectives: 前往黑曜石海滩，从浸水的箱子中找回8份补给品。
text.description: 在部落和纳迦的夹攻之下，我们的舰队损失惨重。葬身大海的同伴已经无法复活，但是如果弄丢了供给品，我的罪过就大了。$B$B游往滩头堡西南方的黑曜石海滩搜寻残骸和海床，找回我们的补给品。
text.progress: How much were you able to recover?
text.completion: Look at all this! You were able to recover more than I thought. We can outfit a whole squad of marines with this stuff. We have the gear. If we only had some way to bolster our numbers here in the Highlands...
text.completed: Bring the Supplies to Simon Chandler at Highbank in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Salvage Operation
english.objectives: Retrieve 8 Recovered Supplies from Waterlogged Crates in the Obsidian Breakers.
english.description: Between the Horde and the naga, our fleet has been decimated. We can't do anything to bring back the men who gave their lives to the sea, but sink me if I allow all of our supplies to be lost forever.$B$BSwim out to the Obsidian Breakers southwest of Highbank and retrieve our supplies from the wrecks and the ocean floor.
english.progress: How much were you able to recover?
english.completion: Look at all this! You were able to recover more than I thought. We can outfit a whole squad of marines with this stuff. We have the gear. If we only had some way to bolster our numbers here in the Highlands...
english.completed: Bring the Supplies to Simon Chandler at Highbank in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 纳迦的支援
text.objectives: 杀死10名黑鳞侍从或是黑鳞唤海者。
text.description: $n，纳迦从海洋深处蜂拥而至。我认为他们是来支援暮光堡垒的，很有可能沿着瓦拉尔河抵达内陆。我们绝不能坐视不管！$B$B让纳迦知道，这片海滩是属于我们的，他们最好滚回黑暗的海底。$B$B杀死黑曜石海滩的黑鳞纳迦！
text.completion: That'll send 'em packing, $n! Cho'gall won't be able to count on the naga to back him up in this fight. From here on out, it's just us versus the Twilight's Hammer. ...And the Horde.
text.completed: Return to Simon Chandler at Highbank in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Naga Reinforcements
english.objectives: Slay 10 Blackscale Myrmidons or Blackscale Seacallers.
english.description: They've come slithering up from the ocean depths, $n. The naga. I think their intent is to reinforce the Bastion of Twilight, probably by heading inland via the Verrall river. We can't let that happen!$B$BTeach them that these shores are ours now, and send them scurrying back to the lightless depths.$B$BKill the Blackscale naga worming their way through the Obsidian Breakers!
english.completion: That'll send 'em packing, $n! Cho'gall won't be able to count on the naga to back him up in this fight. From here on out, it's just us versus the Twilight's Hammer. ...And the Horde.
english.completed: Return to Simon Chandler at Highbank in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 实地作业
text.objectives: 找到10块远古石板碎片。
text.description: 那可怜的俾格米人在错误的时间出现在了错误的地点。$b$b你在回味他的霉运时，注意到了他盾牌上的标记——对俾格米人的手迹来说过于复杂了。$b$b你打算多找一些像这样的碎片来，因为琼斯博士一定会对类似的物体感兴趣的。
text.progress: What'dya have there, $gfriend:young lady;?
text.completion: These tablets are covered with titan writings. There's never-before seen information here, $n! Missing pieces to an ancient puzzle... Good work!
text.completed: Speak with Harrison Jones at the Obelisk of the Stars.

english.title: Field Work
english.objectives: Collect 10 Ancient Tablet Fragments.
english.description: This unfortunate pygmy was in the wrong place at the wrong time.$b$bAs you ponder his bad luck, you take notice of the symbols covering his shield - far too elaborate for pygmy scrawl.$b$bConfident that Doctor Jones will find such objects of interest, you set out to find more fragments like this one.
english.progress: What'dya have there, $gfriend:young lady;?
english.completion: These tablets are covered with titan writings. There's never-before seen information here, $n! Missing pieces to an ancient puzzle... Good work!
english.completed: Speak with Harrison Jones at the Obelisk of the Stars.

text.title: 向死者致敬
text.objectives: 在被遗忘者老兵尸体上获取6个被遗忘者的徽记。
text.description: 今天早些时候，一队老兵护送着被遗忘者投石车试图穿过南边奥森农场时遭到了伏击。他们全军覆没，所有士兵被杀，投石车也都被摧毁了。$B$B血牙的狼群要为这次伏击负责，虽然他们貌似已经全部逃回到了山上，谋划着下一次懦弱的进攻。他们的末日会到来的，但现在我要你到奥森农场去，向我们的阵亡者致敬。$B$B把他们的被遗忘者徽记拿回来。
text.progress: Have you recovered the insignias?
text.completion: I will see to it that these insignias are returned to the Undercity at once. The registrar will place their names in our records so that their sacrifice may never be forgotten.
text.completed: Speak with Lady Sylvanas Windrunner at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.

english.title: Honor the Dead
english.objectives: Recover 6 Forsaken Insignias from Veteran Forsaken Trooper corpses.
english.description: A convoy of veteran troopers and Forsaken catapults were ambushed earlier today while attempting to cross Olsen's Farthing, directly south of here. It was a total loss: all troopers were killed and all catapults destroyed.$B$BBloodfang's pack was responsible for the ambush, though likely they have all fled back into the hills, preparing their next cowardly strike. Their day will come, but for now I want you to go to Olsen's Farthing and honor our fallen.$B$BRecover their Forsaken insignias.
english.progress: Have you recovered the insignias?
english.completion: I will see to it that these insignias are returned to the Undercity at once. The registrar will place their names in our records so that their sacrifice may never be forgotten.
english.completed: Speak with Lady Sylvanas Windrunner at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.

text.title: 洗刷污点
text.objectives: 杀死10名血牙猎手。
text.description: 看来有一队伏击者落在了后面。让他们为自己的傲慢付出代价！杀掉奥森农场里所有的血牙猎手。为了希尔瓦娜斯！为了部落！
text.completion: You have avenged the fallen, $n, but there is more to be done.
text.completed: Speak with Lady Sylvanas Windrunner at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.
text.turninWindow: 这些狗会为他们的傲慢而付出代价！

english.title: Excising the Taint
english.objectives: Kill 10 Bloodfang Stalkers.
english.description: It looks like a group of the ambushers stayed behind. Make them pay for their insolence! Kill all of the Bloodfang stalkers at Olsen's Farthing. For Sylvanas! For the Horde!
english.completion: You have avenged the fallen, $n, but there is more to be done.
english.completed: Speak with Lady Sylvanas Windrunner at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.
english.turninWindow: These dogs will soon learn the price of their arrogance!

text.title: 女巫岭的隐士
text.objectives: 跟水光庄园的“沼泽之眼”加尔谈一谈。
text.description: 沼泽似乎对人类似乎有某种奇怪的效果。有人只是因为住在这里就发疯了。$B$B任何居住在水光庄园的人都不知怎么变得疯狂起来，它最新的主人“沼泽之眼”加尔已经表现出了一定的迹象。$B$B我不是很清楚那里到底有些什么，如果你去查看一下的话，我会对你表示真挚的感谢。$B$B庄园就在沼泽的东部边界，向东穿过蓝色沼泽和北点哨塔，庄园就在那座闹鬼的女巫岭上。
text.completion: Have you come here to spy on me? No? Perhaps you have an appreciation for fine cuisine, then? Good, you can help!

english.title: The Hermit of Witch Hill
english.objectives: Speak with "Swamp Eye" Jarl at Swamplight Manor.
english.description: The marsh seems to have a strange effect on humans. Some grow mad simply by living here.$B$BAnyone who has ever settled at Swamplight Manor has gone mad in a spectacular way.
