english.completion: Hm... I can't read orcish very well, but this looks like a report... written by an orc spy!

text.title: 维米斯队长
text.objectives: 把间谍的报告交给盖兰·维米斯队长。
text.description: 你找到的报告应该让维米斯队长也看看，$n。他的兽人语是最好的。塞拉摩附近有兽人间谍的事情应该让他知道！$B$B队长就在塞拉摩岛东北侧的兵营里。
text.progress: 你有东西要给我吗?
text.completion: 兽人间谍的报告?!你怎麽找到的?不管这个了—先看看上面写了些什麽……$B$B

english.title: Captain Vimes
english.objectives: Bring the Spy's Report to Captain Garran Vimes.
english.description: Captain Vimes should see the orc report you found, $n.  He knows the orcish language better than most.  And he should know that there are Horde spies near Theramore!$B$BThe captain is in the barracks, on the northeastern side of Theramore Isle.
english.progress: You have something for me?
english.completion: A report from an orc spy!  How did you find this?  No matter -- let's see what it says...

text.title: 泥链镇的任务
text.objectives: 跟泥链镇的德拉兹特·迪普瓦尔谈一谈。
text.description: 热砂财阀最近在尘泥沼泽的南部建立起了一处新的前哨。据我所知，它叫做泥链镇，就在塔贝萨的农场和石槌废墟往南的主路上。$B$B这是我们签订新贸易合同的大好机会，吉安娜女士要我派一个代表去谈协议。你愿意去吗？
text.completion: So Theramore is interested in doing business? Well, that's not an offer I'd turn down. Supplies are pretty scarce here right now, so we need all the business contacts we can get!

english.title: Mission to Mudsprocket
english.objectives: Speak with Drazzit Dripvalve at Mudsprocket.
english.description: The Steamwheedle Cartel has recently established a new outpost in the southern part of Dustwallow Marsh. It's called Mudsprocket, if I recall, and it's located on the main road south out of Tabetha's Farm and the Stonemaul Ruins.$B$BThis is an excellent opportunity for us to establish new trade contacts and Lady Jaina wants me to send a representative down there to establish contact. Would you be willing to go?
english.completion: So Theramore is interested in doing business? Well, that's not an offer I'd turn down. Supplies are pretty scarce here right now, so we need all the business contacts we can get!

text.title: 调查废墟
text.objectives: 跟树荫旅店的调查员塔雷姆谈一谈。
text.description: 可怜的詹姆斯还没从树荫旅店的毁灭和他的家人被杀害的阴影中恢复过来。我和伙计们正在尽一切努力找到犯下这些罪行的混蛋。$B$B我已经派出了最好的调查员塔雷姆去了废墟，但这对于任何人来说都是个艰巨的任务。如果你愿意帮助塔雷姆的话，我们会非常感谢的。圣光作证，我们都很愿意去那里帮忙。$B$B这条大路会将你引向旅店，不过要多加小心，你的旅程超出了我们士兵的保护范围。
text.completion: It's good to see that Captain Vimes is finally assigning others to this investigation. I've used a reflective powder to dust the area. It will reveal suspicious objects and markings, helping you to focus your efforts. Look over anything the dust illuminates.

english.title: Inspecting the Ruins
english.objectives: Speak to Inspector Tarem at the Shady Rest Inn.
english.description: Poor James never recovered from the destruction of the Shady Rest and the murder of his family. The boys and I are doing what we can to find the monsters who did this.$B$BI've sent our best investigator, Inspector Tarem, out to the ruins, but this is too big a job for any one man. If you'd lend Tarem a hand, we'd appreciate it. Light knows, we'd all like to be out there helping.$B$BThe main road will lead you to the inn, but take care. Your journey will take you beyond the protection of my soldiers.
english.completion: It's good to see that Captain Vimes is finally assigning others to this investigation. I've used a reflective powder to dust the area. It will reveal suspicious objects and markings, helping you to focus your efforts. Look over anything the dust illuminates.

text.title: REUSE - BAD COPY
text.objectives: 和米奈希尔港的文森特·海厄尔谈一谈。
text.description: 在蓝色隐士旅店干活之前，我曾在一个最棒的厨师兼旅店老板手下学艺，他的名字是詹姆斯·海厄尔。我今天能有这样的成就都得归功于他。$B$B不知道他现在在干什么，他和他的兄弟文森特到米奈希尔港的一家旅店去工作了，不过最近我一直没听到他的消息。$B$B你要是碰巧要往米奈希尔去的话，能不能帮我问候他一下？

english.title: REUSE - BAD COPY
english.objectives: Speak with Vincent Hyal in Menethil Harbor.
english.description: Before working here at the Blue Recluse, I was trained by one of the best chefs and innkeepers I'd ever met. His name was James Hyal. Everything I have and everywhere I've gotten in life is thanks to him.$b$bI wonder how he's doing. His brother Vincent and he went to work in a tavern in Menethil Harbor, but I haven't heard from him recently.$b$bIf you ever happen to be headed in that direction, maybe you could say hello to him for me?

text.title: 微笑的吉姆
text.objectives: 与塞拉摩城堡顶层的盖兰·维米斯队长谈一谈。
text.description: 我对吉姆的事很遗憾……他以前不是那样的。他曾在沼泽地开了个旅店，那是个很不错的地方。$b$b我真不想谈这个。你想谈的话就去找维米斯队长吧。他在塞拉摩的城堡里，也就是吉安娜女士的法师塔东边的那座大兵营。
text.completion: 詹姆士·海尔是他的真名，他在贫瘠之地开了个旅店，想给路过的旅客提供个歇脚的地方……$B$B也许他的期望太高了，不过旅店有一阵的生意还是很不错的。但是後来，沼泽地一带的道路被那些巨魔控制了，我们也无力夺回来。$B$B詹姆士太顽固，尽管那里非常危险，但他还是不愿放弃他的梦想，结果树荫旅店就被烧成了一片废墟。我们正在调查那起事件，但是还没有什麽结果。如果你想帮忙的话，就看看在那堆废墟里能找到些什麽吧。$B$B

english.title: They Call Him Smiling Jim
english.objectives: Speak with Captain Garran Vimes on the top floor of Foothold Citadel.
english.description: I can't help it if I feel sorry for ol' Jim there. He wasn't always like that. Ran an inn out in the marsh for a while, wonderful place.$b$bLook, I don't really want to talk about it. Bring it up with Captain Vimes if you really have to. He's stationed on the top floor of Foothold Citadel, the large barracks to the east of Lady Jaina's tower.
english.completion: James Hyal's his real name. He opened an inn at the edge of the Barrens. Wanted to make a nice place for travelers to stop over... Might be he was thinking too big, but the inn did do well for a while. Then we lost control of the roads in the marsh, and the ogres took over. James was too stubborn to give up his dream for safety within our walls, and the Shady Rest Inn was burnt to the ground. We're investigating, but haven't had much luck. If you want to help out, see what you can find in the rubble.

text.title: 黑色盾牌
text.objectives: 把被熏黑的铁盾牌交给塞拉摩的盖兰·维米斯队长。
text.description: 有一面被烧毁旅店的大火熏黑了的铁盾牌和倒塌的烟囱连在一起，这根烟囱是树荫旅店烧毁之后留下的几段残砖断瓦中的一部分。$b$b这面铁盾牌可以从烟囱的砖上拿下来。
text.progress: 你在树荫旅店的废墟里找到什么证据了吗?
text.completion: 嗯，我可不是制造武器和护甲的专家。我知道它们的用途，可是不懂如何制造。$B$B这个盾牌和一般盾牌没什么区别，只是旅馆的大火在上面留下了些痕迹。$B$B

english.title: The Black Shield
english.objectives: Bring the Blackened Iron Shield to Captain Garran Vimes in Theramore.
english.description: An iron shield, blackened by the fire that raged through the inn, is affixed to the crumbling chimney, one of the few remaining parts of the structure that once made up the Shady Rest Inn.$b$bThe shield can be removed from the brick of the chimney.
english.progress: Have you found evidence from the site of the Shady Rest Inn?
english.completion: Hm, I'm no expert with the construction of arms and armor. Their use, yes, but not their making. This shield seems as ordinary as any, excepting the damage from the fire that engulfed the inn.

text.title: 调查废墟
text.objectives: 调查尘泥沼泽与贫瘠之地边境处的树荫旅店。
text.description: 如果你沿着这条路向南走，然后向西往贫瘠之地方向前进，就可以到达树荫旅店的废墟。$B$B塞拉摩已经派出了调查员去调查旅店是怎么变成现在这般模样的。我在那里安排了一个间谍，因为我根本不相信这帮人类能搞清楚事情的真相。$B$B不管你发现了什么线索，都要守口如瓶。我们自己来进行调查。
text.completion: Leave this place be, errand boy, or I'll be sure to bring a contingent of guard with me next time to sink the lesson home.

english.title: Inspecting the Ruins
english.objectives: Investigate the Shady Rest Inn in at the border of the Barrens in Dustwallow Marsh.
english.description: If you follow the road south from the village, and then west toward the Barrens, you'll come across the ruins of the Shady Rest Inn.$B$BTheramore has sent an investigator to discover how the inn met its fate. I had a man placed in that inn as a spy and I don't trust in the competence of these humans to uncover what happened.$B$BWhatever you find, don't give a scrap of it to that investigator. We'll handle this ourselves.
english.completion: Leave this place be, errand boy, or I'll be sure to bring a contingent of guard with me next time to sink the lesson home.

text.title: 黑色盾牌
text.objectives: 把被熏黑的铁盾牌带给蕨墙村的克罗格。
text.description: 有一面被烧毁旅店的大火熏黑了的铁盾牌和倒塌的烟囱连在一起，这根烟囱是树荫旅店烧毁之后留下的几段残砖断瓦中的一部分。$b$b这面铁盾牌可以从烟囱的砖上拿下来。
text.progress: 你手里拿着什麽，$N?是从树荫旅店的废墟里找到的东西吗?
text.completion: 虽然人类的装饰品味很奇怪，不过我觉得他们不会把一面铁盾挂在壁炉上方做装饰。可能是放火烧旅馆的人放在那儿的。$B$B这是个警告?或者是个威胁?$B$B

english.title: The Black Shield
english.objectives: Bring the Blackened Iron Shield to Krog in Brackenwall Village.
english.description: An iron shield, blackened by the fire that raged through the inn, is affixed to the crumbling chimney, one of the few remaining parts of the structure that once made up the Shady Rest Inn.$b$bThe shield can be removed from the brick of the chimney.
english.progress: What's that you have there, $n? Evidence from the remains of the Shady Rest Inn?
english.completion: I grant that humans have strange decorating tastes, but would they use a plain iron shield to adorn their fireplace? Perhaps this shield was placed there by the ones who burned the inn. A warning? A threat?

text.title: 黑色盾牌
text.objectives: 把被熏黑的铁盾牌拿给蕨墙村的杜高尔看一看。
text.description: 嗯……我看不出这个盾牌有什么特别之处。我们应该把它拿给铁匠杜高尔，看看他有什么说法。不过我也不抱太大希望……
text.progress: 你找我，$C?
text.completion: 这个盾牌很不错，又重又坚硬。不过杜高尔不需要，我自己做盾牌，不买盾牌，$N。$B$B你应该知道。$B$B

english.title: The Black Shield
english.objectives: Show the Blackened Iron Shield to Do'gol in Brackenwall Village.
english.description: Hmm... I don't see anything out of the ordinary with this shield. We should have Do'gol, the blacksmith, take a look at it, and see if he can tell us more about it, but I wouldn't hold out hope...
english.progress: Something for me, $c?
english.completion: This is good shield. Very strong, heavy, good. But Do'gol don't need it. I make shields, not buy them, $n. You should know that.

text.title: 黑色盾牌
text.objectives: 从黑雾蜘蛛身上收集5个酸性毒囊。
text.description: 嗯，在盾牌的边上这儿刻着字，可惜烧过了读不出来。$b$b要用些酸液洗干净，用沼泽地里的暗牙蜘蛛的毒液就可以了。那些蜘蛛盘踞在一座旧矿洞里，现在那里被称为黑雾洞穴。给我找点它们的毒囊来，我可以把盾牌清洗一下以便辨认。
text.progress: 你找到蜘蛛的毒囊了吗?
text.completion: 我可不喜欢这么大的蜘蛛，因为我不能一脚把它们给踩扁。$B$B谢谢你找来这些，$N。看我剥开毒囊，把毒液滴到盾牌上……$B$B
text.completed: Return to Do'gol at Brackenwall Village in Dustwallow Marsh.

english.title: The Black Shield
english.objectives: Collect 5 Acidic Venom Sacs from Darkmist spiders.
english.description: Hmmm, there's writing right here on the rim of the shield, but it's hard to read from all the burned stuff.$b$bI need acid to make it clear. Venom from the darkmist spiders would do good. The spiders have taken over an old mine, the Darkmist Cavern, northwest of the village. Get me some of their sacs and I can clean this up.
english.progress: Did you get them sacs from the spiders?
english.completion: I don't like spiders that are so big I can't sit on them and squish them. Thanks for getting them, $n. Now I rip them open and pour them onto the shield...
english.completed: Return to Do'gol at Brackenwall Village in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: 黑色盾牌
text.objectives: 和蕨墙村的克罗格谈一谈。
text.description: 呃，我想我大概倒了太多酸液在盾牌上，得擦掉点儿……$b$b嗯……有点难辨认，不过好象是一个叫“莫萨恩”的名字。从来没听过这个名字。克罗格认识不少人，他也许知道这个莫萨恩是谁。
text.completion: 莫萨恩?很耳熟……不过一时之间……也许过会儿我能想起来。$B$B可能不是什麽重要的东西。这面盾牌没什麽代表性，不一定有什麽特殊的意义……$B$B

english.title: The Black Shield
english.objectives: Speak with Krog in Brackenwall Village.
english.description: Oh, I think I might have dropped too much acid onto the shield. Let me just rub a little...$b$bHm, kind of hard to read, but it looks like the name Mosarn. Never heard of him. Maybe Krog knows. Krog knows many people.
english.completion: Mosarn? Sounds familiar... I can't put my finger on it. Maybe it'll come to me later. It probably isn't important. A shield can come from anywhere and not mean anything...

text.title: 黑色盾牌
text.objectives: 把被熏黑的铁盾牌拿给雷霆崖的莫萨恩看一看。
text.description: 啊，我想起来了！莫萨恩是个，嗯，他是雷霆崖的一个受人尊敬的铁匠。我就知道以前肯定在哪儿听过他的名字。$b$b大地之环为了感谢我，送了我一套莫萨恩打造的护甲，他的手艺很不错。$b$b关于莫萨恩打造的盾牌，他自己也许可以告诉你更多。$b$b这不是什么重要线索，不过既然帕瓦尔·雷瑟还什么都没有说，这就是我们所了解的全部了。
text.progress: 你好啊，$C。我能帮你什麽忙吗?
text.completion: 是的，你的确是对的，这的确是我做的盾牌。$B$B不过我恐怕也没有太多有用的消息可以告诉你，$N。我打造了很多不同的盾牌和护甲，不可能知道每一个东西的去处。$B$B

english.title: The Black Shield
english.objectives: Show the Blackened Iron Shield to Mosarn in Thunder Bluff.
english.description: Ah, I remember now! Mosarn is a well-respected blacksmith in Thunder Bluff. I knew I had heard his name somewhere, before.$b$bIn thanks, the Earthen Ring awarded me with a set of armor crafted by Mosarn. Very good work.$b$bPerhaps he can tell you more about the shield he crafted.$b$bIt's not much of a lead, but since we didn't get anything useful out of Reethe, it's all we have.
english.progress: Hello there, $c. Something I can help you with?
english.completion: Yes, you are certainly correct. This is a shield that I made. I'm afraid there's not much more I can tell you though, $n. I craft so many different shields and sets of armor, I can't keep track of them all.

text.title: 可疑的蹄印
text.objectives: 把树荫旅店的可疑蹄印报告给蕨墙村的克罗格。
text.description: 有几排蹄印从树荫旅店那仍然冒着烟的废墟中延伸出来。大部分蹄印都埋在沼泽地的松软泥土里没法辨认，不过至少还有一些是可以看清的。
text.completion: 蹄印……我想，有可能是野猪人，或者是半人马。贫瘠之地有不少半人马，要说是他们做了这件事情，我一点也不觉得奇怪。$B$B我跟你说过吗?不仅仅是旅店被烧了……连店主的老婆和孩子都被杀了，这真是太残忍了。$B$B不管怎样，我会派卡古隆去查看那些足迹通向哪里。$B$B

english.title: Suspicious Hoofprints
english.objectives: Report about the suspicious prints at the Shady Rest Inn to Krog in Brackenwall Village.
english.description: Rows of hoofprints lead away from the still-smoking skeleton of the Shady Rest Inn. There are at least a few visible impressions, with more rows of prints almost imperceptible in the soft mud of the marsh.
english.completion: Hoofprints... It could have been the quilboar, I suppose. Or maybe even the centaur. Their presence in the Barrens is not insignificant, and I would not think it a stretch to commit such an act. Did I tell you? It wasn't just that the inn was burned down... The owner's woman and pup were killed. Bad business, that. Nonetheless, I will send Kagoro to find where the tracks lead.

text.title: 帕瓦尔·雷瑟上尉
text.objectives: 把雷瑟的徽章带给蕨墙村的克罗格。
text.description: 地上闪过的一道光芒把你的视线引到碎石的下面。你拨开了碎石，发现灰尘下有一枚白色的徽章，表面上印有金色的船锚，那是塞拉摩的标记。$b$b锚的下面刻着“帕瓦尔·雷瑟上尉”的字样。
text.progress: 你找到关於树荫旅店的线索了吗?
text.completion: Hmm... now this is interesting.

english.title: Lieutenant Paval Reethe
english.objectives: Bring Reethe's Badge to Krog in Brackenwall Village.
english.description: A glint of light on the ground catches your eye from underneath the rubble. Brushing debris and ash caked onto the object reveals the insignia of a gold anchor on white, enameled on the surface: the sign of Theramore.$b$bUnderneath the anchor is embossed the name "Lieutenant Paval Reethe".
english.progress: Have you found any leads on what happened at the Shady Rest Inn?
english.completion: Hmm... now this is interesting.

text.title: 盘问雷瑟
text.objectives: 和奥格隆一起去和雷瑟谈一谈。
text.description: 我花了很长时间终于找到雷瑟了。他躲藏得很好。$b$b奥格隆担心他在沼泽地里待了这么久可能已经疯了，你跟我来，咱们一起去从他那里套出一些我们需要的答案。
text.completion: 嗯!雷瑟不用再鬼鬼祟祟躲在沼泽地里了，这真是太好了。不过人类都这麽虚弱，连这点小小的箭伤都恢复不了，真够丢脸的。$B$B这条线索似乎是没有进展了，我们得再找其他线索。$B$B
text.end: 和奥格隆一起盘问雷瑟
text.completed: 去找尘泥沼泽蕨墙村的克罗格。

english.title: Questioning Reethe
english.objectives: Go with Ogron to speak with Reethe.
english.description: It took a long time, but I found Reethe. He hide good for a human.$b$bOgron worried that he might be crazy after so much time in swamp. You come with me for we go get answers from him.
english.completion: Hmph. It is good that Reethe will no longer be lurking around the swamp, but it is a shame that humans are built so frail that he could not recover from a little arrow wound. It seems that this thread of the mystery has led nowhere, and we must look elsewhere.
english.completed: Return to Krog at Brackenwall Village in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: 可疑的蹄印
text.objectives: 把树荫旅店的可疑蹄印报告给塞拉摩的盖兰·维米斯队长。
text.description: 有几排蹄印从树荫旅店那仍然冒着烟的废墟中延伸出来。大部分蹄印都埋在沼泽地的松软泥土里没法辨认，不过至少还有一些是可以看清的。
text.completion: 蹄印，是吗?尘泥沼泽附近的确有为数非比寻常的半人马在活动。我们在去贫瘠之地的路上看到过牠们的营地和据点。$B$B我会派出我们的侦察兵法格兰·哈斯迪尔，看看他能不能找到这些蹄印通往哪儿。$B$B

english.title: Suspicious Hoofprints
english.objectives: Report about the suspicious prints at the Shady Rest Inn to Captain Garran Vimes in Theramore.
english.description: Rows of hoofprints lead away from the still-smoking skeleton of the Shady Rest Inn. There are at least a few visible impressions, with more rows of prints almost imperceptible in the soft mud of the marsh.
english.completion: Hoofprints, eh? It is true that there is an extraordinary amount of centaur activity in the lands near the Dustwallow Marsh. In brief excursions into the Barrens, we found their camps and holdings dotting the area. I'll send out Falgran Hastil, one of our trackers, to see if he can find where the tracks lead.

text.title: 帕瓦尔·雷瑟上尉
text.objectives: 把雷瑟的徽章拿给塞拉摩的盖兰·维米斯队长。
text.description: 地上闪过的一道光芒把你的视线引到碎石的下面。你拨开了碎石，发现灰尘下有一枚白色的徽章，表面上印有金色的船锚，那是塞拉摩的标记。$b$b锚的下面刻着“帕瓦尔·雷瑟上尉”的字样。
text.progress: 你在树荫旅店找到什么有用的东西了吗?
text.completion: 找到这个守卫的徽章对我来说可不是什么好消息。 $B$B有时候这就意味这有人死在战场上，而我还得把悲伤的消息带给他们的家人，有时我们永远不知道他们发生了什么，还有些时候，事情可能比你想像中的更糟糕。

english.title: Lieutenant Paval Reethe
english.objectives: Bring Reethe's Badge to Captain Garran Vimes in Theramore.
english.description: A glint of light on the ground catches your eye from underneath the rubble. Brushing away debris and ash caked onto the object reveals the insignia of a gold anchor on white enameled on the surface: the sign of Theramore.$b$bUnderneath the anchor is embossed the name "Lieutenant Paval Reethe".
english.progress: Have you found anything of interest at the Shady Rest Inn?
english.completion: It's never good news when a guard's badge is brought to me. Sometimes it's a man or woman who's fallen in battle, and I'm left to bring the news to the grieving family. Other times we never find out what happened to them. And other times it's even worse than that.

text.title: 帕瓦尔·雷瑟上尉
text.objectives: 从塞拉摩的泰索兰副官那儿找出更多关于雷瑟的消息。
text.description: 我不认识这个帕瓦尔·雷瑟上尉，你最好还是去问问泰索兰副官。他负责管理塞拉摩所有守卫的档案，包括守卫的个人资料和他们的装备。$b$b他可以查查这些档案，然后告诉你这个雷瑟到底是谁。
text.completion: 你好，$N。你要查一个塞拉摩守卫的资料?是叫雷瑟的吗?$B$B等一下，让我来找找。$B$B

english.title: Lieutenant Paval Reethe
english.objectives: Find out more about Reethe from Adjutant Tesoran in Theramore.
english.description: I don't recognize the name of Lieutenant Paval Reethe. Your best bet would be to check with Adjutant Tesoran. He keeps track of all the records for the Theramore guard, from personnel to their equipment.$b$bHe should be able to tell you who this Reethe is with a quick check of his books.
english.completion: Hello, $n. You'd like information about a specific member of the Theramore guard? Reethe, was it? Just give me a moment to find the right book.

text.title: 艾祖尔安的召唤
text.objectives: 跟暴风城训练大厅的艾祖尔安谈一谈。
text.description: 艾祖尔安是这个世界最重要的圣骑士之一，他想要和你亲自谈谈。我也不知道他要跟你谈什么，但是看来他对你的进展非常满意。$B$B立即赶往暴风城，去旧城区的训练大厅找他吧。
text.completion: It heartens me to see that my message found you, $n. We have much to discuss.
text.completed: 跟暴风城训练大厅的艾祖尔安谈一谈。

english.title: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
english.objectives: Speak to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in Stormwind's Cathedral of Light.
english.description: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker, one of the foremost paladins in the realm, has asked to speak with you personally. I do not know what he has planned, but it sounds like he has been impressed with your rapid progress.$B$BYou should make your way to Stormwind immediately and meet him inside the city's Cathedral of Light.
english.completion: It heartens me to see that my message found you, $n. We have much to discuss.

enders.name: 格雷森·沙东布瑞克公爵

text.title: 达格伦的召唤
text.objectives: 跟暴风城的达格伦·钢脊谈一谈。
text.description: 达格伦·钢脊在暴风城中负责猎人的训练与指导工作。他说想亲自跟你谈谈。尽快赶往暴风城吧，到旧城区的训练大厅找他吧。$B$B我也不知道他要跟你谈什么，但是看来他对你的进展非常满意。
text.completion: Ah, you've arrived. Make yourself at home, $n. We have much to discuss.

english.title: Wulf Calls
english.objectives: Speak to Wulf Hansreim in Stormwind.
english.description: Wulf Hansreim oversees the training and coordination of hunters in the service of Stormwind. He has asked to speak to you personally. As soon as you are able, travel to Stormwind and exit the Old Town district through the south gate to reach his headquarters.$B$BI have no idea what he has planned, but it sounds like he has been impressed with your rapid progress.
english.completion: Ah, you've arrived. Make yourself at home, $n. We have much to discuss.

text.title: 联系军情七处
text.objectives: 跟暴风城训练大厅的薇卢卡·暗流谈一谈。
text.description: 看来军情七处对你取得的进展以及你对联盟做出的贡献很感兴趣。军情七处的高阶成员薇卢卡·暗流想要跟你谈谈。她会在暴风城的训练大厅等你。$B$B我也不清楚她要跟你谈什么，但是看起来像是紧急的事务。
text.completion: I hope my message didn't unnerve you, $n. I have called you here to recognize your accomplishments.
text.completed: 跟暴风城训练大厅的薇卢卡·暗流谈一谈。

english.title: Make Contact with SI:7
english.objectives: Speak to Osborne the Night Man in Stormwind's Old Town.
english.description: It seems that the leaders of SI:7 have taken an interest in your progress and your service to the Alliance. Osborne the Night Man, a high ranking member of SI:7, has asked to speak with you. Look for him in the southern part of Stormwind's Old Town.$B$BI'm not sure what Osborne wants with you, but it seemed important.
english.completion: I hope my message didn't unnerve you, $n. I have called you here to recognize your accomplishments.

text.title: 帕崔斯·兰卡斯特的消息
text.objectives: 跟暴风城训练大厅的帕崔斯·兰卡斯特谈一谈。
text.description: $n，我收到一条来自暴风城的紧急消息。帕崔斯·兰卡斯特想和你在暴风城旧城区的训练大厅里谈谈。信使没提到具体的谈话内容，但是你最好尽快赶往暴风城。
text.completion: It heartens me to see that you received my message and responded so quickly.
text.completed: 跟暴风城训练大厅的帕崔斯·兰卡斯特谈一谈。

english.title: Make Haste to the Cathedral
english.objectives: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind's Cathedral of the Light.
english.description: I have an urgent message for you from Stormwind, $n. It seems that High Priestess Laurena has asked to speak with you at the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind's Cathedral Square. The messenger did not say what the matter concerned, but that you should travel to Stormwind with all haste.
english.completion: It heartens me to see that you received my message and responded so quickly.

text.title: 月神殿
text.objectives: 跟达纳苏斯月神殿的泰兰德·语风谈一谈。
text.description: $n，我收到一条来自达纳苏斯的紧急消息。是月神的高阶女祭司泰兰德·语风！信使没提到具体的谈话内容，但是你最好尽快赶往达纳苏斯的月神殿，觐见高阶女祭司！
text.completion: Welcome to the Temple of the Moon, $n. I am glad that you chose to answer my summons so quickly.

english.title: The Temple of the Moon
english.objectives: Speak to Tyrande Whisperwind at the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.
english.description: I have an urgent message for you from Darnassus. The message is from the High Priestess of Elune, Tyrande Whisperwind, herself! The messenger did not say what the matter concerned, but that you should travel to the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus and meet with the high priestess at once.
english.completion: Welcome to the Temple of the Moon, $n. I am glad that you chose to answer my summons so quickly.

text.title: 晋见穆尔里克
text.objectives: 跟暴风城训练大厅的穆尔里克·勇石谈一谈。
text.description: $n，我收到一条暴风城发给你的紧急消息。穆尔里克·勇石想在你下次进城的时候和你谈谈。$B$B信使没有对这位萨满的邀请做任何解释，但是你最好尽快赶往暴风城，去旧城区南面的训练大厅找穆尔里克·勇石。
text.completion: Welcome, $n. I am glad that you decided to accept my invitation.
text.completed: 跟暴风城训练大厅的穆尔里克·勇石谈一谈。

english.title: An Audience with the Farseer
english.objectives: Speak with Farseer Umbrua in at the Golden Keg Stormwind's Dwarven District.
english.description: I have an urgent message for you from Stormwind, $n. It seems Farseer Umbrua has asked to speak with you the next time you're in the city.$B$BThe messenger gave no explanation for the farseer's invitation, but you should travel to Stormwind and find Farseer Umbrua at the Golden Keg in the Dwarven District as soon as you can.
english.completion: Welcome, $n. I am glad that you decided to accept my invitation.

text.title: 弗拉兹勒的请求
text.objectives: 跟暴风城训练大厅的弗拉兹勒·霜指谈一谈。
text.description: $n，我刚刚接到来自暴风城的消息。久负盛名的法师弗拉兹勒·霜指希望你前往暴风城的训练大厅拜访他。训练大厅就在暴风城的旧城区。$B$B我也不知道他要跟你谈什么，但是看来他对你的进步神速非常满意。
text.completion: Welcome to the Wizard's Sanctum, $n. I have been watching your progress with interest.

english.title: Journey to the Wizard's Sanctum
english.objectives: Speak with Maginor Dumas at the Wizard's Sanctum inside Stormwind's Mage Quarter.
english.description: I just received a message from Stormwind, $n. One of Stormwind's most renowned mages, Maginor Dumas, has requested that you visit him in the Mage Quarter inside Stormwind. You will be able to find him inside the Wizard's Sanctum atop the large tower in the heart of the Mage Quarter.$B$BI do not know what he has planned, but it sounds like he has been impressed with your rapid progress.
english.completion: Welcome to the Wizard's Sanctum, $n. I have been watching your progress with interest.

text.title: 来自艾芙琳·索恩的消息
text.objectives: 跟暴风城训练大厅的艾芙琳·索恩谈一谈。
text.description: $n，看来你的进展与奉献已经引起了高阶术士的注意。备受尊重的艾芙琳·索恩捎话来说她想跟你谈谈，她可是我们中老资历的前辈。你别不把这份邀请当回事。很多人只能在授课时跟她说上一两句，她现在指明要单独见你，想必是非常重要的事务。$B$B赶紧去暴风城旧城区南面的训练大厅找找她吧。
text.completion: I see that my message managed to reach you. Good. We have much to discuss.
text.completed: 跟暴风城训练大厅的艾芙琳·索恩谈一谈。

english.title: Demisette Sends Word
english.objectives: Speak with Demisette Cloyce at the Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind's Mage Quarter.
english.description: It seems that the elders in our ranks have taken notice of your progress and dedication, $n. Demisette Cloyce, one of the oldest and most respected members of our circle, has sent word that she wishes to speak with you. You should not take such an invitation lightly. Most only speak with her in the course of their lessons, but if she has asked to see you personally, it must be an important matter.$B$BHurry back to Stormwind and look for her beneath the Slaughtered Lamb in the Mage Quarter.
english.completion: I see that my message managed to reach you. Good. We have much to discuss.

text.title: 来自月光林地的邀请
text.objectives: 跟月光林地永夜港的洛甘纳尔谈一谈。
text.description: $n，月光林地的信使刚走。他只说塞纳里奥议会久负盛名的训练师洛甘纳尔有急事要你。$n，尽快赶往月光林地吧。看来是件重要的事情。$B$B你可以在永夜港找到洛甘纳尔。
text.completion: I'm glad to see that you have arrived safely in Nighthaven, $n. I offer you the welcome and the hospitality of the Cenarion Circle.

english.title: An Invitation from Moonglade
english.objectives: Speak to Loganaar at Nighthaven in Moonglade.
english.description: You just missed the messenger from Moonglade, $n. He said little, except that he carried an urgent message from Loganaar, one of the honored trainers of the Cenarion Circle. Head to Moonglade as quickly as you can, $n. The matter sounds important.$B$BLook for Loganaar in the village of Nighthaven.
english.completion: I'm glad to see that you have arrived safely in Nighthaven, $n. I offer you the welcome and the hospitality of the Cenarion Circle.

text.title: 帕崔斯·兰卡斯特的消息
text.objectives: 跟暴风城训练大厅的帕崔斯·兰卡斯特谈一谈。
text.description: $n，我收到一条来自暴风城的紧急消息。帕崔斯·兰卡斯特要你去暴风城会面。信上没提到要讨论的具体是什么事，但你最好尽快赶往暴风城。去旧城区的训练大厅找帕崔斯·兰卡斯特。
text.completion: I see that you received my message. Excellent!
text.completed: 跟暴风城训练大厅的帕崔斯·兰卡斯特谈一谈。

english.title: The Chief Surgeon
english.objectives: Speak to Chief Surgeon Gashweld in Stormwind's Dwarven District.
english.description: I have an urgent message for you from Stormwind, $n. Chief Surgeon Gashweld has asked to meet with you in Stormwind. The message didn't say what the chief surgeon wanted to discuss, but you should make your way to Stormwind as quickly as you can. Look for Chief Surgeon Gashweld in the Dwarven District of the city.
english.completion: I see that you received my message. Excellent!

text.title: 再聚首
text.objectives: 跟千针石林黑云峰的菲拉斯哨兵谈一谈。
text.description: 我们已经将哨兵治好重新武装。我把她派回岗位了。$B$B回到黑云峰去，你可以在那里见到她。
text.completion: Good to see you again, $n. Let us put the fear of the Goddess into the Grimtotem.

english.title: Together Again
english.objectives: Speak with the Feralas Sentinel at Darkcloud Pinnacle in Thousand Needles.
english.description: We saw to it that the sentinel was healed and re-equipped. I already sent her back into the field.$B$BHead back up and go to Darkcloud Pinnacle. She'll meet you there.
english.completion: Good to see you again, $n. Let us put the fear of the Goddess into the Grimtotem.

text.title: 再聚首
text.objectives: 跟千针石林黑云峰的乱风岗卫士谈一谈。
text.description: 我们已经将卫士治好重新武装。我把他派回岗位了。$B$B回到黑云峰去，你可以在那里见到他。
text.completion: I am honored by your presence, $n. Let us put the fear of the Earth Mother into the Grimtotem.

english.title: Together Again
english.objectives: Speak with the Freewind Brave at Darkcloud Pinnacle in Thousand Needles.
english.description: We saw to it that the brave was healed and re-equipped. I already sent him back into the field.$B$BHead back up and go to Darkcloud Pinnacle. He'll meet you there.
english.completion: I am honored by your presence, $n. Let us put the fear of the Earth Mother into the Grimtotem.

text.title: 费尼克斯·奥灼有约
text.objectives: 与奥格瑞玛兵营的费尼克斯·奥灼交谈。
text.description: $n，我收到了一条奥格瑞玛发给你的紧急消息。久负盛名的法师费尼克斯·奥灼想见你一面。我也不知道他想跟你谈什么，但是你最好尽快赶往奥格瑞玛，去荣誉谷的兵营里找到费尼克斯·奥灼。
text.completion: Ah, good. It seems my message did find you.
text.completed: 与奥格瑞玛兵营的费尼克斯·奥灼交谈。

english.title: An Audience with Ureda
english.objectives: Speak with Ureda in the Cleft of Shadow.
english.description: I've received an urgent message from Orgrimmar for you, $n. The renowned mage, Ureda, wants you to meet with her in Orgrimmar. I'm not sure what this is about, but if I was you, I would travel to the capital as fast as possible and seek out Ureda in the Cleft of Shadow.
english.completion: Ah, good. It seems my message did find you.

text.title: 塔曼吉的召唤
text.objectives: 与奥格瑞玛兵营的塔曼吉交谈。
text.description: 来自奥格瑞玛的信使有消息带给你。奥格瑞玛的猎人训练师塔曼吉想见你一面。$B$B赶紧前往奥格瑞玛，去荣誉谷的兵营找塔曼吉吧。
text.completion: Good, you're here. Let's get started.
text.completed: 与奥格瑞玛兵营的塔曼吉交谈。

english.title: Grimshot's Call
english.objectives: Speak with Ormak Grimshot in the Valley of Honor.
english.description: A courier from Orgrimmar just delivered a message for you. I'm to tell you that Ormak Grimshot, master of the hunters in Orgrimmar, has asked to meet with you.$B$BTravel quickly to Orgrimmar and present yourself to Ormak in the Valley of Honor.
english.completion: Good, you're here. Let's get started.

text.title: 破碎之手
text.objectives: 与奥格瑞玛兵营的瑟佳·墓刃交谈。
text.description: 来自奥格瑞玛的信使有消息带给你。奥格瑞玛的高阶盗贼训练师瑟佳·墓刃想见你一面。你必须立即赶往奥格瑞玛，去荣誉谷的兵营里找她。$B$B当瑟佳·墓刃召唤你时，你最好赶紧去找他。$n，别让她久等。
text.completion: Now that you are here, we can begin.
text.completed: 与奥格瑞玛兵营的瑟佳·墓刃交谈。

english.title: The Shattered Hand
english.objectives: Speak with Gordul in Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow.
english.description: A messenger just arrived from Orgrimmar bearing a communication for you. Gordul, the senior rogue trainer in Orgrimmar, has sent for you. You must head to Orgrimmar immediately and meet with him in the Cleft of Shadow.$B$BWhen Gordul summons you, the prudent thing to do is obey. Do not keep him waiting, $n.
english.completion: Now that you are here, we can begin.

text.title: 河语者的召唤
text.objectives: 与奥格瑞玛兵营的赫雷塔·河语者交谈。
text.description: 消息已经随风传播到各地了，年轻的萨满祭司。你的功绩并未被埋没！赫雷塔·河语者好像有些事情要与你商谈。尽快前往奥格瑞玛，到荣誉谷的兵营里找他谈一谈吧。他就和那些训练师站在一起。
text.completion: I see you are both obedient and talented, $n. Stay that way, and you will go far in the Horde.
text.completed: 与奥格瑞玛兵营的赫雷塔·河语者交谈。

english.title: The Dreamseeker Calls
english.objectives: Speak with Kardris Dreamseeker in the Valley of Wisdom.
english.description: Kardris Dreamseeker, a shaman whose wisdom is legendary in the Horde, has sent word that she wishes to speak with you. The messenger didn't mention what was so urgent, but you should make your way to Orgrimmar as quickly as you can and find Kardris in the Valley of Wisdom. She will be among others who offer training to young shamans.
english.completion: I see you are both obedient and talented, $n. Stay that way, and you will go far in the Horde.

text.title: 戈莫克·魔拳
text.objectives: 与奥格瑞玛兵营的戈莫克·魔拳交谈。
text.description: $n，我收到消息让你立即返回奥格瑞玛。奥格瑞玛备受尊敬的战士训练师戈莫克·魔拳想见你一面。这样的邀请可不能忽视。$B$B尽快赶往奥格瑞玛吧，戈莫克就在荣誉谷等你。
text.completion: I see you are both obedient and talented, $n. Stay that way, and you will go far in the Horde.
text.completed: 与奥格瑞玛兵营的戈莫克·魔拳交谈。

english.title: Grezz Ragefist
english.objectives: Speak with Grezz Ragefist in the Valley of Honor.
english.description: I just received word that you are needed in Orgrimmar, $n. Grezz Ragefist, the honored trainer of warriors in the city, has sent for you. It would not be wise to ignore such a summons.$B$BTravel quickly to Orgrimmar and the Valley of Honor where Grezz awaits your arrival.
english.completion: I see you are both obedient and talented, $n. Stay that way, and you will go far in the Horde.

text.title: 卡扎克的请求
text.objectives: 与奥格瑞玛兵营的卡扎克·暗哮交谈。
text.description: $n。我收到了消息，你必须马上返回奥格瑞玛。资深术士训练师卡扎克·暗哮有要事相商，这件事似乎万分火急。$B$B快返回奥格瑞玛和他谈谈，他就在荣誉谷的训练大厅里。
text.completion: Ah, you're here at last.
text.completed: 与奥格瑞玛兵营的卡扎克·暗哮交谈。

english.title: Zevrost's Behest
english.objectives: Speak with Zevrost in the Cleft of Shadow.
english.description: $n, I have received word that you are needed back in Orgrimmar. Zevrost, one of the senior warlock trainers in the Cleft of Shadow, has something important that he wishes to discuss with you. It seems like the kind of thing that cannot wait.$B$BMake your way back to Orgrimmar and speak with him as soon as you can.
english.completion: Ah, you're here at last.

text.title: 月光林地之旅
text.objectives: 跟永夜港的洛甘纳尔谈一谈。
text.description: 你也知道，月光林地是德鲁伊组织塞纳里奥议会的家园。居住在那里的德鲁伊以守护塞纳留斯为己任。训练师洛甘纳尔送来了一封邀请函，请你前往月光林地跟他会面。$B$B你可以在永夜港找到他。
text.completion: Welcome to Moonglade, $n. I have been looking forward to meeting you.

english.title: A Journey to Moonglade
english.objectives: Speak with Loganaar in Nighthaven.
english.description: As you have heard, Moonglade is the home of the Cenarion Circle, the brotherhood of druids. All who dwell there do so in the peace of Cenarius. It is in that spirit that the trainer Loganaar has extended an invitation to visit him in Moonglade.$B$BYou will find him in the village of Nighthaven.
english.completion: Welcome to Moonglade, $n. I have been looking forward to meeting you.

text.title: 黑色盾牌
text.objectives: 把被熏黑的铁盾牌拿给塞拉摩的卡兹·双链看一看。
text.description: 我很抱歉帮不了忙，$n，不过可以给你介绍个能帮忙的人。卡兹·双链是我们最好的铁匠，他就在铁匠铺给人打铁器。$b$b把盾牌拿给他，看看他能告诉你什么。
text.progress: 有什麽事吗?
text.completion: 嗯……这东西有点意思。肯定不是塞拉摩这边的铁匠做的，当然更不可能是我做的。$B$B

english.title: The Black Shield
english.objectives: Show the Blackened Iron Shield to Caz Twosprocket in Theramore.
english.description: I'm sorry I can't be of much help, $n, but I can refer you to someone who would be. Caz Twosprocket, one of our best blacksmiths, works the forge at the smithy.$b$bTake the shield to him, and see what he can tell you.
english.progress: Something for me to look at?
english.completion: Hm... interesting piece of iron you have here. Definitely not made by any of the blacksmiths I know over on this side of the sea, and it's certainly not my work.

text.title: 黑色盾牌
text.objectives: 与塞拉摩的盖兰·维米斯队长谈一谈。
text.description: 啊，我差点没注意到这个……背面的皮带一定是被烧掉了，不过看上去这条皮带是给某个身材高大的家伙用的。我猜是个牛头人。$b$b我就只能告诉你这些了，告诉维米斯队长，很抱歉我帮不上别的什么忙了。
text.completion: 这点资讯还不够，不过我们得把它记下来。也许将来我们还能找到关於这个秘密的其他线索，加在一起就应该能够看出事情的端倪了。$B$B

english.title: The Black Shield
english.objectives: Speak with Captain Garran Vimes in Theramore.
english.description: Ah, I almost missed this... The leather strap on the back must have burned off, but it seems like it was made to fit a large person. I'd guess a tauren, actually.$b$bThat's about all I can tell you. Tell Captain Vimes I'm sorry I couldn't be of more help.
english.completion: That's not much information to work on, but we'll have to keep it in mind. Hopefully some of the other pieces of this mystery will fall into place, and paint a more helpful picture of what happened.

text.title: 戴林的下属
text.objectives: 把雷瑟的资料报告给塞拉摩的盖兰·维米斯队长。
text.description: 雷东……雷德帕斯……啊，找到了！帕瓦尔·雷瑟上尉。$b$b他和大部分跟随普罗德摩尔女士横渡大海的征募兵一起加入了塞拉摩守卫军。16岁时加入库尔提拉斯海军，战绩出色，屡获提升……$b$b已列入失踪名单。
text.completion: 失踪?那是泰索兰对叛徒的仁慈说法。$B$B他就是那种对戴林将军愚忠的傻瓜，最後变成了一个叛徒。这不是很讽刺吗?背叛者反而说我们背叛了联盟。$B$B

english.title: Daelin's Men
english.objectives: Return the information about Reethe to Captain Garran Vimes in Theramore.
english.description: Reddon... Redpath... Ah, here it is! Lieutenant Paval Reethe.$b$bJoined the Theramore guard along with most of the recruits that came across the sea with Lady Proudmoore. Enlisted with the marines of Kul Tiras at the age of sixteen. Distinguished service, promotions...$b$bListed as missing.
english.completion: Missing? That would be Tesoran's kind way of saying traitor. No doubt he's one of those fools so blindly loyal to Admiral Daelin that he turned traitor.  Isn't that a delicious irony? The deserters accuse us of betraying the Alliance.

text.title: 背叛者
text.objectives: 从巴鲁斯·加科因及尘泥沼泽的背叛者那里打探消息。
text.description: 在沼泽地里立足确实是非常艰难的，但是通过不懈的努力，最后我们终于在这一带守住了几座防守哨塔。$b$b我收到的最新消息和侦察报告说一群背叛者占据了旅店西南方的一座废弃哨塔。$b$b这群背叛者的首领叫巴鲁斯·加科因，去看看能不能从他身上找到什么消息。$b$b小心点，$n。他可是个难对付的家伙。
text.completion: 维米斯让你来的?他自己应付不了我，对吧……$B$B
text.giverWindow: 巴鲁斯·加科因，背叛者的领袖

english.title: The Deserters
english.objectives: Get information about Reethe from Balos Jacken and the deserters in Dustwallow Marsh.
english.description: It has been a struggle maintaining a presence in the marsh, but through strength of our resolve, we have been able to maintain several defensive watchtowers throughout the area.$b$bThe latest information and scouting reports I have received indicate that a group of deserters has squatted in our abandoned tower at Lost Point, southeast of the inn.$b$bThe local lieutenant seems to be Balos Jacken. See if you can get some information out of him.$b$bBe warned, $n. He may be a tough nut to crack.
english.completion: Did Vimes send you? Couldn't do his dirty work himself, could he...
english.giverWindow: Balos Jacken, Deserter Leader

text.title: 背叛者
text.objectives: 和塞拉摩的盖兰·维米斯队长谈一谈关于雷瑟的事。
text.description: 雷瑟？那个懦夫？$b$b我们把他赶出营地，因为他坚持要袭击蕨墙村的食人魔，还要抢他们的物资。我们人数不够，没法跟那帮不长脑子的畜生斗。$b$b他不止一次做出过分的事，所以我们就把他赶了出去。$b$b现在我帮了你的忙……那么，别管你是不是偶然来这儿的，不如帮帮我的忙，别给我惹麻烦了吧？
text.completion: 我会派卡德维尔上尉去对付迷失之点的那群背叛者，另外，我还会指引他去找雷瑟。这片沼泽地并没有大到让他没办法找到雷瑟。$B$B

english.title: The Deserters
english.objectives: Speak with Captain Garran Vimes in Theramore about Reethe.
english.description: Reethe? That coward?$b$bWe threw him out of camp because he insisted on raiding the supplies of the ogres up at Brackenwall Village. We're not so many in number that we could stand up to those mindless brutes.$b$bHe crossed the line one too many times, so we left him to fend for himself.$b$bNow, I helped you out... So, why don't you help us out and forget you bumped into us?
english.completion: I will send Lieutenant Caldwell to deal with the deserters at Lost Point. In addition, I will instruct him to find Reethe. The marsh is not so big and trackless that he should be unable to find him.

text.title: 维米斯的报告
text.objectives: Bring Vimes's Report to Lady Jaina Proudmoore in Theramore.
text.description: You've done some good work, $n, best I've seen from an amateur.$b$bLady Proudmoore asked that I keep her apprised of this delicate situation, and I haven't spoken to her for some time now.$b$bI was going to deliver my report to her later, but it seems more fitting that you should be the one to speak with her about it. You can probably answer her questions better than I could.

english.title: Vimes's Report
english.objectives: Bring Vimes's Report to Lady Jaina Proudmoore in Theramore.
english.description: You've done some good work, $n, best I've seen from an amateur.$b$bLady Proudmoore asked that I keep her apprised of this delicate situation, and I haven't spoken to her for some time now.$b$bI was going to deliver my report to her later, but it seems more fitting that you should be the one to speak with her about it. You can probably answer her questions better than I could.

text.title: 到被遗忘者前线指挥部去
text.objectives: 去找吉尔尼斯城被遗忘者被遗忘者前线指挥部的死亡猎手指挥官贝尔蒙特。
text.description: 是该把克罗雷、血牙，还有他们麾下每一条狗都消灭了。不过，要做到这一点，我们需要他们做梦都不敢想的计谋和策略！$B$B作为我最为信任的士兵之一，$n，我需要你前往位于吉尔尼斯城的被遗忘者前线指挥部，去找死亡猎手指挥官贝尔蒙特。我已经把我的计划提前交给了贝尔蒙特。他在等着你的到来。$B$B阿尔苏拉会陪伴你前往前线指挥部。你准备好了就告诉我，我会送你上路。
text.completion: Well if it isn't Mesnanub! I hope you're ready for battle, because that's all you'll find in this hellhole. We're at the heart of contested territory and these worgen mongrels won't give an inch!

english.title: To Forsaken Forward Command
english.objectives: Report to Deathstalker Commander Belmont at Forsaken Forward Command in Gilneas.
english.description: The time has come to destroy Crowley, Bloodfang and every dog at their command. To do this, though, will require cunning and planning the likes of which they would never dare dream!$B$BAs one of my most trusted soldiers, $n, I need you to go to Forsaken Forward Command, located in Gilneas, and report to Deathstalker Commander Belmont. I have sent Belmont ahead with my plans. He awaits your arrival.$B$BArthura will escort you to Forward Command. Tell me when you are ready and I will send you on your way.
english.completion: Well if it isn't Mesnanub! I hope you're ready for battle, because that's all you'll find in this hellhole. We're at the heart of contested territory and these worgen mongrels won't give an inch!

enders.name: 死亡猎手指挥官贝尔蒙特

text.title: 安息
text.objectives: 塞拉摩城堡中的盖兰·维米斯队长想让你在海厄尔家族墓碑前放上一个花圈。
text.description: 我希望有办法让詹姆斯·海厄尔的妻儿知道我们已经将杀害他们的凶手绳之以法了。$B$B<维米斯队长拿出了一个小花圈。>$B$B有人说只要这样做，即使我们不能联系到他们，他们的在天之灵也会安息。我希望你可以把这个花圈放在海厄尔家族的墓碑前，就是塞拉摩大门北面墓地中的一块石碑。
text.completion: It's good to know that they understand. You didn't tell them about James, did you? I'll deliver his wife's message to him, but I doubt he'll understand.
text.completed: Return to Captain Garran Vimes at Foothold Citadel in Dustwallow Marsh.

english.title: Peace at Last
english.objectives: Captain Garran Vimes at Foothold Citadel wants you to lay the Wreath at the Hyal Family Monument.
english.description: I wish we had a way of letting James Hyal's wife and son know that we have brought their murderers to justice.$B$B<Captain Vimes produces a small wreath decorated with flowers.>$B$BThere are some who say that their spirits will know, even if we cannot reach them. It's not much, but I'd like you to lay this wreath at the Hyal family monument. It's one of the stones in the graveyard just north of Theramore's gates.
english.completion: It's good to know that they understand. You didn't tell them about James, did you? I'll deliver his wife's message to him, but I doubt he'll understand.
english.completed: Return to Captain Garran Vimes at Foothold Citadel in Dustwallow Marsh.

objectiveDetails.description: 在海厄尔家族墓碑前放上花圈

text.title: 向克罗格汇报
text.objectives: 与蕨墙村的克罗格谈一谈。
text.description: 我希望可以帮助你，但我确实没有更多的信息可以告诉你了。我和我的学徒们制造了这么多武器和装备，根本不可能知道每件装备到底都是谁在使用。$B$B我们不仅仅供货给保卫牛头人领地的勇士们，恐怖图腾也对我的制品有着特别的偏好。一个有经验的战士一看就知道什么是好装备。
text.completion: He actually said that the Grimtotems are his biggest customers? Mosarn gave us more help than he knows. With this much pointing toward the Grimtotems, I think we just found our first suspects.

english.title: Return to Krog
english.objectives: Speak with Krog at Brackenwall Village.
english.description: I hope I've been helpful to you and I'm sorry I can't offer more information. My apprentices and I produce such a large volume of arms and armor that it's almost impossible to recall details about any individual piece.$B$BNot only do we outfit the braves defending tauren lands, but the Grimtotems have a particular fondness for my work. A seasoned warrior knows good work when he sees it.
english.completion: He actually said that the Grimtotems are his biggest customers? Mosarn gave us more help than he knows. With this much pointing toward the Grimtotems, I think we just found our first suspects.

text.title: 恐怖图腾的密谋
text.objectives: 从恐怖图腾长者身上收集4份恐怖图腾便笺，将它们组合成恐怖图腾作战计划。
text.description: 随着恐怖图腾在千针石林的行动被揭露，现在很多牛头人都对他们产生了怀疑。我们了解到恐怖图腾的高阶成员使用谋杀和绑架的手段来提升他们的影响力，也许我们会变成他们的下一个目标。$B$B东北边靠近蓝色沼泽的黑蹄村是恐怖图腾新的大型据点。他们的长者都按照从雷霆崖送来的命令行事。去看看你是否能截获他们的命令书，把它们拼凑起来，了解恐怖图腾的计划。
text.progress: Were you able to find any trace of the orders?
text.completion: There's no doubt in my mind that the Grimtotems are moving against the humans. What I don't understand is what their intentions are toward us. We knew nothing of these plans and we lost a good man because of it. I don't trust that we're not next on their list.
text.completed: Return to Krog in Dustwallow Marsh.

english.title: The Grimtotem Plot
english.objectives: Collect 4 Grimtotem Notes from Grimtotem Elders and combine them to form the full Grimtotem Battle Plan.
english.description: With the activities of the Grimtotems in Thousand Needles brought to light, many tauren now regard them with suspicion.  We've seen high-ranking Grimtotems engage in murder and kidnapping to advance their interests and I fear we may become their next target.$B$BBlackhoof Village, to the northeast, near Bluefen, is a large new Grimtotem settlement. Their leaders, the elders, will all have orders from Thunder Bluff. See if you can capture the orders and piece them together to learn the Grimtotems' plans.
english.progress: Were you able to find any trace of the orders?
english.completion: There's no doubt in my mind that the Grimtotems are moving against the humans. What I don't understand is what their intentions are toward us. We knew nothing of these plans and we lost a good man because of it. I don't trust that we're not next on their list.
english.completed: Return to Krog in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: 绝非偶然
text.objectives: 在黑蹄村收集7份黑蹄军备。
text.description: 我们从旅店的废墟里收集了尽可能多的线索。我不知道调查的结果到底是什么，但我们必须知道真相。$B$B这些蹄印和有着莫萨恩记号的盾牌，让我感觉到恐怖图腾可能和这件事有关。他们最近在沼泽地里建立了一个被称作黑蹄村的定居点，就在这里的东北方向。去黑蹄村寻找更多莫萨恩的武器制品吧。
text.progress: What did your search of Blackhoof Village reveal?
text.completion: This is unmistakably the work of Mosarn. Questioning him further may draw too much attention, but we have a bit more freedom in dealing with the Grimtotems.
text.completed: Return to Krog at Brackenwall Village in Dustwallow Marsh.

english.title: More than Coincidence
english.objectives: Collect 7 Blackhoof Armaments from Blackhoof Village.
english.description: We've gleaned as much as we can from the ruins of the inn. I'm concerned about where the investigation will lead us from here, but we must know the truth.$B$BBetween the hoofprints and the shield with Mosarn's mark, I'm lead to believe that the Grimtotems may have been involved. They've recently established a settlement in the swamp, Blackhoof Village to the northeast. Travel to Blackhoof Village and search for more arms of Mosarn's manufacture.
english.progress: What did your search of Blackhoof Village reveal?
english.completion: This is unmistakably the work of Mosarn. Questioning him further may draw too much attention, but we have a bit more freedom in dealing with the Grimtotems.
english.completed: Return to Krog at Brackenwall Village in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: 寻找塔贝萨
text.objectives: 前往泥潭沼泽的农场，与那里的塔贝萨谈一谈。
text.description: 你在黑蹄村找到的武器似乎并未在实战中使用过，只是用作练习器械而已，这意味着摧毁树荫旅店的恐怖图腾部队仍然逍遥法外。$B$B在南面，泥潭沼泽的中心，有一位名叫塔贝萨的女巫。尽管她是个人类，但是她很值得我们尊重，而且她还帮助我们训练了一些法师。$B$B去寻求她的帮助，寻找那些焚毁旅店的恐怖图腾部队。一定不能让联盟觉得我们是和恐怖图腾串通一气的。
text.completion: Krog wishes me to scry for the Grimtotems, eh? Well, I have no need of magic in this case. It seems we have a mutual enemy. The Grimtotems have built an outpost nearby and are a constant thorn in the side of me and my students.

english.title: Seek Out Tabetha
english.objectives: Speak with Tabetha at her farm in the Quagmire.
english.description: The arms you captured in Blackhoof Village have not seen any combat beyond mere training exercises, which means the Grimtotems who destroyed the Shady Rest are still at large.$B$BTo the south, in the heart of the Quagmire, lives the witch Tabetha. Though she is a human, she has dealt honorably with us and trained some of our mages.$B$BAsk her for assistance in tracking down the band of Grimtotem responsible for burning the inn. The Alliance must not be allowed to think we were complicit in the attack.
english.completion: Krog wishes me to scry for the Grimtotems, eh? Well, I have no need of magic in this case. It seems we have a mutual enemy. The Grimtotems have built an outpost nearby and are a constant thorn in the side of me and my students.

text.title: 烧毁恐角岗哨！
text.objectives: 使用塔贝萨的火炬烧毁恐角岗哨的北部帐篷、东部帐篷和东北部帐篷。
text.description: 根本没有必要用水晶球来看看我们的新“邻居”在干些什么。如果你所言非虚，这就是焚毁树荫旅店的那支部队，那么我们也没有理由再容忍他们的存在。$B$B拿上这根火把，将他们的营地夷为平地吧！你可以在我的农场略北一些，靠近大路的地方找到恐角岗哨。你不可能看不到，真的，因为恐怖图腾在那里竖着许多非常华丽的图腾，以此表明他们对图腾的喜爱。
text.progress: Have you put that torch to good use?
text.completion: The Grimtotems should have no trouble understanding our latest message. As for you, your contact at Brackenwall Village will want to know of your success. If I know him, he'll appreciate the taste of vengeance.
text.completed: Return to Tabetha at Tabetha's Farm in Dustwallow Marsh.

english.title: Raze Direhorn Post!
english.objectives: Use Tabetha's Torch to burn he North Tent, East Tent, and the Northeast Tent at Direhorn Post.
english.description: There's no scrying necessary to see the trouble my new "neighbors" are creating. And if this is the band that burnt down the Shady Rest Inn, as you claim, there's no reason to tolerate their presence any longer.$B$BTake this torch and raze their camp to the ground! You'll find Direhorn just to the north of my farm, near the road. You can't miss it, really, as the Grimtotems have done a splendid job of announcing their presence with those totems they favor.
english.progress: Have you put that torch to good use?
english.completion: The Grimtotems should have no trouble understanding our latest message. As for you, your contact at Brackenwall Village will want to know of your success. If I know him, he'll appreciate the taste of vengeance.
english.completed: Return to Tabetha at Tabetha's Farm in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: 伸张正义
text.objectives: 回到蕨墙村的克罗格那里复命。
text.description: 我不相信恐怖图腾会放弃他们把人类赶出沼泽的行动。不过至少我们惩治了对树荫旅店下毒手的罪犯。$B$B去告诉你的领袖，他的复仇已报。
text.completion: I'm impressed, $n. I would've thought that the Grimtotem criminals would've been more difficult to locate. The Alliance are truly incompetent. In truth, I just sought to answer the death of one of my men, but this situation has been more fortunate than expected. If the Grimtotem choose to retaliate, it will likely be against the Alliance. Perhaps we will soon have the manpower to drive the scum from these shores once and for all.

english.title: Justice Dispensed
english.objectives: Return to Krog at Brackenwall Village.
english.description: I doubt the Grimtotems will give up their campaign to drive humans from the marsh, though I get the impression you probably don't mind that. At least we have dealt with the perpetrators of the crimes at the Shady Rest Inn.$B$BGo tell your leader that his vengeance has been sated.
english.completion: I'm impressed, $n. I would've thought that the Grimtotem criminals would've been more difficult to locate. The Alliance are truly incompetent. In truth, I just sought to answer the death of one of my men, but this situation has been more fortunate than expected. If the Grimtotem choose to retaliate, it will likely be against the Alliance. Perhaps we will soon have the manpower to drive the scum from these shores once and for all.

text.title: 找到阿瓦罗斯·晨刃
text.objectives: 与奥格瑞玛兵营的阿瓦罗斯·晨刃交谈。
text.description: 高阶血骑士兼酋长的顾问阿瓦罗斯·晨刃想让你去奥格瑞玛跑一趟。$n，他对你的训练课程很感兴趣，迫切地想跟你谈谈。$B$B他也没说为什么要找你，不过你最好尽快赶往奥格瑞玛。你可以在荣誉谷的兵营里找到阿瓦罗斯·晨刃。
text.completion: I've heard much about you, $n. You have a bright future ahead of you in the Horde.
text.completed: 与奥格瑞玛兵营的阿瓦罗斯·晨刃交谈。

english.title: Seek Out Master Pyreanor
english.objectives: Speak with Master Pyreanor in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength.
english.description: Master Pyreanor, a senior Blood Knight and advisor to the warchief, requires your presence in Orgrimmar. He has taken an interest in your training, $n, and it is imperative that you speak with him immediately.$B$BThe message I received didn't mention the reason he requested your visit, but you should set out for Orgrimmar right away. Master Pyreanor can be found in the keep in the center of the Valley of Strength.
english.completion: I've heard much about you, $n. You have a bright future ahead of you in the Horde.

text.title: 撕裂的大地
text.objectives: 消灭3根厄索拉斯的触须。
text.description: 我们不需要太多理由去对付暮光仆从——他们已经成为了我们的敌人。我们来这里参加战斗，所以我们在进入溪谷要塞之前可能需要你的帮助。$B$B你肯定已经注意到，暮光仆从已经把厄索拉斯从地下带到了南方。它的触须遍布在我们周围的地面上。如果你愿意，我们希望你能帮忙击退那些触须。
text.completion: Tank ya, $c. A bit of breathin' room helps a lot.
text.completed: Return to Earthcaller Torunscar at the Ring of the Elements in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Torn Ground
english.objectives: Kill 3 Tentacles of Iso'rath.
english.description: It won't be takin' much convincin' to turn us against da Twilight - dat's already our goal. We've already come to battle here though, so we may be needin' ya help before we can turn towards dey're fortress.$B$BDa Twilight have already brought Iso'rath up from da ground to the south, I'm sure ya noticed. It's tentacles have been burstin' from da ground all around us. We could use a hand beatin' them down if you be willin'.
english.completion: Tank ya, $c. A bit of breathin' room helps a lot.
english.completed: Return to Earthcaller Torunscar at the Ring of the Elements in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 击退
text.objectives: 在德拉卡戈废墟杀死12名暮光之锤。
text.description: 暮光之锤已经摧毁了南边的龙喉村，在那里举行仪式。不要让他们有念动咒语的时间。跟他们战斗！
text.completion: Revenge is bittersweet, but I'm glad we be havin' someone as powerful as you do see dis done.
text.completed: Return to Earthcaller Torunscar at the Ring of the Elements in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Pushing Back
english.objectives: Kill 12 Twilight's Hammer at the Ruins of Drakgor.
english.description: Da Twilight's Hammer have destroyed a Dragonmaw town to the south and are performin' dey're summonin' rituals from there. Offer dem no respite to continue wit dey're incantations. Bring tha battle to dem!
english.completion: Revenge is bittersweet, but I'm glad we be havin' someone as powerful as you do see dis done.
english.completed: Return to Earthcaller Torunscar at the Ring of the Elements in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 牢不可破
text.objectives: 去找德拉卡戈废墟的唤地者耶法。
text.description: 我们正在准备一个仪式，或许可以摧毁厄索拉斯。它被暮光之锤从地底带来，是一名滋生憎恶的古神。攻打他们营地的时候，我们其中最强大的成员之一遭到了俘虏，计划被拖延了。$B$B唤地者耶法就在南部的废墟里。她还没有死。我敢肯定。请把她救出来。要是我们中有谁值得你去帮助的话，那就只有她了。
text.completion: Thank the elements that you've come. Did my brothers send you?

english.title: Unbroken
english.objectives: Find Earthcaller Yevaa within the Ruins of Drakgor.
english.description: We are preparing a ritual that may be of use in destroying Iso'rath, the old god bred abomination that the Twilight's Hammer have brought up from the depths. We are delayed though, for one of our strongest was captured during an assault on their encampment.$B$BEarthcaller Yevaa is within the ruins to the south. She is not dead. I am sure of it. Please, rescue her. If any of us is deserving of your aid, it is her.
english.completion: Thank the elements that you've come. Did my brothers send you?

text.title: 简单的解决方案
text.objectives: 收集10桶柴燃油。
text.description: 我是新来的。初来乍到。但你知道吗？这反而让我视野独特！$B$B我的这些萨满朋友已经干下了丰功伟业，可他们头脑太简单了！他们依赖于元素，却忘了把周围的普通材料利用起来。$B$B在南部的废墟里，我看到暮光的暴徒们拖着成桶的可燃油！那些是用来焚烧镇子用的。要我说，咱们就用它把他们铲除。
text.progress: I wonder what happens when you douse an elemental with that stuff. Jumbo-super-bonfire-elemental? I'm thinkin' so. We'll have to try.
text.completion: Now that's what I'm talkin' about! Can you think of all the uses for this stuff? I definitely can't. But I can think of a lot, and I'm liking the possibilities.
text.completed: Return to Initiate Goldmine at the Ring of the Elements in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Simple Solutions
english.objectives: Gather 10 barrels of Pyreburn Oil.
english.description: I'm new to this gig. Very new. But ya know what? That gives me perspective!$B$BThese shaman buddies of mine have come upon somethin' great, but they're too single minded! They lean on the elements and they forget to make use of the common materials all around them.$B$BIn the ruins to the south, I saw those Twilight goons tote in barrels of flammable oil! They used it when they razed the town. I say we use it when we raze them.
english.progress: I wonder what happens when you douse an elemental with that stuff. Jumbo-super-bonfire-elemental? I'm thinkin' so. We'll have to try.
english.completion: Now that's what I'm talkin' about! Can you think of all the uses for this stuff? I definitely can't. But I can think of a lot, and I'm liking the possibilities.
english.completed: Return to Initiate Goldmine at the Ring of the Elements in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 解脱
text.objectives: 收集5颗血肉灼烧者之心。
text.description: 倒不能说我不打算待在这儿，我们的仪式需要材料……为了找到它们，我耽搁了一会，结果我就被俘了。$B$B我会回到法阵去的，不过如果你能把我未竟的事业完成，我会非常感谢你的。暮光之锤在营地西部奴役了火元素，我们需要它们的心。$B$B元素已经没救了，它们的牺牲可以化为复仇。$B$B到营地去找我。
text.progress: Did you recover the hearts?
text.completion: Thank you, $n. You are quite capable. I'm extremely grateful that you've chosen to aid us.
text.completed: Speak to Earthcaller Yevaa at the Ring of the Elements in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Mercy for the Bound
english.objectives: Gather 5 Fleshburner Hearts.
english.description: It goes without saying that I had no desire to stay here, but there were materials we needed for the ritual... I delayed to secure them, and that is what lead to my capture.$B$BI will return to the circle, but I would be indebted to you if you would finish what I could not. We need hearts from the bound fire elementals that the Twilight's Hammer enslave in the western portion of the encampment.$B$BThe elementals are without hope, but in this sacrifice they can extract their revenge.$B$BFind me at camp.
english.progress: Did you recover the hearts?
english.completion: Thank you, $n. You are quite capable. I'm extremely grateful that you've chosen to aid us.
english.completed: Speak to Earthcaller Yevaa at the Ring of the Elements in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 与阿瓦罗斯·晨刃碰面
text.objectives: 与奥格瑞玛兵营的阿瓦罗斯·晨刃交谈。
text.description: 奥格瑞玛的阿瓦罗斯·晨刃捎话来说，他想跟你谈谈。不用说你也知道，阿瓦罗斯是一位备受尊重的高阶圣骑士，绝不可轻视他的请求。$B$B下次路过奥格瑞玛的时候，就去荣誉谷的兵营里找他吧。
text.completion: I've heard much of your contributions to the Horde, $n.
text.completed: 与奥格瑞玛兵营的阿瓦罗斯·晨刃交谈。

english.title: Follow the Sun
english.objectives: Speak with Sunwalker Atohmo in Orgrimmar's Valley of Wisdom.
english.description: Sunwalker Atohmo sends word from Orgrimmar -- he wishes to speak with you when you're in the city. I needn't remind you that Atohmo is an honored member of our order and his requests should not be ignored.$B$BNext time you are in Orgrimmar, travel to the Valley of Wisdom and speak with him.
english.completion: I've heard much of your contributions to the Horde, $n.

text.title: 爱与家庭
text.objectives: 找到“爱与家庭”。
text.description: 血色十字军堡垒里有一幅画，它对大领主提里奥·弗丁有着特别的意义。去寻找一幅绘有孪生双月的画。把上面的油漆铲掉，你就可以找到杰作“爱与家庭”。愿圣光指引你的行动，另外，请你处理画的时候格外小心。
text.progress: 画，$N。你找到画了吗?
text.completion: Master Fordring will be glad beyond measure to see this painting again.
text.completed: Return to Crusade Commaner Eligor Dawnbringer.

english.title: Of Love and Family
english.objectives: Find 'Of Love and Family.'
english.description: Inside the Scarlet Bastion is a painting of great personal value to Highlord Tirion Fordring. Search for a painting of our twin moons. Chip away at the paint until you uncover the master work, 'Of Love and Family.'$B$BMay the Light guide your actions, and please handle the painting with the utmost care.
english.progress: The painting, $n. Do you have the painting?
english.completion: Master Fordring will be glad beyond measure to see this painting again.
english.completed: Return to Crusade Commaner Eligor Dawnbringer.

starters.name: 十字军指挥官埃里戈尔·黎明使者

enders.name: 十字军指挥官埃里戈尔·黎明使者

text.title: 与奥格隆交谈
text.objectives: 在蕨墙村的东南方找到奥格隆。
text.description: 我认识这个人类，帕瓦尔·雷瑟上尉。就连像他这样的人也算是个悲剧。他背叛了自己的士兵，眼下正躲在森林中。$b$b我派奥格隆去追捕他了。有人怀疑他在偷窃我们的补给品。我记得奥格隆是朝东南方去了。
text.completion: Ogron? Yeah, that me. Shh. Keep voice down. Crocs hear you.

english.title: Talk to Ogron
english.objectives: Find Ogron to the southeast of Brackenwall Village.
english.description: I know this human, Paval Reethe. Pathetic, even for his kind. He deserted his fellow soldiers and is now hiding out in the woods.$b$bI sent Ogron out to track him down. Some of the others suspect he's been stealing from our supplies. I think I saw Ogron heading off to the southeast.
english.completion: Ogron? Yeah, that me. Shh. Keep voice down. Crocs hear you.

text.title: 元素的呐喊
text.objectives: 跟暴风城的石语者埃鲁纳克谈一谈。
text.description: 你感觉到了吗，$C？元素生物陷入焦虑难安的状态。大地之环的成员正在努力查明这场动乱的真相。但是迄今为止我们仍一无所获，只能求助于一切可能的援助力量。跟暴风城的石语者埃鲁纳克谈一谈，看看你能不能帮上忙。
text.completion: I'm glad you've come, $c.  These are troublesome times and we could use all the help we can get.
text.completed: 跟暴风城的石语者埃鲁纳克谈一谈。

Thus far we have been unsuccessful and now turn to others that may aid us.  Speak with Erunak Stonespeaker in Stormwind and see how you might be able to aid us.

text.objectives: Collect 4 Grimtotem Notes from Grimtotem Elders and combine them to form the full Grimtotem Battle Plan.
text.description: With the activities of the Grimtotems in Thousand Needles brought to light, many tauren now regard them with suspicion.  We've seen high-ranking Grimtotems engage in murder and kidnapping to advance their interests and I fear we may become their next target.$B$BBlackhoof Village, to the northeast, near Bluefen, is a large new Grimtotem settlement. Their leaders, the elders, will all have orders from Thunder Bluff. See if you can capture the orders and piece them together to learn the Grimtotems' plans.

text.objectives: 烧毁8个恐怖图腾武器架。
text.description: 好吧，这些懦夫想打仗？让我们瞧瞧他们没兵器怎么打。$B$B我确信你肯定有火把或别的什么，烧了他们的武器架。$B$B统统烧光！
text.completion: Let's see them wage their war now!

text.objectives: 在黑云峰杀死20名恐怖图腾牛头人。
text.description: 没有别的办法。你想要赢得战斗，就得流血。眼下来说……得流很多血。$B$B你知道我们该怎么做。
text.completion: That put a dent in their numbers! Can't say that they didn't deserve it.
text.completed: 跟千针石林黑云峰的菲拉斯哨兵谈一谈。

english.description: There's no way around it. If you want to win a battle, you have to spill some blood. In this case... a lot of it.$B$BYou know what we have to do.

text.objectives: 在黑云峰杀死20名恐怖图腾牛头人。

text.objectives: 杀死伊莎·暗斧。
text.description: 哨兵训练条例101款：射人射马，擒贼擒王。我们正要这么做，$c。$B$B伊莎·暗斧是恐怖图腾酋长中距离我们最近的一个。让我们瞧瞧她到底几斤几两。
text.completion: She was tougher than I thought. We worked well together, but we're going to have to make sure not to underestimate the other Grimtotem chiefs.
text.completed: 跟千针石林黑云峰的菲拉斯哨兵谈一谈。
text.giverWindow: 由于对乱风岗犯下的罪行，她必须受到惩罚！

text.objectives: 杀死伊莎·暗斧。
text.description: 基本的士气理论告诉我们，如果你杀死了敌方首领，他们很快就会溃不成军。这就是我们要去干的事儿，$c。$B$B伊莎·暗斧是最容易下手的恐怖图腾酋长。我们来试试看她和她的斧头有多厉害，而她将会发现自己是多么不堪一击。
text.completion: She was more formidable than her reputation suggested. Although we worked well together, we must make certain not to underestimate the other Grimtotem chiefs.
text.completed: 跟千针石林黑云峰的乱风岗卫士谈一谈。
text.giverWindow: 由于对乱风岗犯下的罪行，她必须受到惩罚！

text.objectives: 将骨鸣响器交给千针石林黑云峰的菲拉斯哨兵。
text.description: 这是一件牛头人的响器，渗着超自然的力量。其持有者被杀了，神器自然任人宰割。$B$B也许哨兵能洞悉其中奥妙所在？

text.objectives: 杀死雷蹄长老。
text.description: 雷蹄长老是一名具有无比力量的萨满。据信，他是巫婆长老、恐怖图腾氏族领袖玛加萨·恐怖图腾的嫡系信徒。$B$B我们得知他在这里训练他们的地卜师。我们得杀了他，$c。

text.objectives: 找到历史文书。
text.description: 在舒哈鲁神话里，骨鸣响器连接着历史文书和战争之鼓。它们都是强大的牛头人神器。$B$B要想找到另外两件，我们必须擦亮眼睛。假如传说是真的，那么文书看起来应该像是某种象形文字卷轴。
text.progress: We'll need the actual writ, not just any tauren scroll hanging.
text.completion: I'm fairly certain that's it. This is very intriguing, $n. What are they doing here? Are they being used as a weapon? The wind serpent flew northwest to that next bluff. Maybe that's where the drums are?
text.completed: Give the Writ of History to the Feralas Sentinel at Darkcloud Pinnacle in Thousand Needles.

They are supposed to be powerful tauren artifacts.$B$BWe must keep our eyes peeled if we're to find the other two. The writ will most likely look like some kind of pictographic scroll if the stories are to be believed.

text.progress: Korok is dead?

text.description: 无论恐怖图腾要战争之鼓来干吗，我们都不能让他们得逞。$B$B不要担心，$n，我们会查清楚怎么回事的。但首先，需要把神器收集齐。
text.progress: War is not an activity to engage in for those who are faithful to the Earth Mother's teachings.
text.completion: Surely that was the voice of the Elder Crone! We must be very careful, $n. Great danger lies ahead if Magatha Grimtotem has taken notice of you.
text.completed: Give the Drums of War to the Freewind Brave at Darkcloud Pinnacle in Thousand Needles.

english.title: The Drums of War
english.objectives: Collect the Drums of War.
english.description: Whatever it is that the Grimtotem are doing with the Drums of War, we do not want them to keep them.$B$BDo not worry, $n, we will figure out what is going on here. But first, we need to gather all of the artifacts.
english.progress: War is not an activity to engage in for those who are faithful to the Earth Mother's teachings.
english.completion: Surely that was the voice of the Elder Crone! We must be very careful, $n. Great danger lies ahead if Magatha Grimtotem has taken notice of you.
english.completed: Give the Drums of War to the Freewind Brave at Darkcloud Pinnacle in Thousand Needles.

text.title: 恐怖图腾酋长：酋长之首
text.objectives: 杀死阿纳克·恐怖图腾。
text.description: 现在是解决黑云峰所有恐怖图腾的首领：阿纳克·恐怖图腾的时候了。$B$B据说他是巫婆长老、恐怖图腾氏族主母玛加萨·恐怖图腾的不肖侄子。据信，他的轻率鲁莽导致了双方的疏远。$B$B不过现在那些都不重要。重要的是我们要杀了他。做个了断。
text.completion: For some reason they all think that you've been sent by Magatha Grimtotem. I know it must have something to do with that wind serpent that's been hanging around. Doesn't matter. Their leader is dead. It's only a matter of time before the tauren of Freewind Post regain their home. If I were them, I'd push back a little to teach the Grimtotem a lesson, but they probably won't. They're tauren.
text.completed: 跟千针石林黑云峰的菲拉斯哨兵谈一谈。
text.giverWindow: 巫婆长老的侄子，酋长之首。击败他！

english.title: Grimtotem Chiefs: The Chief of Chiefs
english.objectives: Slay Arnak Grimtotem.
english.description: And now the time has come to take out the leader of all of the Darkcloud Pinnacle Grimtotem: Arnak Grimtotem.$B$BIt is said that he's the disgraced nephew of Magatha Grimtotem, the Elder Crone and matriarch of the Grimtotem clan. Supposedly, his indiscretions have left him in a state of disfavor with her.$B$BBut none of that matters right now. All that matters is that we kill him. For good this time.
english.completion: For some reason they all think that you've been sent by Magatha Grimtotem. I know it must have something to do with that wind serpent that's been hanging around. Doesn't matter. Their leader is dead. It's only a matter of time before the tauren of Freewind Post regain their home. If I were them, I'd push back a little to teach the Grimtotem a lesson, but they probably won't. They're tauren.
english.completed: Speak with the Feralas Sentinel at Darkcloud Pinnacle in Thousand Needles.
english.giverWindow: Nephew of the Elder Crone. The Chief of Chiefs. Slay him!

text.title: 恐怖图腾酋长：酋长之首
text.objectives: 杀死阿纳克·恐怖图腾。
text.description: 是时候对付黑云峰所有恐怖图腾的首领：阿纳克·恐怖图腾了。$B$B他就是恐怖图腾氏族的主母，巫婆长老玛加萨·恐怖图腾的不肖侄子。他的轻率鲁莽导致了双方的疏远。$B$B现在那些都不重要了。重要的是我们要对付他。就此了结。
text.completion: They all believed that you have been sent by Magatha Grimtotem. There is no arguing that her pet, Arikara, has been lurking about. It does not matter. Arnak is dead. It is only a matter of time before we take back Freewind Post. Perhaps now we will be able to establish a lasting peace with the Grimtotem?
text.completed: 跟千针石林黑云峰的乱风岗卫士谈一谈。
text.giverWindow: 巫婆长老的侄子，酋长之首。杀掉他！

english.title: Grimtotem Chiefs: The Chief of Chiefs
english.objectives: Slay Arnak Grimtotem.
english.description: The time has come to deal with the leader of the Darkcloud Pinnacle Grimtotem: Arnak Grimtotem.$B$BHe is the disgraced nephew of Magatha Grimtotem, the Elder Crone and matriarch of the Grimtotem clan. His indiscretions have left him in a state of disfavor with her.$B$BNone of that matters now. All that matters is that we deal with him. Once and for all.
english.completion: They all believed that you have been sent by Magatha Grimtotem. There is no arguing that her pet, Arikara, has been lurking about. It does not matter. Arnak is dead. It is only a matter of time before we take back Freewind Post. Perhaps now we will be able to establish a lasting peace with the Grimtotem?
english.completed: Speak with the Freewind Brave at Darkcloud Pinnacle in Thousand Needles.
english.giverWindow: Nephew of the Elder Crone. The Chief of Chiefs. Slay him!

text.title: 打草惊蛇
text.objectives: 打败阿利卡拉。
text.description: 我熟悉这些神器。我相信它们是由玛加萨·恐怖图腾亲自带来的。不过她并没有同黑云峰的恐怖图腾混迹一处。她来这里不久就消失了，没有人知道去了哪里。$B$B也许我们可以找到她。$B$B把响器、文书和战鼓带到阿利卡拉针石去。假如我的猜测没错，风蛇一定会再次出现。你必须打败它，才能知道玛加萨的藏身之处。
text.completion: So, she's been taken prisoner by the Twilight's Hammer. I can't say that I feel sorry for her, but she might prove even more dangerous in their hands.
text.completed: Return to Lakota Windsong at Darkcloud Pinnacle in Thousand Needles.
text.giverWindow: 玛加萨·恐怖图腾的魔仆

english.title: Invoking the Serpent
english.objectives: Defeat Arikara.
english.description: I am familiar with these artifacts. I believe that they were brought here by Magatha Grimtotem herself. But she's not amongst the Grimtotem on Darkcloud Pinnacle. She disappeared right after she arrived, and no one knows where she is now.$B$BMaybe we can find out.$B$BTake the rattle, the writ, and the drum out to Arikara's Needle. If my guess is correct, the wind serpent will appear again. You'll have to defeat it to gain knowledge of where Magatha is hiding.
english.completion: So, she's been taken prisoner by the Twilight's Hammer. I can't say that I feel sorry for her, but she might prove even more dangerous in their hands.
english.completed: Return to Lakota Windsong at Darkcloud Pinnacle in Thousand Needles.
english.giverWindow: Familiar of Magatha Grimtotem.

She disappeared right after she arrived, and no one knows where she is now.$B$BMaybe we can find out.$B$BTake the rattle, the writ, and the drum out to Arikara's Needle. If my guess is correct, the wind serpent will appear again. You'll have to defeat it to gain knowledge of where Magatha is hiding.
english.completion: So, she's been taken prisoner by the Twilight's Hammer. I can't say that I feel sorry for her, but she might prove even more dangerous in their hands.
