text.title: 崭露头角的医师
text.objectives: 去影牙城堡指挥官斯普林瓦尔处收集指挥官的神圣符记，还有5捆月触之木和5份幽灵精华。
text.description: 你证明了自己是一名优秀的牧师、诺莫瑞根人民的骄傲。大工匠和暴风城国王希望能够荣誉表彰你的贡献。$B$B他们已经委托皇家附魔师制作一把特殊的法杖。$B$B这把武器的材料只能从银松森林被诅咒的影牙城堡里获得。去那里将失落的指挥官的神圣符记找到，并收集一些月触之木，以及在城堡里游荡的鬼魂的精华来。
text.progress: Did you bring the materials I'll need for your weapon?
text.completion: I can't believe you managed to get all those materials. I wouldn't think of venturing into Shadowfang Keep! The stories about that place are horrific. Enough of that, though. This is a time to recognize your achievements, not prattle on about my silly fears.
text.completed: Speak to Lucan Cordell in Stormwind's Mage Quarter.

english.title: A Budding Young Surgeon
english.objectives: Go to Shadowfang Keep and obtain the Commander's Holy Symbol from Commander Springvale, 5 bundles of Moontouched Wood, and 5 Ghostly Essence.
english.description: You have shown yourself to be a capable priest and a credit to the people of Gnomeregan. The high tinker and the king of Stormwind wish to honor your contribution to the Alliance.$B$BThey have commissioned the royal enchanter to create a special staff.$B$BThe materials for such a weapon can only be found in the cursed Shadowfang Keep in Silverpine Forest. Travel there and find the lost holy symbol of Commander Springvale, a supply of moontouched wood, and ghostly essence from the spirits haunting the keep.
english.progress: Did you bring the materials I'll need for your weapon?
english.completion: I can't believe you managed to get all those materials. I wouldn't think of venturing into Shadowfang Keep! The stories about that place are horrific. Enough of that, though. This is a time to recognize your achievements, not prattle on about my silly fears.
english.completed: Speak to Lucan Cordell in Stormwind's Mage Quarter.

text.title: 谁下的令？
text.objectives: 获得高级指挥官的命令。
text.description: <死亡通讯器响起了一阵蜂鸣声。>$B$B第七军团乃是一支精英特种军团。几乎联盟的每一次主要进攻和军事冲突，幕后总有他们。这是个坏消息。他们是怎么绕过我们的战舰的？是谁下的命令让他们来的？$B$B我们得弄到他们的命令。这个叫皮亚托的人物毫无疑问有着重要情报。在吉尔尼斯城教堂区找到他，把他干掉。在他的尸体上寻找线索。
text.progress: 情况如何?
text.completion: An Alliance armada is en route? How could this have happened? You've got to hurry, $n. We're being overrun up here at Forward Command.
text.completed: Speak with Forward Commander Onslaught at Forsaken Forward Command in the Ruins of Gilneas.
text.giverWindow: 扎伦是你的下一个目标。
text.turninWindow: 被遗忘者前线指挥部要失守啦。
text.turninTarget: 前锋军指挥官昂斯洛特

english.title: On Whose Orders?
english.objectives: Recover the Orders from High Command.
english.description: <The F.C.D. buzzes.>$B$BThe 7th Legion are an elite special ops regiment. They've been there, behind the scenes, for almost every major offensive and military engagement the Alliance has ever done. This is bad news. How did they get past our warships? And on whose orders are they here?$B$BWe need to get our hands on their orders. This Pietro character will undoubtedly have vital information. Find him at the Cathedral Quarter in Gilneas City and take him out. Search his corpse for clues.
english.progress: Status?
english.completion: An Alliance armada is en route? How could this have happened? You've got to hurry, $n. We're being overrun up here at Forward Command.
english.completed: Speak with Forward Commander Onslaught at Forsaken Forward Command in the Ruins of Gilneas.
english.giverWindow: Zaren is your next target.

starters.name: 前锋军指挥官昂斯洛特

enders.name: 前锋军指挥官昂斯洛特

text.title: 合适的武器
text.objectives: 进入影牙城堡，从席瓦莱恩男爵那里夺得席瓦莱恩家族佩剑，还有5箱月钢锭和5束不死肌腱。
text.description: 从一开始，你的训练师就看出来你终有一日将在部落的留下你自己的印记。你战斗英勇，敌人闻风而惧。$B$B作为你献身精神的奖赏，酋长已经委托他的私人工匠为你铸造一把特殊的武器。$B$B银松森林被诅咒的影牙城堡是唯一一个可以获得你所需材料的地方。去那里弄来席瓦莱恩家族佩剑、一些月钢锭，还有在城堡里出没的食尸鬼和恶鬼的肌腱。
text.progress: Did you bring the materials I'll need for your weapon?
text.completion: Grezz Ragefist told me to expect you. Those materials will make a fine sword. Always use it for the glory of the Horde.
text.completed: Speak to Saru Steelfury in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor.

english.title: A Fitting Weapon
english.objectives: Go to Shadowfang Keep and obtain the Silverlaine Family Sword from Baron Silverlaine, 5 crates of Moonsteel Ingots, and 5 Deathless Sinew.
english.description: From your earliest days, your trainers always knew you would make your mark on the Horde. You have fought bravely and given our enemies reason to fear.$B$BAs a reward for your dedication, the warchief has commissioned his personal smith to forge a special weapon.$B$BThe cursed Shadowfang Keep in Silverpine Forest is the only place to get the materials you'll need. Travel there and find the lost Silverlaine family sword, a supply of moonsteel ingots, and sinew from the ghouls and geists infesting the keep.
english.progress: Did you bring the materials I'll need for your weapon?
english.completion: Grezz Ragefist told me to expect you. Those materials will make a fine sword. Always use it for the glory of the Horde.
english.completed: Speak to Saru Steelfury in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor.

text.title: 夺取海滩
text.objectives: 在暮光高地的暮光海滩干掉12名斧咬陆战队员。
text.description: 海滩上到处都是部落的斧咬陆战队员。$B$B<海军上尉埃姆利指向北面的海滩。>$B$B干掉他们。
text.completion: Dead? By the dozen? It's a start, $c. It's a start.
text.completed: Report your success to Lieutenant Emry on the Twilight Shores in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Landgrab
english.objectives: Slay 12 Axebite Marines on the Twilight Shores in Twilight Highlands.
english.description: The Horde's Axebite Marines are all up in my precious, precious beach.$B$B<The Lieutenant points north, along the shore.>$B$BKill them.
english.completion: Dead? By the dozen? It's a start, $c. It's a start.
english.completed: Report your success to Lieutenant Emry on the Twilight Shores in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 吉德文·金须
text.objectives: 去找东瘟疫之地的吉德文·金须。
text.description: 我爱我的小伙子们，别想歪了。但我告诉他们，我需要五分钟来歇歇马，他们干了些什么呢？他们打了一个愚蠢的赌，然后就跑掉了！我就知道……这种事情总是有。$b$b吉德文是那个矮个子的。他沿着河朝北边去了。要是你往那个方向走的话，能不能叫他回来？我们得赶去圣光之愿礼拜堂，其实我倒是不反对撇下他。
text.completion: Tarenar?  Is that you? Whoever you are, would you mind helping me out of this thing?
text.giverWindow: 帮我找到吉德文！

english.title: Gidwin Goldbraids
english.objectives: Find Gidwin Goldbraids in Eastern Plaguelands.
english.description: I love my boys, don't get me wrong.  But I TOLD them that I needed FIVE MINUTES to water and brush the horses, and what did they do?  They made a stupid bet with each other and ran off!  I should have known better... this always happens.$b$bGidwin's the short one.  He headed north, along the river.  If you're headed that direction, would you tell him to come back?  We've got to get to Light's Hope Chapel, and I'm not against leaving without him.
english.completion: Tarenar?  Is that you? Whoever you are, would you mind helping me out of this thing?
english.giverWindow: Help me find Gidwin!

text.title: 缚手缚脚
text.objectives: 从恶蛛隧道中的蛛魔身上收集8瓶地穴蛛魔胆汁。
text.description: 你应该看到我的战绩了吧！我杀的肯定至少有六只怪物，在我……$b$b噢，等等，你会数数儿的，对吧？那么好吧。我杀了四只，然后第五只用网困住了我。更糟糕的是，当它把这堆粘稠的蛛网液体喷向我的时候，我的嘴正好是张开的！$B$B看样子我是扯不断这张网了，换作是你估计也不行。所以你得从那些亡灵蜘蛛肚子里弄点胃液来，就可以融掉蛛网了。
text.progress: Oh boy... Fiona is going to be madder than a wet harpy.  You'd better hurry.
text.completion: You're back?!  Thank the Light! Before you throw that acid on me, I need to ask: Are you the guy who was here before, or are you one of those eight-legged cowards?  I need to know whether or not I should smack you on my way out.
text.completed: Return to Gidwin Goldbraids at the Thondroril River in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: Just Encased
english.objectives: Obtain 8 vials of Crypt Bile from nerubians in Terrorweb Tunnel.
english.description: You should have seen me fight!  I must have killed six of those beasts, when...$b$bOh wait, you can count the bodies, can't you?  OK, fine.  I killed four of them, when the fifth one shot me with this web.  To make things even worse... when he blasted me with web juice, my mouth was open!$b$bI can't seem to break these webs, and I doubt you'll be able to, either.  No, you'll have to get some of the stomach juice from those undead spider-things.  That'll do the trick.
english.progress: Oh boy... Fiona is going to be madder than a wet harpy.  You'd better hurry.
english.completion: You're back?!  Thank the Light! Before you throw that acid on me, I need to ask: Are you the guy who was here before, or are you one of those eight-legged cowards?  I need to know whether or not I should smack you on my way out.
english.completed: Return to Gidwin Goldbraids at the Thondroril River in Eastern Plaguelands.

text.title: 讨好之举
text.objectives: 在索多里尔河沿岸采集10朵女妖之铃。
text.description: 很抱歉，我还以为你是那些蜘蛛怪物假扮的$r呢。$b$b你好，我是吉德文·金须，很乐意为你效劳。我急着赶回马车那里去，不过你能不能再帮我最后一个忙？我的伙伴菲奥拉开了一家小店，她可能用得到生长在河岸边的一种草药。$b$b如果我们给她一些上等草药的话，她就不大可能宰了我啦。反正，我是这么打算的。
text.progress: Giddy's got you mixed up in all of this now?
text.completion: I'll tear that pint-size paladin to shreds before he... wait a minute are those Banshee's Bells?  You brought these for me? Oh, Gidwin asked you to get them for me!  That sweet little guy.  Alright.  He's off the hook for now.
text.completed: Return to Fiona at the Thondroril River in Western Plaguelands.

english.title: Greasing the Wheel
english.objectives: Loot 10 Banshee's Bells from the shore of the Thondroril River.
english.description: Sorry about that.  I was pretty sure you were one of those spider-beasts, doing a bad $r impression.$b$bHow do you do?  Gidwin Goldbraids, at your service.  I'm in a bit of a hurry back to my caravan, but I was wondering if you might do me one last favor?  My pal Fiona runs a small shop, and she could probably use some of these herbs that grow along the river shore.$b$bI'm thinking if we give her some nice herbs, she'll be MUCH less likely to murder me.  That's the plan, anyway.
english.progress: Giddy's got you mixed up in all of this now?
english.completion: I'll tear that pint-size paladin to shreds before he... wait a minute are those Banshee's Bells?  You brought these for me? Oh, Gidwin asked you to get them for me!  That sweet little guy.  Alright.  He's off the hook for now.
english.completed: Return to Fiona at the Thondroril River in Western Plaguelands.

text.title: 塔伦纳·射日者
text.objectives: 去找东瘟疫之地死亡小径的塔伦纳·射日者。
text.description: 我们一停下来，他们就打了一个什么“看谁能在五分钟里杀的亡灵多”的赌。$b$b一小时过去了，而我还在等他们回来。$b$b我看见塔伦纳·射日者朝东南跑了。不幸的是，我不能丢下马车不管。要是你正好往那个方向去的话，能不能找到他，然后叫他回来找我？
text.completion: I've found them, $r.  The Scourge.  How I've longed for this day.
text.giverWindow: 帮我找到塔伦纳！

english.title: Tarenar Sunstrike
english.objectives: Find Tarenar Sunstrike at Death's Step in Eastern Plaguelands.
english.description: As soon as we stopped, they made a bet about "who could kill the most undead in five minutes."$b$bIt's been an hour, and I'm still waiting for them to come back.$b$bI saw Tarenar run off to the southeast.  Unfortunately, I can't leave the caravan here by itself.  If you end up traveling in that direction, could you find him and send him back to me?
english.completion: I've found them, $r.  The Scourge.  How I've longed for this day.
english.giverWindow: Help me find Tarenar!

text.title: 我最擅长的事
text.objectives: 在东瘟疫之地的死亡小径杀死5只死亡小径畸形怪。
text.description: 我还记得，在我年轻的时候，就经常潜入幽魂之地打僵尸，一打就是好几个小时。那时候可没人付钱给我，而我一直乐此不疲。$b$b现在，看看周围，都是些凶猛的僵尸。我准备把它们也收拾了，你要一起来吗？
text.completion: Five should be good enough. Yikes, look at the time!  I need to head back to camp.
text.completed: Return to Tarenar Sunstrike at Death's Step in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: What I Do Best
english.objectives: Kill 5 Death's Step Miscreations at Death's Step in Eastern Plaguelands.
english.description: I remember when I was young, I would sneak off into the Ghostlands and just beat up zombies for hours on end.  Nobody even PAID me.  I just did it.$b$bNow, look in front of you.  Those are some serious zombies.  I was just about to start beating them up, too.  Care to join me?
english.completion: Five should be good enough. Yikes, look at the time!  I need to head back to camp.
english.completed: Return to Tarenar Sunstrike at Death's Step in Eastern Plaguelands.

text.title: 给菲奥拉的礼物
text.objectives: 收集10份天灾犬之血。
text.description: 我的旅伴菲奥拉用她的马车开了一家小店。她和我，外加我们的朋友吉德文，正在前往圣光之愿礼拜堂的路上。如果你愿意的话，也可以跟我们同行……不过菲奥拉没准会生我的气。$b$b如果你能送礼物给菲奥拉的话，她立刻就会转怒为喜了。干掉这里北边的天灾犬，把它们的血交给马车旁的菲奥拉，她就在河边。她肯定会喜欢的。我一会儿会在那边等你。
text.progress: I should have guessed it.  Tarenar made you get me a gift?  That thoughtless idiot!$b$bUmm... what was the gift, anyhow?
text.completion: Why, this is exactly what I needed!  Fine, I'll forgive Tarenar for running off. $n, you're welcome to join us anytime.
text.completed: Return to Fiona at the Thondroril River in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: A Gift For Fiona
english.objectives: Obtain 10 samples of Plaguehound Blood.
english.description: My traveling companion, Fiona, runs a small vendor's shop out of her caravan.  She and I, along with our friend Gidwin, are all on our way to Light's Hope Chapel.  I'm sure you can join us, if you like... though Fiona might be a little mad at me.$b$bFiona always forgets why she's mad if you give her a gift.  Kill some of the plaguehounds north of here, then bring their blood to Fiona at the caravan, down by the river.  She'll love it.  We'll talk again there.
english.progress: I should have guessed it.  Tarenar made you get me a gift?  That thoughtless idiot!$b$bUmm... what was the gift, anyhow?
english.completion: Why, this is exactly what I needed!  Fine, I'll forgive Tarenar for running off. $n, you're welcome to join us anytime.
english.completed: Return to Fiona at the Thondroril River in Eastern Plaguelands.

text.title: 前往圣光之愿礼拜堂
text.objectives: 在东瘟疫之地的索多里尔河搭乘菲奥拉的马车。
text.description: 既然伙计们都回来了，我们就出发吧。你也要去东边吗？$b$b请跟我们一起走吧！我坚持这个要求！昨天在治愈者营地的时候，我就跟塔伦纳说，“我们有两个圣骑士和一个店主，你知道我们还缺什么吗？还缺个$c！”$b$b别那么看着我！我是认真的！来吧，跳上车来。
text.completion: Hope the ride wasn't too bumpy for you. Have a look around the tower while the horses rest.  It's no Light's Hope Chapel, but I'm sure you can find some way to keep yourself busy.
text.completed: Speak with Fiona at Crown Guard Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: Onward, to Light's Hope Chapel
english.objectives: Board Fiona's Caravan at the Thondroril River in Eastern Plaguelands.
english.description: Now that the boys are back, we can head out.  You headed east?$b$bPlease, join us!  I insist!  Yesterday, we were in the Menders' Stead, and I was telling Tarenar, "We have two paladins and a shopkeeper, but you know what we really need?  A $c!"$b$bDon't look at me that way!  I'm serious!  Come on, hop in the cart.
english.completion: Hope the ride wasn't too bumpy for you. Have a look around the tower while the horses rest.  It's no Light's Hope Chapel, but I'm sure you can find some way to keep yourself busy.
english.completed: Speak with Fiona at Crown Guard Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

text.title: 疯狂之喉
text.objectives: 跟元素法阵的唤地者托伦斯卡谈一谈。
text.description: 我不敢相信，$n。我的亲生儿子——我的亲骨血！同那些暮光之锤的恶魔混在一起。你看见了吗？他都变了什么样，打算毁掉婚礼。哦……为什么？为什么？$B$B是那个畜生，$n。从西边地里出现的巨大的嘴。“疯狂之喉！”我的儿子说它能和他交谈，但我认为那只是一个噩梦。$B$B大地之环打算把它消灭掉。去找西边的唤地者托伦斯卡，看你能帮什么忙！
text.completion: Welcome, brotha. You've chosen a harsh time to be joinin' us, but that is to our fortune. We could use ya help.

english.title: The Maw of Madness
english.objectives: Speak to Earthcaller Torunscar at the Ring of the Elements.
english.description: I can't believe it, $n. Me own son - me own flesh and blood! Throwing his lot in with those fiends from the Twilight's Hammer. Did you see what he became when he tried to destroy the wedding? Oh ... why? Why?$B$BIt's that beast, $n. The enormous mouth emerging from the earth to our west. "The Maw of Madness!" My son said it spoke to him, but I thought it was just nightmares.$B$BThe Earthen Ring is trying to destroy it. Go to Earthcaller Torunscar, west of here, and see how you can help!
english.completion: Welcome, brotha. You've chosen a harsh time to be joinin' us, but that is to our fortune. We could use ya help.

text.title: 流脓的伤口
text.objectives: 跟元素法阵的唤地者托伦斯卡谈一谈。
text.description: 一头野兽，$n！我看到了一头野兽。一头胃口更大、更饥饿的。他们可能不知道自己把什么东西给放出来了。$B$B它就在这儿。它那无形而且可怕的身躯正在高地里出没。$B$B我在预言中看到了你，$n。你同大地之环一起，想要将那畜生制服。你将会面对黑暗。$B$B现在去吧，趁那畜生还没有变得更强。跟西北方德拉卡戈废墟远处山脊顶端元素法阵的唤地者托伦斯卡谈一谈。赶快！
text.completion: Welcome, brotha. You've chosen a harsh time to be joinin' us, but that is to our fortune. We could use ya help.

english.title: The Weeping Wound
english.objectives: Speak with Earthcaller Torunscar at the Ring of the Elements.
english.description: A beast, $n! I saw a beast. A great maw, an even greater hungering. They can't possibly know what they unleashed.$B$BIt is here. Its terrible shapeless body is erupting right into the Highlands.$B$BI saw you in my vision, $n. You struggle with the Earthen Ring to contain the beast. You will face the darkness.$B$BGo now, before the beast grows in power. Speak to Earthcaller Torunscar at the Circle of the Elements, northwest of here atop the ridge beyond the ruined Drakgor Encampment. Hurry!
english.completion: Welcome, brotha. You've chosen a harsh time to be joinin' us, but that is to our fortune. We could use ya help.

text.title: 厄索拉斯之喉
text.objectives: 骑一头狮鹫加入对厄索拉斯的进攻。
text.description: 我们已经做好攻打那畜生的准备了。首先，我们需要摧毁它的触须，然后耶法会举行一个仪式，召唤一只强大的火元素，我们则会将其扔到它的胃里去。$B$B我要你和我们的第一组人马飞出去展开进攻。稳住阵脚，等待时机，然后加入战局，和其他萨满一起把触须砍断。$B$B做好进攻的准备后，就随意挑一头狮鹫出发吧。
text.completion: The tentacles swept us off of our gryphons as well! They were far more nimble than we anticipated. No matter. We were prepared for this possibility. I can summon the elemental from here if you can keep me safe.
text.completed: Speak to Earthcaller Yevaa within the stomach of Iso'rath in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: The Maw of Iso'rath
english.objectives: Mount a gryphon to join the attack on Iso'rath.
english.description: We are ready to attack the beast. First, we need to destroy it's tentacles, then Yevaa will perform a ritual to summon a powerful fire elemental that we will drop into its maw.$B$BI want you to fly out with our first group attack. Hold steady until an opportunity presents itself, then join the battle with the rest of the shaman in cutting the tentacles down.$B$BTake any one of the gryphons when you're ready to join the assault.
english.completion: The tentacles swept us off of our gryphons as well! They were far more nimble than we anticipated. No matter. We were prepared for this possibility. I can summon the elemental from here if you can keep me safe.
english.completed: Speak to Earthcaller Yevaa within the stomach of Iso'rath in the Twilight Highlands.

objectiveDetails.description: 加入对厄索拉斯的进攻

text.title: 消化
text.objectives: 保护你和唤地者耶法免受厄索拉斯防御机制的伤害。
text.description: 虽然我们知道这畜生可能会保护自己，但我们不知道它会如何做到这一点。厄索拉斯的身体对我们的威胁迅速地作出了反应。$B$B我可以在这里完成召唤，但是你必须击退厄索拉斯的防御力量。别让它们靠近！我们能活下来！
text.completion: I've brought you back from the brink of death, hero! Deathwing is upon us! We need your help.
text.completed: Speak to Thrall at the Maelstrom.

english.title: Devoured
english.objectives: Defend yourself and Earthcaller Yevaa from Iso'rath's bodily defenses.
english.description: We knew this was a possibility, but we had no idea how the beast would defend itself. Iso'rath's body is reacting quickly to our threat.$B$BI can complete the summoning from here, but only if you can hold back Iso'rath's defenses. Keep them busy! We will survive this!
english.completion: I've brought you back from the brink of death, hero! Deathwing is upon us! We need your help.
english.completed: Speak to Thrall at the Maelstrom.

objectiveDetails.description: 从厄索拉斯的防御中幸存下来

text.title: 灭世者
text.objectives: 打败死亡的化身，死亡之翼。
text.description: 没时间了！死亡之翼趁我们不备发动了进攻。你不阻止他的话，大地之环今日便要休矣！
text.completion: You're awake! Thank the elements. I'd almost lost all hope.
text.completed: Speak to Earthcaller Yevaa within the stomach of Iso'roth in the Twilight Highlands.
text.giverWindow: 你是唯一一个可以和灭世者抗衡的人。如果你失败，整个艾泽拉斯就完了。
text.turninWindow: 噩梦威胁要侵蚀厄索拉斯里的一切。

english.title: The Worldbreaker
english.objectives: Defeat Deathwing, the Aspect of Death.
english.description: There's no time! Deathwing struck before we could form against him. If you do not stop him, the Earthen Ring will end this day!
english.completion: You're awake! Thank the elements. I'd almost lost all hope.
english.completed: Speak to Earthcaller Yevaa within the stomach of Iso'roth in the Twilight Highlands.
english.giverWindow: You are the only one left who can stand against the Worldbreaker. If you fail, all of Azeroth is doomed.
english.turninWindow: Nightmares threaten to swarm and consume all within Iso'noth.

objectiveDetails.description: 帮助萨尔对抗死亡之翼

text.title: 厄索拉斯的恐怖
text.objectives: 营救哈尔格斯·黯刃、大地治愈者达鲁、风暴召唤者贾拉娜，以及风暴召唤者米尔拉。$B$B如果厄索拉斯要将你消化掉了，就到其他萨满那里寻求庇护。
text.description: 我们需要你！我们被困在某种噩梦中。其他很多萨满也是一样。$B$B这已经不重要了……我们的计划正在破产。我们的一些萨满正在释放保护光环，可以对抗消化液，让你活下去，但我们需要你去把其他萨满从触须手里救出来。没有他们，我们是无法打败厄索拉斯的！$B$B站在它的胃里时别离其他萨满太远，不然你就会被活活消化在它的肚子里。
text.completion: United with the Earthen Ring, we can survive the horrors of Iso'rath. Now it is time to turn our vengeance upon him!
text.completed: Speak to Earthcaller Yevaa within the stomach of Iso'roth in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: The Terrors of Iso'rath
english.objectives: Rescue Hargoth Dimblaze, Earthmender Duarn, Stormcaller Jalara, and Stormcaller Mylra.$B$BReturn to the safety of the other shaman if Iso'rath's defenses are eating away at you.
english.description: We need you! You were stuck in some kind of nightmare. So are many of the other shaman.$B$BIt doesn't matter... our plan is falling apart. Some of our shaman are channeling protective auras that should combat the digestive juices and keep you alive, but we need you to rescue the other shaman from the tentacles.  We won't be able to defeat Iso'rath without them!$B$BDon't stay out in the stomach without the other shaman for too long or you'll be digested alive!
english.completion: United with the Earthen Ring, we can survive the horrors of Iso'rath. Now it is time to turn our vengeance upon him!
english.completed: Speak to Earthcaller Yevaa within the stomach of Iso'roth in the Twilight Highlands.

objectiveDetails.description: 拯救风暴召唤者贾拉娜
拯救风暴召唤者米尔拉

text.title: 噩梦
text.objectives: 摧毁厄索拉斯之脑。
text.description: 厄索拉斯的大脑露出来了！你救出来的萨满应该可以让你从他的防御体系中活下来。$B$B向大脑展开攻击，消灭厄索拉斯！
text.completion: You saved many of my closest allies today, $n. I can only imagine what horrors you witnessed within Iso'rath, but you have the thanks of all of the Earthen Ring.
text.completed: Speak to Earthcaller Torunscar at the Ring of the Elements in the Twilight Highlands.
text.giverWindow: 噩梦的主人。

english.title: Nightmare
english.objectives: Destroy the Brain of Iso'rath.
english.description: Iso'rath's brain is revealed! The shaman you've saved should keep you somewhat safe amidst his defenses.$B$BStrike at the brain and destroy Iso'rath!
english.completion: You saved many of my closest allies today, $n. I can only imagine what horrors you witnessed within Iso'rath, but you have the thanks of all of the Earthen Ring.
english.completed: Speak to Earthcaller Torunscar at the Ring of the Elements in the Twilight Highlands.
english.giverWindow: Host of Nightmares.

text.title: 旅伴
text.objectives: 在皇冠哨塔找到愿意与你们同行的人。
text.description: 既然我们要在这里等一会儿，不如看看还有没有什么人要去圣光之愿礼拜堂的。人多了才热闹嘛！$B$B四下问问谁愿意跟我们一起走吧。我相信你肯定可以找到同行的旅伴。
text.completion: Argus Highbeacon... that old guy on the top of the tower?  Great! A man his age must have been in the Argent Crusade for a long time.  Maybe he can put in the good word for us at Light's Hope.
text.completed: Return to Tarenar at Crown Guard Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: Traveling Companions
english.objectives: Find someone at Crown Guard Tower who will join your caravan.
english.description: While we're waiting here at this tower, we might as well see if anybody else is headed to Light's Hope Chapel.  The more, the merrier, I say!$b$bAsk around to see if anybody wants to join us on our trip.  I'm sure you can find somebody who's headed to Light's Hope.
english.completion: Argus Highbeacon... that old guy on the top of the tower?  Great! A man his age must have been in the Argent Crusade for a long time.  Maybe he can put in the good word for us at Light's Hope.
english.completed: Return to Tarenar at Crown Guard Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

text.title: 危险的道路
text.objectives: 在通向圣光之盾哨塔的道路旁消灭13只天灾蝙蝠。
text.description: 银色北伐军建造这些哨塔，是为了在笼罩瘟疫之地的黑暗中点起几盏明灯。我在这些哨塔之间往返巡逻，保卫并维护它们。$B$B最近路上有些不安全，感染瘟疫的动物到处乱闯，蝙蝠也会从空中偷袭那些毫无防备的旅行者。如果你能帮我清理一些危险的野兽，我的下一次巡逻就可以轻松许多了。
text.completion: Of course a young $r like you would have no trouble taking care of a few wild animals.  With the roads clear, my journey to the next tower will be much easier.
text.completed: Return to Argus Highbeacon at Crown Guard Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: Rough Roads
english.objectives: Slay 13 Plaguebats along the path to Light's Shield Tower.
english.description: The Argent Crusade built these towers to be points of light in the darkness of the Plaguelands.  I walk the paths between these towers, protecting and maintaining them.$b$bThe roads have been dangerous lately.  Plagued wildlife runs rampant, and bats swoop down upon unsuspecting travelers.  It would make the next leg of my journey much easier if you could clear some of this wildlife out of the way for me.
english.completion: Of course a young $r like you would have no trouble taking care of a few wild animals.  With the roads clear, my journey to the next tower will be much easier.
english.completed: Return to Argus Highbeacon at Crown Guard Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

text.title: 小帕米拉
text.objectives: 在达隆郡找到帕米拉·雷德帕斯。
text.description: 达隆郡大战的记忆仍然萦绕着我，$r。我经常在夜里惊醒，全身是汗，以为自己就在那里，以为一切都在重演。$B$B我可以承受失去战友的痛苦，但失去家人的痛苦却是无法承受的。在那次战斗中，我有一个名叫帕米拉的小侄女失踪了。$B$B如果你足够勇敢的话，能到达隆郡去找找她的下落吗？达隆郡的废墟就在这里的正南方。
text.completion: 你好。我叫潘蜜拉，你叫什麽名字?$B$B

english.title: Little Pamela
english.objectives: Find Pamela Redpath in Darrowshire.
english.description: The battle for Darrowshire still haunts me, $r.  I wake up in cold sweats, convinced that I'm still there; that it is happening all over again.$b$bI've coped with the loss of my comrades, but the loss of my family members is still cripplingly painful.  One of my kin lost during the attack was my young niece, Pamela.$b$bIf you are brave enough to enter Darrowshire, will you search for any sign of Pammy?  Darrowshire's ruins are due south of here.
english.completion: Hello.  I'm Pamela, what's your name?

text.title: 帕米拉的洋娃娃
text.objectives: 找到帕米拉的洋娃娃。
text.description: 玛莱恩姑妈让我留在家里，因为我的爸爸出去作战了。爸爸是世界上最勇敢的人！$B$B但是我在这里等了很长时间，他一直都没有回来。有时候会有坏人来和我说话，我想让爸爸把他们赶走，但是他不在这里！$B$B有时候，天黑了以后，我会和我的洋娃娃玩，但是我把它丢在镇子里了。$B$B你能不能去帮我找到洋娃娃呢？
text.progress: 你找到我的洋娃娃了吗?
text.completion: 你找到它了!你找到我的洋娃娃了!哦，谢谢你!$B$B
text.completed: Return to Pamela Redpath at Darrowshire in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: Pamela's Doll
english.objectives: Find Pamela's doll.
english.description: My auntie Marlene told me to stay here in our house because my father had to go and fight.  My father's the bravest man in the whole world!$B$BBut I've been here for a long time, and he hasn't come for me.  Sometimes bad people come and whisper to me and I want my dad to make them go away, but he's not here!$B$BAnd sometimes when it gets dark I want to play with my doll but I can't because I left it in town.$B$BWill you find my doll for me?
english.progress: Did you find my doll?
english.completion: You found it!  You found my doll!  Oh, thank you!
english.completed: Return to Pamela Redpath at Darrowshire in Eastern Plaguelands.

text.title: 卡林叔叔
text.objectives: 去东瘟疫之地的皇冠哨塔找到卡林·雷德帕斯。
text.description: 我要跟洋娃娃玩，不想跟爸爸的剑一起玩。你拿着好了。$b$b对了，你能把剑交给我叔叔卡林吗？我不知道他在哪里，但有时候我可以听到他在哭，他好像就在附近，北边的什么地方。$B$B我希望他不是在为我哭泣！$n，你能找到我的叔叔，告诉他我过得很好，好吗？$B$B如果你找到他，跟他说我在等他，还有我想听他过去常讲的故事……那个关于兔子和果酱的故事！那个故事可真有趣！
text.progress: Any news of my Pammy?
text.completion: You've seen Pamela?  She's alive? She's dead?  No!  Oh, Pamela!  Why does your spirit still suffer in this world?  Why are you perished, while fortune keeps me alive?  In an instant I would switch places with you and wander dead Darrowshire, a ghost and alone! Ah, but this news cannot change fate.  Thank you, $n.  Now my duty, my duty to revenge, burns hot as ever. Say, what is that sword you have there?
text.completed: 去东瘟疫之地的皇冠哨塔找到卡林·雷德帕斯。

english.title: Uncle Carlin
english.objectives: Return to Carlin Redpath at Crown Guard Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.
english.description: I'm going to play with dolly, but I don't want to play with daddy's sword after all.  You'd better keep it.$b$bEven better, can you give it to my uncle Carlin?  I'm not sure where he is, but sometimes I hear him crying.  It sounds like he's nearby, to the north.$B$BI hope he's not crying for me!  $n, will you find my uncle and tell him I'm alright?$B$BIf you find him say I'm waiting for him, and I want to hear the story he used to tell... the one about the rabbits and the berry jam!  That story's so funny!
english.progress: Any news of my Pammy?
english.completion: You've seen Pamela?  She's alive? She's dead?  No!  Oh, Pamela!  Why does your spirit still suffer in this world?  Why are you perished, while fortune keeps me alive?  In an instant I would switch places with you and wander dead Darrowshire, a ghost and alone! Ah, but this news cannot change fate.  Thank you, $n.  Now my duty, my duty to revenge, burns hot as ever. Say, what is that sword you have there?
english.completed: Return to Carlin Redpath at Crown Guard Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

text.title: 古怪的历史学家
text.objectives: 把约瑟夫的猎刀交给克罗米。
text.description: 这把剑属于约瑟夫·雷德帕斯，他是帕米拉的父亲——你应该已经知道这一点了。我真心希望约瑟夫能和他的女儿团聚，但这是不可能的了。他的灵魂已经被天灾扭曲，变成了一个怪物。$B$B帕米拉的命运已经无可挽回，但也许我们还能改变约瑟夫的命运。$B$B不久之前，有一个古怪的侏儒来到了这里，她叫克罗米。将这把剑交给她，我觉得她可以帮助我们。
text.progress: 你来访的时间很有意思……你不是来自未来的吧?
text.completion: What is this?  A warsword?  A butter knife?  I'm useless when it comes to blades.  Let me see... Ah!  This sword was once in the hand of a great man, but there is much tragedy in that man's past. Are you here to help him?  It's far too late for him now... but perhaps we can help him in the past!
text.completed: Report to Chromie at Crown Guard Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: A Strange Historian
english.objectives: Bring Joseph's Hunting Blade to Chromie.
english.description: That sword belonged to Joseph Redpath, Pamela's father - though you probably already knew that.  I wish Joseph could again be with his daughter, but it cannot be so.  His soul was twisted by the Scourge, and he became a monster.$B$BPamela's fate is sealed, but perhaps we can change Joseph's fate.$B$BA strange gnome arrived here at this tower not long ago.  Her name is Chromie.  Take that sword to her.  I have a feeling she will be able to help us.
english.progress: There is something timely about your visit.  You're not from the future, are you?
english.completion: What is this?  A warsword?  A butter knife?  I'm useless when it comes to blades.  Let me see... Ah!  This sword was once in the hand of a great man, but there is much tragedy in that man's past. Are you here to help him?  It's far too late for him now... but perhaps we can help him in the past!
english.completed: Report to Chromie at Crown Guard Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

text.title: 达隆郡的恶魔
text.objectives: 将霍古斯的徽记和马杜克的破碎之剑交给东瘟疫之地皇冠哨塔的克罗米。
text.description: 《达隆郡的历史》讲述了那场战役中几个天灾军团头目的下场。联盟在这场战役中杀死了食尸鬼之王，掠夺者霍古斯。他在北方的丘陵中被打倒，现在他的徽记还在那儿呢。$B$B黑衣玛杜克从未吃过败仗，但是他的剑却被击落，留在了通向东南方的大路旁。$B$B去找回徽记和宝剑吧，$n。我不清楚原因，但是我知道它们的命运是跟你有关联的。
text.progress: 你找到头颅和宝剑了吗，$N?
text.completion: You found them!  Well done, $n!  These relics hold within them the memories of the Scourge forces at Darrowshire.  We will need these if we are to save your Joseph Redpath.
text.completed: Return to Chromie at Crown Guard Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: Villains of Darrowshire
english.objectives: Bring the Skull of Horgus and the Shattered Sword of Marduk to Chromie at Crown Guard Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.
english.description: The Annals of Darrowshire tells of the villains of that battle.  It tells how the ghoul lord Horgus the Ravager was destroyed by Alliance forces during the battle.  He was slain among the foothills north of here, and his skull remains there.$B$BMarduk the Black was never defeated, but his fabled sword now rusts, ownerless.  It can be found near the road to our southeast.$B$BRetrieve these items, $n.  I know not why, but I am certain their fate lies with you.
english.progress: Did you find the skull and the sword, $n?
english.completion: You found them!  Well done, $n!  These relics hold within them the memories of the Scourge forces at Darrowshire.  We will need these if we are to save your Joseph Redpath.
english.completed: Return to Chromie at Crown Guard Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

text.title: 达隆郡的英雄
text.objectives: 从卡林·雷德帕斯那里获取达隆郡全史，然后在玛瑞斯农场收集达维的圣契和雷德帕斯之盾。
text.description: 达隆郡的英雄也有他们自己留下的遗物，在那些遗物中，保存着更加珍贵的记忆。$B$B首先，去找卡林谈谈，拿到《达隆郡全史》。里面的叙述文字可以指引我们的时光之旅。$B$B然后，你要到西边的玛瑞斯农场去，那里以前的主人收集了一些达隆郡之战留下来的东西，至于他为什么要这么做，我就不清楚了。$B$B去拿回那些遗物，然后来找我。
text.progress: 你找到那些圣物了吗，$N?
text.completion: You have the relics?  Good.  I will get to work on resolving any temporal discontinuities. Don't worry... that's not something you have to worry about.  You just gather the reagents.
text.completed: Return to Chromie at Crown Guard Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: Heroes of Darrowshire
english.objectives: Obtain the Extended Annals of Darrowshire from Carlin Redpath, and obtain Davil's Libram and Redpath's Shield from the Marris Stead.
english.description: The heroes of Darrowshire held relics of their own, and inside of those relics lie more precious memories.$B$BFirst, speak with Carlin and obtain the Extended Annals of Darrowshire.  Within the tome lies the narrative that will drive our excursion through time.$b$bThen, you will need to head west to the Marris Stead.  The former owner of the Marris farmhouse collected relics from the battle of Darrowshire - for what reason, I am not certain.$B$BGather these relics, and return to me.
english.progress: Do you have the relics, $n?
english.completion: You have the relics?  Good.  I will get to work on resolving any temporal discontinuities. Don't worry... that's not something you have to worry about.  You just gather the reagents.
english.completed: Return to Chromie at Crown Guard Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

text.title: 达隆郡的掠夺者
text.objectives: 把5个共鸣徽记交给东瘟疫之地皇冠哨塔的克罗米。
text.description: 你收集的那些遗物是施放一个强大的法术所必需的材料，此外还需要一样东西：参加达隆郡战役的天灾军团士兵的徽记。$B$B带着这块水晶去猎杀天灾军团的士兵，并拿到他们的徽记。这块水晶已经被施了魔法，如果某个士兵曾参加过那场战斗，那么当你把水晶球放在他的徽记上时，它就会发出共鸣。把那些可以与水晶共鸣的徽记交给我。$B$B快去，$n。你可以在北方的蘑菇谷中找到亡灵天灾的士兵。
text.progress: Do you have the skulls?  They are critical for my spell, which will give us the chance to save Darrowshire.  Maybe.
text.completion: Excellent work, $n.  Are you certain you haven't done this before?
text.completed: Return to Chromie at Crown Guard Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: Marauders of Darrowshire
english.objectives: Bring 5 Resonating Skulls to Chromie at Crown Guard Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.
english.description: I require a rare reagent for the powerful spell I intend to cast: skulls from the scourge who took part in the battle of Darrowshire.$B$BTake this crystal and hunt scourge champions for their skulls.  The crystal is enchanted; if a champion took part in the battle, then when you pass the crystal over its skull it will resonate.  Bring me those resonating skulls.$B$BGo, $n.  You'll find scourge champions in the Fungal Vale to the north.  Go.
english.progress: Do you have the skulls?  They are critical for my spell, which will give us the chance to save Darrowshire.  Maybe.
english.completion: Excellent work, $n.  Are you certain you haven't done this before?
english.completed: Return to Chromie at Crown Guard Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

text.title: 达隆郡的战斗
text.objectives: 将遗物包裹放在达隆郡的广场中。$B$B在霍古斯死亡之前，达维必须存活。$B$B在雷德帕斯队长堕落之前保证他存活。$B$B击败堕落的雷德帕斯。$B$B当约瑟夫·雷德帕斯出现在广场中时，与他的灵魂进行交谈。
text.description: 现在，$n，你将参加达隆郡的战斗，并且拯救约瑟夫·雷德帕斯。$B$B把这个遗物包裹放到达隆郡的广场中，达隆郡居民的灵魂将因此而被唤醒。参加他们的战斗，并确保你完成两件事：在霍古斯死后，达维必须存活；雷德帕斯必须存活，直到他被腐化而堕落，此时再将其击败。$B$B在打败了堕落的雷德帕斯之后，他的灵魂就将得到救赎。同他交谈，然后再去找他的女儿帕米拉。
text.completion: 战斗结束了!我听见爸爸在跟我说话。他吓跑了所有鬼魂，而且他说他正在回家的途中!我太高兴了!$B$B他还说要是你来到我们家，我就得好好欢迎你，所以我已经沏好了茶!$B$B希望你喜欢喝加了好多好多糖的茶水!$B$B
text.completed: Return to Pamela Redpath at Darrowshire in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: The Battle of Darrowshire
english.objectives: Place the Relic Bundle at the Darrowshire town square.$B$BPrevent Davil Lightfire's death until the death of Horgus.$B$BPrevent Captain Redpath's death until Redpath the Corrupted appears.$B$BDefeat Redpath the Corrupted.$B$BSpeak with the spirit of Joseph Redpath when he appears at the town square.
english.description: Now, $n, you will take part in battle of Darrowshire, and you will save Joseph Redpath.$B$BPlace this relic bundle in the Darrowshire town square, and the spirits of Darrowshire will rise.  Join their battle and assure that these two things come to pass: Davil must survive beyond the death of Horgus, and Redpath must survive to be corrupted, then defeated.$B$BAfter defeating the corrupted Redpath, his spirit will be saved.  Speak with him, then return to his daughter Pamela.
english.completion: The fighting is over!  I heard my daddy whisper to me.  He scared away all the ghosts and he says he's coming home!  I'm so happy! He also said I should welcome you if came to our house, so I made some tea! I hope you like lots of sugar!
english.completed: Return to Pamela Redpath at Darrowshire in Eastern Plaguelands.

text.title: 隐藏的宝藏
text.objectives: 用约瑟夫的钥匙打开约瑟夫的箱子。
text.description: 爸爸让我给你这把钥匙，他说你可以用它打开房子后面的一只箱子。$B$B他还要让我谢谢你。你是不是帮过他？你有没有告诉他你帮我找到了我的洋娃娃？$B$B好吧，这里是钥匙。谢谢你，$n。谢谢你！你是个好心的$g先生:小姐;！
text.progress: 这只箱子非常破旧，表面满是污迹。
text.completion: 箱子打开了……$B$B

english.title: Hidden Treasures
english.objectives: Bring Joseph's Key to Joseph's Chest.
english.description: Daddy told me to give you this key.  He said it opens a chest out back behind the house.$B$BHe also wanted me to thank you.  Did you do a favor for him?  Did you tell him you found my doll?$B$BWell here's the key.  And thank you $n.  Thank you!  You're a very nice $gman:lady;!
english.progress: This chest is old and covered in grime.
english.completion: The key fits the lock, and the chest opens...

text.title: 我不该告诉你这个
text.objectives: 从东瘟疫之地的孤独的猎手身上获得约瑟夫的猎刀。
text.description: 我爸爸一直带着两把剑：一把是跟人战斗的时候用的，另一把是打猎的时候用的。他不许我碰他的剑，但我知道他把剑藏在哪里了。$B$B有一天，他跟妈妈说他要到东边的山上去，找一个“孤独的猎手”交战，但他却带着打猎用的剑！他回来的时候却没有带回那把剑。$B$B等到爸爸回来的那一天，如果我把剑还给他的话，他一定会非常高兴的！你能去找找吗？
text.progress: Daddy loved his animal sword.  He seemed sad when he didn't have it anymore.
text.completion: That's my daddy's sword!  How did you find it?  Did you find the bad hunter?
text.completed: Return to Pamela Redpath at Darrowshire in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: I'm Not Supposed to Tell You This
english.objectives: Obtain Joseph's Hunting Blade from The Lone Hunter in Eastern Plaguelands.
english.description: My daddy always kept two swords: one for fighting with men, and one for hunting the animals.  I wasn't supposed to touch his swords, but I knew where he hid them.$b$bOne day, he told my mommy that he was going to fight a "lone hunter" in the hills to the east, but he brought his animal sword with him!  When he came back, he didn't have his sword with him.$b$bWhen daddy comes back, he'll be so happy when I give him his animal sword!  Will you go and find it?
english.progress: Daddy loved his animal sword.  He seemed sad when he didn't have it anymore.
english.completion: That's my daddy's sword!  How did you find it?  Did you find the bad hunter?
english.completed: Return to Pamela Redpath at Darrowshire in Eastern Plaguelands.

text.title: 利刃的召唤
text.objectives: 调查瓦丝琪尔废墟南端的战斗现场。
text.description: 我感应到废墟中有一股强大力量在召唤我。你能再帮我去查查南部战斗现场吗？我敢肯定那儿有东西。
text.completion: The Wavespeaker was right. There's something here.

english.title: The Call of the Blade
english.objectives: Investigate the battle site at the southern end of the Ruins of Vashj'ir.
english.description: I sense a strong power calling to me from the ruins. Can you check again on that southern battle site for me?  I'm certain that there's something there.
english.completion: The Wavespeaker was right. There's something here.

text.title: 利刃的召唤
text.objectives: 调查瓦丝琪尔废墟南端的战斗现场。
text.description: 我感应到废墟中有一股强大力量在召唤我。你能再帮我去查查南部战斗现场吗？我敢肯定那儿有东西。
text.completion: The Wavespeaker was right. There's something here.

english.title: The Call of the Blade
english.objectives: Investigate the battle site at the southern end of the Ruins of Vashj'ir.
english.description: I sense a strong power calling to me from the ruins. Can you check again on that southern battle site for me?  I'm certain that there's something there.
english.completion: The Wavespeaker was right. There's something here.

text.title: 射手的武器
text.objectives: 进入影牙城堡，获得高弗雷的水晶瞄准镜，还有5捆月触之木和5束不死肌腱。
text.description: 你迅速地领悟了猎人之道，$n。你的技能使你成为部落的骄傲，年轻人的榜样。$B$B作为努力和成绩的奖励，酋长已经委托他的私人工匠打造一件独特的武器。$B$B银松森林被诅咒的影牙城堡是唯一一个可以获得你所需材料的地方。去那里弄来高弗雷勋爵枪上的瞄准镜、一些月触之木，还有在城堡里出没的食尸鬼和恶鬼的肌腱。
text.progress: Did you bring the materials I'll need for your weapon?
text.completion: I'm honored that the warchief chose me to craft a weapon for you, $n. With such exotic materials, it will be a very fine bow.
text.completed: Speak to Saru Steelfury in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor.

english.title: A Marksman's Weapon
english.objectives: Go to Shadowfang Keep and obtain Godfrey's Crystal Scope, 5 bundles of Moontouched Wood, and 5 Deathless Sinew.
english.description: You have picked up the ways of the hunter quickly, $n. Your skills have made you a credit to the Horde and an example to the younglings.$B$BAs a reward for your progress and hard work, the warchief has commissioned his personal bowyer to create a unique weapon.$B$BThe cursed Shadowfang Keep in Silverpine Forest is the only place to get the materials we'll need. Travel there and retrieve the scope from Lord Godfrey's gun, a supply of moontouched wood, and sinew from the ghouls and geists infesting the keep.
english.progress: Did you bring the materials I'll need for your weapon?
english.completion: I'm honored that the warchief chose me to craft a weapon for you, $n. With such exotic materials, it will be a very fine bow.
english.completed: Speak to Saru Steelfury in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor.

text.title: 碎手之刃
text.objectives: 进入影牙城堡，从指挥官斯普林瓦尔那里夺得斯普林瓦尔的磨刀石，还有5箱月钢锭和5束不死肌腱。
text.description: 碎手氏族的很多成员在训练时都没能活下来，$n。但你不仅仅活下来了，而且不日将成为部落一把令人胆寒的利刃。$B$B作为你进步的奖赏，酋长已经委托他的私人工匠为你铸造一柄特殊的武器。$B$B银松森林被诅咒的影牙城堡是唯一一个可以获得你所需材料的地方。去那里弄来指挥官斯普林瓦尔的磨刀石、一些月钢锭，还有在城堡里出没的食尸鬼和恶鬼的肌腱。
text.progress: Did you bring the materials I'll need for your weapon?
text.completion: Gordul told me that you would be bringing a variety of unusual materials, but I didn't expect anything like this. Moonsteel is said to be very rare and there's only one place I know to get it. You have risked much for this weapon, $n, and I'll see to it that you receive a fitting reward.
text.completed: Speak to Saru Steelfury in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor.

english.title: Blade of the Shattered Hand
english.objectives: Go to Shadowfang Keep and obtain Springvale's Sharpening Stone from Commander Springvale, 5 crates of Moonsteel Ingots, and 5 Deathless Sinew.
english.description: Many members of the Shattered Hand do not survive their training, $n. Not only have you survived, but you will soon become a feared blade of the Horde.$B$BAs a reward for your progress, the warchief has commissioned his personal smith to forge a weapon.$B$BThe cursed Shadowfang Keep in Silverpine Forest is the only place to get the materials you'll need. Travel there and recover Commander Springvale's sharpening stone, a supply of moonsteel ingots, and sinew from the ghouls and geists infesting the keep.
english.progress: Did you bring the materials I'll need for your weapon?
english.completion: Gordul told me that you would be bringing a variety of unusual materials, but I didn't expect anything like this. Moonsteel is said to be very rare and there's only one place I know to get it. You have risked much for this weapon, $n, and I'll see to it that you receive a fitting reward.
english.completed: Speak to Saru Steelfury in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor.

text.title: 赫雷塔的任务
text.objectives: 进入影牙城堡，从沃登勋爵那里夺取沃登的护符，还有迷失灵魂之书和5份幽灵精华。
text.description: 元素和灵魂能同你清晰地交谈，$n。你已经成为一名强大的萨满，并为那些立志服务部落的人做出了榜样。$B$B酋长也听闻后，已委托他的私人工匠为你铸造一柄特殊的武器。$B$B银松森林被诅咒的影牙城堡是唯一一个可以获得你所需材料的地方。去那里弄来沃登勋爵的护符、迷失灵魂之书，以及在城堡中游荡的幽灵身上的精华吧。
text.progress: Did you bring the materials I'll need for your weapon?
text.completion: Ah, you must be $n. Kardris said that you were venturing to Shadowfang Keep to find the materials needed for this weapon and I see that you have not disappointed. I will make you a mighty weapon worthy of what you have brought.
text.completed: Speak to Saru Steelfury in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor.

english.title: Dreamseeker's Task
english.objectives: Go to Shadowfang Keep and obtain Walden's Talisman from Lord Walden, the Book of Lost Souls, and 5 Ghostly Essence.
english.description: The elements and spirits speak to you with clear voices, $n. You have become a powerful shaman and an example to others wishing to serve the Horde.$B$BWord has even reached the warchief, and he has commissioned his personal smith to forge a special weapon for you.$B$BThe cursed Shadowfang Keep in Silverpine Forest is the only place to get the materials you'll need. Travel there and obtain Lord Walden's talisman, the Book of Lost Souls, and essence from the ghosts haunting the keep.
english.progress: Did you bring the materials I'll need for your weapon?
english.completion: Ah, you must be $n. Kardris said that you were venturing to Shadowfang Keep to find the materials needed for this weapon and I see that you have not disappointed. I will make you a mighty weapon worthy of what you have brought.
english.completed: Speak to Saru Steelfury in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor.

text.title: 战斗已胜，战争未停
text.objectives: 与暴风城东部大地神殿的地语者纳拉特交谈。
text.description: 我们已经击败了这里的敌人，$n。但是海加尔并不是敌人的唯一目标。$B$B我得到消息，大地之环的盟友发出了请求增援的信号，我想这事态一定是非常紧急。$B$B到暴风城的东部大地神殿去，找地语者纳拉特谈谈下一步的行动吧。
text.completion: Your aid is most timely, $n.

english.title: The Battle Is Won, The War Goes On
english.objectives: Speak to Naraat the Earthspeaker at the Eastern Earthshrine in Stormwind City.
english.description: We've defeated the enemy's forces here, $n.  But Hyjal is not the only place where our foes are moving against us.$B$BI've been informed that our allies in the Earthen Ring have put out a call for aid in a matter I've been assured is most critical.$B$BSpeak to Naraat the Earthspeaker at the Eastern Earthshrine in Stormwind City for further instructions.
english.completion: Your aid is most timely, $n.

text.title: 战斗已胜，战争未停
text.objectives: 与奥格瑞玛西部大地神殿的先知克洛伽交谈。
text.description: 我们已经击败了这里的敌人，$n。但是海加尔并不是敌人的唯一目标。$B$B我得到消息说，大地之环的盟友发出了请求增援的信号，我想这事态一定是非常紧急。$B$B到奥格瑞玛的西部大地神殿去，找先知克洛伽谈谈下一步的行动吧。
text.completion: Your aid is most timely, $n.

english.title: The Battle Is Won, The War Goes On
english.objectives: Speak to Farseer Krogar at the Western Earthshrine in Orgrimmar.
english.description: We've defeated the enemy's forces here, $n.  But Hyjal is not the only place where our foes are moving against us.$B$BI've been informed that our allies in the Earthen Ring have put out a call for aid in a matter I've been assured is most critical.$B$BSpeak to Farseer Krogar at the Western Earthshrine in Orgrimmar for further instructions.
english.completion: Your aid is most timely, $n.

text.title: 掌握奥术
text.objectives: 去影牙城堡席瓦莱恩男爵处收集席瓦莱恩魔化水晶，还有5捆月触之木和5份幽灵精华。
text.description: 你所有的训练师都一致认为，$n，你展现出了一个学徒无比的天赋。甚至酋长都听说了你的飞速进步。$B$B作为掌握学业的奖励，酋长委托他的大附魔师为你制造一柄法杖。$B$B银松森林被诅咒的影牙城堡是唯一一个可以获得你所需材料的地方。去那里将席瓦莱恩家的魔法传家宝找到，并收集一些月触之木，以及在城堡里游荡的鬼魂的精华来。
text.progress: Did you bring the materials I'll need for your weapon?
text.completion: Ah, you must be the $c that Uthel'nay mentioned. I've heard tales about the artifacts the Silverlaine family once kept, but I haven't ever seen one. This should make an excellent focus for your staff. Let's get started.
text.completed: Speak to Godan in Orgrimmar's Drag district.

english.title: Mastering the Arcane
english.objectives: Go to Shadowfang Keep and obtain Silverlaine's Enchanted Crystal from Baron Silverlaine, 5 bundles of Moontouched Wood, and 5 Ghostly Essence.
english.description: All of your trainers agree, $n, you show an amazing amount of talent for a journeyman. Even the warchief has heard of your rapid progress.$B$BAs a reward for mastering your studies, the warchief has commissioned his master enchanter to create a staff for you.$B$BThe cursed Shadowfang Keep in Silverpine Forest is the only place to get the materials you'll need. Travel there and find a magical heirloom of the Silverlaine family, a supply of moontouched wood, and the essence of the ghosts haunting the keep.
english.progress: Did you bring the materials I'll need for your weapon?
english.completion: Ah, you must be the $c that Uthel'nay mentioned. I've heard tales about the artifacts the Silverlaine family once kept, but I haven't ever seen one. This should make an excellent focus for your staff. Let's get started.
english.completed: Speak to Godan in Orgrimmar's Drag district.

text.title: 明天的希望
text.objectives: 使用第七军团望远镜侦察港口。
text.description: <死亡通讯器响起了一阵蜂鸣声。>$B$B在教堂区四处看看。附近应该有一架第七军团用来监视的望远镜。找到它，用它勘察一下港口。我们必须知道第七军团是如何绕过我们的舰队的。$B$B赶紧，$n。我们阻挡不了这些畜生多久了。$B$B明天又将会如何？
text.completion: TORPEDOED! We had everything at the water line covered, but nothing below the line. They must have snuck in beneath our defenses and then blown our warships to smithereens. And now the rest of the Alliance fleet is nearly here...
text.completed: Speak with Forward Commander Onslaught at Forsaken Forward Command in the Ruins of Gilneas.
text.giverWindow: 在该地区寻找第七军团望远镜。
text.giverTarget: 前锋军指挥官昂斯洛特
text.turninTarget: 前锋军指挥官昂斯洛特
text.objective1: 使用第七军团望远镜侦查港口。

english.title: What Tomorrow Brings
english.objectives: Use the 7th Legion Telescope to Scout the Harbor.
english.description: <The F.C.D. buzzes.>$B$BLook around the Cathedral Quarter. There should be a telescope nearby that the 7th Legion uses for spying. Find it and use it to scout the harbor. We need to find out how the 7th Legion got past our fleet.$B$BHurry, $n. We can't hold these beasts back much longer.$B$BWhat does tomorrow bring?
english.completion: TORPEDOED! We had everything at the water line covered, but nothing below the line. They must have snuck in beneath our defenses and then blown our warships to smithereens. And now the rest of the Alliance fleet is nearly here...
english.completed: Speak with Forward Commander Onslaught at Forsaken Forward Command in the Ruins of Gilneas.
english.giverWindow: Search the area for the 7th Legion telescope.
english.objective1: Use the 7th Legion Telescope to Scout the Harbor.

text.title: 力量的证明
text.objectives: 进入影牙城堡，从高弗雷勋爵那里夺得晦暗之球，还有迷失灵魂之书和5份幽灵精华。
text.description: 我们的修炼你掌握得飞快，$n，而我也并非唯一一个对你的进步赞不绝口之人。甚至是酋长也注意到了你的成绩。$B$B作为你献身精神的奖赏，酋长已经委托他的私人附魔师为你制造一柄法杖。$B$B银松森林被诅咒的影牙城堡是唯一一个可以获得你所需材料的地方。去那里弄来高弗雷勋爵手中的晦暗之球、迷失灵魂之书，以及在城堡中游荡的幽灵身上的精华吧。
text.progress: Did you bring the materials I'll need for your weapon?
text.completion: So you are the $c who will receive this staff. It will be a fitting reward for one so dedicated to the pursuit of power and the ascendancy of the Horde.
text.completed: Speak to Godan in Orgrimmar's Drag District.

english.title: Token of Power
english.objectives: Go to Shadowfang Keep and obtain the Tenebrous Orb from Lord Godfrey, the Book of Lost Souls, and 5 Ghostly Essence.
english.description: Your mastery of our ways continues to grow quickly, $n, and I am far from the only one impressed by your progress. Even the warchief has taken note of your deeds.$B$BAs a reward for your dedication, the warchief has commissioned his personal enchanter to craft a staff.$B$BThe cursed Shadowfang Keep in Silverpine Forest is the only place to get the materials you'll need. Travel there and retrieve the tenebrous orb held by Lord Godfrey, the Book of Lost Souls, and the essence of the ghosts haunting the keep.
english.progress: Did you bring the materials I'll need for your weapon?
english.completion: So you are the $c who will receive this staff. It will be a fitting reward for one so dedicated to the pursuit of power and the ascendancy of the Horde.
english.completed: Speak to Godan in Orgrimmar's Drag District.

text.title: 真正的烈日行者
text.objectives: 进入影牙城堡，从指挥官斯普林瓦尔那里夺得指挥官的神圣符记，还有5箱月钢锭和5束不死肌腱。
text.description: 我一直在观察你的训练，$n。你选择的道路是成为一名杰出的烈日行者，部落勇敢的守护者，我们人民的忠实拥护者。$B$B为了奖励你的献身精神，酋长已经委托他的私人工匠为你铸造一件特殊的武器。$B$B银松森林被诅咒的影牙城堡是唯一一个可以获得你所需材料的地方。去那里弄来指挥官斯普林瓦尔的神圣符记、一些月钢锭，还有在城堡里出没的食尸鬼和恶鬼的肌腱。
text.progress: Did you bring the materials I'll need for your weapon?
text.completion: I haven't worked with the Sunwalkers before, but from all I've heard, the warchief holds you in high regard. It was a great honor to be asked to forge this weapon for you and I hope it will serve you well.
text.completed: Speak to Saru Steelfury in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor.

english.title: A True Sunwalker
english.objectives: Go to Shadowfang Keep and obtain the Commander's Holy Symbol from Commander Springvale, 5 crates of Moonsteel Ingots, and 5 Deathless Sinew.
english.description: I have watched your training, $n. Yours is the path of an exemplary Sunwalker, a brave defender of the Horde and a follower of our ways.$B$BAs a reward for your dedication, the warchief has commissioned his personal smith to forge a special weapon.$B$BThe cursed Shadowfang Keep in Silverpine Forest is the only place to get the materials you'll need. Travel there and recover the holy symbol of Commander Springvale, a supply of moonsteel ingots, and sinew from the ghouls and geists infesting the keep.
english.progress: Did you bring the materials I'll need for your weapon?
english.completion: I haven't worked with the Sunwalkers before, but from all I've heard, the warchief holds you in high regard. It was a great honor to be asked to forge this weapon for you and I hope it will serve you well.
english.completed: Speak to Saru Steelfury in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor.

text.title: 议会的未来
text.objectives: 进入影牙城堡，从沃登勋爵那里夺取沃登的药剂，还有5捆月触之木和5束不死肌腱。
text.description: 塞纳里奥议会对你的功绩十分满意，$n。你是所有德鲁伊的自豪，我们将你和你的同辈视作议会的未来。$B$B议会决定为你制作一把特殊的法杖以兹嘉奖。$B$B你这把法杖的材料稀有而强大，只能从银松森林的影牙城堡里获得。去那里弄来沃登勋爵配制的药剂、一些月触之木，还有在城堡里出没的食尸鬼和恶鬼的肌腱。
text.progress: Did you bring the materials I'll need for your staff?
text.completion: Ah, you must be the $c Loganaar was talking about. It is a pleasure to finally meet you, $n. I've often heard members of the circle describe you as a talented and promising $c and I'm heartened to see their estimations were correct.
text.completed: Speak to Narianna at Nighthaven in Moonglade.

english.title: The Circle's Future
english.objectives: Go to Shadowfang Keep and obtain Walden's Elixirs from Lord Walden, 5 bundles of Moontouched Wood, and 5 Deathless Sinew.
english.description: The Cenarion Circle is pleased with your progress, $n. You are a credit to all druids and we look to you and your peers as the future of our brotherhood.$B$BThe circle has decided to honor you with the creation of unique staff.$B$BThe rare and powerful materials needed for your staff can only be found in Shadowfang Keep inside Silverpine Forest. Travel there and retrieve Lord Walden's collection of elixirs, a supply of moontouched wood, and sinew from the ghouls and geists infesting the keep.
english.progress: Did you bring the materials I'll need for your staff?
english.completion: Ah, you must be the $c Loganaar was talking about. It is a pleasure to finally meet you, $n. I've often heard members of the circle describe you as a talented and promising $c and I'm heartened to see their estimations were correct.
english.completed: Speak to Narianna at Nighthaven in Moonglade.

text.title: 撤退！
text.objectives: 去找吉尔尼斯废墟烬石村的死亡猎手指挥官贝尔蒙特。
text.description: <死亡通讯器响起了一阵蜂鸣声。>$B$B<背景里能听到阵阵狼嚎。>$B$B$n，你能听到吗？回话，$n。这可能是我最后一次通讯了。狼人已经包围了被遗忘者前线指挥部。营地失陷只是时间问题而已。贝尔蒙特和瓦格里阿尔苏拉已经离开了。贝尔蒙特提到他们将在东北边的烬石村同你会合。去找贝尔蒙特，$n。我们的任务——我们的存续——就寄托在这上面了。$B$B你是我们最后的希望。
text.completion: Forward Commander Onslaught fought until the bitter end, $n. It took a pack of bloodthirsty worgen to finally bring him down. We must not let his death, or the death of all of our soldiers in Gilneas, go in vain. Our mission MUST succeed. Now I will reveal to you why we are here.
text.giverWindow: 这是我最后一次通讯。
text.giverTarget: 前锋军指挥官昂斯洛特

english.title: Fall Back!
english.objectives: Find Deathstalker Commander Belmont at Emberstone Village in the Ruins of Gilneas.
english.description: <The F.C.D. buzzes.>$B$B<Howls can be heard in the background.>$B$B$n, do you read me? Come in, $n. This is likely my final transmission. The worgen have overrun Forsaken Forward Command. It is now only a matter of time before the base is lost. Belmont and the val'kyr, Arthura, have left. Belmont mentioned that they will rendezvous with you at Emberstone Village, located to the northeast. Find Belmont, $n. Our mission - our very existence - depends on it.$B$BYou are our final hope.
english.completion: Forward Commander Onslaught fought until the bitter end, $n. It took a pack of bloodthirsty worgen to finally bring him down. We must not let his death, or the death of all of our soldiers in Gilneas, go in vain. Our mission MUST succeed. Now I will reveal to you why we are here.
english.giverWindow: This is my final transmission.

text.title: 一个名叫高弗雷的人
text.objectives: 找到文森特·高弗雷勋爵的遗体。
text.description: 文森特·高弗雷勋爵穷尽一生来守卫吉尔尼斯人的王国。当狼人的诅咒在这片土地上肆虐的时候，高弗雷是第一批奋起抗争的吉尔尼斯人。据说当发现他的国王已经被诅咒所感染后，高弗雷自尽而亡。他宁可死，也不愿服侍危害他家乡的生物。$B$B我们将给他第二次机会，$n。我们要一起杀往东南方的风暴海崖，去找到他的遗体。
text.completion: Here we are, $n. He is a little rotted, but no worse for the wear. We must hurry before the Alliance finds us!
text.completed: Speak with Deathstalker Commander Belmont in the Ruins of Gilneas.

english.title: A Man Named Godfrey
english.objectives: Find the corpse of Lord Vincent Godfrey.
english.description: Lord Vincent Godfrey spent his life defending the kingdom of Gilneas. When the worgen curse ravaged this land, Godfrey was one of the first Gilneans to take up arms against the beasts. It is said that upon discovering that his king was afflicted by the curse, Godfrey took his own life. He would rather be dead than serve the very creatures that he had defended his home against.$B$BWe are going to give him a second chance, $n. Together we will battle southeast towards Tempest's Reach to collect his corpse.
english.completion: Here we are, $n. He is a little rotted, but no worse for the wear. We must hurry before the Alliance finds us!
english.completed: Speak with Deathstalker Commander Belmont in the Ruins of Gilneas.

text.title: 血沼羽毛
text.objectives: 从血沼迅猛龙身上采集5片血沼羽毛。
text.description: 看见布洛格在这里，你是不是非常惊讶呢，小$r？别担心，泥链镇的地精都是布洛格的朋友，你也可以喔。$B$B新的大王不敢向那些摧毁了我们故乡并屠杀我们同胞的黑龙复仇，所以布洛格就离开了蕨墙村。布洛格来这里，是为了让那些朋友们的灵魂重新得到安息，并向黑龙复仇！不过，布洛格首先需要做一些准备。为了举行仪式，布洛格需要羽毛，具有强大魔力的羽毛，比如镇子西边鲜血沼泽墓穴那边迅猛龙的羽毛。
text.progress: <Brogg looks at you hopefully.>$B$BYou bring Brogg feathers?
text.completion: Brogg pleased with these feathers. Very strong magic. Brogg not know what raptors do to give feathers power, but raptor feathers always best for ritual.
text.completed: Return to Brogg at Mudsprocket in Dustwallow Marsh.

english.title: Bloodfen Feathers
english.objectives: Collect 5 Bloodfen Feathers from Bloodfen Raptors.
english.description: Are you startled by Brogg's presence here, little $r? Don't worry. Goblins at Mudsprocket are Brogg's friends and you can be, too.$B$BBrogg left Brackenwall Village when new overlord not take revenge against black dragonkin for destroying old home and killing many of Brogg's old friends. Brogg come here to lay friends spirits to rest and avenge them, but Brogg need help preparing. For ritual, Brogg need feathers with strong magic, like ones worn by raptors at Bloodfen Burrow to the west of town.
english.progress: <Brogg looks at you hopefully.>$B$BYou bring Brogg feathers?
english.completion: Brogg pleased with these feathers. Very strong magic. Brogg not know what raptors do to give feathers power, but raptor feathers always best for ritual.
english.completed: Return to Brogg at Mudsprocket in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: 石槌战旗
text.objectives: 到火焰洞穴里夺取石槌战旗。
text.description: 当那些龙跑过来夺走布洛格的家时，大多数的石槌食人魔都逃跑了，没来得及带走任何东西，甚至包括氏族的旗帜。$B$B布洛格知道旗帜就藏在石槌食人魔山中，不过现在，那地方被称作火焰洞穴。布洛格一定要夺回旗帜，用它向那些杀死了朋友们的龙复仇。$B$B总之，布洛格氏族的领地火焰洞穴，就在泥链镇的西北方，不过那里现在全是龙族。旗帜一定就藏在洞穴深处，要小心，$n。
text.progress: You bring Stonemaul banner?
text.completion: You have Brogg's thanks, $n. Brogg has big plans for clan banner.
text.completed: Return to Brogg at Mudsprocket in Dustwallow Marsh.

english.title: Banner of the Stonemaul
english.objectives: Retrieve the Stonemaul Banner from within the Den of Flame.
english.description: When the dragons came and took over Brogg's old home, Stonemaul ogres fled and left everything behind, including clan's banner.$B$BBrogg knows banner was kept deep in Stonemaul ogre mound, but these days it's called Den of Flame. Brogg must have clan banner to get his revenge on dragons who killed his friends.$B$BBrogg's clan's old mound, Den of Flame, is northwest of Mudsprocket and crawling with dragonkin. Banner will be deep inside the cave. Be careful, $n.
english.progress: You bring Stonemaul banner?
english.completion: You have Brogg's thanks, $n. Brogg has big plans for clan banner.
english.completed: Return to Brogg at Mudsprocket in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: 憎恨的精华
text.objectives: 将10份黑龙精华交给泥链镇的布洛格。
text.description: 想做出布洛格在仪式上必须要用到的图腾，就需要那些把朋友们杀死的生物的精华。布洛格的敌人所发散出来的仇恨与愤怒，将会增强他复仇的魔法。$B$B去找火鬃灰尾龙人、斥候，或是守卫，杀死它们，在尸体上使用布洛格的图腾。龙类只有在死去的时候才会释放出精华。$B$B这些家伙就在西北方的火焰洞穴和北方的石槌废墟一带活动。
text.progress: Do you have the essences? Brogg must have them to avenge his friends!
text.completion: You have Brogg's thanks, $n. Once Brogg adds their magic to the totem, it will be able to redeem the spirits of Brogg's fallen friends.
text.completed: Return to Brogg at Mudsprocket in Dustwallow Marsh.

english.title: The Essence of Enmity
english.objectives: Bring 10 Black Dragonkin Essences to Brogg at Mudsprocket.
english.description: To make the totem Brogg will need for his ritual, he must use the essences of the creatures who killed his friends. The hate and anger of Brogg's enemies will fuel the magic of his vengeance.$B$BTrack down Firemane ash tails, scouts, or scalebanes and use Brogg's totem on their corpses. Only when the dragonkin die will they give up their essences.$B$BThe creatures you seek swarm over the Den of Flame to the northwest and the Stonemaul Ruins to the north.
english.progress: Do you have the essences? Brogg must have them to avenge his friends!
english.completion: You have Brogg's thanks, $n. Once Brogg adds their magic to the totem, it will be able to redeem the spirits of Brogg's fallen friends.
english.completed: Return to Brogg at Mudsprocket in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: 石槌之魂
text.objectives: 在石槌废墟让10个石槌之魂得到安息。
text.description: 布洛格已经完成了图腾，它可以让朋友们的灵魂安息。那些龙打过来的时候，杀死了所有没来得及逃走的石槌食人魔。布洛格跟着莫格穆洛克大王逃了出来，希望能领导其他幸存下来的石槌食人魔发动反击。$B$B不过，反击一直没有开始，而死去同胞们的灵魂却一直困扰着布洛格与其他人。把这根图腾带到北边的石槌废墟去，在那些食人魔的骸骨旁使用它，将他们的灵魂吸引到你这里，击败那些灵魂，就能让他们获得安息。
text.progress: Brogg must know, have you brought peace to the violent spirits of the Stonemaul?
text.completion: Brogg thanks you for your help, although he knows Overlord Mok'Morokk never will. At least surviving Stonemaul can finally focus on problems with the living and leave dead where they belong. Only one thing remains for Brogg to do.
text.completed: Return to Brogg at Mudsprocket in Dustwallow Marsh.

english.title: Spirits of Stonemaul Hold
english.objectives: Put 10 Stonemaul Spirits to rest at the Stonemaul Ruins.
english.description: Brogg has completed the totem that will put the spirits of his friends to rest. When the dragonkin came, they killed all Stonemaul who did not flee. Brogg fled with Overlord Mok'Morokk, hoping to lead a counterattack with other Stonemaul survivors.$B$BThe counterattack never came and the spirits of the Stonemaul dead still haunt Brogg and the others. Take this totem north to Stonemaul Ruins and use it near ogre skeletons to draw the spirit to you. Defeat the spirit to give it rest with its bones.
english.progress: Brogg must know, have you brought peace to the violent spirits of the Stonemaul?
english.completion: Brogg thanks you for your help, although he knows Overlord Mok'Morokk never will. At least surviving Stonemaul can finally focus on problems with the living and leave dead where they belong. Only one thing remains for Brogg to do.
english.completed: Return to Brogg at Mudsprocket in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: 挑战黑龙军团
text.objectives: 将石槌战旗插在奥妮克希亚的巢穴入口附近，击败回应的人。
text.description: 布洛格已经决定要对沼泽里那些黑龙展开复仇了。$n，为了这一刻你一直在提供帮助。你会帮忙吗？$B$B把布洛格的氏族旗帜带上，到东边去找一处类似龙嘴的洞穴，把旗帜插在那里。这样就象征着布洛格对奥妮克希亚的挑战。$B$B布洛格和石槌氏族一定要夺回属于我们自己的土地！
text.progress: Brogg will have his revenge!
text.completion: Brogg know Onyxia dead. Brogg know her brood still there. Brogg not let them forget the Stonemaul. Brogg is grateful for your help, $n, and he will never forget what you have done for him. Brogg will never give up his quest to bring Stonemaul back where they belong.
text.completed: Return to Brogg at Mudsprocket in Dustwallow Marsh.

english.title: Challenge to the Black Flight
english.objectives: Plant the Stonemaul Banner near the entrance to Onyxia's Lair and defeat anyone who answers.
english.description: Brogg relishes the thought of taking his revenge on the black dragonkin of the marsh. $n, you have been very helpful in preparing for this moment. Will you help?$B$BTake Brogg's clan banner and travel east until you see a cave like a dragon's mouth. At the entrance to that cave, plant Stonemaul banner and issue Brogg's challenge to Onyxia.$B$BBrogg and the Stonemaul will have their lands back!
english.progress: Brogg will have his revenge!
english.completion: Brogg know Onyxia dead. Brogg know her brood still there. Brogg not let them forget the Stonemaul. Brogg is grateful for your help, $n, and he will never forget what you have done for him. Brogg will never give up his quest to bring Stonemaul back where they belong.
english.completed: Return to Brogg at Mudsprocket in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: 悬赏：贪婪的血爪
text.objectives: 杀死贪婪的血爪，然后向泥链镇的德拉兹特·迪普瓦尔复命。
text.description: 旅行者以及从事野外作业的热砂港雇员请注意，不要靠近城镇西边的鲜血沼泽墓穴。$B$B大群迅猛龙盘踞在那片区域，它们的首领“贪婪的血爪”既残忍又狡猾，至少有两名热砂港工程师惨死于这只野兽的利爪之下。$B$B如果谁能替泥链镇解除威胁，德拉兹特·迪普瓦尔愿意慷慨解囊，奖赏这位勇士。
text.completion: Thank goodness someone's finally taken me up on that offer. I was just thinking that I might need to triple the reward to get that stupid raptor killed, and our budget couldn't afford that!
text.completed: Return to Drazzit Dripvalve at Mudsprocket in Dustwallow Marsh.

english.title: WANTED: Goreclaw the Ravenous
english.objectives: Kill Goreclaw the Ravenous and report to Drazzit Dripvalve at Mudsprocket.
english.description: Travelers and Steamwheedle personnel working in the field are advised to avoid the Bloodfen Burrow to the west of town.$B$BThe area is overrun with raptors lead by the cruel and cunning Goreclaw the Ravenous, who has already killed at least two Steamwheedle engineers.$B$BDrazzit Dripvalve has authorized a generous reward to be paid to the individual who rids Mudsprocket of this menace.
english.completion: Thank goodness someone's finally taken me up on that offer. I was just thinking that I might need to triple the reward to get that stupid raptor killed, and our budget couldn't afford that!
english.completed: Return to Drazzit Dripvalve at Mudsprocket in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: 龙尾草
text.objectives: 从黑龙谷或巨龙沼泽收集8根龙尾草。
text.description: 飞艇的坠毁延缓了补给品的到达，我们的药品和绷带都用完了。$B$B我们正在利用一切可以获得的资源，不过这些虫子、伤者和一切与我们为敌的家伙都让我们焦头烂额，我快要坚持不下去了！我找到了一种草药，可以治疗伤口和缓解疼痛，但它也快要用完了。$B$B这种草药被称为龙尾草，它遍布在村子东面的黑龙谷和巨龙沼泽地区。那种植物的茎杆是卷曲的，而且你看着它们的时候似乎会微微地跳动。
text.progress: Did you find any of the wyrmtail?
text.completion: Thank you! This will help keep our guys going out in the field until Moxie returns with the rest of the supplies from the zeppelin crash.
text.completed: Return to Gizzix Grimegurgle at Mudsprocket in Dustwallow Marsh.

english.title: Catch a Dragon by the Tail
english.objectives: Collect 8 Wyrmtail stalks in the Dragonmurk or Wyrmbog.
english.description: With the zeppelin crash delaying supplies, we've run out of medicines and bandages.$B$BWe're making use of what we can, but between all the insects, the injuries, and the enemies we're encountering here, I can barely keep up! I've found one herb that seems to help heal wounds and dull pain, but it, too, is in short supply.$B$BIt's called wyrmtail, and it's abundant in the Dragonmurk and Wyrmbog areas east of town. The plants themselves are made of coiled stalks, and seem to pulsate when you look at them.
english.progress: Did you find any of the wyrmtail?
english.completion: Thank you! This will help keep our guys going out in the field until Moxie returns with the rest of the supplies from the zeppelin crash.
english.completed: Return to Gizzix Grimegurgle at Mudsprocket in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: 龙族的源头
text.objectives: 蕨墙村的德拉兹辛比要你给他带7条灼热之舌和7颗灼热之心。
text.description: 那个洞穴里的傻瓜莫格穆洛克沉迷在权力当中；萨尔格则同悲伤和复仇的恶魔挣扎作一处，想要争夺氏族的领导权。查明入侵我们老家源头的事情，看来只有我一个人关心。$b$b干嘛这么不解地看着我，$n？因为我是一个食人魔，所以就得像个没教养的粗人一样说话吗？$b$b说回正事，给我从雏龙和幼崽身上弄点心脏和舌头来。我将追查这邪恶的根源……
text.progress: 只要有了黑龙的舌头和心脏，我就可以找出是什麽样的卑鄙野兽把它们带到了我们的家园里。我们对这些侵略者的了解越深，就越有可能找到除掉它们的办法，收复已毁灭的石槌村。$B$B当然，要说服莫格穆洛克挪动他那肥胖臃肿的身体离开这个鬼地方根本是不可能的任务……
text.completion: 收集这些心脏和舌头确实是件危险的事。我会深入研究这个秘密，找出袭击我们以前家园的罪魁祸首。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Draz'Zilb at Brackenwall Village in Dustwallow Marsh.

english.title: Identifying the Brood
english.objectives: Draz'Zilb in Brackenwall Village would like you to bring him 7 Searing Tongues and 7 Searing Hearts.
english.description: Whilst that craven fool, Mok'Morokk, wallows in power and Tharg wrestles the demons of sorrow and vengeance and vies for leadership of the clan, I seem to be the only one concerned with identifying the source of aggression on our old home.$b$bWhy the puzzled stare, $n? Expecting me to speak like an uncouth ruffian merely because I am an ogre?$b$bNow back to business, bring to me the hearts and tongues from the whelps and hatchlings. I shall trace the root of this evil...
english.progress: With the hearts and tongues of scorched offspring of the black dragon army, I can decipher what wretched beast introduced her spawn into our home. Perhaps with a greater knowledge of our aggressors, we can seek to destroy them once and for all and reclaim Stonemaul Village from ruin.$b$bOf course, convincing Mok'Morokk to move his lethargic, fat mass out of this muck hole is going to be an epic quest in and of itself...
english.completion: 'Twas a perilous affair, no doubt, collecting all of these hearts and tongues. I shall delve into the depths of the arcane to trace the origin of the black menace which has descended upon our former home.
english.completed: Return to Draz'Zilb at Brackenwall Village in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: 奥妮克希亚的血脉
text.objectives: 摧毁5枚奥妮克希亚的蛋。
text.description: 黑龙谷到处都是奥妮克希亚的子嗣，决不能让它们继续繁殖下去了！$b$b赶紧到尘泥沼泽南部的巨龙沼泽去，那儿肯定是奥妮克希亚的巢穴。找到那里邪恶的龙蛋，把它们给毁了。$b$b如果他们还在不断滋生，我们就别想夺回石槌村。$b$b至于莫格穆洛克这个家伙……我自有办法。
text.completion: 太出色了!奥妮克希亚还得再等一段时间才能产出更多卵来。$B$B我代表我的族人感谢你，$N。$B$B我已经要求你做了太多，不过你还可以为石槌氏族做最後一件事。$B$B莫格穆洛克不适合领导我们，而萨尔格却是个出色的领袖，只不过因为年纪和伤痛而无法胜任。用武力把莫格穆洛克从这儿赶出去吧，只有这样我们才能选出一个新领袖，带领我们重返南方的家园。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Draz'Zilb at Brackenwall Village in Dustwallow Marsh.

english.title: The Brood of Onyxia
english.objectives: Destroy 5 Eggs of Onyxia.
english.description: Onyxia's brood has been scattered across the Dragonmurk. It is imperative that no more whelps be permitted to hatch.$b$bMake haste to Wyrmbog in the south of Dustwallow Marsh. Surely, she has made her lair there. Track down the evil dragon's eggs and destroy them.$b$bWe will never reclaim Stonemaul Village if the surrounding area remains a breeding ground.$b$bAs for Mok'Morokk... I have other plans for the sod.
english.completion: Splendid! It will be sometime before Onyxia can produce more eggs. On behalf of my people, I thank you, $n. I have asked much of you so far. Perhaps you can do the Stonemaul Clan one last service. Mok'Morokk is not fit to lead us. Tharg would make an excellent leader but is hindered by his injuries and age. Drive Mok'Morokk from this place by force. Only then can we appoint a new leader to return us to our proper home in the south.
english.completed: Return to Draz'Zilb at Brackenwall Village in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: 奥妮克希亚的血脉
text.objectives: 跟蕨墙村的莫格穆洛克大王谈一谈。
text.description: 入侵石槌村的是奥妮克希亚的血脉。但黑龙领主死亡之翼的女儿，为什么要屈尊降临在我们的土地上呢？$b$b这实在令人不安。显然，奥妮克希亚来到这里绝对不是为了围攻一小帮食人魔的。$b$b马上通报莫格穆洛克！现在就要采取行动！
text.completion: 你跟我说那些龙干嘛?我不喜欢龙。我喜欢这儿，这儿没有龙。$B$B

english.title: The Brood of Onyxia
english.objectives: Speak with Overlord Mok'Morokk in Brackenwall Village.
english.description: Stonemaul Village was invaded by the brood of Onyxia. But why would the daughter of the black dragonlord, Deathwing, descend upon our lands?$b$bThis is most troubling. Surely, Onyxia was driven here for a purpose beyond laying siege to a small band of ogres.$b$bNotify Mok'Morokk at once! Action must be taken.
english.completion: Why you tell me 'bout dragons? Me no like dragons. Me like it here. No dragons here.

text.title: 奥妮克希亚的血脉
text.objectives: 跟蕨墙村的德拉兹辛比谈一谈。
text.description: 别烦我。去告诉德拉兹辛比，我们就留在这儿。这儿没有黑龙。
text.completion: 那个懒惰的懦夫!$B$B雷克萨还是我们领袖的时候，莫格穆洛克还挺有能力的，谁知道雷克萨一走，他就成了权力的奴仆!他不再领导我们，而是不断要求我们;他不再为他的人民服务，而是要其他人为他服务。$B$B我们一定得做点什麽才行。$B$B

english.title: The Brood of Onyxia
english.objectives: Speak with Draz'Zilb in Brackenwall Village.
english.description: You leave me alone now. Go tell Draz'Zilb we stay here. No black dragon here.
english.completion: That lazy coward! Mok'Morokk displayed strength when Rexxar was our leader. But soon after Rexxar's departure Mok'Morokk fell prey to temptations of power. Rather than lead, he demanded. He does not serve his people but rather expects us to serve him. Something must be done.

text.title: 挑战莫格穆洛克大王
text.objectives: 打败莫格穆洛克，将消息报告给蕨墙村的德拉兹辛比。
text.description: 你竟然挑战莫格穆洛克大王？$b$b哈！$b$b我碾碎小小的$r！$b$b准备好挨揍了就告诉我！
text.completion: 那个懦弱又臃肿的莫格穆洛克象个受惊的小阿一样逃跑了。你做得很好，$N。$B$B现在我们要选一个新领袖来帮助我们重新夺回我们的家园。$B$B
text.end: 把莫格穆洛克大王赶出蕨墙村
text.completed: 去尘泥沼泽，找蕨墙村的德拉兹辛比。

english.title: Challenge Overlord Mok'Morokk
english.objectives: Defeat Mok'Morokk and report the news to Draz'Zilb in Brackenwall Village.
english.description: You dare challenge Overlord Mok'Morokk?$b$bHaw!$b$bMe crush tiny $r!$b$bYou tell me when ready for good beating.
english.completion: That cowardly fat mass Mok'Morokk fled like a scared child. You have done a great service, $n. Now my people can appoint a new leader, one who will help us reclaim our old home once and for all.
english.end: Drive Overlord Mok'Morokk from Brackenwall Village
english.completed: Return to Draz'Zilb at Brackenwall Village in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: 黑龙军团
text.objectives: 蕨墙村的萨尔格要你去杀掉10个火鬃斥候，10个火鬃灰尾龙人和5个火鬃守卫。
text.description: 雷克萨让莫格穆洛克做大王。莫格穆洛克只知道权力，很少关心食人魔。$B$B黑龙杀了很多食人魔，还杀了萨尔格的妻子。莫格穆洛克叫我们逃跑，让我们到这儿来。$B$B食人魔应该战斗。食人魔不逃跑。莫格穆洛克只关心他自己。$B$B我只把石槌村叫做家。我喜欢南边。$B$B帮食人魔打黑龙军团。我们要复仇。我们要回家。
text.completed: Return to Tharg at Brackenwall Village in Dustwallow Marsh.

english.title: Army of the Black Dragon
english.objectives: Tharg in Brackenwall Village wants you to kill 10 Firemane Scouts, 10 Firemane Ash Tails, and 5 Firemane Scalebanes.
english.description: Mok'Morokk was made Overlord by Rexxar. He care more for power than he care for ogres.$b$bBlack dragons kill many ogre. Kill Tharg's wife. Mok'Morokk tell us to run. Make us come here.$b$bOgre should fight. Ogres not good at running. Mok'Morokk care only about Mok'Morokk.$b$bMe call Stonemaul Ruins home. Me like it in the south. This place not home.$b$bHelp ogres fight army of the black dragon. Me want revenge. Me want to go home.
english.completed: Return to Tharg at Brackenwall Village in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: 延缓灾难
text.objectives: 从黑暗教徒和暗影法师手中夺取控制符文，然后对它们使用过载魔尘，摧毁3台瘟疫传播器。
text.description: 你的眼睛可真尖，我藏在草丛里都被你看到了。$B$B我们前方就是蘑菇谷，那里仍然被天灾军团牢牢控制着。它们使用浮空的设备，持续侵蚀着土地，使它保持邪恶的污染状态。$B$B那些设备是由符文控制的，黑暗教徒和暗影法师手里就有这种符文。去弄到他们的符文，对准那些瘟疫传播器，然后使用这种魔尘使它们过载。结果想必会很有趣。
text.completion: The sooner those Scourge are pushed out of the Fungal Vale, the sooner we can heal it. Thank you, $n.
text.completed: Return to Rayne near the entrance to the Fungal Vale in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: Postponing the Inevitable
english.objectives: Obtain Control Runes from Dark Cultists and Shadowmages, then use the Overcharged Mote on them to destroy 3 Plague Disseminators.
english.description: You have a keen eye to have seen me here, hidden among the grasses.$b$bAhead of us lies the Fungal Vale, an area that the Scourge still cling tightly to.  They use floating constructs to continually re-plague the land, keeping it vile and polluted.$b$bThe devices are controlled with runes, which are held by dark adepts and shadowmages.  Take the controlling runes that these cultists hold, aim them at the plague disseminators, then overcharge them with this mote.  The results should be amusing.
english.completion: The sooner those Scourge are pushed out of the Fungal Vale, the sooner we can heal it. Thank you, $n.
english.completed: Return to Rayne near the entrance to the Fungal Vale in Eastern Plaguelands.

text.title: 死亡中的新生
text.objectives: 在蘑菇谷的三座通灵塔的中心区域使用莱茵的种子。
text.description: 天灾军团确实把蘑菇谷变成了一片不毛之地——你在这里只能看到腐烂的蘑菇和烧焦的野草。谷中的三个角落里各有一座大型通灵塔，他们在那里复活亡者，召唤新的士兵投入战场。$B$B但是，就在这样邪恶荒芜的地方，生命之花依然可以绽放。拿着这些种子，把它们种在那些通灵塔的中心。让天灾军团看看，生命是多么的坚强。
text.completion: Even if the flowers died out shortly after they bloomed, they proved our point to the Scourge: they are losing, and we are winning. Thank you for your assistance.
text.completed: Return to Rayne near the entrance to the Fungal Vale in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: Amidst Death, Life
english.objectives: Use Rayne's Seeds in the center of the three ziggurats in the Fungal Vale.
english.description: Scourge forces have made it a point to ensure that nothing survives in the Fungal Vale - all you will find are husks of rotted mushrooms and scorched grasses.  The three corners of the vale are home to three large ziggurats, which they use to reanimate their dead and summon new soldiers to the battlefield.$b$bYet even in this evil, lifeless place, life finds a way to flourish.  Take my seeds and plant them in the centers of these ziggurats.  Prove to them that life will prevail.
english.completion: Even if the flowers died out shortly after they bloomed, they proved our point to the Scourge: they are losing, and we are winning. Thank you for your assistance.
english.completed: Return to Rayne near the entrance to the Fungal Vale in Eastern Plaguelands.

text.title: 兵临城下
text.objectives: 跟马队管理者布鲁斯·石锤谈一谈。
text.description: 如果控制不了斯坦索姆，我们就控制不了东瘟疫之地。它不仅仅是一个战略要冲，同时也是敌魁——巴纳扎尔和奥里克斯·瑞文戴尔领主的老家。他们的复生者和天灾大军会让我们的一切努力都化为泡影。$B$B这个任务交给银色北伐军再合适不过了。到西边穿过斯坦索姆的大门，同马队管理者布鲁斯·石锤谈一谈。他将做出进一步的指示。
text.completion: What a relief it is to see an able-bodied soldier that's on our side! There's plenty for ye to do around here, $r.

english.title: A City Under Siege
english.objectives: Speak to Packmaster Stonebruiser.
english.description: We will never control the Eastern Plaguelands if we do not control Stratholme. Not only is it a point of incredible strategic importance, it also houses our enemies' leaders - Balnazzar and Lord Aurius Rivendare. Their Risen and Scourge armies threaten to erase all the progress we've made.$B$BThe Argent Crusade is well-suited to this task. Travel west through Stratholme's main gate and speak with Packmaster Stonebruiser. He will direct you further.
english.completion: What a relief it is to see an able-bodied soldier that's on our side! There's plenty for ye to do around here, $r.

starters.name: 银色黎明军官伊利扎里

enders.name: 马队管理者布鲁斯·石锤

text.title: 抵抗是徒劳的
