english.completion: Only one may enter? I know just the person for this mission. I will prepare our forces and have them at the ready.

text.title: 热烈欢迎
text.objectives: 去找朱红庇护所的莉拉斯塔萨。
text.description: 真高兴你回来了！我肯定，你是去拯救世界或别的什么了。$B$B我被派来同这一地区的红龙建立联系，但我发现这一群不像龙眠联军的那些好说话。然而，我听说你十分擅长解决此类问题。$B$B你就是专门来解决麻烦的。$B$B去西南的朱红庇护所赢得莉拉斯塔萨的信任如何？只要能说服她，剩下的就好办了。
text.completion: I'm glad Lira didn't scare you off. I won't say her concerns aren't warranted, but we have a common enemy. She is perhaps a bit overzealous.
text.completed: Speak with Calen at Vermillion Redoubt.

english.title: Warm Welcome
english.objectives: Meet with Lirastrasza at Vermillion Redoubt.
english.description: I'm glad you're back! Saving the world or something, I'm sure.$B$BI was dispatched to establish relations with the red dragons in the area, but I'm finding this bunch somewhat less accommodating than the ones at Wyrmrest were. I have, however, been told that you are the type that solves problems.$B$BA problem solver as it were.$B$BCare to take a crack at earning a bit of trust with Lirastrasza at Vermillion Redoubt to the southwest? Anything that might soften her up a bit for me would be lovely.
english.completion: I'm glad Lira didn't scare you off. I won't say her concerns aren't warranted, but we have a common enemy. She is perhaps a bit overzealous.
english.completed: Speak with Calen at Vermillion Redoubt.

text.title: 热烈欢迎
text.objectives: 去找朱红庇护所的莉拉斯塔萨。
text.description: 很好。你回来了。又拯救了一次世界吧，我想。$B$B我被派来同这一地区的红龙建立联系，但我发现这一群不像龙眠的那些好说话。然而，我听说你十分擅长解决此类问题。$B$B你就是专门来解决麻烦的。$B$B我需要你去西南边的朱红庇护所赢得莉拉斯塔萨的信任。我们同龙喉的关系让事情有点复杂，不过但愿你能让事情缓和下来。
text.completion: I'm glad Lira didn't scare you off. I won't say her concerns aren't warranted, but we have a common enemy. She is perhaps a bit overzealous.
text.completed: Speak with Calen at Vermillion Redoubt.

english.title: Warm Welcome
english.objectives: Meet with Lirastrasza at Vermillion Redoubt.
english.description: Good. You're back. Saving the world again I assume.$B$BI was dispatched to establish relations with the red dragons in the area, but I'm finding this bunch somewhat less accommodating than the ones at Wyrmrest were. I have, however, been told that you are the type that solves problems.$B$BA problem solver as it were.$B$BI need you to gain the trust of Lirastrasza at Vermillion Redoubt to the southwest. Our association with the Dragonmaw has complicated things, but I'm hoping you can ease relations.
english.completion: I'm glad Lira didn't scare you off. I won't say her concerns aren't warranted, but we have a common enemy. She is perhaps a bit overzealous.
english.completed: Speak with Calen at Vermillion Redoubt.

text.title: 冥界领主埃克斯拉尔
text.objectives: 击败冥界领主埃克斯拉尔和他的10个爪牙。
text.description: 我知道我们应该去北谷，但这事不是很急，对吧？而且，这个可爱的小地精刚刚告诉我，这附近就有一些天灾余孽。$b$b是这样的，有个名叫埃克斯拉尔的蛛怪领主，在巫妖王死后就一直想要确立自己的势力，他在我们的北边建立了一座亡灵营地。$b$b当然，泰罗索斯想让我们去北谷杀女妖，没问题。不过我们可以先去干掉这个蛛魔，反正很近嘛！
text.completion: I couldn't stop him.  While you and Tarenar were out, Giddy ran north all alone! Tarenar, you should have known better!  Gidwin gets so impatient sometimes, and you only egg him on.  If Giddy gets into any trouble, I'm blaming you for this.
text.completed: Return to Fiona at Eastwall Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: Ix'lar the Underlord
english.objectives: Kill Ix'lar the Underlord and 10 of his minions.
english.description: I know we're supposed to head to Northdale, but that can wait, right?  Besides, this lovely little goblin was just telling me about some Scourge that are even closer by.$b$bSo apparently there's this nerubian underlord named Ix'lar that has been trying to make a name for himself ever since the Lich King was slain.  He's set up a camp of undead to our north.$b$bSure, Tyrosus wants us to kill banshees in Northdale.  We'll get to that.  But let's kill this nerubian first, while we're close!
english.completion: I couldn't stop him.  While you and Tarenar were out, Giddy ran north all alone! Tarenar, you should have known better!  Gidwin gets so impatient sometimes, and you only egg him on.  If Giddy gets into any trouble, I'm blaming you for this.
english.completed: Return to Fiona at Eastwall Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

objectiveDetails.description: 杀死埃克斯拉尔的爪牙

text.title: 急躁
text.objectives: 在北谷里寻找吉德文·金须。
text.description: 那个天杀的矮人。他总是让我跟菲奥拉闹矛盾。看看她吧！她都懒得理我了！$b$b我要待在这里，弥补我跟这位狼人朋友之间的友谊。你能去看看吉德文的情况吗？我相信他是不会出事的，他肯定知道怎么照顾自己。吉德文朝北边去了，应该没有走远。
text.progress: Northdale is home to a few ghosts and banshees.  Nothing ol' Giddy can't handle.
text.completion: You didn't see him?  Where could he have gone then? His... his prayer book?  Why would he leave that behind? Oh... By the Light, what have I done?
text.completed: Return to Tarenar Sunstrike at Eastwall Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: Impatience
english.objectives: Search for Gidwin Goldbraids in Northdale.
english.description: Damn that dwarf.  He's always getting me in trouble with Fiona.  Look at her!  She won't even TALK to me!$b$bI'm going to stay here and try to mend my friendship with our worgen friend.  Would you mind going out and making sure Gidwin is alright?  I'm sure he's fine; he knows how to take care of himself.  He headed north, and he can't have gone far.
english.progress: Northdale is home to a few ghosts and banshees.  Nothing ol' Giddy can't handle.
english.completion: You didn't see him?  Where could he have gone then? His... his prayer book?  Why would he leave that behind? Oh... By the Light, what have I done?
english.completed: Return to Tarenar Sunstrike at Eastwall Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

text.title: 全都怪我
text.objectives: 跳上菲奥拉的马车，前往北地哨塔。
text.description: 这是我的错。我……我忽略了他的警告，他的抱怨，我全都忽略了。我控制不住自己——我看到哨塔那边的天灾士兵，就……就忍不住杀过去了。$B$B阿尔古斯说吉德文被带到了西北方，我们只有这一条线索，所以我们只能朝那边去。$B$B该死的北谷和银色北伐军！我们必须从那些天灾渣滓手中夺回吉德文。
text.progress: We have no time, $n!  We must press on!
text.completion: Time is wasting, $n.  Every minute we waste gives the Scourge another chance to kill Gidwin.  If he isn't dead already. Not that I think he is.  Giddy may be a stick-in-the-mud, but when it comes down to it, he can swing the Light like a champion.
text.completed: Speak with Tarenar Sunstrike at Northpass Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: Nobody to Blame but Myself
english.objectives: Hop in Fiona's Caravan and ride to Northpass Tower.
english.description: This is my fault.  I... I ignored his warnings, his complaints, everything.  I couldn't help myself - I saw those Scourge just beyond the tower, and I... I HAD to go kill them.$b$bArgus says that Gidwin was taken northwest, and that's our only lead, so that's where we'll head.$b$bNorthdale and the Argent Crusade be damned!  We're getting Gidwin back from those Scourge trash.
english.progress: We have no time, $n!  We must press on!
english.completion: Time is wasting, $n.  Every minute we waste gives the Scourge another chance to kill Gidwin.  If he isn't dead already. Not that I think he is.  Giddy may be a stick-in-the-mud, but when it comes down to it, he can swing the Light like a champion.
english.completed: Speak with Tarenar Sunstrike at Northpass Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

objectiveDetails.description: 乘坐菲奥拉的马车前往北地哨塔

text.title: 空降军情七处
text.objectives: 从安古斯·巍山那里接收一支蛮锤恶徒小队，护送他们前往暮光之门里的空降点。
text.description: 马迪亚斯·肖尔和军情七处的特工来到了这里支援我们在暮光堡垒的行动，我要派你护送他们过去。$B$B蛮锤矮人为我们提供了运输设备。不过特工们还要先去暮光之门那里办一些事情。$B$B去跟安古斯·巍山谈谈，让他派一支小队给你。你负责把他们运送到目的地，就是有一个蓝色X标记的地方。
text.completion: That must have been deadly. While I don't approve of their methods, no one can question the effectiveness of Master Mathias Shaw and his SI:7. Not to mention that you're here. Our victory is all but assured.
text.completed: Return to Cassius the White at Victor's Point in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: SI:7 Drop
english.objectives: Get a Wildhammer Hellions squad from Angus Stillmountain and then escort them to the drop off point in the Twilight Gate.
english.description: Mathias Shaw and the SI:7 are here to assist us with operations up top in the Twilight Citadel. I need you to escort them there.$B$BThe Wildhammer are being kind enough to give us a lift in. The agents have some things that they need to do down in the Twilight Gate area first, though.$B$BSpeak with Angus Stillmountain and get yourself a squad to drop off. You'll fly them in. A big blue X marks the spot.
english.completion: That must have been deadly. While I don't approve of their methods, no one can question the effectiveness of Master Mathias Shaw and his SI:7. Not to mention that you're here. Our victory is all but assured.
english.completed: Return to Cassius the White at Victor's Point in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 空降库卡隆
text.objectives: 从乔乔·黏脖那里接收一支碎击驭风者小队，护送他们前往暮光之门里的空降点。
text.description: 迦罗娜和一队库卡隆战士来到了这里支援我们在暮光堡垒的行动，我要派你护送他们过去。$B$B我已经让本地的巨魔部族提供了双足飞龙作为运输工具，不过那些刺客还有些事要先去暮光之门那里办了。$B$B去跟巨魔酋长乔乔·黏脖聊聊，然后带着一支库卡隆分队出发吧。你负责把他们运送到目的地，就是有一个红色X标记的地方。
text.completion: That must have been exciting. Despite any losses that the Kor'kron may have incurred along the way, no one will be able to doubt their effectiveness, nor that of Garona. And with you in the mix, it's only a matter of time before victory is ours.
text.completed: Return to Lady Cozwynn at Crushblow in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Kor'kron Drop
english.objectives: Get a Crushblow Wind Rider squad from Jon-Jon Jellyneck and then escort them to the drop off point in the Twilight Gate.
english.description: Garona and a detachment of the Kor'kron are here to assist us with operations up top in the Twilight Citadel. I need you to escort them there.$B$BI've called upon a local tribe of trolls to give us a lift in with their wind riders. The assassins have some things that they need to do down in the Twilight Gate area first, though.$B$BSpeak with the troll chief, Jon-Jon Jellyneck and get yourself a detachment of Kor'kron to drop off. You'll fly them in. A big red X marks the spot.
english.completion: That must have been exciting. Despite any losses that the Kor'kron may have incurred along the way, no one will be able to doubt their effectiveness, nor that of Garona. And with you in the mix, it's only a matter of time before victory is ours.
english.completed: Return to Lady Cozwynn at Crushblow in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 食人魔和双头魔
text.objectives: 在暮光之门杀死10个食人魔和双头魔。
text.description: 在发动任何攻击之前，都要先削弱敌人的防御力量。攻进堡垒的战况僵持不下，但是像你这样的……嗯，这么说吧，我一点都不怀疑你可以冲进西南方的暮光之门去，给那些血眼氏族的食人魔和双头魔一点颜色尝尝！
text.completion: That's the spirit, lad! Today's already shaping up to be a good one.
text.completed: Return to Kurdran Wildhammer at Victor's Point in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Ogres & Ettins
english.objectives: Slay 10 ogres or ettins at the Twilight Gate.
english.description: As with any offensive, you first need to soften them up. We've been having a heck of a time getting in there. But someone like you... well, let's just say I have no doubt in my mind that you can get into the Twilight Gate to the southwest and teach the Bloodeye Clan ogres and ettins a thing or two!
english.completion: That's the spirit, lad! Today's already shaping up to be a good one.
english.completed: Return to Kurdran Wildhammer at Victor's Point in the Twilight Highlands.

objectiveDetails.description: 杀死血眼氏族的食人魔和双头魔

text.title: 食人魔和双头魔
text.objectives: 在暮光之门杀死10个食人魔和双头魔。
text.description: 我要派你到那堆石头工事后面去，前往西北方的暮光之门，干掉里面的所有血眼氏族的食人魔和双头魔。你能摆平他们吗，$n？
text.completion: And here I thought that today couldn't get any better. I enjoy being wrong, occasionally.
text.completed: Return to Warlord Zaela at Crushblow in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Ogres & Ettins
english.objectives: Slay 10 Bloodeye Clan ogres or ettins at the Twilight Gate.
english.description: I want you to get in there past those boulders to the northwest at the Twilight Gate. Kill every Bloodeye Clan ogre and ettin in sight. Think you can handle that for me, $n?
english.completion: And here I thought that today couldn't get any better. I enjoy being wrong, occasionally.
english.completed: Return to Warlord Zaela at Crushblow in the Twilight Highlands.

objectiveDetails.description: 杀死血眼氏族的食人魔和双头魔

text.title: 移山
text.objectives: 引爆隐藏的炸药，将碎颅者魔山从暮光之门引开。
text.description: 在攻打暮光之门之前，我们必须先把碎颅者魔山引开！$B$B在你们的军情七处特工出发之前，我让他们拿了一些炸药并藏在暮光之锤的箱子里。现在，他们应该已经把炸药安放在通往堡垒顶部的台阶上了。$B$B我要你去引爆炸药，然后等那个怪物跑出去查看的时候给我们发信号。$B$B届时我们就会发动攻击，解决这个食人魔的据点！

english.title: Move the Mountain
english.objectives: Detonate the Hidden Explosives to lure Skullcrusher the Mountain away from the Twilight Gate.
english.description: If the Twilight Gate is to fall, we need to get Skullcrusher the Mountain out of there!$B$BBefore they left, I saw to it that your SI:7 agents took some explosives hidden in a Twilight's Hammer crate. By now, they will have planted them on the steps leading up to the upper portion of the Citadel.$B$BI want you to set the explosives off and then signal us when that monster's out of the way.$B$BThat's when we'll attack and finish off the ogre compound!

text.title: 移山
text.objectives: 引爆隐藏的炸药，将碎颅者魔山从暮光之门引开。
text.description: 在攻打暮光之门之前，我们必须先把碎颅者魔山引开！$B$B在你们的库卡隆刺客出发之前，我让他们拿了一些炸药并藏在暮光之锤的箱子里。现在，他们应该已经把炸药安放在通往堡垒顶部的台阶上了。$B$B我要你去引爆炸药，然后等那个怪物跑出去查看的时候给我们发信号。$B$B届时我们就会发动攻击，解决这个食人魔的据点！

english.title: Move the Mountain
english.objectives: Detonate the Hidden Explosives to lure Skullcrusher the Mountain away from the Twilight Gate.
english.description: If the Twilight Gate is to fall, we must get Skullcrusher the Mountain out of there!$B$BBefore they left, I saw to it that your Kor'kron assassins took some explosives hidden in a Twilight's Hammer crate. By now, they will have planted them on the steps leading up to the upper portion of the Citadel.$B$BI want you to set the explosives off and then signal us when that monster's out of the way.$B$BThat's when we'll attack and finish off the ogre compound!

text.title: 呼叫炮火
text.objectives: 在暮光之门里使用炮火信号弹标记北部、东北部、西南部和南部的建筑物。
text.description: 其实我更喜欢堂堂正正的对决。我们本该手刃这些该死的怪物，但是眼下的局势要求我们动用更凶狠的手段。$B$B拿着这把信号枪，标记西南边的暮光之门里面的四座建筑物。我们的火炮会好好修理他们一番的。
text.completion: Thanks to you, our cannoneers hit their marks. Tell me about the situation within the Twilight Gate.
text.completed: Return to Cassius the White at Victor's Point in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Call in the Artillery
english.objectives: Use the Artillery Flare to target the Northern, Northeastern, Southwestern, and Southern buildings at the Twilight Gate.
english.description: I prefer a stand up honorable fight. These monsters deserve nothing better than to be destroyed by the weapons in our hands. However, this particular situation calls for the use of more powerful measures.$B$BTake this flare and mark each of the four buildings within the Twilight Gate to the southwest. Our cannons will handle the rest.
english.completion: Thanks to you, our cannoneers hit their marks. Tell me about the situation within the Twilight Gate.
english.completed: Return to Cassius the White at Victor's Point in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 呼叫炮火
text.objectives: 在暮光之门里使用炮火信号弹标记南部、西南部、东北部和东部的建筑物。
text.description: 真遗憾，我们不能再向敌人撒播瘟疫了，要不然这种局面简直是小菜一碟。算了，至少我们还有办法轰穿他们的大门。$B$B拿着这把信号枪，到西北方的暮光之门去标记里面的四座建筑物。剩下的事情就交给我们的火炮啦。
text.completion: I must say that I rather enjoyed the sight of their buildings being hit.
text.completed: Return to Lady Cozwynn at Crushblow in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Call in the Artillery
english.objectives: Use the Artillery Flare to target the Northern, Northeastern, Southwestern, and Southern buildings at the Twilight Gate.
english.description: A pity that we're no longer allowed to drop the Plague on our enemies. It would prove quite effective in this situation. Oh well, at least we have war machines to destroy their precious gates.$B$BI want you to take this flare. Use it to mark each of the four buildings within the Twilight Gate to the northwest. The war machines will handle the rest.
english.completion: I must say that I rather enjoyed the sight of their buildings being hit.
english.completed: Return to Lady Cozwynn at Crushblow in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 发出攻击信号
text.objectives: 到暮光之门中的某座哨塔顶部去，发出攻击信号。
text.description: 既然你已经把碎颅者魔山从暮光之门引开了，现在就赶快发信号通知你们部署在胜利者岗哨的部队发起进攻吧！

english.title: Signal the Attack
english.objectives: Use the Attack Signal from atop one of the towers at the Twilight Gate.
english.description: Now that you've lured Skullcrusher the Mountain away from the Twilight Gate, it's time to signal your forces at Victor's Point to attack!

text.title: 发出攻击信号
text.objectives: 到暮光之门中的某座哨塔顶部去，发出攻击信号。
text.description: 既然你已经把碎颅者魔山从暮光之门引开了，现在就赶快发信号通知你们部署在粉碎者据点的部队发起进攻吧！

english.title: Signal the Attack
english.objectives: Use the Attack Signal from atop one of the towers at the Twilight Gate.
english.description: Now that you've lured Skullcrusher the Mountain away from the Twilight Gate, it's time to signal your forces at Crushblow to attack!

text.title: 四个总比没有好
text.objectives: 收集扎布鲁克斯和毕布伏德的四枚徽记。
text.description: 进攻暮光之门的战斗已经打响，还有最后一点小麻烦要处理：扎布鲁克斯和毕布伏德，古加尔的信徒。$B$B情报显示，他们就在信徒之穴里面，那是暮光之门西南角的一座小型的食人魔洞穴。$B$B你认为卡修斯和库德兰肯定会要求你提供击败他们的证明。
text.progress: Is that blood dripping from your pack?
text.completion: That's quite a gruesome trophy collection you have there. I would have believed you if you had simply said they were dead. Regardless, thank you for having the foresight to take care of them. The Twilight Gate will soon be ours. Time to move up to the Twilight Citadel.
text.completed: Return to Cassius the White at Victor's Point in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Four Heads are Better than None
english.objectives: Collect the four heads of Za'brox and Beeble'phod.
english.description: Now while the attack upon the Twilight Gate is launched, there is one last loose end to tie up: Za'brox and Beeble'phod, the disciples of Cho'gall.$B$BIntelligence has placed them within the Den of the Disciples, a small ogre cave at the southwest corner of the Twilight Gate.$B$BYou're fairly certain that Cassius and Kurdran will want proof of their deaths.
english.progress: Is that blood dripping from your pack?
english.completion: That's quite a gruesome trophy collection you have there. I would have believed you if you had simply said they were dead. Regardless, thank you for having the foresight to take care of them. The Twilight Gate will soon be ours. Time to move up to the Twilight Citadel.
english.completed: Return to Cassius the White at Victor's Point in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 四个总比没有好
text.objectives: 收集扎布鲁克斯和毕布伏德的四枚徽记。
text.description: 进攻暮光之门的战斗已经打响，还有最后一点小麻烦要处理：扎布鲁克斯和毕布伏德，古加尔的信徒。$B$B情报显示，他们就在信徒之穴里面，那是暮光之门西南角的一座小型的食人魔洞穴。$B$B你认为柯丝温女士和扎伊拉肯定会要求你提供击败他们的证明。
text.progress: Is that blood dripping from your pack? I hope that it's not yours.
text.completion: That's quite a gruesome trophy collection you have there. I would have believed you if you had simply said they were dead, though I do appreciate the extra effort. Thank you for having the foresight to take care of them. The Twilight Gate will soon be ours. Time to move up to the Twilight Citadel.
text.completed: Return to Lady Cozwynn at Crushblow in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Four Heads are Better than None
english.objectives: Collect the four heads of Za'brox and Beeble'phod.
english.description: Now while the attack upon the Twilight Gate is launched, there is one last loose end to tie up: Za'brox and Beeble'phod, the disciples of Cho'gall.$B$BIntelligence has placed them within the Den of the Disciples, a small ogre cave at the southwest corner of the Twilight Gate.$B$BYou're fairly certain that Lady Cozwyn and Zaela will want proof of their deaths.
english.progress: Is that blood dripping from your pack? I hope that it's not yours.
english.completion: That's quite a gruesome trophy collection you have there. I would have believed you if you had simply said they were dead, though I do appreciate the extra effort. Thank you for having the foresight to take care of them. The Twilight Gate will soon be ours. Time to move up to the Twilight Citadel.
english.completed: Return to Lady Cozwynn at Crushblow in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 前往暮光堡垒
text.objectives: 跟军情七处战队指挥官谈一谈，然后护送军情七处战队。
text.description: 攻击行动已经展开，是时候前往暮光壁垒了。不介意的话，我想请你护送军情七处的军队抵达马迪亚斯·肖尔大师的所在。$B$B他就躲在高地的某处。你可以向军情七处战队指挥官打听他的具体位置。$B$B谢谢你，$n。我们希望能与你一同打响暮光壁垒的攻击战！

english.title: Up to the Citadel
english.objectives: Speak with the SI:7 Squad Commander and then escort the SI:7 squad.
english.description: Now that the attack is underway, it's time to deal with the Twilight Citadel. If you don't mind, I'd like for you to escort the SI:7 forces to Master Mathias Shaw.$B$BHe's hiding somewhere up top. The SI:7 squad commander can tell you where.$B$BThank you, $n. We look forward to joining you in the assault upon the Citadel!

text.title: 前往暮光堡垒
text.objectives: 跟库卡隆战队指挥官谈一谈，然后护送库卡隆战队。
text.description: 攻击行动已经展开，是时候前往暮光壁垒了。不介意的话，我想请你护送库卡隆的军队抵达迦罗娜的所在。$B$B她就躲在高地的某处。你可以向库卡隆战队指挥官打听她的具体位置。$B$B谢谢你，$n。我们希望能与你一同打响暮光壁垒的攻击战！

english.title: Up to the Citadel
english.objectives: Speak with the Kor'kron Squad Commander and then escort the Kor'kron squad.
english.description: Now that the attack is underway, it's time to deal with the Twilight Citadel. If you don't mind, I'd like for you to escort the Kor'kron forces up to Garona.$B$BShe's hiding somewhere up top. The Kor'kron squad commander can tell you where.$B$BThank you, $n. We look forward to joining you in the assault upon the Citadel!

text.title: 止住巨龙之血
text.objectives: 跟朱红庇护所的瓦莱斯塔萨谈一谈。
text.description: 既然你要提供帮助，那我就恭敬不如从命。$B$B长期以来，我们都苦于和南边的暮光幼龙和巨龙作战。我们的进攻倒也不是没有成效，但是格瑞姆巴托的巨龙对我们施展的腐败吐息需要花时间才能得以净化。$B$B瓦莱斯塔萨和烽焰正在照顾我们受伤的兄弟们。去看看你能不能帮他们什么忙。
text.completion: Calen has become very trusting. It is not often that strangers are permitted within the redoubt.

english.title: Even Dragons Bleed
english.objectives: Speak to Velastrasza within the Vermillion Redoubt.
english.description: I won't be so impolite as to refuse your aid if you're offering it.$B$BWe're locked in constant battle with the twilight drakes and dragons to the south. Our strikes have not been entirely without success, but the dragons coming out of Grim Batol have been breathing some kind of corruption upon us that takes time to cleanse.$B$BVelastrasza and Baleflame are attending to our injured brothers. Go and see if you can be of help to them.
english.completion: Calen has become very trusting. It is not often that strangers are permitted within the redoubt.

text.title: 治疗龙伤
text.objectives: 保护5名治疗受伤巨龙的朱红治疗者。
text.description: 我们的巨龙从战场上撤下来的时候，身上带着暮光的堕落之火，后面还有暮光幼龙在追赶。$B$B我的治疗者可以处理巨龙的伤口，但得有人保护他们。不要让幼龙攻击我的治疗者。愿意的话，你也可以帮忙治疗我们的巨龙。$B$B你能帮忙，我真是太感激了。我们在格瑞姆巴托的战斗简直是无休无止的，必须尽快让最强壮的巨龙重新投入战场。
text.completion: We will take Grim Batol back from the Twilight's Hammer and thier allies. It may take time, but this is one charge that we cannot forsake.
text.completed: Return to Velastrasza in the Vermillion Redoubt.

english.title: Draconic Mending
english.objectives: Safeguard 5 Vermillion Menders as they heal wounded dragons.
english.description: Our dragons are returning from battle covered in Twilight corrupted flame and pursued by Twilight drakes.$B$BMy menders can tend to our dragons' wounds, but they must be defended. Keep the drakes off of my menders. Lend your healing to our dragons as well if you are able.$B$BThank you for your help with this. Our battles for Grim Batol are never-ending. We need to get our strongest dragons back into the battle as soon as possible.
english.completion: We will take Grim Batol back from the Twilight's Hammer and thier allies. It may take time, but this is one charge that we cannot forsake.
english.completed: Return to Velastrasza in the Vermillion Redoubt.

text.title: 起死回生
text.objectives: 将红宝石之种种在朱红庇护所的6具龙族尸体上。
text.description: $R，我有一个任务要交给你。$B$B将这些红宝石之种种在你所发现的龙族尸体上。无论暮光还是朱红，不管龙崽还是巨龙。我们要让他们的尸体重归大地，让生命得以继续繁荣。$B$B新的生命永远会在死亡中出生。在战争和悲剧的年代里，这或许也是一种慰藉。
text.completion: In this, we deny Deathwing the destruction that he so passionately seeks. In this, life continues.
text.completed: Return to Baelflame within the Vermillion Redoubt.

english.title: Life from Death
english.objectives: Plant Ruby Seeds at the corpses of 6 dragonkin within the Vermillion Redoubt.
english.description: $R, I have a task for you.$B$BTake these ruby seeds and plant them at the corpses of any dragonkin that you come across. Twilight or Vermillion, whelping or dragon, it matters not. We need to see that their bodies are returned to the earth so that life can continue to flourish.$B$BIn death, there should always be new life. This may be our one consolation during times of war and great tragedy.
english.completion: In this, we deny Deathwing the destruction that he so passionately seeks. In this, life continues.
english.completed: Return to Baelflame within the Vermillion Redoubt.

text.title: 入侵的暮光
text.objectives: 在朱红庇护所杀死12名暮光入侵者。
text.description: 那些不堪一击的暮光侵略者蜂拥而入。他们从庇护所的西边找到了一个进来的入口。$B$B对那些践踏圣地的人不要留情。把你心头的暴力统统释放在他们头上吧。
text.completion: You have a talent for killing I see. In times like these, that has its place.
text.completed: Return to Calen within the Vermillion Redoubt.

english.title: Encroaching Twilight
english.objectives: Kill 12 Twilight invaders within the Vermillion Redoubt.
english.description: Fragile Twilight invaders litter the redoubt. They're pouring in from somewhere to the west.$B$BThere can be no mercy offered to them within this hallowed place. Whatever violence grips your moral heart, release it upon them.
english.completion: You have a talent for killing I see. In times like these, that has its place.
english.completed: Return to Calen within the Vermillion Redoubt.

text.title: 远离巢穴
text.objectives: 拿回6枚朱红之卵。
text.description: 瞧……我知道你没有理由喜欢我，当然我也不是很喜欢你，但我需要帮助。$B$B我们的卵被这些暮光侵略者给偷走了。我怀疑他们想把卵带回格瑞姆巴托做实验，将它们腐化。我决不允许这事发生。$B$B如果你真的想要帮助我们，就去阻止他们！把卵拿回来，带来给我。
text.progress: Twilight dragons were born of these disgusting experiments of theirs. The Twilight's Hammer have gone too far. Deathwing has gone too far.
text.completion: I don't know if you did this for me or the young inside these eggs, but it doesn't really matter, either way it's clear that you want to be an ally of our flight. I appreciate that. I cannot forgive the attacks by your allies against my brood, but for now, it seems you have chosen the right side.
text.completed: Return to Lirastrasza in the Vermillion Redoubt.

english.title: Far from the Nest
english.objectives: Recover 6 Vermillion Eggs.
english.description: Look... I know you have no reason to be fond of me, just as I'm not terribly fond of you, but I need any help I can get.$B$BOur eggs are being stolen by these Twilight invaders. I have no doubt that they want to take them back to Grim Batol to experiment on and pervert. I will NOT let that happen.$B$BIf you truly do want to help us, stop them! Recover the eggs. Bring them back to me.
english.progress: Twilight dragons were born of these disgusting experiments of theirs. The Twilight's Hammer have gone too far. Deathwing has gone too far.
english.completion: I don't know if you did this for me or the young inside these eggs, but it doesn't really matter, either way it's clear that you want to be an ally of our flight. I appreciate that. I cannot forgive the attacks by your allies against my brood, but for now, it seems you have chosen the right side.
english.completed: Return to Lirastrasza in the Vermillion Redoubt.

text.title: 防线上的突破口
text.objectives: 找到朱红庇护所里暮光之锤的入口，将其摧毁。
text.description: 莉拉的幼龙监视着环绕庇护所的每一寸天空，每一个山头。他们一定是从地下来到圣殿的。$B$B带上这些速燃粉尘。不管他们是通过洞口、通道，还是传送门绕过我们的防御，这些粉尘都能有效地将其关闭。$B$B找到防线上的突破口。封住它。
text.completion: Well done. Thank you, $r. I will not be so foolish as to let such an oversight happen again.
text.completed: Return to Calen in the Vermillion Redoubt.

english.title: Breach in the Defenses
english.objectives: Find the source of the Twilight's Hammer in the Vermillion Redoubt and destroy it.
english.description: Every inch of air and every hill surrounding the redoubt is constantly under the watchful eye of Lira's drakes. They must have found a way into the shrine from beneath.$B$BTake this Flashgrowth mote. It should prove more than sufficient to close any hole, tunnel, or portal they might have used to get inside our defenses.$B$BFind the breach in our defenses. Close it.
english.completion: Well done. Thank you, $r. I will not be so foolish as to let such an oversight happen again.
english.completed: Return to Calen in the Vermillion Redoubt.

text.title: 披着熊皮的狼
text.objectives: 杀死10头低调的熊。
text.description: 这些狼人把我们当傻瓜！你以为只有白痴才会把他们德鲁伊的熊形态和真正的熊搞混吧。不幸的是，银松森林这里白痴还特别多。在有组织的狼人熊攻击下，我们已经损失了好几个营。是的，这事比它听上去更白痴。$B$B往东朝希尔斯布莱德方向去，你可以在林子里找到游荡的狼人德鲁伊，伪装成了野生熊的样子。杀掉他们，确保我们南部补给线的安全。
text.completion: I only hope that we don't end up getting beat down by inconspicuous birds, cats and trees next... or seals. Could you imagine it?
text.completed: Return to High Warlord Cromush at the Forsaken Front in Silverpine Forest.

english.title: A Wolf in Bear's Clothing
english.objectives: Kill 10 Inconspicuous Bears.
english.description: These worgen take us for fools! One would think that only an idiot would mistake one of their druids in bear form as a real bear. Unfortunately, there are many idiots here at the Forsaken Front. We've already lost a few battalions to organized worgen bear attacks. Yes, it's even more idiotic than it sounds.$B$BDirectly east of here, heading towards Hillsbrad, you will find worgen druids roaming the woods, masquerading as bears. Kill them and make our southern supply line safe again.
english.completion: I only hope that we don't end up getting beat down by inconspicuous birds, cats and trees next... or seals. Could you imagine it?
english.completed: Return to High Warlord Cromush at the Forsaken Front in Silverpine Forest.

text.title: 发现的快感
text.objectives: 探索群星之厅。
text.description: 了不起的发现！不知它是如何逃过盗墓者之手的……$b$b听好，$n。在我们破坏任何东西之前，我要先把这个地方的原貌记录下来。我忙的时候，你为什么不四处看看呢——你知道，探索一下。你应该的。$b$b注意任何不同寻常的东西。$b$b哦！还有……请别把东西搞坏了，好吗？
text.completion: Your exploration of the Chamber of the Stars has yielded more questions than answers...
text.completed: 与群星之厅的哈里森·琼斯谈谈。

english.title: The Thrill of Discovery
english.objectives: Explore the Chamber of the Stars.
english.description: What a find! And somehow it's all remained untouched by plunderers...$b$bListen, $n. I need to document this site before we disturb anything. While I do, why don't you have a look around - you know, explore a bit. You've earned it.$b$bKeep your eyes open for anything unusual.$b$bOh! And please... don't break anything, ok?
english.completion: Your exploration of the Chamber of the Stars has yielded more questions than answers...
english.completed: Speak to Harrison Jones in the Chamber of the Stars.

text.title: 超次元战争：第一章
text.objectives: 找到安伯米尔次元传送门。
text.description: <希尔瓦娜斯把图章指环交给你。>$B$B带上指环前往东南边的博伦的巢穴，它就位于山上的一座洞穴里。到那里之后，搜索洞穴，找到通往掩藏安伯米尔法师的微缩空间的传送门。$B$B我会通过你的思想和你联络，$n，等你到达传送门后，我将给你下达出发的指令。
text.progress: <The portal hums.>
text.completion: Yes, this is it. Now run the ring along the runes of the portal and you should become attuned for transdimensional travel.
text.completed: Speak with Lady Sylvanas Windrunner at the Forsaken Front in Silverpine Forest.

english.title: Transdimensional Warfare: Chapter I
english.objectives: Find the Ambermill Dimensional Portal.
english.description: <Sylvanas hands you the signet ring.>$B$BTake the ring and make your way to Beren's Peril, southeast of here, located in a cave in the hills. Once there, search the cave for the portal to the pocket dimension that conceals the Ambermill magi.$B$BI will communicate with you through your thoughts, $n. Once you have reached the portal I will give you your marching orders.
english.progress: <The portal hums.>
english.completion: Yes, this is it. Now run the ring along the runes of the portal and you should become attuned for transdimensional travel.
english.completed: Speak with Lady Sylvanas Windrunner at the Forsaken Front in Silverpine Forest.

text.title: 超次元战争：第二章
text.objectives: 杀死20名安伯米尔法师。
text.description: <女妖之王的话语在你脑中回荡。>$B$B你现在做好准备，可以使用传送门了。要当心，$n，一旦穿过去，你就会出现在安伯米尔的另一个维度中。那里会有一百个，也许一千个法师等着要把你杀掉。$B$B你必须活下去，杀出一条血路来。
text.completion: Excellent work, $n. Now to eject them into our waiting hands!
text.completed: Speak with Lady Sylvanas Windrunner at the Forsaken Front in Silverpine Forest.
text.giverWindow: 准备过来吧！
text.turninWindow: 他们的尸体将会为被遗忘者的战争机器添油加料！

english.title: Transdimensional Warfare: Chapter II
english.objectives: Kill 20 Ambermill mages.
english.description: <The Banshee Queen's words float in your head.>$B$BYou are now ready to use the portal. Be warned, $n, once you step through you will appear in another dimension at Ambermill. There will be a hundred, perhaps a thousand, magi waiting to kill you.$B$BYou must persevere and kill all in your path.
english.completion: Excellent work, $n. Now to eject them into our waiting hands!
english.completed: Speak with Lady Sylvanas Windrunner at the Forsaken Front in Silverpine Forest.
english.giverWindow: Prepare to cross over!
english.turninWindow: Their corpses will feed the Forsaken war machine!

text.title: 狮鹫坠落！狮鹫坠落！
text.objectives: 在暮光高地的暮光海滩上寻找坠地的蛮锤狮鹫骑士索尔顿·锤击。
text.description: 当你在海滩奋战时，我看见一只狮鹫从正西方的云端坠下。$B$B它不属于我们的军队编制。$B$B像是蛮锤矮人的坐骑。在夺得海滩的控制权后，库德兰最大的心愿就是与失散的蛮锤矮人建立联系。$B$B我实在是抽不出人手去那里侦察了，希望你可以跑一趟。找到坠地的蛮锤矮人！
text.completion: Aw dang crap it all. You're just an Alliance $c. I was hoping for a rescue.
text.completed: 在暮光高地的暮光海滩上寻找坠地的蛮锤狮鹫骑士索尔顿·锤击。

english.title: Bird Down! Bird Down!
english.objectives: Locate Thordun Hammerblow, a downed Wildhammer gryphon-rider, at the Twilight Shores in Twilight Highlands.
english.description: While you were fighting along the coast, I spotted a gryphon tumble out of the clouds almost due west of here.$B$BIt wasn't one of ours.$B$BLikely it belonged to one of the Wildhammer. I know that Kurdran wanted to establish contact with the lost Wildhammer clans as one of his primary objectives after taking the beach. $B$BI can't spare any more of my men to scout it out, but I can spare you. Find that downed Wildhammer!
english.completion: Aw dang crap it all. You're just an Alliance $c. I was hoping for a rescue.
english.completed: Locate Thordun Hammerblow, a downed Wildhammer gryphon-rider, at the Twilight Shores in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 臭根的价值
text.objectives: 在暮光海滩收集8条带刺的臭根。
text.description: 朋友，你瞧。她快死了！没有狮鹫，我也就失去了价值。$B$B帮帮我吧。在半岛上挖掘带刺的臭根。它的气味臭得熏死人，但是放入水中后就会沸腾，最终凝结成万能的特效膏药。$B$B我得留下来照顾她，只能麻烦你了。快去吧！联盟都没有时间观念的吗？
text.progress: Didja get me roots, $c? Well?
text.completion: Oh, that's the stuff all right! Hope ya didn't eat any. Gives you the cramps something awful but it does wonders for birds.
text.completed: Bring the roots to Thordun Hammerblow at the Twilight Shores in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Roots'll Do 'Er
english.objectives: Gather 8 Thorny Stankroots from the Twilight Shores.
english.description: Look here, mate. She's on her last legs! If me bird dies, I'm as good as worthless.$B$BSo make yerself useful. Here on the peninsula you can dig up thorny stankroots. Oh the smell will knock you on yer patoot but steeped in water it'll boil up into a right powerful cure-all.$B$BGather some while I defend me bird. An' hurry! You Alliance wanks don't have a reputation for timely intervention, right?
english.progress: Didja get me roots, $c? Well?
english.completion: Oh, that's the stuff all right! Hope ya didn't eat any. Gives you the cramps something awful but it does wonders for birds.
english.completed: Bring the roots to Thordun Hammerblow at the Twilight Shores in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 飞向滩头堡
text.objectives: 跟索尔顿·锤击谈一谈，跟他一起飞回滩头堡。
text.description: 嗨，瞧！我觉得她已经恢复了活力。$B$B$g先生:女士;，你真是个厉害的联盟$c。海滩上的建筑物是你们的基地吗？是叫“滩头堡”对吧。我能带上狮鹫去那里歇息一下，等她养好伤吗？$B$B来吧！我们一起飞过去！
text.completion: Well done, $n! Aiding that downed gryphon-rider has given us our first contact with the old Wildhammer clans. We'll be able to find out who's still left, and in what numbers. Our campaign is looking up!
text.completed: Talk to Kurdran Wildhammer at Highbank in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Wings Over Highbank
english.objectives: Speak with Thordun Hammerblow and fly together back to Highbank.
english.description: Aye, look! I think she's perkin' up already.$B$BOkay $gMr.:Miss; Alliance fancy-pants $c. Is that your base I see on the shore? "Highbank" you say. Can me and my bird hunker down there until she's better?$B$BHop on! We'll fly together back to Highbank!
english.completion: Well done, $n! Aiding that downed gryphon-rider has given us our first contact with the old Wildhammer clans. We'll be able to find out who's still left, and in what numbers. Our campaign is looking up!
english.completed: Talk to Kurdran Wildhammer at Highbank in Twilight Highlands.

objectiveDetails.description: 跟索尔顿·锤击一起飞回滩头堡

text.title: 做好准备
text.objectives: 收集6根断绳。
text.description: 任何一个称职的冒险家都明白，千万不能在没有足够绳子的情况下，进入洞穴、地牢、寝陵或古墓……对吧？$b$b多一根绳子总是好的！$b$b你决心从这里的骷髅身上把每一条能找到的绳头都弄来。
text.progress: What have you found, $n?
text.completion: Ahh, rope! Thanks, kid. Something tells me I'm going to need this.
text.completed: Speak with Harrison Jones in the Chamber of the Stars.

english.title: Be Prepared
english.objectives: Collect 6 Rope Pieces.
english.description: Every adventurer worth their salt knows never to step foot in a cave, dungeon, crypt or tomb without an ample supply of rope... right?$b$bYou can never have too much of this stuff!$b$bYou resolve to scrounging every scrap of it you can find from the skeletons here.
english.progress: What have you found, $n?
english.completion: Ahh, rope! Thanks, kid. Something tells me I'm going to need this.
english.completed: Speak with Harrison Jones in the Chamber of the Stars.

text.title: 超次元战争：第三章
text.objectives: 用奥术力量让大法师阿塔瑞克过载，消除超次元魔法盾。
text.description: <希尔瓦娜斯直接同你进行对话。>$B$B你必须找到维持这个微缩空间的人。很可能就是那个蠢货，阿塔瑞克……把他从院子里找出来，尽你所能阻止他施放魔法。他无疑会被一面强大的奥术护盾所保护着，并会放出奥术能量的爪牙来对付你。在他的旁边打败那些爪牙，释放出他们的能量。没有一个法师能承受得住那样的力量！
text.completion: Had I not witnessed what you did with my own eyes I would not have believed it, $n. Now, with the Ambermill magi on our side, there is but one thing left to do before we retake Gilneas and send those Alliance dogs running for Stormwind.
text.completed: Return to Lady Sylvanas Windrunner at the Forsaken Front in Silverpine Forest.
text.giverWindow: 必须阻止大法师阿塔瑞克！

english.title: Transdimensional Warfare: Chapter III
english.objectives: Overload Archmage Ataeric with arcane power to bring down the Transdimensional Shield.
english.description: <Sylvanas speaks directly through you.>$B$BYou must find the being responsible for keeping this dimensional pocket active. Likely that fool, Ataeric... Search the compound for him. Should you find him, do what you must to stop him from channeling his magic. He is undoubtedly protected by a powerful arcane shield, and will send minions of arcane energy after you.  Defeat the minions while they are near him to unleash their energies.  No mage can handle that much power!
english.completion: Had I not witnessed what you did with my own eyes I would not have believed it, $n. Now, with the Ambermill magi on our side, there is but one thing left to do before we retake Gilneas and send those Alliance dogs running for Stormwind.
english.completed: Return to Lady Sylvanas Windrunner at the Forsaken Front in Silverpine Forest.
english.giverWindow: Archmage Ataeric must be stopped!

text.title: 在窒息的沙子下
text.objectives: 营救8名奥西斯幸存者
text.description: 不……不可能。$B$B奥西斯已经被埋葬在沙漠的飞沙下了。$B$B敌人将会为此付出代价。$B$B但我们首先得救助我的人民。快，$n。我们没有多少时间，我最后的弟兄们就要被活埋了。
text.completion: I thank you, $n.  Orsis was punished for not joining the forces of Deathwing. Prince Nadun has offered my people refuge in his city.  I must go there and tend the survivors.
text.completed: Return to Ammantep at Orsis in Uldum.

english.title: Under the Choking Sands
english.objectives: Rescue 8 Orsis Survivors.
english.description: No... it cannot be.$B$BOrsis is all but buried beneath the desert sands.$B$BThe enemy will pay for this.$B$BBut first we must aid my people.  Quick, $n.  We do not have much time before the last of my brethren are buried alive!
english.completion: I thank you, $n.  Orsis was punished for not joining the forces of Deathwing. Prince Nadun has offered my people refuge in his city.  I must go there and tend the survivors.
english.completed: Return to Ammantep at Orsis in Uldum.

text.title: 奥拉基尔的爪牙
text.objectives: 杀死6个奥拉基尔的子嗣。
text.description: 奥拉基尔派了他的爪牙来为死亡之翼卖命。$B$B意图很清楚。要么加入他们，要么消灭我们。$B$B我对你不是很熟悉，$r。但我对这却很熟悉。如果你证明自己是奥拉基尔的敌人，你的援助是不会被忽视的。$B$B你怎么说，$c？
text.completion: You continue to prove to be a valuable ally, $n.
text.completed: Return to Prince Nadun at Orsis in Uldum.

english.title: Minions of Al'Akir
english.objectives: Slay 6 Scions of Al'Akir.
english.description: Al'Akir has sent his minions to do Deathwing's bidding.$B$BThe message is clear.  We join them or they destroy us.$B$BI do not know much about you, $r.  But I do know this.  If you prove yourself to be an enemy of Al'Akir's, your aid will not go unnoticed.$B$BWhat do you say, $c?
english.completion: You continue to prove to be a valuable ally, $n.
english.completed: Return to Prince Nadun at Orsis in Uldum.

text.title: 邪恶之巢
text.objectives: 在东瘟疫之地的奎尔林斯小屋杀死9名失心者。
text.description: $R……求求你，我需要你的帮助。$b$b我们的同胞发生了某种变化。我们的指挥官游侠之王隼戟大人得到了一件魔法物品，我的朋友和家人……全都屈从于它那诱惑性的力量。$b$b他们被腐蚀了，$r。他们全都被腐蚀了。$b$b我的埃拉莉亚一定不愿意像那样活着，我的兄弟们也绝对不会。请你去帮助他们解脱吧。奎尔林斯小屋离这里不远，就在西北边的山丘上。
text.completion: Do not feel sorry for me.  Those were my friends that you saw at Quel'lithien Lodge, but they were already as good as dead.
text.completed: Return to Kirkian Dawnshield at Northpass Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: Wretched Hive of Scum and Villainy
english.objectives: Kill 9 Wretched at Quel'lithien Lodge in Eastern Plaguelands.
english.description: $R... please, I ask your help.$b$bSomething's happened to my people.  Our commander, Ranger Lord Hawkspear, came upon an item of magical energy, and my friends, my family... they succumbed to its seductive power.$b$bThey're corrupted, $r.  All of them.$b$bMy Ellaria wouldn't want to live like that, nor would any of my brothers.  Please, put them out of their misery.  Quel'lithien Lodge is not far; it's just up the hill, to the northwest.
english.completion: Do not feel sorry for me.  Those were my friends that you saw at Quel'lithien Lodge, but they were already as good as dead.
english.completed: Return to Kirkian Dawnshield at Northpass Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

text.title: 不打不成招
text.objectives: 殴打至少6名天灾攻城技师，找出吉德文的下落，并搞清楚是谁抓了他。
text.description: 我们圣骑士通常受到的教育是要在作战时谨慎判断形势，控制自己的行为，但眼下的情况非常紧急，再说我从来都没有认真听过导师的教诲。$b$b我要进入病木林，看看我能帮吉德文做些什么。你去东北边对付那些亡灵，就在这座塔的另一侧。亡灵不惧怕死亡，但是如果你把它们揍得够狠，也许它们会透露只言片语，为我们提供找到吉德文的线索。
text.completion: It sounds like you were successful.  Hopefully this is enough information to find Gidwin.
text.completed: Return to Fiona at Northpass Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: Beat it Out of Them
english.objectives: Beat down at least 6 Scourge Siege Engineers to discover details about Gidwin's location and his captor.
english.description: We paladins are normally taught to exercise judgment and control when dealing with foes, but this is an emergency, and I never paid too much attention to my trainers anyhow.$b$bI'm going to head into the Plaguewood and find out what I can about Giddy.  You deal with the Scourge just to our northeast, on the other side of this tower.  The undead don't fear death, but if you beat them enough, their tongues might slip, and we may get some clues to Gidwin's location.
english.completion: It sounds like you were successful.  Hopefully this is enough information to find Gidwin.
english.completed: Return to Fiona at Northpass Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

text.title: 天杀的暗翼蝠
text.objectives: 获取一块暗翼蝠的毛皮。
text.description: 我见识过许多事情，$r。海加尔的山峰……诡异的外域……排山倒海的天灾士兵冲向战场。但是我从没有见过像暗翼蝠这样巨大而惨白的蝙蝠。$B$B它居然在自己的窝里嘲弄我！$b$b这只白色的恶魔蝙蝠在这里西南边、黑木湖正北边游荡。去找到它，把它干掉。如果它飞得太高，就用我的火炬吸引它的注意力。
text.progress: I hope you've done away with that creature.
text.completion: Excellent work.  I can now continue my work without the distractions of that great white beast. I shall fashion this fur into something you can use.
text.completed: Return to Corpseburner Tim at Northpass Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.
text.giverWindow: 它居然在这儿筑巢了，这简直是赤裸裸的嘲讽！

english.title: Duskwing, Oh How I Hate Thee...
english.objectives: Obtain a Patch of Duskwing's Fur.
english.description: I have seen many things in my day, $r.  The peaks of Mt. Hyjal... the oddities of Outland... a wall of Scourge soldiers, proceeding into war.  But I have never seen a bat as big, or as shockingly white, as Duskwing.$B$BHow he taunts me from his roost!$b$bThis albino demon bat circles to the southwest of here, due north of Blackwood Lake.  Track him down and destroy him.  If he flies too high for you to reach, use my flare to get his attention.
english.progress: I hope you've done away with that creature.
english.completion: Excellent work.  I can now continue my work without the distractions of that great white beast. I shall fashion this fur into something you can use.
english.completed: Return to Corpseburner Tim at Northpass Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.
english.giverWindow: How he taunts me from his roost!

text.title: 盲目的愤怒
text.objectives: 在东瘟疫之地的病木林中找到塔伦纳·射日者。
text.description: 塔伦纳说他不在乎什么判断和谨慎，他还真不是开玩笑的。他冲进病木林去找吉德文的时候，差点没把那个高等精灵的脑袋给拧下来。你最好去找找他。$B$B病木林是一片很大的区域，$n。祝你好运。希望你们$g这些小伙子:三个;能平安地从那片林子里出来。
text.completion: I haven't found anything but brainless undead, and plenty of them.  I was just about to kill my way into Stratholme when you arrived. Did you have any more success?

english.title: Blind Fury
english.objectives: Find Tarenar Sunstrike within the Plaguewood in Eastern Plaguelands.
english.description: Tarenar wasn't joking when he said that he didn't care about judgment and caution.  He nearly took off that high elf's head as he ran into the Plaguewood, looking for Gidwin.  You should go after him.$b$bThe Plaguewood is a big place, $n.  Good luck.  I hope to see you $g boys: three; come out of the woods in one piece.
english.completion: I haven't found anything but brainless undead, and plenty of them.  I was just about to kill my way into Stratholme when you arrived. Did you have any more success?

text.title: 斯坦索姆的守护者
text.objectives: 杀死奥玛苏·凋蹄和卡尔西斯·暗符。
text.description: 是安娜丝塔丽男爵夫人抓住了他？就在病木林里？$b$b病木林很大……不过我们会找到他的。我们一定会找到吉德文。$B$B紧邻我们的东侧和西侧分别有一座通灵塔，护卫着斯坦索姆的入口。在这两座通灵塔里，你可以找到两名死亡骑士——瑞文戴尔的副官。我不认为他们手上会有一名圣骑士人质，不过也许他们知道一些关于他所在位置的情报。
text.completion: We've got to keep moving!  We're getting so very close!
text.completed: Return to Tarenar Sunstrike within the Plaguewood in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: Guardians of Stratholme
english.objectives: Kill Omasum Blighthoof and Karthis Darkrune.
english.description: Baroness Anastar holds him?  Here in the Plaguewood?$b$bThe Plaguewood is a big place... but we will find him.  We WILL find Gidwin.$b$bImmediately to our east and our west are a pair of necropoli that flank the entrance to Stratholme.  Inside them, you will find a pair of death knights - Rivendare's lieutenants.  I doubt either would have any use for a paladin hostage, but perhaps they will have some information on his location.
english.completion: We've got to keep moving!  We're getting so very close!
english.completed: Return to Tarenar Sunstrike within the Plaguewood in Eastern Plaguelands.

text.title: 营救吉德文
text.objectives: 在病木林中心的屠宰房中寻找吉德文·金须的踪迹。
text.description: 快点——找到进入南方那座屠宰房的入口。我会在里面与你会合。$b$b准备战斗！
text.completion: You have no idea how happy I am to see you two!  You're a sight for sore eyes... sore eyes that have been starin' through a banshee for far too long now. I'm sorry for causing so much trouble.  Will you take me back to the caravan?
text.completed: Speak with Gidwin Goldbraids within the Plaguewood in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: Gidwin's Fate Revealed
english.objectives: Search for Gidwin Goldbraids within the slaughterhouse in central Plaguewood.
english.description: Quickly - find an entrance to the slaughterhouse to our south.  I will meet you on the inside.$b$bBe ready for a fight!
english.completion: You have no idea how happy I am to see you two!  You're a sight for sore eyes... sore eyes that have been starin' through a banshee for far too long now. I'm sorry for causing so much trouble.  Will you take me back to the caravan?
english.completed: Speak with Gidwin Goldbraids within the Plaguewood in Eastern Plaguelands.

text.title: 旅途的终点
text.objectives: 与东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的菲奥拉交谈。
text.description: 我简直受够这鬼地方了。亡灵的恶臭已经够让我抓狂的了，还额外附送了蘑菇？我讨厌蘑菇！$b$b我要回圣光之愿礼拜堂去了，$n……塔伦纳和菲奥拉也一起回去。我想，我们都凭自己的努力换来了应得的假期。$b$b拿着这个吧，这是我的炉石——你可以用它直接返回圣光之愿礼拜堂。我不需要它了，因为我要坐马车回去。$B$B前排的座位哟。
text.completion: You've been more help than anyone expected of you, $n.  The doors of my caravan are always open to you. The boys and I have even put together a little something special for you.  Here, take your pick!

english.title: Journey's End
english.objectives: Speak with Fiona at Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands.
english.description: I've had just about enough of the funk of this place.  Undead stink is bad enough, and then you add mushrooms to the mix?  I hate mushrooms!$b$bI'm going to head back to Light's Hope Chapel, $n... and I'm taking Tarenar and Fiona with me.  I think we've all earned a well-deserved break.$b$bLet me give you this.  It's my hearthstone - you can use it to travel instantly back to Light's Hope.  I won't need it - I'm going to be riding in the caravan.$b$bIn the FRONT SEAT.
english.completion: You've been more help than anyone expected of you, $n.  The doors of my caravan are always open to you. The boys and I have even put together a little something special for you.  Here, take your pick!

text.title: 天灾之躯
text.objectives: 杀死8个肥胖的傀儡，然后对它们的尸体使用十字军的火把。
text.description: 仅仅杀掉天灾亡灵是不行的。他们还会回来。你必须摧毁构成他们躯体的邪恶物质……即便是那样，他们仍然会以鬼魂的形式回来。$b$b很少有亡灵像憎恶那样身形臃肿。杀掉它们，然后焚烧它们的尸体。病木林里到处可见这种怪物。$b$b你必须保持旺盛的斗志，$r。记住：这些憎恶是用无辜者的尸体缝合而成的，它们的存在本身就是罪孽。
text.completion: A blessed fire cleanses even the most corrupt of flesh. They stood no chance in the face of the Light.
text.completed: Return to Crusader Kevin Frost in the Plaguewood in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: Scourged Mass
english.objectives: Kill 8 Overstuffed Golems, then use the Crusader's Torch on their corpses.
english.description: You can't just kill the Scourge.  They will come back.  You must destroy the vile matter that makes up their being... and even then, they may come back as spectres.$b$bFew undead use up as much mass as the lumbering abominations.  Kill them, then burn their bodies.  You will find them all over the Plaguewood.$b$bNever let your rage dissipate, $r.  Remember: these abominations are sewn together from the bodies of good people.  Their crime is that they exist.
english.completion: A blessed fire cleanses even the most corrupt of flesh. They stood no chance in the face of the Light.
english.completed: Return to Crusader Kevin Frost in the Plaguewood in Eastern Plaguelands.

starters.name: 十字军战士凯文·弗洛斯特

enders.name: 十字军战士凯文·弗洛斯特

objectiveDetails.description: 焚烧肥胖的傀儡的尸体

text.title: 达隆郡的守卫者
text.objectives: 从吃人的食尸鬼的尸体上释放8名达隆郡居民的灵魂，然后同他们交谈。
text.description: 在人类饱受天灾涂炭的惨剧中，达隆郡的战斗只是其中之一。它的影响至今依然没有消散。$b$b城镇许多英勇的守卫者们成了天灾可怖的亡魂，再度游荡。$B$B杀掉病木林这里吃人的食尸鬼。这些魔鬼很多一度都是达隆郡的好人，摧毁它们的肉身，将他们的灵魂释放出来。
text.completion: It is good to hear you found the tortured souls of my brethren and freed them.  I find my strength renewed, knowing at least some of the defenders of Darrowshire no longer wallow in the vile subservience of the Scourge.
text.completed: Return to Crusader Kevin Frost within the Plaguewood in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: Defenders of Darrowshire
english.objectives: Free 8 Darrowshire Spirits from the bodies of Cannibal Ghouls, then speak with them.
english.description: The battle of Darrowshire was one of the many tragedies that we humans suffered at the hands of the Scourge.  Its effects are still felt even today.$b$bMany of the town's valiant defenders now roam again as the ghastly servants of the Scourge.  We will end their misery.$B$BHunt cannibal ghouls here within the Plaguewood.  Many of these fiends were once the good folk of Darrowshire, and destroying their forms now will set their souls free.
english.completion: It is good to hear you found the tortured souls of my brethren and freed them.  I find my strength renewed, knowing at least some of the defenders of Darrowshire no longer wallow in the vile subservience of the Scourge.
english.completed: Return to Crusader Kevin Frost within the Plaguewood in Eastern Plaguelands.

starters.name: 十字军战士凯文·弗洛斯特

enders.name: 十字军战士凯文·弗洛斯特

objectiveDetails.description: 解放达隆郡居民的灵魂

text.title: 血肉巨兽
text.objectives: 将三枚银色光明之泉咒符放在血肉巨兽身边，摧毁它们的躯体。你无法在战斗中放置银色光明之泉咒符，它们之间相互间隔也不得小于十码。
text.description: 没胆的邪教徒们在南边从事一项邪恶的任务：聚集大量血肉之躯，制造名为血肉巨兽的巨大亡灵生物。幸运的是，这些巨兽毫无生气，羸弱不堪。$b$b拿上这咒符——使用它可以在地上形成一股神圣能量的泉水。假如你能成功地在一个邪教徒试图复生的血肉巨兽身边放置三道符咒，神圣能量就能让它超过负荷，永远地摧毁其躯体。
text.completion: You are a true Champion of the Light, $n.  I wish you luck in your future endeavors, wherever they might take you. If you need anything in the future, you can always find me here - knee-deep in the corpses of the slain.
text.completed: Return to Crusader Kevin Frost within the Plaguewood in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: The Corpsebeasts
english.objectives: Destroy the hulks of three Corpsebeasts by placing three or more Argent Lightwells next to them.  You cannot place Argent Lightwells while in combat, and you may not place them within ten yards of one another.
english.description: To the south, gutless cultists are focused on a grim task: re-animating enormous hunks of flesh, to create giants known as corpsebeasts.  Luckily for us, these giants are still lifeless and weak.$b$bTake this charm - using it will place a font of holy energy on the ground.  If you can manage to place three of them near one of the corpsebeasts that the cultists are reanimating, the holy energy should overload it, destroying its body forever.
english.completion: You are a true Champion of the Light, $n.  I wish you luck in your future endeavors, wherever they might take you. If you need anything in the future, you can always find me here - knee-deep in the corpses of the slain.
english.completed: Return to Crusader Kevin Frost within the Plaguewood in Eastern Plaguelands.

starters.name: 十字军战士凯文·弗洛斯特

enders.name: 十字军战士凯文·弗洛斯特

text.title: 反瘟疫研究
text.objectives: 收集20颗腐莓、5条脱离躯体的手臂，以及1堆血肉巨人的足屑。
text.description: 我曾经替所谓的“女妖之王”希尔瓦娜斯效力，当一名药剂师。那时候我很崇敬她，但是她变了。她不再是以前的那个她了。$b$b于是我打破了效忠被遗忘者的誓言，加入了北伐军。现在，我运用自己的炼金学知识，致力于寻找反瘟疫的介质，而病木林就是完美的去处。$b$b我需要补充一批材料，它们都可以在病木林中找到。如果你能找到这些东西的话，我会付你钱的。
text.progress: You got the stuff?
text.completion: I love the smell of fresh foot scrapings, don't you? If we're going to find a cure to the plague, we need to get creative with our ingredients.  Now, if you don't mind, I'm going to get back to work.
text.completed: Return to Argent Apothecary Judkins at Plaguewood Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: Counter-Plague Research
english.objectives: Obtain 20 Rotberries, 5 Disembodied Arms, and 1 pile of Flesh Giant Foot Scrapings.
english.description: I once worked for the so-called "Banshee-Queen", Sylvanas, as an apothecary.  I used to admire her, but something's changed within her.  She's not herself anymore.$b$bI broke my vows with the Forsaken and joined the Crusade.  Now, I use my knowledge of alchemy to seek a counter-plague agent.  And the Plaguewood is the perfect place to do so.$b$bI need to resupply a few reagents, any of which can be found within the Plaguewood.  I'll pay you if you can find any of these items.
english.progress: You got the stuff?
english.completion: I love the smell of fresh foot scrapings, don't you? If we're going to find a cure to the plague, we need to get creative with our ingredients.  Now, if you don't mind, I'm going to get back to work.
english.completed: Return to Argent Apothecary Judkins at Plaguewood Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

text.title: 病木林哨塔
text.objectives: 将海毕肯的包裹交给东瘟疫之地病木林哨塔的银色药剂师杰德金斯。
text.description: 近来吉德文遇到的状况使我觉得……像我这样一把年纪的人最好不要去病木林这样危险的地方。不要紧——我可以下次再去病木林哨塔。$B$B不过我有一些东西要交给杰德金斯，你比我年轻得多，也更擅长战斗，能不能帮我把东西交给他？
text.progress: Highbeacon's Parcel... is Argus safe?  Did something happen?
text.completion: Whew.  Every time Argus comes plodding through that Plaguewood, I fear it to be his last.  It's good to see that he's wise enough to send a youngblood like you in his stead.
text.completed: Speak to Argent Apothecary Judkins at Plaguewood Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: The Plaguewood Tower
english.objectives: Bring Highbeacon's Parcel to Argent Apothecary Judkins at Plaguewood Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.
english.description: With the recent, unfortunate developments involving Gidwin, it might not be wise for a man my age to take the dangerous trip through the Plaguewood.  This is fine - I can visit the Plaguewood Tower on my next trip around the loop.$b$bI do, however, have a delivery that I need to get to Judkins.  You are younger than I, and stronger in combat.  Will you take this delivery to him?
english.progress: Highbeacon's Parcel... is Argus safe?  Did something happen?
english.completion: Whew.  Every time Argus comes plodding through that Plaguewood, I fear it to be his last.  It's good to see that he's wise enough to send a youngblood like you in his stead.
english.completed: Speak to Argent Apothecary Judkins at Plaguewood Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

text.title: 猪的悲惨命运
text.objectives: 杀死9只天灾野猪。
text.description: 恐惧谷里的人，他们得了病之后，就变成了坏人。绝不是什么好事。$b$b但是那些猪呢……也病了！猪犯了什么事要遭这份罪？哈哈哈哈！没有理由可言！$b$b人，我可以忘掉，但是坏掉的猪仍然会让我感到伤心。不过如果你杀掉它们……我也许会开心一点。
text.completion: I see them!  Can you?  The little pig spirits, on their way to the great sty in the sky...
text.completed: Return to Augustus the Touched at Terrordale in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: A Fate Worse Than Butchery
english.objectives: Kill 9 Plagued Swine.
english.description: The people of Terrordale, they were sick, then they turned bad.  Definitely not good times.$b$bThe pigs, though... they also got sick!  What did pigs do to deserve to get sick?  Hah hah hah!  Nothing!$b$bPeople I can forget about, but the bad pigs still make me sad.  If you kill them, though... I might get happy.
english.completion: I see them!  Can you?  The little pig spirits, on their way to the great sty in the sky...
english.completed: Return to Augustus the Touched at Terrordale in Eastern Plaguelands.

text.title: 奥古斯图斯的收据册
text.objectives: 在恐惧谷的旅店里找到奥古斯图斯的收据册。
text.description: 准备开张啦！你想要点什么？$B$B呃，等等……没有收据册就不能开张。没有收据册的话，我要怎么记账啊？$B$B我肯定是把它丢在哪里了。我在旅店里有一间卧室……应该就在那里。$B$B把收据册拿来给我。求你了，把它拿来给我！把它拿来之后你就知道了！我会开张营业，那时候你就知道我的价钱是很疯狂的！
text.progress: 你找到我的收据册了吗?我还等着重新开业哪!
text.completion: 你成功了!天哪!我简直都忘记这里面记载了多少东西!$B$B真是荣耀的一天，$N!太惊人了!简直太棒了!$B$B
text.completed: Return to Augustus the Touched in Terrordale in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: Augustus' Receipt Book
english.objectives: Get Augustus' Receipt Book from the inn in Terrordale.
english.description: I'm ready for business!  What do you want?$B$BOh wait... I can't open up shop without my receipt book.  How am I to keep track of things without my receipt book?$B$BI must have left it in town somewhere.  I had a room in the inn... the book must be there.$B$BBring me my book.  Please, bring it to me!  Bring me my book and you'll see!  I'll set up shop and you'll see that my prices are INSANE!
english.progress: Do you have my receipt book?  I can't wait to get back to business!
english.completion: There it is!  And oh my!  I forgot how full it was! This is a glorious day, $n!  Stupendous!  Insanely good, I say!
english.completed: Return to Augustus the Touched in Terrordale in Eastern Plaguelands.

text.title: 受到一点小小的感动
text.objectives: 跟恐惧谷被感动的奥古斯图斯谈一谈。
text.description: 我会经常性地去恐惧谷看看奥古斯图斯，确保他一切都好。我想，我们亡灵比其他人更容易对付瘟疫。$b$b恐惧谷就在西边。你介不介意帮我去看看他？
text.completion: You've come to the right place, mister!  No place better than Terrordale, yes siree, that's right!  The jewel of Lordaeron!
text.completed: 跟东瘟疫之地恐惧谷被感动的奥古斯图斯谈一谈。

english.title: Just a Little Touched
english.objectives: Speak with Augustus the Touched in Terrordale.
english.description: I like to check in on Augustus in Terrordale every once in a while, just to make sure he's alright.  Some of us undead cope with the plague better than others, I suppose.$b$bTerrordale is west of here.  Would you mind checking in on him for me?
english.completion: You've come to the right place, mister!  No place better than Terrordale, yes siree, that's right!  The jewel of Lordaeron!
english.completed: Speak with Augustus the Touched at Terrordale in Eastern Plaguelands.

text.title: 基本无害
text.objectives: 从沼桨镇东边的忧伤湿地找到8个被偷走的地雷。
text.description: 这儿另有一件事你可以帮我，伙计。$B$B那天我从藏宝海湾进了一批地雷。可有人在晚上偷走了好多！$B$B不管是谁干的，他肯定很马虎，因为地雷在东边的沼泽里掉得到处都是。我可不认识那种粗心的地精。$B$B我要你帮我把地雷拿回来。我保证它们绝对安全，没有挂弦。每一个都是。没错。
text.progress: Hey, you get those things I asked you about?
text.completion: What did I tell you, eh? Perfectly safe! I'll see about getting some of these over to to your friends, $n. At a discount.
text.completed: Return to Trade Baron Silversnap at Bogpaddle in Swamp of Sorrows.

english.title: Mostly Harmless
english.objectives: Collect 8 Disarmed Land Mines from the Sorrowmurk to the east of Bogpaddle.
english.description: Here's another favor you can do for me, pal.$B$BWe had a whole shipment of Landmines come in from Booty Bay just the other day. But someone stole the whole lot of 'em in the night!$B$BWhoever it was must be sloppy, because they dropped them all over the swamp to the east. No goblin I know would be that careless.$B$BI need you to go gather those landmines up for me. I'm sure they're perfectly safe and disarmed. Every single one. Yup.
english.progress: Hey, you get those things I asked you about?
english.completion: What did I tell you, eh? Perfectly safe! I'll see about getting some of these over to to your friends, $n. At a discount.
english.completed: Return to Trade Baron Silversnap at Bogpaddle in Swamp of Sorrows.

text.title: 风暴中的传送门
text.objectives: 杀死泥浆水元素，收集5个漩涡之核。
text.description: 大地之环一直想要开启返回暴风城的传送门，却始终没有成功。索尔顿告诉我说，他有办法可以一试。$B$B附近瓦拉尔河三角洲的水元素陷入了疯狂的状态。索尔顿认为我们可以引导它们的能量，创造出一道传送门。$B$B我完全不懂元素生物的事，我只知道：杀死元素生物，并将它们的漩涡之核交给庭院里的塔娜！
text.progress: Hello, $c. Kurdran tells me you've got a solution to getting this portal opened?
text.completion: My word, $n. These elemental energies are so powerful, so chaotic - no wonder the Twilight's Hammer has chosen to build their stronghold here! I should be able to channel these energies into something more benign and productive though. Let's give it a try...
text.completed: Deliver the Whirlpool Cores to Talaa at Highbank in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Any Portal in a Storm
english.objectives: Slay Muddied Water Elementals to collect 5 Whirlpool Cores.
english.description: Our friends in the Earthen Ring have been trying to open portals back to Stormwind, with no luck. But Thordun here tells me he might just have the key.$B$BThe crazed water elementals in the nearby Verrall River Delta have been sent into a frenzy. Thordun tells me we can channel their energy into a portal.$B$BI don't understand all this elemental-claptrap, but I understand one thing: killin' elementals and takin' their whirlpool cores. Deliver them to Talaa in the courtyard!
english.progress: Hello, $c. Kurdran tells me you've got a solution to getting this portal opened?
english.completion: My word, $n. These elemental energies are so powerful, so chaotic - no wonder the Twilight's Hammer has chosen to build their stronghold here! I should be able to channel these energies into something more benign and productive though. Let's give it a try...
english.completed: Deliver the Whirlpool Cores to Talaa at Highbank in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 完美的泥敷剂
text.objectives: 收集10堆瓦拉尔河淤泥。
text.description: 你会路过瓦拉尔河口三角洲吗？我告诉你一个秘密，对你对大家……以及对我的狮鹫都有好处！$B$B水元素在岩石上移动时，会留下一种特殊的淤泥。这种淤泥变干后硬得跟石头一样，其中却蕴含着水之复苏能量。将它涂抹在骨折处，折断的地方就能迅速愈合。$B$B将这种淤泥带给楼下的萨满祭司塔娜。她知道该如何使用！
text.progress: What is this I keep hearing about the muck of the Verrall River?
text.completion: Oh... mud. You brought me mud? Wow - this stuff oozes with power! I see what Thordun was saying, now. I'll distribute this to all of the healers. Our wounded will be on their feet in no time!
text.completed: Bring the muck to Talaa at Highbank in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: The Perfect Poultice
english.objectives: Collect 10 piles of Verrall River Muck.
english.description: Are you goin' by way of the Verrall river delta? I've got a tip that'll help your men here... and my bird!$B$BWhen water elementals carve their way through rock, they create a peculiar kind of muck. It dries hard as stone but carries with it the rejuvenating power of water. You make a cast out of that muck and broken bones knit together like iron.$B$BBring some of that muck to Talaa, your shaman downstairs. She'll know what to do with it!
english.progress: What is this I keep hearing about the muck of the Verrall River?
english.completion: Oh... mud. You brought me mud? Wow - this stuff oozes with power! I see what Thordun was saying, now. I'll distribute this to all of the healers. Our wounded will be on their feet in no time!
english.completed: Bring the muck to Talaa at Highbank in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 把它们堆起来
text.objectives: 从病木林的诅咒法师和天灾士兵身上收集16件破烂的装备。
text.description: 我在收集被我击败的骷髅的破烂装备，已经有一小堆啦。$b$b如果你弄到新的装备，欢迎你把它们放到我的装备堆上。巨大的装备堆可以满足我的收集癖，而且……嗯……当我看着它时，抑制不住的成就感就从心底里涌上来啦。
text.progress: You seem to have your hands full.  Are those skulls I see?
text.completion: May my pile never stop growing.
text.completed: Return to Crusader Kevin Frost within the Plaguewood in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: Add 'em to the Pile
english.objectives: Obtain 16 Stinking Skulls from Cursed Mages and Scourge Soldiers in the Plaguewood.
english.description: I've been collecting the skulls of the skeletons I defeat.  I've amassed a small pile of them.$b$bIf you come across any skulls, you are welcome to add them to my pile.  The huge pile of skulls seems to keep the waves of undead at bay and... well... it also just makes me happy to look at it.
english.progress: You seem to have your hands full.  Are those skulls I see?
english.completion: May my pile never stop growing.
english.completed: Return to Crusader Kevin Frost within the Plaguewood in Eastern Plaguelands.

starters.name: 十字军战士凯文·弗洛斯特

enders.name: 十字军战士凯文·弗洛斯特

text.title: 蛮锤萨满祭司
text.objectives: 跟暴风要塞的加文·灰羽谈一谈。
text.description: 毫无疑问，你感觉到了剧烈的地震活动。或许你也看到了元素生物向陆地和城镇发动了攻击。大地之环正在努力调查这场动乱的真相。幸运的是，蛮锤萨满祭司向我们伸出了援手。$b$b加文·灰羽与众多阵营的首领聚集在暴风要塞协商对策。跟他谈一谈，进一步了解大灾变的情况，$n。
text.completion: Well met, $c.  I am Gavan Grayfeather, emissary of the Wildhammer shaman. There is much work to be done.  The leaders fear for their citizens, as many have turned to cults.  We shaman are concerned with the elemental unrest. Our advice to you, $c, is to be vigilant.  Help where you can, be it calming the people or putting the elementals at rest.  There is plenty to do.
text.completed: 跟暴风要塞的加文·灰羽谈一谈。

english.title: The Wildhammer
english.objectives: Speak to Gavan Grayfeather in Stormwind Keep.
english.description: No doubt you've felt the earthquakes.  You may even have seen elementals attacking the lands or towns.  The Earthen Ring struggles to understand what is going on.  We've been fortunate to gain assistance from the Wildhammer shamans.$b$bGavan Grayfeather is in Stormwind Keep to help coordinate our efforts with the various faction leaders.  Speak to him and see what you may learn about these events, $n.
english.completion: Well met, $c.  I am Gavan Grayfeather, emissary of the Wildhammer shaman. There is much work to be done.  The leaders fear for their citizens, as many have turned to cults.  We shaman are concerned with the elemental unrest. Our advice to you, $c, is to be vigilant.  Help where you can, be it calming the people or putting the elementals at rest.  There is plenty to do.
english.completed: Speak to Gavan Grayfeather in Stormwind Keep.

text.title: 前车之鉴
text.objectives: 获得6个损坏的护目镜。
text.description: 这个不幸的探险家显然最近的运气不太好。$b$b慎重心告诉你，虽然在尸体上寻找线索这不是一件很美的差事，但是也许可以让你对周围环境有更好的了解……
text.progress: Any news, $n?
text.completion: Odd... It looks as if someone used gemstones as lenses. I should be able to fix them without too much trouble.
text.completed: Bring the Broken Goggles to Harrison Jones in the Chamber of the Stars.

english.title: Lessons From the Past
english.objectives: Acquire the Broken Goggles.
english.description: This unfortunate explorer has clearly suffered a bit of bad luck in the recent past.$b$bPrudence dictates that you perform the unenviable task of searching the corpse for clues that might shed light on your surroundings...
english.progress: Any news, $n?
english.completion: Odd... It looks as if someone used gemstones as lenses. I should be able to fix them without too much trouble.
english.completed: Bring the Broken Goggles to Harrison Jones in the Chamber of the Stars.

text.title: 上前线
text.completion: The hour of victory approaches, $n. Godfrey has devised a plan to decimate our enemies. I am sending you into the field with him and his men to bring the rebel insurgents to their knees and seal the fate of the Alliance filth encroaching upon our lands.$B$BOur final march begins when you are ready.

english.title: Taking the Battlefront
english.completion: The hour of victory approaches, $n. Godfrey has devised a plan to decimate our enemies. I am sending you into the field with him and his men to bring the rebel insurgents to their knees and seal the fate of the Alliance filth encroaching upon our lands.$B$BOur final march begins when you are ready.

text.title: 塞纳里奥议会的坚持
text.objectives: 与蘑菇谷入口附近的莱茵谈谈。
text.description: 说真的，那些德鲁伊永远不会放弃。几年前我就不对瘟疫之地抱有希望了，但塞纳里奥议会的成员一直跟我说，这片土地并不是无药可救。$b$b最近有一个暗夜精灵来这里拜访，她去了北边的蘑菇谷。她说，如果我们努力的话，这片土地可以完全恢复生机。我不知道该不该相信她。$b$b你相信这番傻话吗？也许你该找她谈谈。她大概还在蘑菇谷吧。
text.completion: I suppose I had better work on my stealth, if you were able to find me. Are you interested in helping me heal the Plaguelands?
text.completed: 与东瘟疫之地蘑菇谷入口处的莱茵交谈。

english.title: Cenarion Tenacity
english.objectives: Speak with Rayne near the entrance to the Fungal Vale.
english.description: Those druids never give up, I swear.  I'd given up on the Plaguelands years ago, but the Cenarion Circle folks keep telling me that the land is not beyond hope.$b$bThe most recent visitor was a night elf, on her way to the Fungal Vale, to the north.  She told me that these lands will make a full recovery, if we try hard enough.  I'm not sure I believe her.$b$bDo you buy this drivel?  Maybe you and her should talk.  She should still be up there.
english.completion: I suppose I had better work on my stealth, if you were able to find me. Are you interested in helping me heal the Plaguelands?
english.completed: Speak with Rayne near the entrance to the Fungal Vale in Eastern Plaguelands.

text.title: 通道
text.objectives: 跟暮光高地滩头堡的库德兰·蛮锤谈一谈。
text.description: 我会和萨满祭司留在这里，确保传送门处于开启状态。$B$B上楼去通知库德兰，这里的事情告一段落了。听到这样的好消息，他应该会很高兴吧。
text.completion: Ho! I knew you were a $c I could count on, $n. Use that portal anytime you need to get from Stormwind back to the Highlands. Now then, time to get to business. We need to locate and unite the lost Wildhammer clans scattered around the Highlands. Talking with Thordun here is a good start!
text.completed: 跟暮光高地滩头堡的库德兰·蛮锤交谈。

english.title: The Way is Open
english.objectives: Speak with Kurdran Wildhammer at Highbank in Twilight Highlands.
english.description: My fellow Shaman and I will stay here to keep the portal open.$B$BYou should go upstairs and notify Kurdran that the work here is done. It'll please him to hear some good news for once.
english.completion: Ho! I knew you were a $c I could count on, $n. Use that portal anytime you need to get from Stormwind back to the Highlands. Now then, time to get to business. We need to locate and unite the lost Wildhammer clans scattered around the Highlands. Talking with Thordun here is a good start!
english.completed: Speak with Kurdran Wildhammer at Highbank in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 跟安顿上尉交谈
text.objectives: 跟暴风要塞的安顿上尉谈一谈。
text.description: 毫无疑问，你感觉到了剧烈的地震活动。或许你也看到了元素生物向陆地和城镇发动了攻击。我们已经派出了最聪敏的智者，前往纳格兰与元素生物进行交流。$b$b但是要做的工作还有很多。臣民们非常担心亲人的安危，暴风城卫兵疲于应付恐慌的民众。$b$b$c，请前往暴风要塞跟安顿上尉谈一谈，看看你能不能帮上忙。
text.completion: King's honor, $c.  I am Captain Anton.  I am leading the investigation into the cultists that have appeared in Stormwind.
text.completed: 跟暴风要塞的安顿上尉谈一谈。

english.title: Speak with Captain Anton
english.objectives: Speak with Captain Anton in Stormwind Keep.
english.description: No doubt you've felt the earthquakes.  You may even have seen elementals attacking the lands or towns. We have sent many of our brightest minds to Nagrand to commune with the elements.$b$bBut there is still much work to be done here.  Stormwind Guards are being overwhelmed with citizens worried about their loved ones.$b$bPlease, $c, speak with Captain Anton in Stormwind Keep and see how you might assist him.
english.completion: King's honor, $c.  I am Captain Anton.  I am leading the investigation into the cultists that have appeared in Stormwind.
english.completed: Speak with Captain Anton in Stormwind Keep.

text.title: 无关紧要
text.objectives: 营救8名畏缩的步兵。
text.description: 我们在焚木村的部队最近遭到了偷袭。第七军团的斥候成功地渗透到了镇子里，最终把我们的人消灭殆尽。$B$B黑暗女王给了我们一个营救任务。我们要找到幸存者，把他们安全救出焚木村。如果那里还有士兵活着的话，他们多半已经派不上用处了，但我们得照黑暗女王所命令的做。$B$B咱们快点结束这场闹剧吧，$n。焚木村就在被遗忘者先锋军的西南边。
text.completion: What happened here today is between us. Say a word to anyone and you will find yourself in a corpse pit next to these poor fools.
text.completed: Speak with Baron Ashbury in Silverpine Forest.

english.title: Of No Consequence
english.objectives: Rescue 8 Cowering Troopers.
english.description: Our forces in Pyrewood were recently taken by way of sneak attack. The 7th Legion managed to infiltrate the town with their scouts, ultimately decimating our troops.$B$BThe Dark Lady has tasked us with a rescue mission. We are to find survivors and get them out of Pyrewood safely. If any soldiers live they are likely worthless, but we do as the Dark Lady commands.$B$BLet's get this nonsense over with, $n. Pyrewood is directly southwest of the Forsaken Front.
english.completion: What happened here today is between us. Say a word to anyone and you will find yourself in a corpse pit next to these poor fools.
english.completed: Speak with Baron Ashbury in Silverpine Forest.

text.title: 领略恐惧
text.objectives: 杀死12名第七军团斥候。
text.description: 我们的敌人正在变聪明——适应着我们的战略。最近西南边的焚木村遭到了一次攻击。当然，我们的驻军尽数覆没，不过这次进攻特别有意思的地方，是其种族构成。没有人类参与。$B$B<沃登笑了。>$B$B很合理嘛，他们怕被转化成被遗忘者。$B$B让我们给那些非人类尝尝恐惧的味道。我们将携手让他们知道，对于用不着的尸体，我们将会怎么做。
text.completion: I suspect we'll see fewer humans at the Battlefront. The risk for these cowards is too great.
text.completed: Speak with Lord Walden in Silverpine Forest.

english.title: Lessons in Fear
english.objectives: Kill 12 7th Legion Scouts.
english.description: Our enemies are becoming smarter - adapting to our tactics. Recently an attack was made upon Pyrewood Village, southwest of here. Our troops occupying the town were decimated, of course, but what made the attack especially interesting was the racial composition of the attacking force. No humans were used.$B$B<Walden laughs.>$B$BRightfully, they fear being reanimated as Forsaken.$B$BLet us teach the non-humans a lesson in fear. Together we will show them what happens to corpses that we cannot use.
english.completion: I suspect we'll see fewer humans at the Battlefront. The risk for these cowards is too great.
english.completed: Speak with Lord Walden in Silverpine Forest.

text.title: 在星光下
text.objectives: 收集7份悬浮星光。
text.description: 瞧这个，$n。$b$b<哈里森举起已死斥候的护目镜。>$b$b我把中间的夹钳紧了紧，边上的电线也固定好了。戴起来可能不是特别舒服，不过应该不会散架。$b$b如果我对你的石板翻译无误的话，那么这里就应该藏着什么东西——拼图的最后一块。$b$b希望你的眼镜能够找到其关键。$b$b有什么发现就告诉我！
text.progress: So?$b$bFind anything interesting?
text.completion: Well, kid, it looks like you've done it again. This starlight is exactly what we were missing. Now we can get to work!
text.completed: Speak with Harrison Jones in the Chamber of the Stars.

english.title: By the Light of the Stars
english.objectives: Collect 7 Suspended Starlight.
english.description: Look at this, $n.$b$b<Harrison holds up the dead scout's goggles.>$b$bI tightened the clamp in the middle and crimped the wires on the edges. They may not be the most comfortable, but they should hold together.$b$bIf I've translated your tablets correctly, there's something hidden here - a final piece to our puzzle.$b$bI hope your spectacles hold the key.$b$bLet me know what you find!
english.progress: So?$b$bFind anything interesting?
english.completion: Well, kid, it looks like you've done it again. This starlight is exactly what we were missing. Now we can get to work!
english.completed: Speak with Harrison Jones in the Chamber of the Stars.

text.title: 焚木的焚毁
text.objectives: 使用火把点燃焚木城镇大厅、焚木旅店以及焚木礼拜堂。
text.description: 前线的进攻是调虎离山计。把我们的注意吸引在狼人的攻击上，联盟成功地从我们的驻军手中拿下了焚木村。$B$B<高弗雷递给你一束火把。>$B$B必须将其净化掉。$B$B用这些火把，我们要把焚木村烧成平地，只留下灰烬，让敌人无处藏身。$B$B一分钟也不要浪费了。焚木村就在被遗忘者先锋军的西南方。带头出发，$n。
text.completion: The part of me that was Gilnean died at Tempest's Reach. Only vengeance remains, $n. To that end, we have work to do. Spare me your pointless queries.
text.completed: Speak with Lord Godfrey in Silverpine Forest.

english.title: Pyrewood's Fall
english.objectives: Use the Bundle of Torches to torch the Pyrewood Town Hall, Pyrewood Inn and Pyrewood Chapel.
english.description: The attacks against our front are a distraction. With our attention turned towards the worgen onslaught, the Alliance has managed to take Pyrewood Village from our occupying forces.$B$B<Godfrey hands you a bundle of torches.>$B$BIt must be purged.$B$BWith these torches we will burn Pyrewood Village to the ground, leaving only ashes for the enemy to hide behind.$B$BLet us not waste another minute. Pyrewood Village is located southwest of the Forsaken Front. Lead us there, $n.
english.completion: The part of me that was Gilnean died at Tempest's Reach. Only vengeance remains, $n. To that end, we have work to do. Spare me your pointless queries.
english.completed: Speak with Lord Godfrey in Silverpine Forest.

text.title: 男爵夫人的信函
text.objectives: 将男爵夫人的信函交给塔伦纳。
text.description: 这张便笺是安娜丝塔丽男爵夫人写的，上面记载着一个即将发生在病木林中心位置的屠宰房中的仪式——那地方就在塔伦纳的南边。他们很可能把吉德文关在了这里！$b$b必须把这条消息告诉塔伦纳……而且要尽快，不然就来不及了！
text.progress: What?  Did you find something?
text.completion: This is it!  If this missive is to be believed, then he's literally right over this hill! What are we waiting for, $n?
text.completed: Return to Tarenar Sunstrike within the Plaguewood in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: The Baroness' Missive
english.objectives: Bring the Baroness' Missive to Tarenar.
english.description: The note is from Baroness Anastari, and it describes a ritual that is about to happen in the Plaguewood's central slaughterhouse - just south of where Tarenar is at.  This could be where they're holding Gidwin!$b$bTarenar will want to know about this... and quickly, before it's too late!
english.progress: What?  Did you find something?
english.completion: This is it!  If this missive is to be believed, then he's literally right over this hill! What are we waiting for, $n?
english.completed: Return to Tarenar Sunstrike within the Plaguewood in Eastern Plaguelands.
